jobs.title: Senior QC Engineer, CMC / GMP QA
jobs.description:
The Senior Consultant, CMC / GMP Documentation & Quality Control provides long-term, hands-on expert support primarily focused on CMC and GMP documentation review, with additional support for Quality Control (QC) activities related to technology transfer, for an early- to late-stage pharmaceutical development organization.

This role serves as a senior subject matter expert embedded within CMC and Quality teams, supporting sustained development, regulatory readiness, and inspection preparedness through detailed review, quality assessment, and remediation of CMC and GMP documentation. QC support is primarily documentation- and review-focused, with limited hands-on involvement in technical transfer activities as needed. This is a long-term consulting role with no people-management responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities

- Perform detailed quality review of CMC documentation including specifications, batch records, validation documentation, stability protocols and reports, and technical reports

- Review GMP documentation for compliance with FDA, EMA, ICH, and other applicable global regulatory requirements

- Identify documentation gaps, inconsistencies, and compliance risks and recommend corrective actions

- Support QC documentation review activities related to analytical methods, test records, and data packages

- Provide QC documentation and quality review support for technology transfer activities, as needed

- Support investigations related to QC deviations, OOS/OOT results, and documentation discrepancies

- Support inspection readiness by ensuring CMC and GMP documentation is inspection-ready, accurate, and complete

- Assist with responses to regulatory questions, inspection observations, and information requests related to CMC and QC topics

- Review CMC and GMP documentation generated by CDMOs, testing laboratories, and other external partners

- Provide clear, practical documentation feedback to vendors to drive compliance and quality improvements

- Collaborate closely with CMC, QA, Regulatory Affairs, and external partners

Required:

- Bachelor’s degree in Chemistry, Engineering, Life Sciences, or related discipline (advanced degree preferred)

- Minimum of 10 years of experience in pharmaceutical or biotechnology CMC, GMP, or Quality roles

- Strong hands-on experience reviewing CMC and GMP documentation

- Working knowledge of GMP requirements applicable to drug substance and drug product development

- Experience supporting QC documentation, investigations, and data integrity requirements

- Demonstrated ability to identify documentation gaps and drive corrective actions

Preferred:

- Experience supporting early-stage through late-stage development programs

- Experience working with CDMOs and external testing laboratories

- Experience supporting technology transfer documentation or QC readiness activities

- Experience supporting regulatory inspections or agency interactions

- Familiarity with electronic document management systems and QMS platforms

jobs.title: Full-Time Night Shift QMAP – Sunday through Tuesday
jobs.description:
Position Summary

Responsible for meeting the daily personal care needs of the residents in a manner that aligns with the company’s mission and values.  Anticipates, identifies and reports care needs. Supervises medications for residents using established procedures under the supervision of a licensed nurse. Reviews medication administration records (MAR) and administers medications to right resident, right dose, right time, right medication, and right route.

Essential Duties

• Attends to the personal care needs of residents in a timely manner and provides assistance with ADLs as requested by residents or directed by supervisor.
• Provides personal care services to residents such as assistance with bathing, dressing, attendance at meals, laundry, etc. with attention to individual resident needs (i.e., hair is combed, shoes are tied, oral hygiene, etc.)
• Anticipates and identifies any resident care needs and reports to supervisor (i.e., hygiene needs, broken eye glasses, skin rash, lost hearing aids, supply needs, etc.).
• Responds to the needs of family members as appropriate
• Maintains open communication with supervisor and/or peers to promote awareness of resident issues.
• Monitors the safety and well-being of residents
• Reports suspicion of abuse, neglect or misappropriation of resources as required by regulation.
• Reports changes in resident status, health or otherwise, to supervisor.
• Monitors and documents resident’s condition as directed.
• Assists residents with prescribed daily medication routine as appropriate and in accordance with state law.
• Alerts RN/LPN and/or supervisor of any questions or concerns with medication records/supply.
• Ensures that proper documentation occurs timely including any refusal of medication and/or treatment.
• Restocks medication carts, drawers and/or storage areas with miscellaneous supplies only (i.e. gloves, sanitizer cups, etc.)
• Completes work orders to communicate necessary replacements or repairs.
• Attends, participates and contributes to monthly staff meetings addressing resident and departmental needs
• Other duties as assigned.

Basic Qualifications & Experience

• Per the state of operation requirements, Medication certification; QMAP-A/L, Med Tech, Med Aide, Nurse Delegation
• Must be able to read, write and speak the English language.
• High school or Equivalent (GED)
• One (1) year experience in some level of elder care preferred
• Proficient computer skills preferred
• Strong self-management and organization skills
• Strong multi-tasking abilities with the ability to handle competing deadlines, flexible and adaptable (open to change).
• Ability to effectively handle difficult and sensitive issues and maintain confidentiality

Working Conditions / Physical Requirements

• Moderate physical activity required by handling objects up to 50 pounds occasionally and/or up to 20 pounds frequently.
• Constant standing, walking, and grasping. Frequent stooping and reaching above shoulder heights, occasional sitting, crawling, kneeling, and squatting.
• May have exposure to blood borne pathogens, body excretions and communicable diseases possible.
• Possible exposure to household chemicals.
• Sits, stands, bends and moves intermittently during working hours.
• May be subject to frequent interruptions.
• Interacts with clients, family members and visitors frequently.

jobs.title: Manager Analytics and Data Integrity
jobs.description:
We are seeking a results-driven and technically-oriented Manager of Analytics and Data Integrity to lead site analytics web and data quality initiatives within our pharmaceutical operation reporting into Digital Systems organization.  This role is central to ensure that all data used in GxP systems are connected, accurate, secure and in full compliance with AbbVie’s global program and regulatory standards including FDA, EMA and MHRA requirements.

This role bridges the data stream from strategy, governance and analytics. This role will lead and implement a site strategy in compliance with regulatory and AbbVie global expectations, champion key site initiatives, and contribute to the global Data Integrity Center of Excellence. Execute a vision of world class data governance that serves our patients by managing the site’s efforts at driving best practices within the data lifecycle.

Responsibilities:

Data Integrity

• Implement and maintain Data Integrity compliance activities across the end-to-end product lifecycle and various departments in alignment with relevant regulatory regulations and guidelines.
• Implement data governance framework like metadata, ownership and lineage.
• Establish data mapping and monitor data lifecycle – collection, storage, processing and usage. Work closely with data engineers, data scientists, and business units.

Analytics Management

• Collaborate with various functional stakeholders to integrate analytics into everyday activities and decision-making processes.
• Collaborate with functional leads and peer teams to define and create analytical products tailored to specific category needs, including definition of the data domain and standards for data enrichment on enterprise-approved platforms.
• Lead the development of advanced analytical models and tools for use cases, ensuring they effectively meet the needs of functional leads and other teams.
• Oversee development and delivery of dashboards, KPI’s and business insights.

Governance & compliance

• Represent AbbVie Worcester site, Data Integrity subject matter expert during internal and external regulatory inspections related to data integrity.
• Ensure adherence to regulatory standards (e, g FDA, GxP etc.)
• Manage remediation efforts, utilizing risk management-based principles to identify risk and establish appropriate prioritization.

Leadership

• Manage and guide a team of employees, fostering a culture of innovative problem solving and continuous improvement. Build and maintain the team’s capabilities to effectively execute analytics strategy, ensuring team members possess the necessary skills and tools to excel in their roles.
• Train staff on data best practices.
• Establish strong partnerships with category leads to understand and anticipate their analytical needs across business areas – Operations, R&D, Commercial, etc.

• Bachelor’s Degree required, preferably in Physical or Life Sciences, Pharmacy, or Engineering
• 15+ years of combined experience in Manufacturing, QA, Engineering, R&D in pharmaceutical, biologics, device or chemical industry
• Must be familiar with use of electronic document management, Bench Top equipment systems and laboratory information management.
• Must also be familiar with cGMP, Quality Systems, ALCOA+ principles, and other global regulatory requirements of data governance.
• Strong communication skills, both oral and written.
• Expert knowledge of US Code of Federal regulations and the EU regulations
• Subject Matter Expertise on Data Governance principles, computerized systems and compliance activities.
• Excellent communication and influencing skills at all levels of the organization are required to influence diverse, ad hoc teams of SMEs.
• Demonstrated project management skills and ability to lead effective change management.

jobs.title: Sr. Electrical and Electronic Design Engineer - Future Forward
jobs.description:
The Future Forward group within Intuitive Surgical is searching for a Sr. Electrical and Electronic Design Engineer to architect, design, and bring up the electronic hardware behind next-generation robotic and vision systems. This role is an exciting opportunity to join a small and innovative team in the early phases of product development, where design decisions made at the schematic and architecture level shape the performance of the entire system.

Joining Intuitive Surgical means joining a team dedicated to using technology to benefit patients by improving surgical efficacy and decreasing surgical invasiveness, with patient outcomes as our highest priority. The Sr. Electrical and Electronic Design Engineer owns analog, digital, and mixed-signal circuit design from concept through schematic capture, layout direction, prototype bring-up, design verification, and transfer to manufacturing. The ideal candidate designs for electromagnetic compatibility and signal integrity from the first block diagram rather than after the first chamber failure, and can isolate the most difficult board-level and system-level failures on the bench. A strong sense of integrity, care, and attention to detail is required, together with a commitment to developing products of the highest quality.

Roles and Responsibilities:

• Design analog, digital, and mixed-signal circuits from concept through schematic capture, layout direction, prototype bring-up, and transfer to manufacturing.
• Lead schematic and design reviews, and guide PCB layout for signal integrity, power integrity, and manufacturability.
• Design for EMC and EMI from the start through grounding, shielding, filtering, isolation, and ESD protection, and support pre-compliance and compliance testing.
• Bring up and debug prototypes in the lab, and drive hardware issues to root cause and a verified fix.
• Integrate sensors, cameras, illumination, motor drives, and compute platforms in partnership with Mechanical, Firmware, Software, Vision, and Test teams.
• Document designs, verification protocols, and results under Intuitive design controls.
• Mentor engineers and help shape design practices, reference designs, and the technology roadmap for future products.
• Drive external suppliers and design partners for camera, sensor, optics, and PCBA subsystems, setting technical direction and holding builds to schedule and quality targets.

Skills/Job Requirements:

• Minimum 8 years' experience designing production electronics in the medical device, automotive, or robotics industry, including at least one product taken from concept to production.
• Bachelor of Science degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or Computer Science; a Master of Science degree preferred.
• Strong schematic design, review, and debug skills across analog, digital, and mixed-signal circuits, using Altium Designer, Cadence OrCAD/Allegro, or Siemens Xpedition.
• Practical EMC and EMI design and troubleshooting experience, with working knowledge of standards such as IEC 60601-1-2, CISPR 11/32, or the IEC 61000-4 immunity series.
• Solid signal integrity and power integrity fundamentals for high-speed interfaces such as MIPI CSI-2, LVDS, PCIe, USB, DDR, or Ethernet, including impedance control, return paths, crosstalk, and decoupling.
• Direct experience with imaging and vision hardware, motor drive electronics, or precision sensing, and with transferring designs into manufacturing and production test.
• Confident in the lab with oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, near-field probes, and logic or protocol analyzers, working with embedded interfaces such as I2C, SPI, UART, CAN, USB, and Ethernet, and using Python or MATLAB for test automation and data analysis.
• Experience under a regulated quality system such as ISO 13485, FDA 21 CFR Part 820, IEC 60601-1, and ISO 14971, or automotive functional safety such as ISO 26262, is desired; FPGA design experience with VHDL or SystemVerilog is a plus.
• Clear communication, strong documentation habits, and the ability to lead technical decisions, work independently, and mentor others.

jobs.title: Construction Scheduler
jobs.description:
Construction Scheduler (P6 & Commercial Construction Experience)

AECOM Hunt has an immediate need for an experienced Construction Scheduler with expertise in Primavera P6 and a strong background in commercial construction to join our dynamic team.  This individual will work closely with our team in Chicago to develop and maintain detailed schedules, identify potential risks, and drive project success.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop, update, and maintain project schedules using Primavera P6.
• Collaborate with project teams to define scope, milestones, and deliverables.
• Analyze project timelines, identify critical paths, and provide recommendations to mitigate delays.
• Monitor and report on project progress, including schedule variances and resource allocation.
• Conduct regular schedule reviews with project managers and stakeholders to ensure alignment.
• Integrate subcontractor schedules into the master schedule and resolve discrepancies.
• Prepare detailed reports, including Gantt charts, progress updates, and forecasts.
• Support claims analysis and provide documentation for schedule-related disputes, if necessary.

jobs.title: QA Manager, Audit and Inspection Managment
jobs.description:
Position Summary

The Quality Assurance Manager, Audits & Inspections is responsible for the planning, execution, management, and continuous improvement of the company’s GxP audit and regulatory inspection readiness programs supporting late-stage pharmaceutical development.

The role provides hands-on leadership for internal, external, vendor, and study-related audits and establishes a sustainable inspection-readiness program as the organization progresses through Phase 3 clinical development toward regulatory submission, pre-approval inspection, and commercialization readiness.

Working under the direction of the Head of Quality Assurance, the Manager partners with Clinical Operations, CMC, Regulatory Affairs, Pharmacovigilance, Nonclinical, and other functional teams to identify compliance risks, assess inspection readiness, manage audit observations and corrective actions, and ensure the organization and its critical service providers remain prepared for regulatory inspection.

This is a hands-on individual-contributor role requiring demonstrated experience conducting GxP audits and supporting FDA and/or other health-authority inspections.

Key Responsibilities

Audit Program Management

• Develop and maintain a risk-based annual and multi-year GxP audit program covering internal functions, clinical studies, CROs, CDMOs, laboratories, pharmacovigilance providers, and other critical GxP vendors.
• Plan, schedule, conduct, document, and close GxP audits in accordance with approved procedures and applicable regulatory requirements.
• Develop audit plans, agendas, checklists, reports, observations, and follow-up documentation.
• Evaluate audit observations for regulatory significance, systemic risk, and potential impact on product quality, subject protection, data integrity, and regulatory submissions.
• Track audit findings, commitments, CAPAs, and effectiveness activities through closure.
• Perform audit trending and provide periodic reporting of significant findings and emerging compliance risks to QA leadership.

Regulatory Inspection Readiness

• Develop and maintain the company’s inspection-readiness program for FDA and other applicable health authorities.
• Support readiness for BIMO, GCP, GMP, GLP, GVP and, as applicable, Pre-Approval Inspections (PAI).
• Conduct inspection-readiness assessments, mock inspections, document reviews, interview preparation, and functional readiness exercises.
• Identify potential inspection vulnerabilities and coordinate remediation activities with responsible functional owners.
• Maintain inspection-readiness tools, procedures, playbooks, request-management processes, and supporting documentation.
• Support development and maintenance of inspection war-room, document-request, response-review, escalation, and communication processes.

Regulatory Inspection Management

• Support the Head of Quality Assurance in coordinating and managing regulatory inspections.
• Facilitate inspection logistics, document requests, SME preparation, inspection-room activities, and real-time issue escalation.
• Review proposed responses and supporting evidence for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and regulatory defensibility.
• Support evaluation and response to inspection observations, including FDA Form 483 observations and comparable health-authority findings.
• Track post-inspection commitments and associated CAPAs through completion and effectiveness verification.

Vendor and Partner Quality Oversight

• Conduct qualification, routine, for-cause, and risk-based audits of CROs, CDMOs, laboratories, and other GxP service providers.
• Evaluate vendor audit findings in the context of sponsor oversight responsibilities and program risk.
• Partner with functional owners to establish appropriate remediation and escalation plans.
• Support vendor qualification and ongoing performance monitoring based on audit results, quality events, compliance history, and risk.

Compliance Risk & CAPA

• Identify emerging or systemic compliance risks through audit findings, inspection trends, quality events, and other quality intelligence.
• Support or lead root-cause investigations associated with significant audit and inspection findings.
• Review CAPAs for adequacy, proportionality, sustainability, and regulatory defensibility.
• Perform or coordinate CAPA effectiveness verification associated with audit and inspection observations.
• Escalate significant compliance risks promptly to the Head of Quality Assurance.

Cross-Functional Quality Partnership

• Serve as a hands-on QA resource to functional teams preparing for audits and regulatory inspections.
• Provide training and coaching to employees and SMEs regarding inspector interactions, documentation practices, inspection conduct, and response expectations.
• Collaborate with QMS and GxP QA program functions to translate audit and inspection findings into sustainable improvements to the Quality Management System.
• Maintain appropriate independence and objectivity when conducting audits and evaluating compliance.
• Promptly escalate requests requiring significant regulatory interpretation, acceptance of material compliance risk, or final compliance disposition to the Head of Quality Assurance before communicating a final QA position.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, pharmacy, chemistry, engineering, or another relevant discipline.
• Minimum of 7 years of progressive pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or regulated life-sciences Quality Assurance experience.
• Demonstrated hands-on experience planning, conducting, documenting, and closing GxP audits.
• Experience conducting audits of CROs, CDMOs, laboratories, clinical sites, or other regulated service providers.
• Demonstrated experience supporting FDA or other health-authority regulatory inspections.
• Strong working knowledge of applicable FDA regulations, ICH guidance, and GxP requirements.
• Experience with audit observations, investigations, CAPA development, remediation, and effectiveness verification.
• Strong technical writing skills and ability to produce clear, evidence-based audit reports and compliance assessments.
• Ability to independently evaluate complex compliance issues and appropriately escalate significant risks.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience supporting Phase 3 and late-stage pharmaceutical development.
• Experience preparing for or supporting FDA BIMO and/or Pre-Approval Inspections (PAI).
• Cross-functional auditing experience spanning GCP, GMP, GLP, and/or GVP.
• Experience with clinical-stage organizations operating through outsourced CRO/CDMO models.
• Experience developing or implementing formal inspection-readiness programs.
• Lead Auditor certification, ASQ certification, RQAP, or comparable professional credential is desirable but not required.

Key Competencies

The successful candidate should demonstrate strong auditor judgment and independence, exceptional attention to detail, regulatory and compliance acumen, concise technical writing, effective interviewing skills, and the ability to distinguish between isolated procedural deficiencies and systemic compliance risk. The individual must be comfortable challenging conclusions when warranted while maintaining productive working relationships with operational teams.

jobs.title: Structural Applications Engineer II
jobs.description:
ICON is seeking a Structural Applications Engineer II to enable customers, Structural Engineers of Record (SEORs), Design and Construction teams, many encountering ICON's system for the first time, to design and build with our technology confidently. This role uses structural engineering judgment for applied cases the validated product hasn't specifically addressed: new details, connections, anchorages, reinforcement approaches, and installation conditions ICON hasn't previously encountered, documented, or addressed in customer-facing resources. It determines whether a case is a structural engineering question, a gap in how a condition is represented in BuildOS, or a genuine software issue, and owns the first two directly: providing structural recommendations based on established work and teaching customers and partners how to apply them to their own projects, and configuring known-capability structural cases in BuildOS in collaboration with the Design Technologist, Applied Solutions.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Serve as the structural engineering resource for applied cases the validated product hasn't specifically addressed: evaluate feasibility and provide recommendations for new details, connections, anchorages, reinforcement approaches, and attached-element anchor or embed selection, including confirming whether a given approach has been used before, based on engineering judgment and precedent.

• Teach and onboard customers, SEORs, and design and construction teams, particularly those encountering ICON's system for the first time, how to apply structural recommendations to their own projects, building their working capability to design and build with the system confidently; partner with Customer Success on new-customer onboarding as needed.

• Determine whether a structural condition is correctly represented in BuildOS, configuring known-capability cases directly and distinguishing a structural design gap from a software implementation issue; escalate genuine software issues to the Software team, remaining the structural point of contact through resolution.

• Provide structural recommendations for field-surfaced and undocumented installation conditions that fall outside documented precedent, covering adjacent performance implications, with field execution remaining the customer's or contractor's responsibility.

• Convert resolved, previously undocumented structural problems into entries in ICON's internal knowledge base so they are available for future applications, distinguishing reusable applied guidance from cases that reveal a genuine product gap requiring Product Development work; partner with Product Development to produce customer-facing documentation for new products and features, so customers can apply them independently once deployed.

• Manage a caseload of concurrent structural applied requests across active projects and customers, sequencing by urgency and structural risk.

• Track recurring structural application issues across customers and projects and route them to Product Development in a structured, evidence-based format when a pattern suggests a product gap rather than a one-off case.

• Communicate structural findings, recommendations, and constraints clearly to internal stakeholders and external partners, adapting technical detail to the audience.

• Provide technical input and support to ICON's business and partner relationships as needed.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

• 5+ years of related experience in structural engineering, reinforced concrete or precast connection design, or a closely related applied structural field, or equivalent demonstrated experience

• Bachelor's degree in structural/civil engineering, Architectural Engineering or equivalent practical experience

• Demonstrated ability to independently develop or evaluate structural details, connections, anchorages, or reinforcement approaches for conditions without existing precedent

• Demonstrated ability to read and apply structural engineering documentation (drawings, calculations, specifications) to real project conditions

• Demonstrated ability to learn and work within technical software platforms (e.g., BuildOS, Revit, CAD, or similar), even without prior experience on ICON's specific tools

• Demonstrated ability to explain technical or design decisions to clients, contractors, or less experienced team members with varying levels of technical fluency, in a design, construction, or project delivery setting

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• PE license, or PE-eligible

• Direct experience with digital fabrication, robotics, CNC, or additive manufacturing workflows

• Experience with concrete, precast, tilt-up, or another systemized/manufactured building method

• Direct experience working with a Structural Engineer of Record or in a design-build delivery environment

• Familiarity with anchor and post-installed anchor design (e.g., ACI 318 Chapter 17) and building code application for non-standard structural conditions

• Demonstrated experience training, onboarding, or teaching technical users, particularly those unfamiliar with a new tool, platform, or method

jobs.title: Business Immigration Associate – Remote, Mid-Senior Level Associate Yrs (H/L/PERM/E)
jobs.description:
Manifest Law is one of the first AI-native corporate immigration firms in the country, and one of the fastest-growing — proof that attorneys want to practice law this way. Our attorneys handle sophisticated, high-stakes matters, with technology that removes the busywork rather than replacing the lawyer.



Manifest was built to offer the best of both worlds: the scale of a larger firm with the quality client service of a boutique. Manifest OS — the technology that powers the firm — carries the operational weight, so our attorneys spend their time where it actually matters: on strategy, on judgment, on the client in front of them. The result is a practice with the care of a boutique and the capability of a large firm.



We think the practice of law should be a craft, and the attorneys who do it well deserve a practice that grows with them — supported by technology, not replaced by it, with the time and autonomy to build something that's genuinely their own. We're building the kind of institution attorneys are proud to put on their résumé.



This is a firm for attorneys who want more from their career: real ownership of your cases, the kind of client relationships that come from having time with them, a sustainable pace, and a front-row seat in building what a modern immigration practice can look like.



Immigration law has been done the same way for decades. We're here to raise the bar, and we're hiring the people who will raise it with us.






WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own your matters end to end. As a senior member of the client team, you’ll take matters from handoff through final submission with minimal supervision. You’ll build the legal strategy, manage every milestone, and guide clients through one of the most important decisions of their lives.

 - Know your clients deeply. Develop expert-level understanding of your client base, the industries they operate in, and Manifest Law’s practice areas and services, so your advice reflects their business, not just their petition.

 - Solve complex problems creatively. Research technical immigration issues, apply legal precedent to specific client situations, and develop solutions across H-1B, PERM, L-1A/B, TN, E-1/E-2/E-3, O-1A, EB-1C, and EB-2 NIW matters. Clients range from funded startups to large enterprises.

 - Lead strategy on complex cases. Independently execute case preparation and filing, and advise clients directly on petition strategy, RFE responses, and compliance obligations.

 - Assess and advise in a consultative capacity. Use your legal judgment to evaluate which prospects have viable cases, build trust quickly, and set honest, clear expectations from the first conversation.

 - Communicate with clarity. Translate complex issues for audiences ranging from founders and HR teams to in-house counsel. Respond proactively, within team SLAs, in a way that is precise, thoughtful, and organized.

 - Build lasting client relationships. Serve as a trusted advisor to key stakeholders through client meetings, briefings, workshops, Q&A sessions, and proactive case reporting. Manage high-volume employer accounts, HR contacts, and deadlines.

 - Develop the people around you. Mentor, coach, and manage the performance of junior attorneys and team members, directly or indirectly. Partner with your team on document collection and filing logistics so your time stays on strategy and outcomes.

 - Work AI-native. Use Manifest Law’s AI tools and technology as a genuine performance multiplier for case quality and efficiency, not as a shortcut.

 - Uphold our standards. Make sure you and your team follow firm protocols on file maintenance, record keeping, data quality, and risk mitigation, so we stay compliant with regulatory, operational, and client requirements.

 - Drive results and growth. Meet individual and team productivity goals, and spot opportunities to expand the services we provide to clients.

 - Make the work better. Proactively find and implement improvements to the quality, efficiency, and standardization of our processes and services.

 - Help build the firm. Understand the business strategy of your practice area and the firm, and take part in marketing and business development opportunities.

 - Collaborate firmwide. Share knowledge and work closely with colleagues across teams and practice areas.

 - Pitch in where it counts. Take on other responsibilities as the firm grows and evolves.




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - J.D. and active admission to a U.S. state bar.

 - 4+ years of experience at Associate level

 - Exceptional working knowledge of employment-based immigration law across NIV and IV matters. Ideally that includes PERM, H-1B, L-1A/B, and TN, alongside E-3, O-1A, EB-1C, and EB-2 NIW.

 - Prior experience managing or mentoring a team is preferred.

 - Excellent written and verbal skills. You explain complex legal concepts in plain language and make HR contacts and beneficiaries feel supported.

 - A client-first mindset: You’re dedicated to exceptional service and take real ownership of the client experience.

 - Strong attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy. You document thoroughly and hand off cleanly.

 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, especially on complex or ambiguous fact patterns.

 - Comfort with pace: You thrive in a high-cadence environment with real volume expectations, and you manage competing priorities without dropping the details.

 - A team builder: You contribute to a positive, collaborative culture, even in a fully remote setting.




WHY ATTORNEYS JOIN MANIFEST

● Higher-agency work | Intake, document collection, status tracking, and client updates run through Manifest OS — the administrative weight of practice is reduced. Your day goes to strategy, drafting, and the client.

● No billable hour | We charge clients flat fees, so there's no timekeeping requirement and no billable target. Your work is judged on outcomes — what gets filed and how clients experience the relationship — not hours recorded.

● Remote by design | The legal side of the firm works remotely. It's how the firm was built, and there are no plans to change it — practice from wherever you do your best work.

● Real upside | Pay is competitive from day one, strong work is rewarded as the practice grows.

● Ground floor | Manifest is an ambitious firm building the infrastructure to last — and to change the way law firms operate. Attorneys who join now grow with it: into senior roles, into leadership, into shaping what the practice becomes next.

● Your experience shapes the practice | Attorney feedback and firsthand case experience directly inform what the firm builds next, so the technology keeps evolving around how the best lawyers actually work.






READY TO HELP REDEFINE LEGAL WORK?

We're looking for attorneys who lead through expertise, treat Manifest's technology as a genuine performance multiplier rather than a shortcut, and want to do the most meaningful work of their careers.

The attorneys who thrive here are full-time, deeply client-centered, tech-forward, and mission-driven — energized by building something real, not just joining something finished. If that's you, we want to hear from you.



Compensation & Pay Transparency

Manifest is a remote-first firm, and this role is open to candidates in the United States. The good-faith salary range for this position is $165K - $195K USD. This range reflects base compensation and may not include bonus, equity, or other components of total compensation. Actual pay is determined by a range of factors, including but not limited to the candidate's location, experience, education, and skills, as well as the specific scope of the role. Candidates outside of the United States are welcome to apply, and compensation will be assessed according to regional models.




OUR USE OF AI IN RECRUITING

Manifest uses AI-powered tools to support administrative aspects of our recruitment process, such as organizing applications and surfacing candidate information for review. Some interviews may also be recorded and transcribed using an AI note-taking tool, used solely to support accurate note-taking — it does not score, analyze, or evaluate candidates in any way. These tools do not make hiring decisions, and no candidate is advanced, screened out, or otherwise dispositioned without review by a member of our human recruiting team. You are welcome to ask any interviewer for a non-recorded conversation instead. If you would like to request a reasonable accommodation or an alternative application process at any stage, please contact your recruiter.

jobs.title: Senior RF Electrical Engineer (Prism)
jobs.description:
About Northwood:

Northwood is a modern space infrastructure company bringing the benefits of space to the masses through advanced communications technology. We are building a global network of phased array ground stations that enable real-time, reliable communication for satellite missions such as national security, global connectivity, and disaster response. With a vertically integrated approach, Northwood designs, builds, and rapidly deploys scalable systems that power the next generation of space missions. If you like solving complex challenges and seeing your work deployed around the world with real impact, Northwood is the place to do it.



Role:

As a Senior RF Electrical Engineer, you will design and own RF hardware for Prism, Northwood's 2.4-meter parabolic antenna for high-throughput satellite links. You will work across Prism's multi-band RF chain (receive front ends, frequency conversion, filtering, and the transmit line-up that drives Prism's high power amplifiers), taking hardware from architecture through prototype, characterization, and production. You will make system-level RF performance trades and collaborate across hardware, software, and test teams to deliver hardware that performs in the field. 

 

Responsibilities:

 - Design RF electronics hardware for Prism, and iterate on existing Prism hardware to improve reliability, performance, and manufacturability

 - Own RF line-up design for Prism's receive and transmit chains, balancing gain, noise figure, linearity, output power, and blocker/interference tolerance

 - Design and trade RF architectures that support Prism's multiple frequency bands, including band switching, filtering, and shared signal paths

 - Create electromagnetic simulation models of Prism hardware (amplifiers, filters, PCB layout) to design and evaluate performance

 - Build RF circuits for Prism (LNAs, filters, power amplifiers, frequency converters) as well as support circuitry (power, digital control), and characterize their performance

 

Basic Qualifications: 

 - Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or related engineering discipline

 - 5+ years of RF design experience, across circuits, filters, or antennas 

 - Experience taking RF hardware from design through bring-up, characterization, and debug in the lab

 - Comfort with RF test equipment, including network analyzers, spectrum analyzers, signal generators, noise figure analyzers, and power meters

 

Preferred Qualifications:

 - RF line-up design, considering non-linearity, noise, output power, and blocker/jammer tolerance

 - Power amplifier, LNA, and filter design

 - Satellite ground terminal hardware across multiple frequency bands, such as LNBs, block upconverters/downconverters, or tracking receivers

 - Frequency synthesis and LO design, including PLLs and phase noise optimization

 - Filter, diplexer, and multiplexer design, including waveguide and planar implementations

 - Waveguide component and transition design, including waveguide-to-microstrip transitions, OMTs, and feeds

 - Theory and testing related to EVM, Noise Figure, power handling metrics (IIP2, IMD), impedance matching, amplifier stability, and cascaded network analysis

 - Design and bring-up of point-of-load converters and common digital interfaces such as I2C/SPI

 

Additional Requirements:

 - This position requires successfully obtaining and maintaining a Top Secret Security Clearance as a condition of employment. While the clearance may not be immediately necessary upon hire, we encourage you to initiatethe application process promptly upon accepting this offer. Your ability to secure the necessary clearance is essential for fulfilling key responsibilities of the role. Should you be unable to obtain it, Northwood Space reserves the right to modify or terminate your employment to align with operational needs.

 

Compensation:

RF Hardware/Level 3: $140,000-$175,000

RF Hardware/Level 4: $152,000-$190,000

RF Hardware/Level 5: $180,000-$226,000



Additional Information:

If you need a reasonable accommodation as part of your application for employment or interviews with us, please let us know.



To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.



Northwood Space is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with Northwood Space is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.location: San Francisco, NYC, or Fully Remote
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Office Hours is an on-demand marketplace for verified human knowledge. We connect leading organizations with trusted experts who earn income by sharing their knowledge through advisory work, research, and AI model training.

We're a fast-growing, profitable company building new ways for people and AI agents to access human expertise. We are headquartered in San Francisco, with offices in Brooklyn and Bangalore, and backed by leading marketplace investors and operators from companies like DoorDash, Airbnb, Pinterest, and Affirm.




WHAT WE BELIEVE

Human knowledge is the world's most valuable asset. Yet most of it remains inaccessible and underutilized.

We're building a world where anyone can get paid for what they know, and anyone can access trusted human expertise on demand. We believe great products can make this exchange effortless, creating more opportunities for experts and more valuable answers for the people who need them.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Product Manager with exceptional entrepreneurial drive, strong product judgment, and commercial instincts. We're open to candidates at both the Product Manager and Senior Product Manager levels, and care more about demonstrated ability, impact, and potential than years of experience or previous titles.

You'll help Office Hours discover, build, and bring new products to market. Initially, you'll focus on expanding how organizations access and use expert knowledge, exploring new customer needs, developing new product experiences, and turning promising opportunities into successful, growing businesses.

This is a hands-on, externally facing role for someone who loves building things from scratch. You'll work directly with prospective customers to uncover problems, pitch ideas, validate demand, and win early adopters. You'll partner closely with engineering, design, sales, and operations to turn those insights into products that customers love and are willing to pay for.

We're looking for someone ambitious, resourceful, and highly self-directed. Someone who sees an opportunity, takes ownership, and has the drive and discipline to make it happen.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Discover new opportunities. Work directly with customers and prospects to understand their needs, uncover unmet demand, and identify opportunities for new products and businesses.

 - Build products from zero to one. Turn ambiguous opportunities into compelling product concepts, rapidly prototype solutions, and work with engineering and design to bring them to market.

 - Win early customers. Pitch new ideas, recruit design partners, run pilots, and work directly with customers to validate demand and drive early adoption and revenue.

 - Find product-market fit. Develop hypotheses, test assumptions, gather feedback, and iterate quickly to discover what customers truly value and are willing to pay for.

 - Drive commercialization. Partner with Sales, Marketing, and Operations on positioning, pricing, packaging, and go-to-market strategies that help products gain traction.

 - Own outcomes, not output. Define clear success metrics, measure adoption and commercial performance, and use what you learn to determine where to invest, iterate, or change direction.

 - Drive execution end to end. Bring structure to ambiguous initiatives, coordinate cross-functional teams, communicate clearly, and maintain momentum from initial exploration through launch and growth.




WHAT YOU BRING

 - 3+ years of relevant professional experience in product management, entrepreneurship, consulting, engineering, business operations, or a related field. We care more about demonstrated ability and impact than a specific career path.

 - An entrepreneurial mindset. You're ambitious, self-motivated, and energized by building something from nothing. You take initiative, create momentum, and don't need someone telling you what to do next.

 - Strong commercial instincts. You enjoy talking to customers, understanding their businesses, pitching ideas, and finding opportunities to create and capture value.

 - Exceptional product judgment. You can identify meaningful customer problems, develop creative solutions, and translate ambiguous ideas into simple, compelling product experiences.

 - A bias toward action. You're resourceful, scrappy, and comfortable moving quickly with incomplete information. You'd rather test an idea in the real world than endlessly debate it.

 - Strong analytical and organizational skills. You approach problems with structure and rigor, pay attention to details, and can manage complex initiatives without losing sight of what matters.

 - Clear communication and collaboration. You can explain complex ideas simply, build relationships with customers and colleagues, and bring people together to achieve ambitious outcomes.




BONUS EXPERIENCE

 - Experience launching new products, finding product-market fit, or building new businesses at an early-stage startup.

 - Experience with B2B software, developer platforms, APIs, AI products, or two-sided marketplaces.

 - Experience in customer development, enterprise sales, or partnerships.

 - Background in management consulting, investment banking, or another analytically rigorous environment, combined with a strong builder's mindset.

 - Experience building products, prototypes, or side projects using AI-assisted development tools.




BENEFITS + PERKS

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Medical, dental, and vision coverage

 - 401(k)

 - Monthly wellness and fitness stipend

 - Flexible vacation time and company holidays

 - Annual company offsites

 - Flexible remote work policy

 - Paid parental leave




PAY TRANSPARENCY NOTICE

Full-time offers include base salary, equity, and benefits.

The expected base salary range for this role is $160,000–$220,000, depending on relevant experience, skills, and scope.

We're open to hiring at either the Product Manager or Senior Product Manager level and will calibrate title and compensation accordingly.

Job Title: NETA Level 4 Certified Senior Technician

Company: Loenbro, LLC
Business Unit/Department: Inspection Services
Location: Hybrid; open to remote
Reports to: VP of Inspection
Employment Type: Full-Time
FLSA Classification: Exempt

About Loenbro

Loenbro is a trusted, long-term construction lifecycle partner to thousands of customers across the U.S. Our market spans all industries, and our service offerings include Critical Electrical, Mechanical & Structural, Soft Crafts, Inspection, Underground Maintenance and Installation, and Fabrication. Our expertise lies in simplifying the complex and establishing long-standing relationships with our partners. We have a national presence but a local approach—every customer benefits from our capabilities and our care.

At Loenbro, we don’t just offer jobs—we build careers grounded in integrity, teamwork, excellence, and purpose. Join a team where your expertise is valued, your growth is supported, and your work helps maintain and enhance the critical infrastructure that powers communities across the nation.

Job Summary

As an InterNational Electrical Testing Association (NETA) Level 4 Certified Senior Technician within Loenbro's Critical Electrical team, you're responsible for independently performing and taking full technical ownership of the most complex electrical acceptance and maintenance testing projects. This individual acts as the on-site technical authority, guiding project execution, upholding NETA and safety standards, and mentoring less experienced technicians.

You’re a highly visible, client-facing team member that sits at the intersection of advanced technical testing, field leadership, and quality assurance. You’re the person clients and project teams rely on to deliver accurate, high-integrity results on the most demanding electrical power systems, and the person responsible for ensuring Loenbro's testing work is completed safely, correctly, and to the highest professional standard.

Role and Responsibilities

Electrical Testing & Commissioning

• Perform and take full technical responsibility for acceptance and maintenance testing of low-, medium-, and high-voltage electrical equipment in accordance with the American National Standards Institute (ANSI)/NETA Automatic Transfer Switch/Maintenance Testing Specifications (ATS/MTS) standards.

• protective relays, cables, motors, and motor control centers.

• Independently diagnose complex electrical system issues and recommend corrective actions, repairs, or further testing.

• Interpret drawings, schematics, one-line diagrams, and specifications to plan and execute testing scopes.

• Perform relay calibration, power metering, and infrared thermography as needed.

Field Leadership & Mentorship

• Act as the senior technician and project lead on assigned job sites, overseeing scope execution, schedule, and quality of work.

• Guide, mentor, train, and supervise Level 1, 2, and 3 technicians and trainees in proper testing procedures and safety practices.

• Serve as the primary technical point of contact for clients, engineers, and project managers regarding testing results and recommendations.

• Always represent Loenbro professionally when interacting with clients and site personnel.

Safety, Compliance & Reporting

• Ensure strict compliance with NETA, National Fire Protection (NFPA) 70E, National Electric Code (NEC), and Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) electrical safety standards on every job.

• Review and approve test data, calculations, and field reports for accuracy and completeness prior to client submission.

• Identify and communicate any deviations from expected results, safety hazards, or scope changes to project leadership.

• Maintain, calibrate, and troubleshoot test equipment; ensure proper use and care of company tools and instruments.

• Assist in developing test procedures, job hazard analyses (JHAs), and method statements for complex or first-of-a-kind projects.

• Complete required documentation, timesheets, and reports accurately and on schedule.

Skills

• Demonstrated experience leading and supervising testing crews on complex, high-voltage projects.

• Strong working knowledge of NETA ATS/MTS, NFPA 70E, NEC, and OSHA electrical safety standards.

• Proven ability to read and interpret electrical drawings, one-line diagrams, and specifications.

• Proficiency with standard electrical test equipment such as megohmmeters, Transfer Turns Ratio (TTR) sets, relay test sets, hi-pot testers, Doble equipment, etc.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including report writing.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook).

Qualifications

Required:

• 8+ years of progressive experience in electrical testing, commissioning, or a related electrical field.

• Current active NETA Level 4 Certification.

• Employment eligibility with a NETA Accredited Company (Loenbro will support certification maintenance)

• Valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record.

Preferred:

• Associate's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Electrical Technology, or a related field, or equivalent military/technical school training.

• Additional certifications such as NFPA 70E Qualified Electrical Worker or OSHA 30.

• Experience in data centers, power generation, oil & gas, mining, or heavy industrial environments.

• Experience working in a large, geographically distributed organization.

Physical Demands and Work Environment

The physical demands and work environment described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

This role requires compliance with all applicable safety regulations, personal protective equipment (PPE) requirements, and Loenbro's Environmental Health and Safety (EH&S) policies.

Benefits

Loenbro offers a competitive salary, comprehensive benefits package, and rewards to those who join our team:

• Medical, dental, and vision insurance

• 401(k) retirement plan with company match

• Paid time off (PTO)

• Life and disability insurance

• Professional development and training opportunities

• Employee assistance program (EAP)

Benefits eligibility may vary based on employment classification and hours worked.

Guided by Core Values (LEAD), grounded in grit and a commitment to excellence, Loenbro betters our families, customers, and local communities.  If you’re ready to be part of a company that LEADS by:

• Living with Integrity

• Exceeding Expectations

• Acting with Urgency

• Delivering Excellence

…we want to hear from you.

Loenbro is an Equal Opportunity Employer

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer (AI Automation)
jobs.description:
BUILD A SAFER WORLD.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

As a Senior AI Engineer, you will be the embedded AI automation engineer for Product, building the agents, automations, and apps that help product managers, product marketers, and designers move faster. You work directly with them, and with engineering, across the product lifecycle from early discovery through launch and adoption. You sit inside the teams, not behind a ticket queue.

The impact you will have:

 - Move repetitive, manual work into agents and automations so Product, Product Marketing, and Design spend their time on judgment and customer work, not busywork.

 - Give teams direct access to customer insight and the data behind it through the tools you build, so they make better-informed decisions.

 - Ship agentic solutions teams actually adopt, so the same headcount operates at a scale it otherwise could not.

 - Build reusable, maintained components so each new build is faster than the last and no one rebuilds what already exists.

 - Turn a rough idea into a working prototype in hours and ship same-day production fixes to shared agents, driving faster speed to market across Product and Marketing.

What we’re looking for:

 - Strong software engineering in Python or TypeScript. You ship production code, not just workflows wired together.

 - Very high AI fluency. You build with AI every day and build agentic solutions on current frontier models, including MCP, retrieval, evals, and observability. Show us something you built.

 - Experience taking requirements from non-engineers and finding the need behind the ask.

 - Judgment about where AI adds value and where it does not.

 - Experience building solutions that non-technical teams adopted and kept using.

 - Daily use of AI-assisted coding tools such as Claude Code or Cursor.

 - Senior scope: you own problems end to end, need little direction, and are comfortable with ambiguity.

About the Team:

 - AI Automation Engineering is the engineering home for internal tooling and agents, embedded with Product, Product Marketing, and Design.

 - You stay connected to engineering for standards, code review, and shared infrastructure, so what you build holds up in production and compounds across teams.

 - The work is high-ownership and ambiguous by design. You set your own priorities and own problems end to end.

 - Globally distributed, fully remote, and async-first.

Team Operating Rhythms:

 - Roughly a 6 hour overlap with 8:00am to 5:00pm PST.

 - Embedded side by side with the teams you serve, with a connection back to the AI Automation team and engineering.

 - Async-first communication through Slack and written documentation. Distributed, not distant.

 - No travel, no onsite, and no on-call.

Required online and collaboration hours:

 - Schedule: Roughly a 6 hour overlap with 8:00am to 5:00pm CT.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

 - A rough idea becomes a working prototype in hours, so the team reacts to something real instead of a description.

 - You ship an improvement to a shared agent or app to production the same day a user reports a problem.

 - Within the first 90 days, a team relies on something you built as part of their weekly work.




APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.




INTERVIEWING WITH TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

 - Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

 - Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

 - First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

 - Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

 - References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

 - Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

 - Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.




AI FLUENCY AT TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

 - Accelerate repeatable workflows

 - Structure and solve problems

 - Improve output quality

 - Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.




LIFE AT TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

 - Priorities and targets to change quickly

 - Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

 - A high level of personal ownership and accountability

 - Close collaboration across teams and functions

 - Frequent, high-touch communication

 - Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

 - A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute. 




LEADERSHIP PRINCIPLES

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

 - Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

 - Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

 - Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.





JOIN OUR MISSION

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore. 





PRIVACY POLICY AND ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy https://www.trmlabs.com/policies/privacy-policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@trmlabs.com.

To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSc6e8jRCl2cQwgIzXLpIGQXtwvMQh__TcokvO2toAAkT44A6Q/viewform?usp=dialog. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates. 

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSevmAzPxWOYm_7kMHb9lEJlX3tpdBeHvvvNWjsI_6xhUfnXjw/viewform?usp=dialog.




RECRUITMENT AGENCIES

TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement.

jobs.title: Principal Partner Solutions Architect
jobs.location: Remote, New York, United States, AMER
jobs.description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Principal Partner Solutions Architect (GSI) to be Fivetran + dbt Labs' global technical advisor to our priority Global Systems Integrators (GSIs) — comfortable operating at executive level, leading the conversation, and directing execution of the joint business plan by combining technical depth with business insight. You are the ecosystem peer to the GSI's lead architects and delivery leads. You will own the technical capability, overarching solution architecture, and multi-year bets of the GSI partnership you support.

This role partners closely with the global alliance leads for these GSIs to articulate the true total value of each technical solution and execute impactful engagements across regions and countries. Functionally, the role sits at the intersection of field engineering, product management, and partnerships. Your closest counterparts are the GSI's practice and delivery leadership, the regional Partner Solutions Architects and Partnerships teams who run the day-to-day motion, and product managers across both Fivetran and dbt Labs. Operating at the Principal level, you will report directly to the Global Head of Partner Solutions Architecture.

This is a full-time position based in the US.

What You’ll Do

• Build a trusted advisory relationship with priority GSIs and engage with their senior technical stakeholders and practice leads to secure multi-year technology bets with Fivetran and dbt Labs.

• Own the joint technical narrative and capability messaging for the combined Fivetran + dbt Labs platform as it applies to this GSI's delivery practice — reference architectures, integration patterns, and the joint value story their consultants use with mutual customers.

• Provide domain expertise around modern data platforms and enterprise technology, and effectively promote Fivetran + dbt Labs with partners, at conferences, and online.

• Make recommendations on integration strategies, partner-side enterprise architectures, platforms, and application infrastructure required to successfully implement complete solutions for complex GSI mega-agreements.

• Maintain a single, current view of integration state, gaps, and opportunities across the combined platform (ingestion, transformation, semantic layer, catalog/metadata, agent and MCP interfaces) as it affects this GSI's delivery methodology, and collaborate with Product to drive the right outcomes.

• Co-develop intellectual property with GSI partners — enterprise-grade, replicable joint solutions and accelerators built with product management and technical teams — and evangelize that IP with partners, customers, and the field to drive adoption.

• Run the standing technical cadence with the GSI's practice and delivery leadership as their primary technical counterpart.

• Drive and influence GSI audiences, identify expansion engagements within partner accounts, and ensure accelerated agreement velocity with zero partner-delivery escalations on GSI-led mega-agreements.

• Partner with the regional Partner Solutions Architects and Partnerships organization so the global GSI relationship turns into regional execution, and so they can run the motion without you in the room.

• Travel to partner and customer sites, conferences, and other related events as needed.

Skills We’re Looking For

• Direct experience with technology and/or systems integrator alliances, or having sat on the delivery/practice side of a GSI or similar consulting organization — with a track record of shaping and scalingtechnical partner GTM.

• 10+ years of experience as an enterprise/solutions architect or in an equivalent customer- and partner-facing role.

• Fluency across the modern data stack (ingestion, transformation, orchestration, warehouses/lakehouses, semantic layers, catalogs, BI, and the agent/MCP layer) and the ability to explain how the pieces fit for a systems integrator's delivery practice.

• A demonstrable understanding of how GSIs operate, build, deploy and monetise Intellectual Property with technology partners.

• Experience engaging with, and presenting to, senior technical stakeholders and executive leaders, with the business acumen to translate technical solutions into partner and customer value.

• Experience with modern AI paradigms, generative AI, and data technologies, including experience evaluating and reviewing technical solutions.

• Ability to drive and influence GSI audiences, identify expansion engagements within partner accounts, and ensure accelerated agreement velocity with zero partner-delivery escalations on GSI-led mega-agreements.

• Ability to deliver results and work cross-functionally to position and orchestrate joint solutions spanning multiple products

Bonus Skills​

• Verticalized knowledge of data and analytics technology solutions, with the ability to learn and work with new and emerging tools, methodologies, and platforms.

• Experience with structured enterprise architecture practices, hybrid deployments, and on-premise-to-cloud migration roadmaps.

• Ability to influence product roadmap: gathering requirements from a partner, building a prioritization case, and getting it accepted by product leadership.

• Hands-on experience with dbt and with Fivetran.

Compensation & Benefits
The compensation range displayed on this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire compensation for the target position and level, and may include sales incentives or target bonuses depending on the role. For this role, on-target earnings (OTE) are split 70% base salary and 30% variable compensation. Our compensation ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Our job titles may span more than one career level. Within the range, individual compensation is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, relevant education or training, business need, market demands. The compensation range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. Your recruiter can share more about the specific compensation range for your location during the hiring process.

$239,446.04—$332,562.90 USD

Perks and Benefits

• 100% employer-paid medical insurance*

• Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off.

• Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents.

*May vary by country and worker type - please reach out to your recruiter for more information
