jobs.title: Presales Customer Engineer
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Location: Sydney, Australia

What you will do as a Customer Engineer

The Customer Engineer (CE) is the core driver of our technical go-to-market strategy: a trusted technical advisor and primary architect of the customer journey. You will bridge the gap between technical strategy and business value—guiding enterprise clients from initial pre-sales technical validation through onboarding, deployment architecture, and full lifecycle expansion. Sitting within the GTM organization and reporting to a Customer Engineering Leader, you will not hand off your customers once an initial agreement is reached. Instead, you will operate as a quota-carrying technologist, leveraging AI-augmented workflows to eliminate administrative toil so you can focus on high-value architectural design and driving measurable business outcomes across the entire customer journey.

Key Responsibilities

• Technical Validation: Partner closely with Account Executives to lead technical deep-dive discovery, capture business requirements, and map complex customer infrastructure - DNS, CDN, Zero Trust, Network Security, Workers - to fit-for-purpose Cloudflare architectures and bespoke solutions. . Define, scope, success criteria, and technical evaluations plans for Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and Technical Validations. Deliver tailored technical presentations, architectural diagrams, and demonstrations that show how Cloudflare solves specific performance, security, and reliability challenges. Proactively address complex technical objections, security compliance questions, and edge-case architectural requirements during the sales cycle. Take accountability for a suitable solution deployment strategy (Customer, Partner or Cloudflare Professional services) being an integral part of all proposals.

• Customer Adoption & Value Realization: Provide oversight to technical onboarding and implementation, but not execute the implementation, serving as the primary executive and engineering contact for the customer. Design structured migration and onboarding blueprints tailored to the customer’s environment (e.g. DNS migrations, Zero Trust rollouts, WAF tuning guidance), and act as the lead consultant for customer engineering teams, walking them step-by-step through configuration best practices. Partner with Account Executives to own discovery, demos, onboarding, technical health, risk, and expansion strategy. Proactively monitor customer health scores and telemetry to ensure rapid time-to-value, resolve integration bottlenecks, and reduce deployment risk.

• Commercial Accountability & Expansion: Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. Be commercially accountable for ensuring deep platform adoption, retaining revenue, and identifying strategic cross-sell and up-sell opportunities based on product usage data. Lead technical Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to translate platform capabilities into return on investment for C-level executives.

• Trusted Advisory: Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion. Provide thought partnership on architecture, AI control layers, security posture, and deployment confidence. Identify potential deployment risks or integration bottlenecks early, and provide remediation strategies to de-risk customer outcomes.

• AI Orchestration & Workflow Automation: Leverage AI agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), and internal platforms to automate routine tasks such as RFP/Security Questionnaire responses, sandbox provisioning, basic telemetry monitoring, and internal/external documentation, reclaiming your time for strategic customer advisory.

• Education & Enablement: Partner closely with the Enablement Team to design, build, and govern technical resources. Define, document, and educate both internal teams and customers on deliverables such as Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), architectural best practices, and technical guides to continuously raise the technical baseline across the organization.

Minimum Qualifications

• Experience: Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, Professional Services, Sales Engineering, Technical Account Management, or as a Forward Deployed Engineer (years of experience required will vary based on Associate, Senior, Staff, or Principal leveling).

• Architectural Mindset: Ability to white-board, design, and articulate complex enterprise network and security architectures clearly.

• Consultative & Advisory Skills: Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate deeply technical concepts into business outcomes for both hands-on engineers and C-level executives.

• Commercial Mindset: Proven track record of operating in a quota-carrying or revenue-aligned environment, with a strong understanding of SaaS metrics, business value translation, and enterprise sales cycles.

• Communication: Exceptional presentation and stakeholder management skills, capable of bridging the gap between deep technical implementation details and high-level C-suite business strategy.

• Technical Breadth: We do not expect every candidate to be an expert in every domain. Qualified candidates will demonstrate depth in at least four of the technical areas below:

• Internet fundamentals: Deep understanding of how the Internet works, including OSI Model layers 1–7, BGP, GRE, TCP/UDP, DNS (authoritative and recursive), HTTP(S), and SSL/TLS.

• Security: Expertise in the security of Internet properties, including WAF, Bot Management, Firewalls, Rate Limiting, (M)TLS, Zero Trust, and SASE concepts.

• Performance: Expertise in the performance of Internet properties, including speed, latency, caching, video streaming, HTTP/2, and TLS 1.3.

• AI Proficiency: Familiarity with prompt engineering, AI-assisted scripting and log analysis, LLM utilization, and workflow automation to augment everyday CE workflows.

• Coding/Scripting: Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, Bash, Lua, Go, or similar languages to write custom integration scripts, API connectors, and edge computing functions.

• Developer Platform Fluency: Experience designing, building, deploying or scaling applications using RESTful/GraphQL APIs, SDKs, webhooks, and developer tooling in cloud-native environments. Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi), CI/CD pipelines, and observability for developer-led deployments.

Strongly Preferred Qualifications (The "Good-to-Haves")

• Technical Enablement: Track record of creating and delivering technical enablement - workshops, code samples, documentation, or developer onboarding - that accelerates customer adoption of complex platforms.

• Applied AI Knowledge: Experience with LLM orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, and model-access controls.

• Regulatory Knowledge: Understanding of regulatory requirements such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, and SOC 2.

• Hyperscaler / Digital Native Background: Talent coming out of hyperscalers, digital natives, distributed systems environments, or startups is strongly valued for its deeper cloud fluency and advanced architecture depth.

Education

Undergraduate or graduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

Travel

This role may require travel up to 20–50% to attend customer meetings, conferences, industry events, and in-person team collaboration.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.

Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Homeowner and Partner Experiences
jobs.description:
About the Job

As the Engineering Manager for Homeowner and Partner Experiences at Splitero, you will lead the team responsible for the systems our homeowners and partners interact with, from marketing through origination, in a fintech and proptech ecosystem. You will report to our Director of Engineering and manage a team of full-stack engineers, including a technical lead who partners with you on day-to-day technical decisions. You will work closely with product, QA, our Salesforce team, and our offshore engineering team.

In this role, you'll split your time roughly 70/30 between hands-on engineering and people management. Your hands-on focus leans toward the foundation: cloud infrastructure, AWS CDK, security, and observability, making sure our systems are scalable, maintainable, and ready for where the business is going, not just where it is today. We're actively shaping what AI-first engineering looks like for this team, and this role will have a direct hand in defining it. You'll help us find the right balance between what LLMs do well and the quality, review, and maintainability standards a regulated fintech business requires. We care about what ships, and we care nearly as much about the systems that produce it.

• Own the architecture and evolution of our AWS infrastructure using AWS CDK, making sure our systems scale well beyond today's business needs.

• Drive security, observability, and reliability across our systems, including logging, monitoring, alerting, and incident response practices.

• Optimize AWS services for performance, cost, and scalability, including serverless applications built on AWS Lambda.

• Help define and roll out AI-first engineering practices for the team: the tooling, context, conventions, guardrails, and review processes that let engineers build with AI tools reliably and at scale.

• Build internal tools and workflows that reduce manual engineering effort and help the team get consistent, high-quality output from AI-assisted development.

• Contribute to product development across our homeowner and partner experiences using Node.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and a modern React ecosystem (Next.js, Tailwind, Vercel).

• Partner with your technical lead to guide technical decisions, making sure tradeoffs are well understood and documented across product and engineering.

• Improve engineering lifecycle standards across the team, including code review, testing, deployment, documentation, and knowledge sharing.

• Manage and develop a team of full-stack engineers through regular 1:1s, feedback, goal setting, and performance management.

• Partner with product leads to plan work, set priorities, and deliver on a consistent and predictable pace.

• Partner with the Salesforce team on the data sync between Salesforce and our consumer applications to support GTM initiatives.

• Coordinate with our offshore engineering team and its technical lead to keep handoffs clean and work aligned with our standards.

• Partner with Engineering Leadership and People Operations to hire, onboard, and grow the engineering team.

The salary range for this position is $160,000 - $180,000. Within the range, individual pay is determined by job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

About You

• 8+ years of experience as a full-stack or platform engineer with a strong focus on back-end and cloud infrastructure

• 3+ years managing engineers directly while remaining hands-on

• Deep experience with AWS, including production infrastructure built and maintained with AWS CDK

• Strong background in cloud security, observability, and building systems that scale and stay maintainable over time

• Strong proficiency in TypeScript and Node.js, with experience in PostgreSQL and database design

• Working experience with a modern React ecosystem (Next.js, Tailwind, Vercel)

• Demonstrated experience leading AI-first engineering practices on a team, not just using AI tools individually. You know where LLMs speed up the work, where they need guardrails, and how to keep quality high as output increases.

• Experience building internal tooling, automation, or developer workflows that help teams work more effectively with AI

• Strong technical judgment, with the ability to zoom in or out on projects and make decisions to keep work moving

• A track record of giving direct feedback and supporting engineers in their growth and performance

• Clear communication with product, QA, and non-technical stakeholders

• Experience working with offshore or distributed teams across time zones is a plus

• Experience with Salesforce platforms or integrations is a plus

• Candidates must be located in the United States. Working timezone in PST or MST preferred.

• Desire to participate in fast-paced early-stage startup

• Adaptability: Embraces changing circumstances with resiliency and positivity

• Team-Oriented: Prioritizes collaboration, inclusivity, and teammate support

About Us

Millions of homeowners in today’s economy are sitting on substantial home equity they are unable to access due to rising interest rates and strict qualification requirements of traditional lenders. That means millions of homeowners can’t convert their hard-earned equity into cash to pay off debt, start a home renovation, or pad their retirement to better their lives.

Splitero co-founders Michael Gifford and David Zvaifler witnessed the problem firsthand throughout their real estate careers. They set out to create a win-win product that could help those homeowners access their home equity but not make monthly payments like traditional financing options. And thus, Splitero was born.

As part of our team, you will join our quest to revolutionize the real estate industry while helping families in need. We offer a suite of benefits designed to help you thrive in all areas of life.

• OneTeam Culture - We foster a culture of transparency, innovation, and inclusivity, where every voice is heard and every team member is valued. We believe in celebrating our successes, doing the right thing, and helping each other so we grow as a team and as individuals.

• Generous Resources - We want to ensure you are set up to do your best work. In addition to a solid tech stack, and access to any WeWork location, you will receive a monthly cell and internet stipend.

• Premium Healthcare - We offer comprehensive healthcare plans for you and your family, which employees are eligible for on their first day.

• Flexible PTO and Parental Leave - We offer a generous PTO and encourage employees to take time off to recharge. We're proud to offer a parental leave policy that allows you to welcome your new addition without worry.

We are a workforce composed of individuals with diverse backgrounds, abilities, minds, and identities. In keeping with our commitment to inclusion, we will ensure that people with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodations are required when applying, interviewing, or performing the essential functions of this position, please contact People Operations, at peopleops@splitero.com.

We're the world's leading consumer healthcare platform, supporting millions of patients across the US, Australia, the UK, Germany, Japan, Spain and Canada.

We're driven by the belief that good health should last a lifetime, and that to get there we need to deliver the personalised, high quality and empathetic care that the traditional system cannot support.

You'll partner with our care teams of prescribers, nurses, health coaches, pharmacists and dietitians to support patients across preventative health, weight management and specific women's and men's health conditions.

We joined Hims & Hers so that you can do all of the above on a bigger scale, with more ambition, a stronger global brand and the resources to deliver care to patients in dozens of countries.

We're looking for people who appreciate and are excited by the enormity and uniqueness of this challenge, and want to work in the most ambitious, smart, fast moving and positive sum environment of their lives to transform how healthcare is delivered globally.

We hope that's you.

About you (Who you are)

• At least 5-8 years of experience in a similar role at other startups or software companies under your belt.

• A problem solver at heart. You’re able to work in a fluid and fast paced environment where you may not always have all the information you need

• Ability to ideate on our products. Engineering is able to influence the product direction so we’re building the right things in the right way

• Capable of engaging in considered and productive discourse with others on a regular basis, especially during technical scoping

• Adaptable, sometimes requirements change and we need to be able to move with them

• Several years in a similar role at other startups, scale-ups or software companies under your belt, using elements of our tech stack.

• A Fullstack Software Engineer, capable and willing to contribute to both frontend and backend code bases. Ideally a specialist in one

• You own what you ship and have been involved in the full product lifecycle. You have experience leading projects, from discovery, design, architecture and system design, all the way through to work breakdown, implementation and monitoring.

• Have excellent written and verbal communication skills

Why you should join Engineering at Euc

• We’re on a quest to build a robust, scalable, configurable, multi-brand platform (that’s also enjoyable to work on!) on which we can solve the world’s biggest healthcare challenges, and you can be a pivotal player in that journey.

• We have a high performance culture We have a high bar for talent, so you’ll get to learn from some of the best engineers in the industry We write as many low quality memes as we do high quality PRs We optimise for velocity and deploy to production hundreds of times a month. Once you merge your code, it’s in prod in minutes

• You’ll get to work with a modern tech stack that we’re always improving. If something isn’t working for us, we’ll iterate until we get it right and everyone on the team is encouraged to help refine it. Frontend: React, React Native + Expo, TypeScript, Apollo, Tailwind Backend: Node (TypeScript) and Go microservices, Federated GraphQL, gRPC, Protobufs, Pub/Sub and Postgres, hosted on GCP Kubernetes Engine (GKE)

• You’ll work on interesting engineering challenges: Euc has a large appetite for product development, so we have a roadmap of innovative, greenfield features to work on We've been running microservices smoothly in production for a few years, but there is still a lot of complex business logic in our legacy mono-repo to understand, break down, improve and port across. We strive for efficiency and invest heavily in internal tooling to improve developer experience

• We’ll invest in your growth, development and career When we introduced Go microservices we invested in upskilling the whole team in a new language No matter which direction you want to take your career, we’ll provide opportunities for you Every engineer has a yearly Learning and Development budget that they can use for courses, books, conferences, anything to help you learn.

Why join Eucalyptus?

Euc is also behind a growing family of digital healthcare clinics (Pilot, Kin, Software, Compound) across men’s health and well-being, fertility, skincare, and preventative health.

Here’s what makes joining Euc unique:

• What’s next - Our goal for the next three years is to support 1 million patients globally to live better for longer. We’re launching into new conditions, demographics, and geographies as we build a truly preventive healthcare ecosystem.

• Build something world-changing - We’re on the path to becoming the world’s largest international digital healthcare company. It will be challenging, fast-paced, and deeply rewarding.

• Make real impact - You will deliver work that directly shapes patient outcomes and scales evidence-based care across markets.

• Accelerate your growth - You will have high ownership, continuous feedback, and dedicated development support.

• Join a motivated team - You will collaborate with talented peers to solve complex clinical and operational problems at scale.

What’s ahead in Australia?

• Grow with us globally - Get mentorship from leaders across Australia, the UK, Germany, and Japan, collaborate with teams in the Philippines and South Africa, and explore new markets or travel internationally. Recognised on Hatch’s Hotlist as one of Australia’s top employers, we support early-career professionals to become future global leaders.

• Shape your career - Access learning budgets, conferences, certifications, peer shadowing, and a global knowledge-sharing culture.

• Be an owner - Equity for everyone means you share in our success.

• Work where well-being matters - Experience catered wellness talks, exercise classes, free barista coffees, funded social clubs, and quarterly rooftop parties.

• Innovate with purpose - Use state-of-the-art tools and contribute to bold, impactful solutions in healthcare.

• Support at every stage - Benefit from parental and miscarriage leave, to health, professional development, and personal days, and our Employee Assistance Program.

At Eucalyptus, we value individuals from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we embrace the unique qualities each person brings. When you apply, please let us know of any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process. These tools support our team — all hiring decisions are made by real people, and every application is reviewed by a member of our recruitment team.

jobs.description:
Each year, Perplexity hires an exceptional cohort of early career talent to join our technical team. We’re looking for a University Recruiter to architect our early career programs and shape our strategy for attracting and evaluating the world’s most elite early-career talent.



This is a full-stack role where you’ll be responsible for all aspects of campus lifecycle recruiting: building relationships with external organizations, driving partnerships with internal stakeholders, and running full-cycle recruiting for all candidates. You’ll enjoy incredible latitude to design our programs and candidate experiences end-to-end, along with high-taste playbooks for how we bring the best and brightest to Perplexity.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own full-cycle recruiting process for all early career candidates from sourcing to closing.

 - Partner closely with leaders at Perplexity on workforce planning, hiring strategy, and candidate evaluation.

 - Build and scale a strategy that goes far beyond the usual playbooks. Explore creative, unconventional ways to build a talent brand and foster relationships that help uncover hidden superstar talent.

 - Plan and execute campus programming including but not limited to technical talks, coding competitions and hackathons, on-campus interviews, and VIP events.


WHAT YOU BRING

 - 4+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience owning university, campus, intern or early-career hiring.

 - Strong organizational mindset–this role is high volume and pressure, juggling multiple workstreams and candidates that you’ll have to manage.

 - Willingness to travel up to 25%, concentrated during fall and spring recruiting seasons.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Existing relationships with top CS, ML and engineering programs, research labs or competitive programming communities (ICPC, USACO, etc.).

jobs.title: Senior IT Support Specialist
jobs.description:
Hermeus is a venture-backed defense aviation company reclaiming the lost art of rapid iterative prototyping to build the fastest aircraft in the world today. By prioritizing relentless hardware iteration, we deliver high-speed systems at the pace of the modern battlefield. We work with the Department of War to provide the high-speed capabilities our nation and its allies need to maintain a durable, asymmetric advantage.


About The Role:
As a Senior IT Support Specialist, you will be a senior individual contributor and the hands-on technical anchor for daily IT operations. You will resolve the issues no one else can, mentor junior staff, and own the technical layer beneath the service desk: endpoint management, identity, and endpoint security. We are looking for someone who does not just close tickets but eliminates the work behind them, automating manual processes with PowerShell, replacing one-off fixes with repeatable procedures, and maturing how IT operates as we scale. You will partner closely with our Cyber, Networking, and People teams on work that crosses team boundaries. 
This role reports to the IT Service Desk Manager and is based on site at our Los Angeles office. Two shifts are available, 7:00am to 4:00pm or 9:00am to 6:00pm, with flexibility based on team coverage. Travel to other Hermeus sites runs roughly one to two trips per quarter to support projects and operations.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Business Operations & NPI
jobs.description:
SambaNova is a leader in next-generation AI infrastructure, delivering a full-stack inference platform for customers worldwide. At the core of SambaNova's technology is the RDU (Reconfigurable Dataflow Unit) — a chip built on a dataflow architecture rather than the traditional GPU model. Its decode performance is especially strong for agentic workloads like multi-turn agents, code generation, and long-running applications. RDUs are packaged into SambaRack, rack-scale hardware that lets customers deploy state-of-the-art models with better performance, greater energy efficiency, and faster time to value.

The era of pervasive AI has arrived.  SambaNova builds the chips, systems, and cloud services that make high-performance AI inference practical at scale.  Our fifth-generation Reconfigurable Dataflow Unit (RDU), the SN50, is purpose-built for agentic AI and fast token generation, and our SambaRack systems are designed to run in the air-cooled data centers customers already have.  We work with NeoClouds, AI labs, sovereign AI providers, service providers, and enterprises that want faster tokens at a lower total cost of ownership.

SambaNova is growing quickly, and we are expanding our partner and ecosystem work to keep pace.  We are looking for people who want to help shape what comes next.

About the Role

SambaNova is looking for a Senior Director of Business Operations and New Product Introduction (NPI) to help bring SambaNova's silicon and systems to market through a growing ecosystem of partners.  You will work directly with the Chief Corporate Development Officer, and you will have a visible, company-level impact from your first week.

We are at the forefront of heterogeneous disaggregated inference (HDI), where GPUs and SambaNova RDUs each do what they do best.  Interest from OEMs, ODMs, NeoClouds, hyperscalers, and sovereign customers is growing quickly, and we want every partner to have a clear, consistent experience working with us.  Many of our engagements today are tailored to the partner.  You will help turn what we learn from them into a repeatable playbook: a clear path from first conversation to signed agreement, from prototype to volume shipment, and from first order to lifecycle support.  That playbook will make SambaNova easier to work with and become a differentiating moat for the company.

This is a rare opportunity to shape how SambaNova works with its partners at a pivotal moment.  You will begin by listening to colleagues across the company to understand what is working, where the gaps are, and what each team needs to succeed.  From there, you will collaborate with those teams to fill the gaps, connect the pieces, and amplify the work already underway, and you will help create new opportunities across a range of partner and business models.  Your technical depth will let you translate what customers and partners need into clear priorities for SambaNova, and your judgment will help the company act on them with confidence.

Responsibilities

Build the NPI framework and playbook

• Define and drive SambaNova's end-to-end NPI flow for partner and OEM engagements, covering partner engagement and agreements, architecture and reference design, development and validation (EVT/DVT/PVT), manufacturing readiness, customer proof of concept, workload validation, acceptance, mass production, and lifecycle support

• Set gate criteria, owners, templates, and checklists for each phase, and make them simple enough that teams actually use them

• Convert one-off deals into repeatable playbooks by business model and partner type, and keep improving them as we learn

• Define the metrics, dashboards, and executive reporting that show where every engagement stands

Lead technical project execution across engagements

• Run the plan, milestones, dependencies, risks, and action items for a growing number of concurrent OEM and partner engagements

• Work across silicon, hardware, rack and thermal, firmware, software, supply chain, QA, sales, support, marketing, finance, and legal to get the right people and decisions in place at the right time

• Help the team interpret customer and partner requirements, including architecture, BOM, power and cooling, form factor, test, and qualification, and translate them into clear SambaNova actions and trade-off decisions

• Understand and track architecture decisions alongside engineering leaders, and highlight early when a decision is blocking progress

Help drive the commercial lifecycle

• Partner with the CCDO, CFO, and Legal to shape customer and partner agreements, including deliverables, roles and responsibilities, milestones, audit functions, and support obligations

• Track every engagement from NDA, MOU, LOI, and MSA through orders, forecasting, pricing, delivery, QA support, returns, and revenue recognition

• Bring structure to supply and commercial terms such as NCNR commitments, MOQs, forecast commitments, lead times, and allocation

Develop the ecosystem and the go-to-market

• Work with sales, product, and marketing on sales enablement, reference architectures, co-sell motions, training, and joint launches with partners

• Define software, firmware, and technical support models for partners and their customers

• Help establish QA, RMA, failure analysis, and returns processes that match what partners expect from a silicon supplier

Base Salary Range:

Base Pay Range

$230,000—$280,000 USD

Submission Guidelines
Please note that in order to be considered an applicant for any position at SambaNova Systems, you must submit an application form for each position for which you believe you are qualified.

EEO Policy
SambaNova Systems is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard basis of age (40 and over), color, disability, gender identity, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, national origin/ancestry, race, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding), sexual orientation, and any other applicable status protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Benefits Summary for US-Based, Full-Time Employment Positions
SambaNova offers a competitive total rewards package, including the base salary, plus equity and benefits. We cover 95% premium coverage for employee medical insurance, and 77% premium coverage for dependents and offer a Health Savings Account (HSA) with employer contribution. We also offer Dental, Vision, Short/Long term Disability, Basic Life, Voluntary Life, and AD&D insurance plans in addition to Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options like Health Care, Limited Purpose, and Dependent Care. Our library of well-being benefits available to you and your dependents includes a full subscription to Headspace, Gympass+ membership with access to physical gyms, One Medical membership, counseling services with an Employee Assistance Program, and much more.

jobs.title: Principal Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Join a team where your impact reaches beyond the stars! At Terran Orbital, you’re not just part of the system – you’re a vital force propelling our mission forward. As trailblazers in satellite manufacturing and aerospace innovation, we shatter boundaries daily to deliver groundbreaking solutions that power our nation’s defense and commercial missions. We are a unique, fast growing, and trusted team dedicated to swiftly and efficiently designing, building, launching, and operating state of the art satellites for advanced mission constellations. If you’re driven by purpose, inspired by challenges, and ready to leave your mark on the universe, you’ll find a home and endless opportunities for growth here. Together, let’s redefine what is possible in orbit and beyond!

Terran Orbital is seeking an experienced Principal Embedded Software Engineer  to join our dynamic team. Reporting to the Embedded Software & FPGA Manager, the Principal Embedded Software Engineer will lead the architecture, development, and integration of embedded software across multiple satellite programs, ensuring robust, reliable, and high‑performance mission solutions.

Key Duties and Responsibilities

• Develop and maintain embedded software and support hardware bring‑up on satellite modules.

• Architect, design, develop, and maintain embedded software (Linux, RTOS, bare metal) for satellite systems.

• Collaborate with cross‑functional engineering teams to define and refine software requirements.

• Serve as the technical lead for multiple satellite programs.

• Create and maintain unit tests using Test‑Driven Development methodologies.

• Develop and automate system‑level tests.

• Build software for specialized payloads, including imagers, image processors, communication devices, and astronomical science instruments.

• Integrate and test software in simulation, flight‑replica, flight‑vehicle, and hardware‑in‑the‑loop environments.

• Lead and mentor junior software engineers, providing technical guidance and task direction.

• Represent Terran Orbital in technical working groups and customer interactions.

• Support the security of embedded systems.

• Support occasional travel (up to 10%) to customer or vendor sites for design reviews and collaborative technical work.

Required Qualifications and Skills

• Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field; a Master’s degree is preferred.

• 12+ years of experience developing C/C++ applications for embedded, high‑performance, or mission‑critical systems.

• Experience with bare‑metal and/or RTOS‑based designs (FreeRTOS, internal schedulers, etc.).

• Deep understanding of microcontroller architectures, peripheral subsystems, and low‑level interface design across multiple MCU families.

• Experience with electronic test equipment and embedded debug tools (oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, hardware debuggers, etc.).

• Experience with serial communication protocols (CAN, RS‑232/422/485, I2C, SPI, PCI).

• Highly motivated, self‑starting, responsible, thorough, and able to perform duties autonomously.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• U.S. Citizenship with ability to obtain and maintain DoD security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications and Skills

• Experience with ARM and Texas Instruments embedded platforms.

• Experience with oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, and other test equipment.

• Experience with Linux and GNU tools such as Make, GCC, and GDB.

• Experience with scripting languages such as Bash and Python.

• Familiarity with build pipelines, deployment processes, and on‑target testing.

• Familiarity with SOLID software design principles.

Your actual level and base salary will be determined case-by-case and may vary based on the job-related qualification, knowledge, skills, education, and experience. In addition to base salary, we offer 100% covered medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) match, Flexible Time Off (FTO), covered life insurance, maternity and paternity leave, tuition reimbursement, employee referrals, and lots of swag!

Salary Range

$175,000—$230,000 USD

Full-time positions only:

Benefits

• 100% Company-paid comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents

• 401(k) Match

• Flexible Time Off (FTO)

• Education Reimbursement

• Competitive Paid Parental Leave

About Terran Orbital

Terran Orbital is a leading manufacturer of satellite products primarily serving the aerospace and defense industries. Terran Orbital provides end-to-end satellite solutions by combining satellite design, production, launch planning, mission operations, and on-orbit support to meet the needs of the most demanding military, civil, and commercial customers. Learn more at www.terranorbital.com

Physical Demands

An employee must meet the physical demands described to perform the essential functions of this job successfully. In performing the duties of this job, the employee is routinely required to sit or stand for long durations of time, in addition to bending, reaching, and walking. This would require the ability to lift or move objects up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift or move objects up to 25 pounds. This position is generally sedentary, with substantial computer usage.

Work Environment

The job operates in a professional office environment but in a manufacturing company. This job routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, and scanners.

Disclaimers

To comply with U.S. Government space technology export regulations, the applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. In addition, please note that this position may require a current United States National Security clearance or eligibility for such a clearance.

Terran Orbital is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. We consider applicants without regard to race, color, religion, age, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or membership in any other group protected by federal, state, or local law.

If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at hr@terranorbital.com.

Terran Orbital does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters, employment agencies, or staffing firms. To conduct business with Terran Orbital, a Master Services Agreement (MSA) must be executed and confirmed prior to submitting any information relating to a potential candidate. Without a signed MSA, Terran Orbital shall not be responsible to any individual or entity for any payment relating to any form of fee or compensation.

And, in the event that a resume or candidate is submitted by a recruiter, an employment agency, or a staffing firm without a fully executed MSA, Terran Orbital has the unrestricted right to pursue and hire any of those candidate(s) without any legal or financial responsibility to the recruiter, agency, and/or firm.

jobs.title: PCBA Reliability Engineer
jobs.description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

Hardware Engineering is an innovative and collaborative group of electrical, mechanical, reliability, software and vehicle engineers. We design, build, and perfect the products which are the eyes and ears of Waymo's autonomous driving technology, and integrate those products into vehicle platforms. We're seeking curious and talented teammates to keep us moving in the right direction.

You will:

• Act as the primary Subject Matter Expert on PCB and PCBA quality and reliability across all Waymo Compute and Sensor modules.

• Collaborate with external laboratories and suppliers to secure necessary test chamber and validation resources. Lead test vehicle layout and design for Waymo semi-custom components; establish comprehensive test plans and secure internal or third-party lab resources for execution.

• Oversee manufacturing quality issues across PCB/PCBA suppliers, leading corrective and preventive action (CAPA) initiatives.

• Perform root cause investigations and execute corrective/preventive actions for failures identified during reliability testing of custom components or PCBAs.

• Evaluate DFMEAs to pinpoint high-risk elements, defining risk mitigation strategies through early design modifications or targeted follow-on testing.

• Lead and support systemic process enhancements across both internal and external quality and reliability management systems.

You have:

• Master's degree in Electrical, Computer, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field with at least 10 years of relevant professional experience.

• Strong foundation in reliability systems, including system reliability concepts, failure distributions, and accelerated life modeling.

• In-depth expertise in failure mechanisms associated with electronic packaging, components, printed circuit boards (PCBs), and PCB assemblies (PCBAs).

• Hands-on SMT and PCB manufacturing process expertise, quality control systems, and failure analysis methods (e.g., cross-sectioning, dye and pull).

• Proficiency with industry IPC standards governing PCBs, PCBAs, and electronic components, as well as the ability to interpret electrical schematics and PCB layout files.

• Working knowledge of silicon-level failure mechanisms, thermal and cooling solutions, finite element modeling, and effective cross-functional collaboration.

We prefer:

• Experience with APQP/PPAP processes, ideally within the automotive sector.

• Proficiency in PCB layout and test fixture design.

• Strong electrical debugging skills, along with a thorough understanding of electrical schematics.

Travel requirements:

• 10% travel as needed

The expected base salary range for this full-time position across US locations is listed below. Actual starting pay will be based on job-related factors, including exact work location, experience, relevant training and education, and skill level. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for the role location or, if the role can be performed remote, the specific salary range for your preferred location, during the hiring process.

Waymo employees are also eligible to participate in Waymo’s discretionary annual bonus program, equity incentive plan, and generous Company benefits program, subject to eligibility requirements.

Salary Range

$177,000—$218,000 USD

jobs.title: Ambassador Partnerships Manager
jobs.description:
We're the world's leading consumer healthcare platform, supporting millions of patients across the US, Australia, the UK, Germany, Japan, Spain and Canada.

We're driven by the belief that good health should last a lifetime, and that to get there we need to deliver the personalised, high quality and empathetic care that the traditional system cannot support.

You'll partner with our care teams of prescribers, nurses, health coaches, pharmacists and dietitians to support patients across preventative health, weight management and specific women's and men's health conditions.

We joined Hims & Hers so that you can do all of the above on a bigger scale, with more ambition, a stronger global brand and the resources to deliver care to patients in dozens of countries.

We're looking for people who appreciate and are excited by the enormity and uniqueness of this challenge, and want to work in the most ambitious, smart, fast moving and positive sum environment of their lives to transform how healthcare is delivered globally.

We hope that's you.

About the role (What you'll be doing)

You will build and scale Juniper's ambassador program, taking the success we've had with partnerships like Liesel Jones and turning it into a repeatable, scalable engine. Reporting to the Head of Editorial, your mission is to identify, recruit, and nurture authentic partnerships with ambassadors who can deliver reach, credibility, trust, and relatability for our brand—while building an aspirational brand that women genuinely want to engage with.

You aren't here to chase follower counts or manage transactional influencer deals. Your role is to build a strategic ambassador ecosystem that creates genuine connections with our audience and produces high-performing content that works both organically and in paid media. Every ambassador you bring on should elevate our brand, making women think, "I want to be part of what they're part of."

At Juniper, we believe authenticity drives performance. Your success is defined by your ability to find the right voices, build meaningful relationships, and create a content engine that scales our message while maintaining the trust and empathy our category demands.

We'll also expect you to:

• Scale What's Working: Take the learnings from successful partnerships like Liesel Jones and codify them into a repeatable playbook. Identify what made those partnerships work—authenticity, content quality, audience fit—and replicate it across a broader roster.

• Build the Ambassador Strategy & Infrastructure: Develop the frameworks for identifying, vetting, onboarding, and activating partners who authentically align with our mission to be the most supportive partner in women's health. Create processes that allow us to manage multiple ambassadors simultaneously without losing quality.

• Recruit & Manage a Diverse Ambassador Roster: Source ambassadors across different platforms, audience sizes, and demographics. Balance macro reach with micro relatability. Build relationships that go beyond one-off posts to create ongoing, authentic partnerships.

• Drive Multi-Platform Content Creation: Brief ambassadors to create content that performs organically on their channels while also being optimised for use in our paid media. Ensure content feels native to each platform—Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, podcasts—while maintaining Juniper's brand integrity and aspirational positioning.

• Optimise for Dual Use: Work closely with the Performance and Creative teams to ensure ambassador content can seamlessly transition from organic posts to high-performing ads. You'll need to understand what makes content work in both contexts and brief accordingly.

• Measure Impact & Scale What Works: Track performance across reach, engagement, credibility metrics, and paid media ROI. Use data to refine the ambassador mix and double down on what's driving real business outcomes.

• Manage Partnerships & Agreements: Work with ambassadors to structure partnerships that work for everyone—clear on deliverables, usage, and expectations while building fair, long-term relationships that feel collaborative rather than purely commercial.

• Champion Authenticity & Trust: Ensure every partnership feels genuine. In women's health, trust is everything—your ambassadors need to believe in what they're promoting, and audiences need to believe them.

• Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Work with Creative, Performance, Social, and PR teams to integrate ambassador content into broader campaigns and ensure alignment with brand strategy.

About you (Who you are)

• Experienced Partnership Builder: Strong experience in influencer marketing, ambassador programs, talent management, or creator partnerships. You've built programs from scratch or scaled them significantly.

• Brand-Builder at Heart: You understand the power of association. You know how to select ambassadors who don't just drive reach, but elevate brand perception and make people aspire to be part of the community.

• Relationship-Driven: You know how to identify authentic voices and build genuine, long-term partnerships. You're not just transactional—you invest in relationships that deliver mutual value.

• Platform-Native: You understand the nuances of Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and emerging platforms. You know what content works organically versus what performs in ads, and how to brief for both.

• Performance-Minded: You can balance brand-building with performance. You understand metrics like CPM, engagement rate, conversion attribution, and can use data to optimise the program.

• Commercially Thoughtful: You're comfortable managing partnership agreements and budgets, ensuring mutual value while maintaining positive, collaborative relationships.

• Systems Thinker: You can take what works in one partnership and turn it into a scalable process. You've built playbooks, onboarding workflows, and measurement frameworks before.

• Empathetic & Culturally Aware: You understand that Juniper operates in a sensitive category. You can identify ambassadors who will handle women's health topics with care, authenticity, and relatability.

• Scrappy & Entrepreneurial: You thrive in building something new. You're comfortable with ambiguity, can move fast, and don't need a playbook handed to you—though you're great at creating them for others.

• Collaborative: You work well cross-functionally and can translate ambassador opportunities into actionable briefs for Creative, Performance, Social, and PR teams.

• Passionate About the Mission: You genuinely care about women's health and can identify ambassadors who share that passion and can communicate it authentically.

Why join Eucalyptus?

Euc is also behind a growing family of digital healthcare clinics (Pilot, Kin, Software, Compound) across men’s health and well-being, fertility, skincare, and preventative health.

Here’s what makes joining Euc unique:

• What’s next - Our goal for the next three years is to support 1 million patients globally to live better for longer. We’re launching into new conditions, demographics, and geographies as we build a truly preventive healthcare ecosystem.

• Build something world-changing - We’re on the path to becoming the world’s largest international digital healthcare company. It will be challenging, fast-paced, and deeply rewarding.

• Make real impact - You will deliver work that directly shapes patient outcomes and scales evidence-based care across markets.

• Accelerate your growth - You will have high ownership, continuous feedback, and dedicated development support.

• Join a motivated team - You will collaborate with talented peers to solve complex clinical and operational problems at scale.

What’s ahead in Australia?

• Grow with us globally - Get mentorship from leaders across Australia, the UK, Germany, and Japan, collaborate with teams in the Philippines and South Africa, and explore new markets or travel internationally. ****Recognised on Hatch’s Hotlist as one of Australia’s top employers, we support early-career professionals to become future global leaders.

• Shape your career - Access learning budgets, conferences, certifications, peer shadowing, and a global knowledge-sharing culture.

• Work where well-being matters - Experience catered wellness talks, exercise classes, free barista coffees, funded social clubs, and quarterly rooftop parties.

• Innovate with purpose - Use state-of-the-art tools and contribute to bold, impactful solutions in healthcare.

• Support at every stage - Benefit from parental and miscarriage leave, health, professional development, and personal days, and our Employee Assistance Program.

At Eucalyptus, we value individuals from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we embrace the unique qualities each person brings. When you apply, please let us know of any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process. We use AI-assisted tools across our business to help our teams work more efficiently, including within our recruitment process. These tools support our team — all hiring decisions are made by real people, and every application is reviewed by a member of our recruitment team.

jobs.title: Summer Camp Director, Shoreline - North City (2027)
jobs.location: Shoreline - North City, WA, United States
jobs.description:
Galileo is looking for an experienced leader to join our team as a Camp Director. Camp Directors lead our dynamic summer camps for K–8th grade, serving as both site General Manager and the public face of the organization.

You will open and operate a Camp Galileo location serving campers and their families within your community! You will lead a dynamic seasonal team of educators as well as enthusiastic entry-level staff to create joyful, safe environments and ensure smooth daily operations. With a focus on exceptional camper and family experiences, you will uphold program quality, foster creativity, and deliver excellence in customer care, curriculum, and team leadership.

Why This Role Matters

Galileo started in 2002 with a single summer camp in Palo Alto, named for Galileo Galilei, one of history’s great innovators. Today we run 90+ sites across eight states, and Camp Directors are still the people who give each camp its own traditions and magic. Our mission is to develop innovators who envision and create a better world, and at camp, you’re the one who makes that real for campers, families, and staff every day.

You will be Accountable for

Bringing Galileo’s Spirit to Life

• Infuse camp with joy, tradition, and creativity

• Build an inclusive environment where every camper, staff member, and family feels seen, supported, and inspired

Leading with Ownership and Vision

• Own every aspect of your camp’s launch, from preseason planning through end-of-summer wrap-up

• As both operational lead and culture builder, oversee every detail from daily camp operations to parent communication while delivering an exceptional program

Keeping Camp Safe and Running Smoothly

• Prioritize camper safety, family trust, and program fidelity at all times

• Anticipate needs, adapt quickly, and problem-solve on the fly so camp runs seamlessly, even when things don’t go as planned

Developing and Managing Your Team

• Train and mentor a staff of 7 to 40 (depending on site size), including educators and entry-level staff, while actively building your team culture

Perks:
