jobs.title: Experienced Engineering Manager, Payments
jobs.description:
We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

Plaid Payments is building the infrastructure that makes paying from a bank account as simple and as trusted as paying with a card — at better economics for everyone involved. We verify that an account is real and safe to debit, we score the risk of Billions in transactions a month against more than a thousand signals drawn from the Plaid network, and we move billions of dollars a month across ACH, RTP, and FedNow. Our customers range from the largest billers in the country to fintechs moving money in real time. We are in the middle of a shift from selling payment primitives that customers assemble themselves to selling payment decisions: a turnkey verification engine, guaranteed payments where Plaid takes on the risk, and fully managed payment flows. That shift is what takes bank payments from a cheaper alternative to a better one.

You'll lead Plaid's Payments engineering organization—three teams covering account verification, payment risk, and money movement—partnering with our Product Area Lead to co-own the strategy and execution of one of Plaid's largest and fastest-growing businesses. You'll manage three engineering managers, own the engineering hiring bar, and set technical direction across a platform where reliability and correctness carry real financial weight. You'll decide where to invest in foundations versus ship product. You'll work closely with data science on the ML models behind our risk products, with operations and compliance on regulated money movement, and with go-to-market on key deals and customer relationships. This is a role for someone who wants the whole problem: the systems, the people, and the business.

 

Responsibilities:

 - Set engineering strategy for Payments in partnership with the Product Area Lead, balancing product delivery against foundational investment across three teams.

 - Manage three engineering managers — coach them, calibrate performance, and build the management bench.

 - Own technical direction for the payments platform: verification infrastructure, the Signal risk platform and its ML and data pipelines, money movement rails, and customer-facing APIs and dashboards.

 - Hold the reliability bar for systems where failures move money incorrectly.

 - Drive recruiting and hiring across the org; set the bar and own pipeline health.

 - Drive overall strategy of the product area together with Product leadership.

 - Partner cross-functionally with product, data science, PMM, GTM, payment operations, compliance, and customers.

Qualifications:

 - 10+ years of software engineering experience and 4+ years in engineering management, including 1+ years managing managers.

 - Experience leading an engineering organization of 20+ through an EM layer.

 - Experience owning transactional, high-reliability systems where correctness and availability have direct financial consequences.

 - Track record of building technical foundations that created compounding returns.

 - Experience working cross-functionally with product, data, operations, and business teams as a true partner.

 - Nice to have: bank payments experience (ACH, RTP, FedNow, or card rails), experience shipping ML-powered risk or fraud products, and experience leading AI transformation in an engineering org.

Our mission at Plaid is to unlock financial freedom for everyone. To support that mission, we seek to build a diverse team of driven individuals who care deeply about making the financial ecosystem more equitable. We recognize that strong qualifications can come from both prior work experiences and lived experiences. We encourage you to apply to a role even if your experience doesn't fully match the job description. We are always looking for team members that will bring something unique to Plaid!



Plaid is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and values diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, ethnicity, religion or religious belief, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, military or veteran status, disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, GRC Platform
jobs.description:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 



As Vanta expands upmarket, we have a unique opportunity to redefine how security and compliance programs are operated, while giving customers the flexibility to run their programs their way, especially in an AI-powered world. GRC Platform is a new team at the center of this effort, building the foundational capabilities that enable mid-market and enterprise customers to operate their GRC programs efficiently and at scale with Vanta.



As the Senior Product Manager for GRC Platform, you will own core platform capabilities and primitives that customers rely on every day and that power critical GRC workflows—such as search, imports, exports, custom fields, and approval workflows. You will evolve these capabilities into more intelligent, agentic experiences that are increasingly flexible, automated, and adaptive, helping customers save time, reduce cognitive load, and focus on higher-value work.



What you’ll do as a Senior Product Manager, GRC Platform at Vanta:

 - Own the GRC Platform strategy and roadmap, delivering platform primitives and customer facing features leveraged across Vanta’s GRC product

 - Distill complex problems and opportunities into clearly prioritized product goals, focus for your team, and high-quality execution in collaboration with stakeholders across the company.

 - Partner closely with teams across GRC to develop a deep understanding of customer needs, identify opportunities for platform leverage, and translate those insights into intuitive, agentic experiences that solve critical user needs.

 - Drive AI-first product redesigns, including defining model evaluation criteria and managing the transition from legacy experiences to agent-led workflows.

 - Help define and shape Vanta’s product team culture as we grow



How to be successful in this role:

 - 5+ years of product management experience, with at least 2 years in a platform or horizontal product role at a B2B SaaS company

 - Platform product thinking — demonstrated track record of building shared primitives or capabilities adopted by multiple product and engineering teams

 - Cross-functional leadership — ability to influence and align multiple squads without direct authority, and to drive clarity across complex stakeholder sets

 - Technical depth — comfort with backend-heavy infrastructure, architectural trade-offs, API standards, and data model decisions

 - AI product experience — ability to drive AI-first product redesigns and define model evaluation criteria for experiences like imports, search, or structured agent workflows

 - Metrics and data orientation — ability to define and track adoption rates, quality signals, and business impact for platform investments

 - Experience working with enterprise customer segments (10K+ employees) and translating their feedback into platform-level priorities

 - Have a learner's mindset, a genuine passion for building AI products, and the grit to experiment, iterate, and fail

 - Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.



What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

 - Industry-competitive salary and equity

 - Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans

 - 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents

 - Health & wellness stipend

 - Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend

 - Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office

 - Family planning benefits

 - Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting

 - Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time

 - 11 company-paid holidays

 - Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

 - Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney
   
   

To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base pay ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar-stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors and may vary based on candidate location, skills, depth of work experience, and relevant licenses/credentials.  



#LI-remote



At Vanta, we are committed to hiring diverse talent of different backgrounds and as such, it is important to us to provide an inclusive work environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply.



About Vanta

We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged. 

Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent.

jobs.title: Vice President, Market Access (Hybrid/Remote)
jobs.description:
About Ceribell

Ceribell is a medical technology company focused on transforming the diagnosis and management of patients with serious neurological conditions. The Ceribell System is a novel, point-of-care electroencephalography (“EEG”) platform specifically designed to address the unmet needs of patients in the acute care setting, and is being used in hundreds of community hospitals, large academic facilities and major IDN's across the country. Our entire team is driven by a shared commitment to transforming the landscape of critical care through our rapid seizure detection technology, come join the movement!

The Vice President of Market Access will own Ceribell’s reimbursement, payer, and health policy strategy to accelerate adoption of our neuro-diagnostic solutions. As a member of the commercial leadership team, this leader is accountable for the coverage, payment, and policy outcomes that enable growth, and serves as the company’s senior authority on reimbursement and health policy.

This role builds and leads the Market Access organization, including strategy, policy, evidence, health economic tooling, and field reimbursement. The VP partners with the CEO, CFO, Chief Revenue Officer, and other executive leaders to ensure the value of Ceribell’s technology is clearly understood by payers, policymakers, and health system leaders.

What you'll achieve

Lead the Market Access organization

• Build, lead, and develop a team spanning HEOR, payer and policy strategy, and health economic tools.

• Own headcount planning, budget, and vendor and consultant strategy

• Set functional goals, MBOs, and operating cadence

Own payment and access strategy and external relationships

• Own the multi-year payment and access roadmap for Ceribell’s portfolio, including POC EEG and emerging neuromonitoring technologies

• Lead strategy for new and existing payment pathways, including MS-DRG and add-on payment mechanisms, and pursue coding and coverage pathways (e.g., CPT/HCPCS, payer medical policy) where they support adoption

• Anticipate and mitigate payment risk, not only pursue upside

• Identify and resolve barriers across payment, hospital workflows, and provider economics in ED, ICU, and inpatient settings

• Cultivate senior relationships with MAC medical directors, national and regional commercial payers, Medicaid plans, IDNs, CMS staff, and health system CFOs

• Oversee payer and health system education initiatives that highlight Ceribell’s clinical evidence, economic value, and outcomes impact

• Represent Ceribell as a thought leader at industry, payer, and policy forums

Drive federal policy and regulatory strategy

• Own CMS rulemaking strategy (IPPS, OPPS, PFS, NTAP, and TCET pathways), including comment letters and public testimony

• Engage CMS, Congress, and policymakers on Breakthrough Device payment policy

• Manage relationships with trade associations, coalitions, specialty societies (e.g., AdvaMed, neurology and critical care societies), and outside counsel and consultants

Set evidence and health economic strategy

• Set the evidence generation strategy and prioritize investment across HEOR, real-world evidence, and publications to support payer, hospital, and policy goals

• Co-own the evidence plan with the CMO and Medical Affairs

• Oversee budget impact models and cost-effectiveness analyses that clearly articulate Ceribell’s clinical and financial impact

Lead health economic tooling

• Own the strategy, development, and governance of health economic tools, including economic impact calculators, budget impact models, and program cost comparisons for payers, hospitals, and health systems

• Ensure tools are built on validated, defensible assumptions and are tailored to different hospital types and care settings

• Equip sales leadership and field teams with these tools, along with the training and guidance to use them effectively with hospital C-suite and finance buyers

• Keep tools current as payment policy and evidence evolve

Partner with Commercial

• Set the standard for how economic and reimbursement value is communicated to payers and health system leaders Support strategic IDN and health system engagements where access and economics intersect Quantify and report the impact of access wins and risks to the executive team and Board Other responsibilities as assigned by your Manager/Supervisor

What We're Looking For:

• Bachelor’s degree in health policy, business, science, public health, or a related field; MBA, MPH, MHA, or JD preferred

• 15+ years of experience in the medical device, diagnostics, or digital health industry, with 8+ years directly in market access, reimbursement, HEOR, or health policy

• 5+ years leading and developing teams, including managers or directors, ideally including a field-based reimbursement or customer reimbursement support team

• Led a successful payment pathway end to end (e.g., NTAP, MS-DRG assignment, new CPT code, or national coverage), ideally for a novel or Breakthrough-designated technology

• Deep expertise in U.S. reimbursement, particularly inpatient: DRG payment, CMS policy and rule making, NTAP/TCET, commercial payer processes, and medical policy development; working knowledge of CPT/HCPCS

• Experience building or overseeing health economic models and tools used by commercial teams

• Experience building compliant field reimbursement programs and partnering closely with sales leadership

• Experience advising C-suite and Board and representing the company externally with CMS and policymakers

• Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate complex clinical and economic evidence into persuasive payer and executive messaging

• Experience in high-growth or public-company environments preferred

Compensation Range

$280,000—$320,000 USD

A candidate’s final salary offer will be based on their skills, education, work location and experience, and thus it may differ from the posted range. Compensation may also include bonuses consistent with Ceribell’s corporate compensation plan. jobs.title: Program Manager, Partner Enablement
jobs.description:
Forward was founded in 2013 by four Stanford Ph.D.s, building the industry's first network digital twin: a mathematically accurate model of the production network. It's the foundation for autonomous networking, giving engineers and AI agents the ability to know the impact of every change before it touches production. That founding instinct still defines how we work. We're accurate and evidence-driven, relentless about clarity, and we'd rather be certain than comfortable, building a groundbreaking platform that transforms how teams run and secure networks across every major cloud and vendor environment.

Global leaders like Goldman Sachs, PayPal, S&P Global, IBM, and Dell trust Forward, alongside fast-growing enterprises and government agencies, realizing an average of $14.2 million in annual benefits, according to IDC. Backed by top-tier investors, including A. Capital, Andreessen Horowitz, Goldman Sachs, MSD Partners, Omega Venture Partners, Section 32, and Threshold Ventures, and headquartered in Santa Clara, we're most proud of our team: curious people who'd rather build what doesn't exist than accept how things have always been done.

Forward Networks is looking for an experienced Program Manager, Partner Enablement to build an ecosystem of partners equipped to sell, deploy, and operate Forward to the same standard as our own teams.

You will own the partner enablement strategy from onboarding through certification, designation, and recertification. Working with Channel leadership, Sales Enablement, Technical Enablement, and Technical Services, you will turn existing content and targeted new materials into practical learning paths that help partners generate pipeline, deliver services independently, and protect the customer experience.

Responsibilities

Strategy and Program Ownership

• Define and evolve the Partner Enablement Charter aligned with Forward Partner Program goals and Channel leadership priorities.

• Own partner onboarding and certification curricula across four tracks: Sales; Technical Pre-Sales for resale partners; Deployment and Implementation; and Operator and MSP.

• Design individual certifications for partner sellers and technical pre-sales professionals, and company designations for Deployment and Implementation and Operator and MSP partners, including the higher readiness bar for “Powered by Forward” MSPs.

• Align learning paths with partner levels, designation requirements, and program incentives in partnership with Channel leadership and Technical Services.

• Build recertification and quarterly release refresh programs, and work with LMS, CRM, and Partner Portal owners to track certification status accurately.

Content and Delivery

• Partner with Sales Enablement and Technical Enablement to adapt existing messaging, discovery guides, use-case plays, customer stories, and deal support assets for partner audiences.

• Coordinate partner technical learning covering NQE, the Forward API, integrations, and quarterly Essential Updates release courses, plus customer engagement runbooks, QBRs, and escalation practices for MSP operators.

• Identify content gaps and coordinate subject matter experts to develop hands-on labs, graded capstones, scoring rubrics, and consistent assessment standards.

• Ensure certification demonstrates practical skills through assessed work and clear readiness criteria.

• Manage partner learning paths, content taxonomy, and governance in the LMS.

• Deliver live and virtual boot camps, certification cohorts, launch webinars, and partner events; coordinate enablement readiness for launches and pilots.

Measurement and Feedback

• Measure partner time to certification, designation, and revenue, along with certified seller and engineer coverage across the partner community.

• Track enablement’s contribution to partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, deal registration, win rates, and services attach.

• Partner with Technical Services to monitor designated partners’ delivery quality through L3 escalation rates, SLA attainment, and end-customer health.

• Use partner satisfaction survey results and structured feedback from partners and Channel Account Managers to improve programs quarterly.

• Within the first 12 months, launch all four tracks and support the first partners earning Deployment and Implementation and Operator and MSP designations.

Requirements

• 7–10 years in Partner or Channel Enablement, Sales Enablement, or Revenue Enablement, including at least 3 years enabling channel partners, systems integrators, or MSPs.

• Experience enabling complex, multi-stakeholder deals and building tiered partner certification programs with hands-on labs and graded assessments.

• Working technical fluency in networking or security sufficient to scope labs and capstones with Technical Services and assess content quality; direct lab development is not required.

• Strong facilitation and executive communication skills, including experience engaging partner executives.

• Proficiency with Salesforce and LMS analytics; experience with Absorb or a similar learning platform.

• Ability to take ownership, navigate ambiguity, and manage changing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

• An approach focused on measurable partner selling and delivery outcomes, with the judgment to reuse existing content and prioritize new development where it adds value.

• Familiarity with MSP and managed-services business models is a plus.

Compensation

The expected On-Target Cash Earning for this role is between $135,000 - $175,000 per year. Within this range, individual pay is determined by several factors including but not limited to, job-related skills, work experience, and relevant education/training

jobs.title: Staff Mechanical Engineer (Flexible Instruments)
jobs.description:
Primary Function of Position

The Staff Mechanical Engineer, Advanced Energy, will serve as a technical and design lead for the development of advanced energy products and/or sub-systems at Intuitive. This role is responsible for driving early concept exploration through commercialization translating ambiguous clinical/technical needs into robust architectures, and leading rapid prototype iteration to de-risk key technical challenges. They will have both the technical depth to resolve complex mechanical, material, and manufacturing design issues as well as the ability to work in an interdisciplinary team to troubleshoot and root cause higher level system issues. They must have strong technical depth in relevant areas and have a track record of successful product development efforts. Using their subject matter expertise, exceptional communication skills and cross-functional collaboration, they will investigate and develop advanced energy applications for novel clinical applications across our robotic surgical systems.

This person thrives in a small, high-energy team, takes end-to-end ownership, and consistently delivers high-quality prototypes, data-driven decisions, and scalable designs. A strong sense of shared responsibility and shared reward is required as well as a commitment to high product quality.

Essential Job Duties

• Work in a small, cross-functional project team to design, develop and verify new concepts for advanced energy catheters and/or flexible electromechanical instruments
• Define early product architecture, interfaces, and design requirements; translate feasibility prototypes into scalable products
• Develop, implement, test and document new solutions, processes, and designs according to corporate standards and departmental operating procedures
• Hands-on assembly and testing of devices to support proof of concept, design development, pre-clinical and V&V activities
• Investigate and determine root cause of emerging design or manufacturing defects/failures.
• Development and documentation of design and manufacturing documentation including inspection procedures, assembly instructions, test methods, purchase specifications, BOMs, part and assembly drawings using appropriate change control procedures
• Collaborate with clinical engineering team to assess product concepts and do tradeoff analysis of proposed designs and feature sets
• Partner with testing engineering and NPI to define verification approaches, ensure design outputs are measurable, and support design transfer
• Observe clinical cases and participate in interviews with clinical experts to inform designs; provide support for pre-clinical labs and clinical cases
• Establish individual goals consistent with overall project goals
• Performs other duties as required to support the company's overall strategy and goals

Required Skills and Experience

• Typical minimum of 12 years of relevant experience, minimum 8 years with a masters
• Demonstrated success as a technical lead (and/or design lead) in cross-functional R&D teams, influencing decisions across engineering, testing, clinical, quality and manufacturing.
• Demonstrated ability to originate novel concepts and rapidly convert ideas into functional prototypes to evaluate technical feasibility and clinical value
• Proven track record operating in highly ambiguous environments with limited data, effectively identifying key risks and prioritizing experiments to accelerate learning
• Demonstrated ability to determine what to prototype versus what to analyze, balancing speed, risk reduction, and long-term scalability
• Expertise in structured problem-solving and rapid design iteration cycles (build–test–learn)

• Experience with all phases of the product development lifecycle; including proof-of-concept, design, implementation, debug, verification, qualification, and transfer
• High autonomy and ability to work independently under limited supervision to determine and develop approach to solutions.
• Strong written and verbal communication; able to clearly present tradeoffs, risks, and technical rationale to varied audiences.
• Experience with FDA QSR 21 CFR Part 820, ISO 13485, ISO 14971 and other related standards

Required Education and Training

• Minimum education: BS or MS in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Biomedical Engineering or related engineering or scientific discipline, or equivalent work experience

Preferred Skills and Experience

• Experience with energy delivery devices is a strong plus
• Experience with flexible electromechanical device development is a strong plus
• Understanding of medical system integration and interfaces is a plus

jobs.description:

jobs.title: Sourcing Specialist II
jobs.description:
ABOUT ROCKET LAB

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

SUPPLY CHAIN

Rocket Lab’s Supply Chain team orchestrates the seamless flow of materials, products, and components across the entire organization. As many of our products serve as mission-critical elements for both Rocket Lab and our customers, the Supply Chain team plays a pivotal role in the success of our rocket and satellite programs. From assembling kits that empower our technicians to build rockets, satellites, and space systems, to managing inventory, procurement, shipping, and receiving, the team ensures operational excellence at every stage. They also oversee rigorous inspection processes to guarantee that all materials and products meet our stringent quality and compliance standards. Serving as the vital link between departments, the Supply Chain team is essential to driving Rocket Lab’s mission and enabling our continued success.

SOURCING SPECIALIST II - RAW MATERIALS

Based onsite at Rocket Lab’s global headquarters in Long Beach, CA, the Sourcing Specialist plays a critical role in shaping the supply chain strategy that powers our mission to redefine space access. As a key member of the procurement team, you will be responsible for sourcing and securing the raw materials essential to the development and production of our launch vehicles, satellite systems, and advanced aerospace components. Your decisions will directly impact Rocket Lab’s ability to achieve its cost, quality, and delivery objectives, supporting both rapid R&D cycles and scalable production. This role will focus on all raw material procurement—including, but not limited to, metallics, composites, and powders—across all Rocket Lab programs.

WHAT YOU’LL GET TO DO:

• Develop and execute a comprehensive raw material sourcing strategy to support global operations, encompassing production, R&D, and testing requirements.

• Lead end-to-end supplier engagement activities including RFIs, RFPs, supplier selection, contract negotiations, and onboarding, ensuring alignment with Rocket Lab’s strategic objectives.

• Analyze spend, market dynamics, and supplier capabilities to identify opportunities for cost optimization, risk mitigation, and supply chain innovation—including the development of reuse and recycling processes.

• Drive total cost of ownership (TCO) improvements through supplier consolidation, standardization, and the cultivation of strategic partnerships.

• Own the sourcing process by rigorously evaluating vendor capabilities, pricing, delivery performance, and alignment with Rocket Lab’s quality standards.

• Ensure on-time delivery of critical materials to meet program schedules and production milestones.

• Manage and strengthen supplier relationships, serving as the primary business interface for assigned vendors.

• Lead the RFQ process to secure competitive bids and ensure best-value procurement for goods and services.

• Collaborate closely with Engineering teams to anticipate and fulfill procurement requirements, acting as the primary point of contact for R&D order status and material needs.

• Provide proactive updates to material planners regarding purchase order status and expected delivery timelines.

• Negotiate commercial terms with suppliers to achieve optimal outcomes in quality, cost, and delivery.

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date purchase order data within Rocket Lab’s ERP system, ensuring data integrity and operational transparency.

YOU'LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Business Management, or other relevant fields

• 2+ years of related experience as Buyer, Manufacturing Engineer, or equivalent

• Proven ability to source, onboard, and negotiate pricing with suppliers

• Proven knowledge of purchasing processes.

• Ability to travel domestically and internationally up to 10% of time

THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:

• Proficient in MRP systems

• Prior experience in aerospace, automotive, or other disruptive manufacturing industries

• Prior experience in rapid growth environment

• Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings

• Experience with AS9100, US export controls

• Strong organizational and problem-solving skills, with the ability to prioritize effectively and efficiently

• Excellent verbal and written communication abilities

• Team oriented, strong ability to multi-task and work in a fast-paced environment and to multiple deadlines

This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas.

Join one of the world's fastest-growing space companies and own a piece of it. In addition to competitive base pay, you'll receive company stock as part of your total compensation package, giving you a direct stake in our success. As we expand to new launch sites, groundbreaking missions, and global markets, your ownership has the opportunity to grow alongside the company.

Our comprehensive benefits package includes our industry-leading Employee Stock Purchase Program (with a 15% discount on company stock), top-tier medical plans (HMO, PPO, and a zero cost HDHP option with a significant HSA company contribution), dental and vision coverage, paid vacation and sick time, 11 paid holidays, flexible spending and dependent care accounts, paid parental leave, disability and life insurance, and a 401(k) retirement plan with company match.

Additional perks include subsidized EV charging, onsite fitness centers (where available), discounted gym memberships, complimentary snacks and beverages, 50% employee discount on our popular merch store, and a variety of other employee discounts.

Level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base Pay Range (CA Only)

$76,800—$96,000 USD

WHAT TO EXPECT

We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other’s backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.

Important information:

FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN US OFFICES ONLY:

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), Rocket Lab Employees must be a U.S. citizen, lawful U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State and/or the U.S. Department of Commerce, as applicable. Learn more about ITAR here.

Rocket Lab provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment at Rocket Lab, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

Applicants requiring a reasonable accommodation for the application/interview process for a job in the United States should contact Giulia Johnson at g.biow@rocketlabusa.com.This dedicated resource is intended solely to assist job seekers with disabilities whose disability prevents them from being able to apply/interview. Only messages left for this purpose will be considered. A response to your request may take up to two business days.

FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN NEW ZEALAND OFFICES ONLY:

For security reasons, background checks will be undertaken prior to any employment offers being made to an applicant.  These checks will include nationality checks as it is a requirement of this position that you be eligible to access equipment and data regulated by the United States' International Traffic in Arms Regulations.

jobs.title: Senior Scientist / Research Scientist, Molecular Biology
jobs.description:
About GenScript

Founded in 2002 in New Jersey, GenScript Biotech Corporation accelerates innovation in biotech and healthcare by providing researchers and companies with the building blocks needed to develop groundbreaking treatments and products. Guided by its mission to Make People and Nature Healthier Through Biotechnology, and its role as a well-recognized biotechnology company, GenScript has a team of approximately 6,165 employees and has served more than 200,000 customers across over 100 countries and regions.

Position: Senior Scientist / Research Scientist, Molecular Biology

Location: Seattle, WA

Reporting to: Project Lead

Role Description:

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced scientist with a multidisciplinary background in molecular biology and synthetic biology, a strong product-development mindset, and the ability to build new technologies and workflows from the ground up.

As a key member of a small, collaborative R&D team, this scientist will lead the development of innovative molecular biology products and technologies, with a particular focus on gene synthesis and DNA library construction using GenScript’s proprietary high-throughput DNA synthesis platforms. The role combines bench-based research, technical leadership, supervision of junior team members, and management of R&D projects from concept and feasibility assessment through process development, technology transfer, and commercialization.

The successful candidate will help establish robust, scalable workflows that enable automated, large-scale production while collaborating closely with cross-functional partners in bioinformatics, chemistry, manufacturing, and quality.

Key Responsibilities:

• Lead bench-based research to design, develop, and optimize molecular biology products and services using GenScript’s proprietary high-throughput DNA synthesis platform.

• Develop next-generation gene synthesis technologies and associated assays to simplify workflows and improve performance, quality, cost, safety, and scalability.

• Lead new product and process development to expand capabilities in gene assembly, DNA library construction, next-generation cloning, and DNA amplification.

• Assist to manage R&D projects from concept through technology transfer, defining project scope, experimental strategies, deliverables, timelines, resource requirements, and success criteria. Track progress, identify technical risks, and coordinate mitigation plans to support timely execution.

• Supervise, mentor, and train junior scientists and research associates. Set clear objectives, guide experimental design and troubleshooting, review data and documentation, and provide regular feedback to support scientific development and accountability.

• Coordinate day-to-day research activities and prioritize experimental work across assigned projects in alignment with team objectives and available resources.

• Lead technology transfer to manufacturing, collaborating with manufacturing and quality teams to support successful product launches and continuous process improvement in an ISO 9001-compliant environment.

• Develop and optimize automated workflows that translate research methods into robust, reproducible, and scalable production processes.

• Collaborate with colleagues in bioinformatics, chemistry, and other key functions to translate research advances into competitive reagent and service offerings.

• Critically evaluate experimental data, draw actionable conclusions, and communicate scientific findings, project progress, risks, and recommendations through presentations, reports, and team updates.

• Author and review technical documentation, including technology transfer packages, standard operating procedures (SOPs), analytical reports, invention disclosures, and patent applications.

Qualifications:

Education

• A degree in Biochemistry, Chemical Biology, Molecular Biology, Chemistry, Synthetic Biology, or a closely related discipline, with one of the following combinations of education and relevant industry experience: Bachelor’s degree with at least 8 years of relevant industry experience. Master’s degree with at least 5 years of relevant industry experience. D. with at least 3 years of relevant industry experience.

Required Qualifications

• Proven track record in assay and product development, including turning research concepts into reproducible, scalable methods.

• Strong knowledge of molecular biology, biochemistry, and enzymology, including DNA and RNA. Knowledge of protein synthesis, protein characterization, and affinity assays is a plus.

• Hands-on expertise in nucleic acid manipulation and analysis, including primer and probe design, PCR, isothermal amplification, gene assembly, cloning, qPCR, DNA/RNA purification, and capillary electrophoresis.

• Experience with next-generation sequencing (NGS) is preferred, especially for characterizing synthetic DNA and libraries.

• Expertise in liquid handlers and laboratory automation, including method development, optimization, and troubleshooting. Experience with Beckman and Hamilton systems is preferred.

• Experience with method verification and validation in a product-development setting.

• Familiarity with automated laboratory systems and electronic documentation systems (ELN/LIMS) is preferred.

• Experience transferring workflows to automated, large-scale manufacturing in an ISO 9001-compliant environment is preferred.

• Ability to lead R&D projects, including setting priorities, managing timelines, and resolving technical challenges.

• Experience supervising, mentoring, or guiding junior scientists or research associates.

• Demonstrated success collaborating with interdisciplinary teams.

• Excellent documentation and communication skills, including preparing data summaries, technical and scientific reports, and SOPs, and transferring procedures to manufacturing.

• Goal-oriented, hands-on, and innovative approach to problem solving.

• Self-motivated and passionate, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.

jobs.title: Infrastructure Engineer (Platform)
jobs.description:
About Northwood:

Northwood is a modern space infrastructure company bringing the benefits of space to the masses through advanced communications technology. We are building a global network of phased array ground stations that enable real-time, reliable communication for satellite missions such as national security, global connectivity, and disaster response. With a vertically integrated approach, Northwood designs, builds, and rapidly deploys scalable systems that power the next generation of space missions. If you like solving complex challenges and seeing your work deployed around the world with real impact, Northwood is the place to do it.



Role
Northwood runs a global network of phased array ground stations supported by cloud infrastructure; clusters that run mission software, identity systems every service depends on, the observability stack that tells operators what is happening at every site, and the IaC that defines all of it. The Infrastructure Engineer – Cloud owns and operates that environment.
This is a core individual contributor role on the Infrastructure team. You take a defined scope, run it independently, and bring real depth in cloud infrastructure. You'll work directly with Platform software engineers building the services and config models that describe what the environment should be. You'll make that intent real in cloud infrastructure, and keep it running.


Responsibilities

 - Own and operate all components of the cloud infrastructure stack: cloud accounts, hosted k8s clusters, CA, secrets, IAM, the observability pipeline. Take a defined scope and execute it without ongoing oversight.

 - Build and maintain infrastructure as code. Define and implement GitOps practices and proper CI gates to test, audit, and approve infrastructure changes.

 - Implement cloud-side networking: VPCs, transit route tables, VPNs and Direct Connect attachments, egress and ingress inspection. Partner with the network engineering on cloud to site handoff.

 - Carry on-call for the cloud stack. Resolve the majority of incidents independently and run post-incident reviews for the ones you own.

 - Partner with security engineering and compliance on controls implementation in your areas: policies, IAM boundaries, logging coverage, evidence collection, CVE mitigation.

 - Treat toil as a design signal. When manual work repeats, automate it or fix the underlying system.

 - Write and maintain runbooks, design docs, and component documentation. Keep them current with the system.

 - Collaborate across infrastructure, platform software, security, and ground station operations on cross-cutting work.



Basic Qualifications

 - 2–5 years of production infrastructure experience (SRE, DevOps, platform, cloud, or systems engineering). See Levels below for what we expect across that range.

 - Depth in cloud: multi-account organizations, IAM, VPC networking, EKS or equivalent managed Kubernetes.

 - Strong IaC experience: state management, CI-driven plan and apply, working in a shared monorepo with other engineers.

 - Working competence across Linux, networking fundamentals, containers and Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and observability tooling.

 - Demonstrated end-to-end ownership of a production system: design, implementation, operation.

 - On-call experience in a production environment with measurable reliability outcomes.

 - Comfortable in code (Python, Go, or similar) for automation, tooling, and integration work.

 - Strong technical writing: design docs, runbooks, post-mortems.



Preferred Qualifications
Depth in one or more of the following weighs heavily. We hire generalists with a spike.

 - AWS GovCloud or other regulated or air-gapped cloud environments, including the service gaps and workarounds that come with them.

 - Secrets and identity infrastructure: Vault (PKI, auth methods, policy design), Okta or IAM Identity Center integration, workload identity.

 - Observability at scale: VictoriaMetrics or Prometheus, Grafana, alerting design, log pipelines (Vector, Loki).

 - EKS: multi-cluster ArgoCD, cluster lifecycle, node and network policy, workload isolation.

 - Cloudflare: Zero Trust, DNS, tunnels, WAF.

 - Compliance partnership: implementing technical controls for CMMC, NIST 800-171, NIST 800-53, FedRAMP.

 - Hybrid connectivity between cloud and on-prem or edge sites.



Additional Information:

If you need a reasonable accommodation as part of your application for employment or interviews with us, please let us know.



To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.



Northwood Space is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with Northwood Space is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

At Freenome, we are seeking a Computational Biologist I, Assay Development to help grow the Freenome’s Computational Biology, Assay Development (CBAD) team (can be a Senior Computational Biologist role depending on experience). As part of our team, you will  apply your scientific expertise to the development of early, noninvasive tests for cancer detection. With a strong background in bioinformatics, statistics, and molecular biology, you will develop, write, and execute analysis plans and reports for the development and characterization of Freenome’s in vitro diagnostic devices and regulatory filings. You will work closely and cross-functionally with many teams, including Regulatory and Quality, Molecular Research and Development, Laboratory Operations, Biostatistics, Computational Science, and Engineering to enable the successful development of multiple molecular assays as part of Freenome’s diagnostic products.

What you’ll do:

• Plan and execute development experiments for Freenome’s multiomics cancer screening tests.

• Work closely with molecular and computational research teams developing Freenome’s IVD products for blood-based molecular assays including cell-free DNA, proteins, and additional biomarkers.

• Impact patient lives through the development and launch of high quality cancer screening technologies

Must haves:

• Post-graduate degree (MS or PhD) in statistics, computational biology, bioinformatics, cancer biology, or related quantitative field.

• Familiarity with and ability to select and leverage bioinformatics tools for the above molecular assays.

• Experience in applied statistics, such as in hypothesis testing, regression techniques, and appropriate use of simulation.

• Expertise in data analysis and visualization using R (tidyverse), or Python statistical packages (Numpy, Matplotlib, Pandas), or equivalent, under version control.

• Excellent oral and written communication skills to communicate to scientific and broader audiences, with keen attention to detail.

• Ability to work on a cross-functional team in our highly collaborative environment, working with both computational and experimental scientists.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT EARNIN

As one of the first pioneers of earned wage access, our passion at EarnIn is building products that deliver real-time financial flexibility for people living paycheck to paycheck. Our community members access their earnings as they earn them, with options to spend, save, and grow their money without mandatory fees, interest rates, or credit checks. We’re fortunate to have an incredibly experienced leadership team, combined with world-class funding partners like A16Z, Matrix Partners, DST, Ribbit Capital, and a very healthy core business with a tremendous runway. We’re growing fast and excited to bring on world-class talent to help shape the next chapter of our growth journey.

EarnIn is becoming an AI-native company, embedding AI agents into how we build, analyze, and operate across every function. Teams use AI Agents to move from ideas to execution faster. By letting agents handle repetitive tasks, our people can focus on judgment, creativity, and hard problems. We pair this experimentation with the strict review and security guardrails our regulated financial environment requires, always keeping a focus on privacy and the people who rely on our products.

As a company, we are becoming AI-native, and we encourage you to use AI tools throughout much of your interview process. If you use AI during the live interview, just say so; a quick, natural mention of how it helped and why you are using it is all we need. What we're evaluating is your judgment, reasoning, and ability to own and defend your work, not whether AI was involved. Some rounds, particularly those focused on your career history and past experiences, will not allow the use of AI, and we'll let you know of those in advance. When in doubt, ask your recruiter or interviewer directly.

POSITION SUMMARY
We seek an experienced, passionate, and resourceful Senior Staff Software Engineer to join our product engineering team. You will work cross-functionally with various teams and contribute to designing and developing our core products. The Mountain View base salary range for this full-time position is $279,000-$341,00-00, plus equity and benefits. We determine salary ranges by role, level, and location. This hybrid position in Mountain View requires 2 days of in-office work per week.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Own architecture that spans business units: define domain boundaries, decide where cross-cutting concerns belong, and keep product logic, policy, and funds flow in the right layers.

• Lead design and architecture reviews across BUs, and record decisions in clear, durable architecture decision records.

• Drive decomposition and unification roadmaps for shared systems, including how user state is split across domains, and sequence the work so teams can adopt it incrementally.

• Prevent accumulated complexity by making deprecation, experiment cleanup, and clear ownership part of the design, not an afterthought.

• Partner with Platform, Money Platform, and BU engineering leads so standards are practical, adopted, and not duplicated.

• Use AI tools daily for design exploration, code analysis, and review, and build the agents, skills, and documentation that make our architecture legible to both engineers and AI coding agents.

• Set the bar for responsible AI-assisted development: guardrails, review practices, and patterns that keep AI-generated code consistent with our architecture.

• Mentor Staff and Senior engineers through design reviews, code, and architecture guidance, and help raise the technical bar across teams.

• Contribute to hiring and onboarding, and represent engineering in technical discussions with product, risk, and leadership.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

• Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in computer science, computer engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent industry experience.

• 10+ years of backend or full-stack software development, with a track record of designing and evolving large distributed systems.

• Demonstrated experience defining domain boundaries and service contracts across multiple teams, with practical knowledge of domain-driven design, event-driven systems, and clean architecture.

• Hands-on, daily use of AI coding and design tools, with concrete examples of how they changed the way you work and the results you achieved.

• Experience leading cross-team technical initiatives and influencing without direct authority, including resolving disagreements between teams.

• Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to turn complex trade-offs into clear decisions and documentation.

• Experience in fintech, payments, or other regulated, high-reliability environments is a plus.

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic, results-driven environment.

At EarnIn, we believe that the best way to build a financial system that works for everyday people is by hiring a team that represents our diverse community. Our team is diverse not only in background and experience but also in perspective. We celebrate our diversity and strive to create a culture of belonging. jobs.title: Investigations Analyst, Safety, NAST
jobs.description:
Are you interested in working on a fast-paced team that pioneers ways to improve safety and compliance within North American Surface Transportation (NAST)? Do you enjoy digging into the details of an event and tracing it across multiple systems until you have a clear answer? Are you motivated by challenging problems where the answer isn't handed to you?
Amazon's NAST Safety & Compliance team, within Middle Mile Investigations (MMI), is seeking a detail-oriented Investigations Analyst to determine whether Amazon loads, equipment, or carrier relationships were involved in reported safety events across our carrier programs: Relay Marketplace Carrier (RMC), RMC LineHaul (RMCLH), RMC Box Truck (RMCBT), and Amazon Freight Partner (AFP).
Working within established investigation workflows and SOPs, with periodic review and guidance from the Program Manager, you'll review source documents such as police and crash reports, then match what they show (trailer and tractor plates, DOT numbers, carrier and driver details) against internal load, assignment, and location records. Each event ends in a clear, documented determination of whether Amazon had involvement, backed by the evidence behind it. Along the way you'll spot issues that need follow-up, such as events that were never reported, or loads moved by a carrier other than the one assigned, and route them to the right partner teams. An ideal candidate is comfortable with ambiguity, has strong attention to detail, is vocally self-critical, and collaborates well in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment.

Key job responsibilities
Investigation
•	Conduct assigned incident investigations from intake through documented finding across RMC, RMCLH, RMCBT, and AFP, determining whether an Amazon load, asset, or carrier relationship was involved.
•	Collect and preserve evidence including telematics, dash-camera footage, law enforcement and crash reports, and carrier documentation.
•	Match physical evidence (trailer/tractor plates, DOT numbers, carrier and driver details) against load, assignment, and location records.
•	Apply FMCSA Crash Preventability Determination Program criteria and video review standards.
•	Write clear investigation narratives documenting what occurred and the factors identified, with every line sourced to verifiable data, so partner teams can act without re-investigating.
•	Serve as a point of contact on assigned incidents to internal stakeholders.
Analysis & escalation
•	Identify events needing follow-up (unreported incidents, mis-assigned loads) and route them to the appropriate partner teams.
•	Query and reconcile data across multiple transportation systems to support investigations.
•	Identify trends across regions, carrier programs, and individual carriers, and surface them to the Program Manager.
•	Recommend enforcement action under published authority matrices for Program Manager review.
Operating rhythm & process improvement
•	Work a steady queue of cases against turnaround expectations, keeping case records and queue status current and auditable in the systems of record.
•	Review recurring vendor investigation reports for completeness and escalate vendor performance issues.
•	Report investigation status, closure metrics, and case aging to the Program Manager on a recurring cadence.
•	Flag recurring data or process gaps that slow investigations, and propose improvements to investigation standard work and SOPs.

A day in the life
Your morning starts with the queue: new incidents overnight, open evidence requests, cases aging. You pull telematics and video on an assigned collision and chase the law enforcement report and carrier documentation. By afternoon you are writing the narrative, sourcing every line. Some events bring outside counsel into the file, and you are the person who knows what happened. A pattern you flagged last month across two regions becomes a recommendation your Program Manager takes to an enforcement decision. No two investigations are the same, and what you document today shapes what the network changes next quarter.

About the team
Middle Mile Investigations (MMI) sits within NAST Safety & Compliance. We investigate transportation incidents across Amazon's Middle Mile carrier programs, document what happened from verifiable evidence, and surface patterns that inform how the network operates. The team is geographically distributed, and the written product carries to senior leaders who act on it. If you enjoy detailed problem-solving and are comfortable with ambiguity, you'll do well here.

Basic qualifications:
- High school or equivalent diploma
- 2+ years of professional or military experience
- 2+ years of experience working with computers and Microsoft Office products and applications
- Experience with investigations, auditing, risk management, compliance, or safety

Preferred qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience in a business analyst, data analyst, or equivalent role
- Experience with end-to-end project management

jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager – Technical, Leo Futures, Leo Connectivity
jobs.description:
Amazon Leo is building a constellation of 3,000+ Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellites to deliver fast, affordable broadband connectivity to customers around the world. The Leo Connectivity Product team is responsible for defining and delivering the end-to-end networking and service experiences that connect customers — consumers, enterprises, and the public sector — to the Leo network.

We are seeking a highly technical Sr. Product Manager to own product definition for future generations of Leo’s satellite connectivity system. This is a strategic, cross-functional role focused on identifying the customer problems we will solve with next-generation architectures. You will work at the intersection of vehicle engineering, software engineering, modeling and simulation, and the PMT teams building our first-generation network, constellation and customer devices — synthesizing insights across all of them to define what comes next.

This role requires someone who thrives in ambiguity. The problems are not yet well-defined, the solution space is wide open, and the timelines may be long. You will frame ill-defined challenges into actionable product strategies, drive system-level trade studies with modeling and simulation teams and translate technical possibilities into customer-centric product direction. This is a high-visibility individual contributor role based in Redmond, WA.

*** Export Control Requirement***
- Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
- Define the product vision and requirements for future-generation satellite connectivity systems, grounded in deep understanding of customer problems across consumer, enterprise, and public sector segments.

- Drive system-level trade studies in partnership with modeling and simulation teams — translating simulation outputs into product requirements and investment recommendations.

- Partner deeply with vehicle engineering and software engineering to understand technical constraints and opportunities that inform future system architectures.

- Collaborate with PMTs owning first-generation constellation systems and customer antenna products to identify gaps, lessons learned, and opportunities that shape future generations.

- Frame ambiguous, long-horizon problems into structured product strategies with clear hypotheses, evaluation criteria, and decision frameworks.

- Write PRFAQs, technical narratives, and investment proposals that articulate the customer need, technical approach, and business case for future system capabilities.

- Represent the futures roadmap in leadership reviews, clearly communicating trade-offs, dependencies, and strategic rationale to senior technical and business stakeholders.

A day in the life
Your morning might begin with a review of simulation results from the modeling team — a new trade study has landed overnight comparing architectural approaches for a capability that could unlock performance improvements for enterprise customers. You dig into the data, identify the assumptions that need stress-testing, and draft follow-up questions for the simulation engineers.

Mid-morning, you’re in a working session with vehicle engineering, walking through how a proposed design change to the satellite bus impacts the connectivity services you’re defining. You push on the customer experience implications and propose a set of requirements that preserve flexibility for future service evolution.

After lunch, you sit down with a PMT colleague who owns our payload software. Together you review field data and customer feedback, looking for patterns that signal where the current architecture falls short and where the next generation needs to leap forward. You capture three hypotheses to validate with simulation runs.

The afternoon is heads-down writing time. You’re drafting a narrative that frames a customer problem — one that doesn’t have an obvious solution yet — and propose an evaluation framework for the engineering team to assess multiple architectural paths. You end the day in a cross-functional sync, aligning vehicle, software, and simulation teams on priorities for the next sprint of trade studies.

About the team
You’ll be part of the Leo Connectivity Product team — a group of product and technology leaders responsible for defining the end-to-end connectivity experience for Leo’s customers. Our team spans device products, networking services, enterprise solutions, and future systems.

We value deep technical curiosity, comfort with ambiguity, and a relentless focus on the customer problems worth solving. We operate with a builder’s mentality — moving fast on the things we understand and moving deliberately on the things that require getting it right. We are a team that debates rigorously, decides clearly, and supports each other once a direction is set.

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We believe the best products come from teams with varied perspectives and experiences.

Basic qualifications:
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
- Experience managing technical products or online services
- Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning
- Working knowledge of RF systems, propagation physics, spectrum allocation, and the physical-layer constraints that govern satellite connectivity performance.
- 5+ years of experience in aerospace, satellite communications, or telecommunications systems.

Preferred qualifications:
- Background in satellite communications, space systems, or LEO constellation architectures.
- Experience defining products that span multiple customer segments (consumer, enterprise, public sector).
- Experience working with large-scale simulation and modeling systems to inform product decisions and system architecture trade-offs.
- Demonstrated ability to thrive in ambiguity — defining 0→1 product strategies where the problem space is undefined and the solution set is wide open.
- Proven ability to influence without authority across multiple engineering disciplines (hardware, software, systems).
- Experience with Amazon’s product development mechanisms (PRFAQs, narratives, working backwards).

jobs.title: Economist, Entertainment Economics
jobs.description:
The charter of the Entertainment Economics team includes working on high-impact projects that require economics expertise and a cross-business perspective. Our team supports Amazon’s diverse entertainment businesses – especially Prime Video, Amazon Music, Amazon MGM Studios, and Gaming (Luna) – through complex causal measurements (observational and experimental) and structural modeling. Some of our team’s areas of science expertise include marketing science, long-term value measurement, and experimentation. As a central economics team not embedded in any particular business, we strive to provide objective analyses that take a customer-obsessed, pan-Amazon perspective.

This role partners with the Prime Science team to evaluate and improve the way Amazon allocates Prime subscription revenue across its benefit teams, including entertainment businesses. Prime is Amazon's premiere membership program, with over 200mm members world-wide, bringing in billions in Prime subscription revenue annually. Prime is at the center of many major company decisions that impact Amazon's customers. These decisions span a variety of industries, each reflecting the diversity of Prime benefits: fast and free shipping, entertainment & digital content, reading, healthcare, and grocery. Each of these Prime benefits is supported by a different organization, and each relies on Prime subscription revenue to make critical investment decisions. Our team partners with Prime Science to ensure that these allocations are credible, actionable, and incentive compatible for every benefit.

To support this work, this role will create science models, validate them, and productionize them. In addition to stellar economics expertise, this role requires systems thinking (anticipating how complex interconnected models will respond to changes in data or modeling), strategic thinking (supporting decisions that affect 200 million+ customers and set Amazon’s direction for years to come), and scientifically novel thinking (using AI and the latest science advancements to achieve move).

The ideal candidate is expert in causal inference with experience working in large, complex structural modeling environments. They are a creative problem-solver, able to identify new approaches that solve multiple problems at once while minimizing churn. They think big, not limiting themselves to what’s been done before, while tactfully accounting for the costs of major changes. They can add structure to incredibly ambiguous business contexts, making defensible assumptions and delivering measurements that drive impactful business decisions. They have effective communication and the skill to translate data-driven findings into actionable insights for senior leaders. Finally, they are empathetic and constructive. Our healthy team culture is supportive and fast-paced, and we prioritize learning, growth, and helping each other to continuously raise the bar.

Impact and Career Growth
In today’s entertainment landscape, critical decisions are made with data and economic models. You’ll help leaders ask the right questions, and then deliver data-driven answers, helping to create the future of Amazon. You’ll help define a long-term science vision in this space and translate it into an actionable roadmap. This role combines science leadership, organizational ability, technical strength, product focus, and business understanding – a perfect recipe for career growth as an economist in tech.

Key job responsibilities
•	Design and build econometric models, especially causal models, to measure the value of the business and its many features
•	Develop science products from concept to prototype to production, incorporating feedback from scientists and business partners
•	Independently identify and pursue new opportunities to leverage economic insights across entertainment and Prime
•	Write business and technical documents communicating business context, methods, and results to business leadership and other scientists
•	Serve as a technical reviewer for our team and related teams, including document and code reviews

- PhD in economics or equivalent

Preferred qualifications:
- 2+ years of industry, consulting, government, or academic research experience
- Experience with handling of large datasets
- Experience in reduced form causal analysis, modeling, and experimental design

jobs.description:

this sounds like the type of experience you'd like to help build - apply here and let's chat!

1. Lead the design, implementation, and delivery of multi-tier distributed services and customer experiences across multiple engineers.
2. Own team architecture—providing system-wide perspective, design guidance, and influencing future technology choices.

About the team
We are deeply connected with the idea that live sports events are fundamentally different: there is only one shot at delivering the moment until it is forever lost. Our mission is to make sure that our customers never miss a single moment of the sports they love. Our team engineers for speed, quality, availability, and scale. As Prime Video has grown, we've increased the depth and breadth of video products we support, with a corresponding increase in the associated size and complexity of our engineering activity and the load on our services. Our goal is to adapt our architecture to maintain and improve our velocity of delivery for customers in the face of these changes, and for our services to be on and error-free 24/7, especially for high-profile, exclusive content. jobs.title: Shop Helper - Logistics
jobs.description:
Career Area:

Operations

Job Description:

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other.  We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Ketika Anda bergabung dengan Caterpillar, Anda bergabung dengan tim global yang peduli tidak hanya tentang pekerjaan yang kami lakukan – tetapi juga tentang satu sama lain. Kami adalah pembuat, pemecah masalah, dan pembangun dunia masa depan yang menciptakan komunitas yang lebih kuat dan berkelanjutan. Kami tidak hanya berbicara tentang kemajuan dan inovasi di sini – kami mewujudkannya, bersama dengan pelanggan kami, di tempat kami bekerja dan tinggal. Bersama-sama, kami membangun dunia yang lebih baik, sehingga kita semua dapat menikmati hidup di dalamnya.

Kami sedang mencari Shop Helper (Logistic) untuk bergabung dengan tim Logistic kami di Caterpillar Indonesia Batam.

Sebagai Shop Helper (Logistic) di Caterpillar, Anda akan bertanggung jawab untuk menangani material dan pergudangan dengan aman, tepat waktu, dan akurat.

Informasi Tambahan:

Shift: Rotasi Shift

Lokasi Kerja: Batam, Kepulauan Riau

Jenis Pekerjaan: 6 Bulan Kontrak

Anda akan bekerja di lingkungan area produksi.

Relokasi domestik tidak tersedia untuk posisi ini.

Sebagai seorang Shop Helper Anda akan:

• Bekerja di lingkungan dengan suhu yang sering berubah.
• Mengarahkan stok ke rak atau lokasi penyimpanan.
• Menangani material dalam proses penerimaan, termasuk penyimpanan, pemindahan, pengepakan, dan pengiriman barang, bahan, peralatan, dan persediaan.
• Memverifikasi jumlah, menghitung barang/bahan, dan memenuhi pesanan berdasarkan sumber dokumen.
• Menggunakan mesin atau alat untuk menimbang, mengikat, membungkus, mengemas, memindai, dan membuat identifikasi barang/bahan.
• Memelihara dan melakukan konfirmasi serta validasi dengan mengoperasikan komputer untuk mengakses dan memperbarui informasi untuk menerima dan memproses pesanan.
• Menggunakan peralatan bergerak seperti forklift, dock stocker, reach truck, order picker, tuggers, atau stock chaser untuk memfasilitasi fungsi pekerjaan.

Kandidat yang berhasil harus memiliki:

• Pendidikan mínimum Sekolah Menengah Atas atau sederajat.
• Memiliki SIO Forklift dan Scissor Lift akan menjadi nilai tambah.
• Komitmen yang kuat terhadap keselamatan dan kerja tim.
• Pengalaman kerja di bidang Logistic/Warehouse sebelumnya.
• Kemampuan komunikasi yang baik
• Kemampuan mengolah data menggunakan Microsoft Office (Excel) dan menngunakan aplikasi SAP menjadi nilai tambah.
• Kemampuan membaca, menulis, dan menafsirkan dokumen.
• Kemampuan untuk melakukan berbagai fungsi klerikal dan matematika dasar.
• Bersedia bekerja mengikuti rotasi shift.

Persyaratan Fisik (Dengan atau Tanpa Akomodasi yang Wajar):

• Pekerjaan ini mungkin memerlukan banyak gerakan aktif di seluruh pabrik termasuk naik turun tangga dan anak tangga, mengangkat peralatan, serta mendorong dan menarik peralatan.

Detail Akhir

Silakan periksa email yang terkait dengan aplikasi Anda secara berkala, termasuk folder sampah/spam, karena ini adalah metode korespondensi utama. Jika Anda ingin mengetahui status aplikasi Anda, silakan gunakan log-in kandidat di situs karir kami untuk mengetahui pembaruan status Anda.

Harap diingat bahwa dalam proses aplikasi, Caterpillar tidak akan pernah meminta pembayaran dalam bentuk apapun. Kami menyarankan Anda untuk mengabaikan tawaran pekerjaan dari individu yang mengaku bekerja untuk atau berafiliasi dengan Caterpillar.

Posting Dates:

November 5, 2026 - November 10, 2026

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer.  Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply
