jobs.title: Marketing Manager, Programmatic Advertising, Amazon Autos
jobs.description:
Amazon Autos is reinventing how people discover, research, and buy cars. Programmatic advertising through the Amazon DSP (ADSP) is one of our most important awareness and demand-generation channels, connecting high-intent car shoppers to the Amazon Autos experience across display, online video, and streaming TV at the moments that matter most. The ADSP channel is how we show up programmatically to drive qualified traffic, maximize channel efficiency, and improve the shopper experience end to end.
We are seeking a hands-on, highly analytical Marketing Manager to manage the Amazon DSP channel for Amazon Autos. This is a true channel-manager role: you will help shape the channel strategy, manage and pace a significant media budget, and run the day-to-day setup, pacing, and optimization of our programmatic campaigns. You will be actively managing campaigns in the Amazon Ads / DSP interface, with deep expertise in how to structure, optimize, and scale campaigns and extract the best possible results from every lever the platform offers. The role requires a highly analytical mindset and a curiosity to seek out new possibilities. You will read performance both at a top-line channel level and granularly within the campaign structure, and understand how this translates to on-platform performance. You will balance the art and science of advertising, with deep strength on the technical side of marketing as well as the creative and experimental side, consistently using one to inform the other. You will be accountable for your channel's day-to-day performance, applying learnings across campaigns and audiences, partnering with more senior colleagues on larger or more ambiguous bets and constantly looking for new ways to experiment as Amazon Autos helps blaze a trail within Amazon Ads.
The successful candidate will think strategically and execute rigorously. You must be able to thrive in an entrepreneurial environment and not be hindered by ambiguity or competing priorities. You will anticipate and remove bottlenecks, make tradeoffs with limited guidance, and balance business needs against constraints. You will dive into performance data, incremental business impact, and budget pacing for your channel, which requires strong analytical skills. You Earn Trust with your stakeholders, including but not limited to the Amazon Ads team, Product team, Reporting & Analytics partners, and other lines of business.

Key job responsibilities
- Contribute to the strategy for the Amazon DSP channel and manage a significant, growing programmatic media budget, collaborating with the marketing team, internal Amazon Ads counterparts, and external agencies on larger allocation decisions
- Own day-to-day setup, management, and optimization of ADSP campaigns, hands-on in the Amazon Ads / DSP interface
- Drive performance through continuous optimization (bidding, budget pacing, audience and inventory strategy, and campaign structure) at both a top-line and granular level on the ad platform and in the total traffic funnel
- Design, launch, and read out A/B tests to improve channel efficiency and inform new campaign strategy
- Manage brand lift and creative lift studies to inform future optimizations
- Monitor and analyze campaign performance metrics; troubleshoot and resolve delivery issues, ad-serving errors, and reporting discrepancies
- Conduct creative performance analysis and deliver clear, data-backed feedback to the creative team to strengthen future ads
- Help develop and scale our presence in emerging programmatic surfaces and new ADSP capabilities
- Translate performance data into actionable insights and concise business recommendations, refining them with senior colleagues; generate detailed reports and present findings
- Partner with Supply and Product teams, surfacing feedback that helps inform improvements to Amazon DSP offerings
- Support channel budget planning and OP1/OP2 inputs by scoping spend, flagging efficiency opportunities, and helping recommend where to invest next

A day in the life
You will start your day reviewing performance across your ADSP campaigns (pacing, spend, and conversion trends) and making optimizations directly in the Amazon DSP interface. Mid-morning you might dig into a line item that's underperforming, restructure audiences or adjust bids, and set up an A/B test to validate a new approach. After lunch, you're analyzing creative performance and pulling together feedback for the creative team on what's resonating and what isn't. Later in the week, you might build a readout on channel performance, size an opportunity in a new programmatic surface, and work with your manager on where to invest next. The work moves constantly between hands-on execution and deep analysis, and you'll always have multiple campaigns and tests in flight.

About the team
We're the marketing team at Amazon Autos, responsible for driving broad awareness of a marketplace that's fundamentally changing how people buy cars. You'll work alongside Creative, Analytics, and Product teams who are building something that's never existed in automotive retail. We test constantly, share learnings openly, and push each other to get better. If you enjoy a start-up environment, where you get to build from 0 to 1 and no two days are the same, this may be the role for you.

Basic qualifications:
- 4+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
- Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
- Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
- Experience building and optimizing multiple, simultaneous marketing campaigns
- Experience managing or working within cross-functional marketing and creative teams
- Experience delivering paid media campaigns spanning TV, print ads and digital/social channels
- Experience in audience segmentation and targeting

Preferred qualifications:
- Experience in multi-territory campaign management
- Experience in digital marketing and content production timelines and process
- Experience managing and optimizing campaigns within the Amazon DSP/Amazon Digital Ads

MACHINE OPERATOR (COPV)

The Starship COPV Composites Technician manufactures flight-critical composite overwrapped pressure vessels (COPVs) used to store high-pressure gases on Starship and Super Heavy. This is a hands-on production role: preparing metallic liners, filament-winding the composite overwrap, curing, and trimming, finishing, and assembling COPV hardware to engineering drawings and process specifications.

This position is onsite at a SpaceX production facility supporting Starship COPV manufacturing. The successful candidate is detail-oriented, comfortable working from travelers and work instructions, and able to produce consistent, high-quality composite work in a fast-paced flight-hardware environment.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Prepare metallic COPV liners and bond interfaces for overwrap, including grit blast, hand abrasion, and power abrasion

• Manufacture COPVs by filament winding composite fiber onto liners, including hoop and helical winding patterns, fiber tension, and resin application (wet winding and/or towpreg)

• Set up, operate, and tend filament winding equipment; load liners, verify winding programs, and monitor fiber path, bandwidth, and resin wet-out during the wrap

• Mix, handle, and apply resins and adhesives per process specification, including pot life, mix ratio, and material traceability

• Cure COPV overwraps and bonded assemblies in ovens or autoclaves, including thermocouple placement and process monitoring

• Trim and finish composite and composite-metallic COPV assemblies to drawing requirements

• Assemble COPV hardware, including setup, bonding, and fastener installation at bosses, fittings, and related structure

• Complete basic layouts on parts and assemblies to establish reference points and verify dimensions using calipers, micrometers, precision scales, and torque wrenches

• Follow travelers, work instructions, and standard operating procedures; record work and nonconformances as required

• Maintain FOD control, material traceability, and a clean, organized work area in a high-rate production environment

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• High school diploma or equivalency certificate

• 1+ years of experience working with in a manufacturing environment

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Experience manufacturing composite overwrapped pressure vessels (COPVs) or other filament-wound pressure-critical hardware

• Experience operating CNC or programmable filament winding machines

• Experience controlling hoop and helical wind patterns, fiber tension, bandwidth, and resin content

• Experience drilling, reaming, honing, and/or countersinking close-tolerance holes, and installing fasteners with the correct tool for the job (drill motor, power screwdriver, C-squeeze, ratchet wrench, nut runner, rivet gun and bucking bar, etc.)

• Experience reading and interpreting engineering drawings, including drawing symbols, flag notes, and general notes

• Ability to follow written and verbal instructions and to work from travelers and SOPs (standard operating procedures)

• Experience with oven or autoclave cure cycles and thermocouple placement

• Experience building flight hardware or other pressure-critical composite structures

• Attention to detail and accuracy while working in a fast-paced production environment

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Must be able to lift and carry up to 25 lbs. unassisted

jobs.title: Fertigation Technician
jobs.description:
At Curaleaf, we’re redefining the cannabis industry with a strong commitment to quality, expertise, and innovation. As a leading global cannabis provider, our brands—including Curaleaf, Select, and Grassroots—offer premium products and services in both medical and adult-use markets.

Join us at Curaleaf to be part of a high-growth, purpose-driven company that champions corporate social responsibility through our Rooted in Good initiative, supporting community outreach and positive change. Here, you’ll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact, drive innovation, and help shape the future of cannabis.

Title: Fertigation Technician
Pay Range: $17.50-$19.75/hr
Location: Phoenix, AZ
Job Type: Full Time | Non-Exempt
Shift: Saturday - Wednesday | 5:00 AM - 1:30 PM

Who You Are:
You’re someone who takes ownership of your work, notices the small details, and doesn’t wait to be told twice — if something looks off, you investigate and correct it. You’re comfortable working independently (including weekends) and understand that fertigation accuracy directly impacts plant health and yield. You enjoy hands-on work, staying organized, and keeping systems running smoothly. You follow SOPs, ask questions when needed, and bring forward solutions, not just problems. Experience in cannabis cultivation or irrigation is helpful, but a willingness to learn, take initiative, and stay consistent in data logging matters just as much.

What You’ll Do:

As a Fertigation Technician at Curaleaf, you’ll support our cultivation team by managing daily irrigation and nutrient delivery to ensure healthy plants and consistent feed schedules across the facility. You’ll be hands-on with our fertigation systems, monitor and record irrigation metrics, and keep equipment, tanks, and lines clean and functioning properly.

• Operate and maintain fertigation systems and batch tanks.

• Prepare and mix daily nutrient feed for flower rooms.

• Monitor runoff/catch systems and verify correct pH/EC.

• Use solus reader for spot checks and log all irrigation data in Aroya/Growlink.

• Track feed volume, pH, EC, VWC, and root-zone EC for irrigation zones.

• Keep cultivar-specific notes on feed schedules, irrigation shot counts, and observations.

• Clean and sanitize batch tanks and irrigation lines regularly.

• Maintain fertigation equipment, workspace, and nutrient inventory par levels.

• Pull irrigation data daily and escalate issues quickly if readings fall outside range.

• Prepare line-cleaning solutions during harvest cycles.

What You’ll Bring:

• Comfortable working independently, including weekend coverage.

• Strong attention to detail and consistency with data logging.

• Initiative — you notice issues, troubleshoot, and communicate proactively.

• Ability to follow SOPs, stay organized, and maintain a clean workspace.

• Experience with irrigation, nutrient systems, or cultivation is a plus (not required).

• Basic understanding of pH/EC or willingness to learn quickly.

• Ability to perform physical labor (lift/move equipment, bend/stand for long periods).

• Reliable attendance and a team-first mindset.

Physical Requirements & Work Environment:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

• This position has allergen warnings, potential exposure to dust, pollen, and plant pathogens, and requires daily use of provided PPE, such as masks, hair nets, beard covers, respirators, boot covers, scrubs, non-slip shoes, and Tyvek suits as necessary, has exposure to loud noises, including but not limited to air compressors, packaging equipment, and alarms, has exposure to CO2 manufacturing procedures at OSHA approved CO2 levels, requires high-stress tolerance, adaptability, and flexibility, as well as the ability to work in an ever-changing environment.

• While performing the duties of this Job, the employee is regularly required to stand, walk, sit, talk, use hands to finger or feel, reach with hands and arms. The employee is occasionally required to climb and balance, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, and lift up to 50 lbs.

• This position requires close vision, distance vision, color vision, distance vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

Curaleaf Pay Transparency

$17.50—$19.75 USD

• Competitive Pay and Benefits

• Generous PTO and Parental Leave

• 401(K) Retirement Plan

• Life/ Disability Insurance

Benefits vary by state, role type, and eligibility.

jobs.title: Robotics Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Company Overview

At Skild AI, we are building the world's first general purpose robotic intelligence that is robust and adapts to unseen scenarios without failing. We believe massive scale through data-driven machine learning is the key to unlocking these capabilities for the widespread deployment of robots within society. Our team consists of individuals with varying levels of experience and backgrounds, from new graduates to domain experts. Relevant industry experience is important, but ultimately less so than your demonstrated abilities and attitude. We are looking for passionate individuals who are eager to explore uncharted waters and contribute to our innovative projects.

Position Overview

We are seeking a Robotics Systems Engineer to own the system-level architecture, integration, and reliability of a new robotic platform. You will work across mechanical design, electrical integration, embedded firmware, and ML policy deployment. You will shape product architecture decisions and prove the platform is ready through testing against external standards and internal targets.

Responsibilities

• Define system-level specifications, interfaces, power budgets, and sensor suites across diverse robot morphologies, including quadrupeds, humanoids, and custom mobility platforms.

• Drive hands-on bring-up of new sensors, compute payloads, actuation systems, and custom power distribution architectures on third-party and in-house robotic hardware.

• Build hardware qualification pipelines, end-of-line functional tests, and diagnostic frameworks to verify system readiness before field deployment.

• Perform FMEA and run rapid root-cause investigations on hardware failures seen in field operation or aggressive policy stress testing.

• Partner with ML research engineers, mechanical design teams, and manufacturing technicians to turn software performance goals into hardware requirements and physical test fixtures.

• Standardize sensor sync protocols, communication topologies (CAN bus, EtherCAT, Ethernet, GMSL), and cabling architectures for hardware survivability in high-impact industrial operations.

Preferred Qualifications

• 5+ years of experience in systems engineering, mechatronics, or robotics hardware development.

• Strong fluency across mechanical assemblies, custom wire harnessing, power electronics, sensor integration (LiDAR, depth cameras, IMUs, encoders, load cells, force/torque sensors), and embedded communication protocols (CAN, EtherCAT, SPI, UART, GMSL).

• Proficiency with Linux-based robotics tools (ROS/ROS2, system telemetry), bench debugging equipment (multimeters, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers), and test scripting in Python/C++.

• Proven experience taking complex electromechanical or robotic products from zero-to-one prototyping through verification and high-reliability field deployment.

• Experience deploying ML policies or AI-driven control loops directly onto physical hardware.

• Hands-on experience with industrial functional safety standards (ISO 13849, IEC 61508) or EMI/EMC compliance for mobility platforms.

• Background with high-performance BLDC actuators, cycloidal/harmonic drive gearboxes, and high-density battery management systems.

• Thrives in fast-paced startup environments with ambiguous requirements and tight iteration loops.

Base Salary Range

$175,000—$275,000 USD

jobs.title: Staff Data Engineer
jobs.description:
About Us

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.

About the Team

Launched in 2021, Fanatics Betting and Gaming is the online and retail sports betting subsidiary of Fanatics, a global digital sports platform. The Fanatics Sportsbook is available to 95% of the addressable online sports bettor market in the U.S. Fanatics Casino is currently available online in Michigan, New Jersey, Pennsylvania and West Virginia. Fanatics Betting and Gaming operates twenty-two retail sports betting locations, including the only sportsbook inside an NFL stadium at Northwest Stadium. Fanatics Betting and Gaming is headquartered in New York with offices in Denver, Leeds and Dublin.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Staff Data Engineer to join our Data Engineering team, which builds and governs the data foundation that powers the business. You’ll set technical direction for our stack (Python ingestion pipelines, Airflow orchestration, and Snowflake/Databricks) and make sure data moves reliably, securely, and cost-effectively from source to decision-ready output.

This is a senior individual-contributor role with broad scope and influence. You’ll own the architecture of our most critical data systems, define the standards the team builds against, and take on novel, ambiguous, high-stakes problems that don’t have a runbook. You’ll be accountable for outcomes, not just deliverables.

Responsibilities

• Own the architecture and design of ingestion pipelines, orchestration frameworks, and data delivery systems, producing design docs that DE2s, DE3s, and senior engineers can implement against

• Define and evolve the team’s frameworks, conventions, and reference patterns for pipelines, Airflow DAGs, testing, monitoring, and catalog registration so new sources onboard quickly and consistently

• Lead diagnosis of the novel data integrity, performance, and reliability problems that escalate past senior engineers, driving systemic fixes and turning recurring failures into runbooks, automation, or better design

• Set and track reliability standards (SLOs, alerting, on-call health) and reduce operational toil

• Lead data security and governance strategy, including PII masking, RBAC, data classification, and lineage, in partnership with Security, Legal, and Compliance

• Design reverse ETL and data delivery integrations (e.g., Segment, LaunchDarkly, Kafka, S3) with clear SLAs, downstream-impact analysis, and failure-handling guarantees

• Drive platform decisions on Snowflake, Databricks, and AWS, including cost optimization, capacity planning, and build-vs-buy evaluation

• Lead spec and design review, anticipating downstream impact, race conditions, idempotency gaps, and failure modes before code is written, and review high-risk PRs with rigor

• Partner with BI, Data Science, Product, and business leadership to turn ambiguous requirements into scalable solutions, prioritize competing demands, and shape the roadmap

• Mentor engineers at every level, represent the team in cross-functional forums, pay down technical debt, and participate in hiring

Experience and Skills

• 8+ years of professional software or data engineering experience, including significant experience owning production data platforms at scale

• A track record of designing and delivering large, cross-team data systems from ambiguous requirements through production operation

• Expert-level Python and SQL, with deep experience in ETL/ELT patterns for complex, high-volume transformations

• Deep expertise in Airflow / Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow, including DAG design at scale and operational best practices

• Strong command of pipeline fundamentals: idempotency, backfills, schema evolution, late-arriving data, data quality frameworks, and failure recovery

• Hands-on experience with several of Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, dbt, Tableau, MongoDB, and PostgreSQL, with the judgment to choose the right tool for the job

• Experience building data security and governance capabilities (PII masking, RBAC, catalog/lineage) and reusable pipeline frameworks that other engineers extend

• Strong testing, CI/CD, and code review practices, and the ability to set those standards for a team

• Proven ability to mentor engineers, influence without authority, and build alignment across teams

• Excellent written and verbal communication, including design docs, tradeoff analysis, and incident write-ups

Nice to Have

• Experience with reverse ETL, real-time or streaming data (e.g., Kafka), and observability tooling (e.g., Datadog)

• Experience with FinOps and cost governance on cloud data platforms

• Background in gaming, betting, e-commerce, or another regulated industry, including audit, compliance, and responsible handling of PII

jobs.description:
About Us

Twitch is the world’s biggest live streaming service, with global communities built around gaming, entertainment, music, sports, cooking, and more. It is where thousands of communities come together for whatever, every day.

We’re about community, inside and out. You’ll find coworkers who are eager to team up, collaborate, and smash (or elegantly solve) problems together. We’re on a quest to empower live communities, so if this sounds good to you, see what we’re up to on LinkedIn and X,  and discover the projects we’re solving on our Blog. Be sure to explore our Interviewing Guide to learn how to ace our interview process.

About the Team

We're a dynamic group of security engineers passionate about creating resilient, intelligent systems. Our team is committed to developing innovative technologies that protect and empower live streaming communities worldwide. We value collaboration, continuous learning, and making meaningful impact through sophisticated technical solutions.

About the Role

Twitch Security Platform builds and operates the foundational software, data, and automation that enable security at scale across Twitch. As a Software Development Engineer I (SDE I) on the Security Platform team, you will design, build, and operate critical services, pipelines, and tooling that power Twitch's security, privacy, and compliance programs.

In this role, you will work at the intersection of software, security, privacy, and data engineering, contributing production systems that handle large-scale security telemetry, automate security workflows, and provide reliable data and services to internal teams. You will partner closely with engineers and product teams to solve real-world security problems through well-designed software..

This role is ideal for an engineer who learns quickly, values operational excellence, and wants to see their work directly improve Twitch's security posture.

You Will:

• Work with technical program managers, technical leads, and other engineers to design, develop, launch, and operate security and privacy software

• Work backwards from security and privacy problems to drive business impact

• Maintain and improve our existing backend services.

You Have:

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Business Technology Enablement
jobs.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

We are looking for a Senior Manager to lead BizTech Enablement and Innovation (BEI), BizTech's solutions partner to the rest of the company. BEI works with Finance, Legal, People, Marketing, Global Operations, Policy and Communications, Design, and other non-technical functions to understand how they work, turn their problems into working solutions, and make sure employees know about and adopt the technology BizTech provides. The team also brings what it learns back to BizTech product teams and vendors to shape their roadmaps. You will report to the Director, Tech Foundations.

The Difference You Will Make:

This is a strategic leadership role within a large business unit. For the next 18 months, the team's focus is AI. You will own the company's approach to AI adoption and impact outside of Engineering, set the vision for AI-enabled work, hold functions accountable to measurable outcomes, and serve as BizTech's primary partner to E-Team leaders on AI transformation.

More broadly, you will lead how Airbnb's non-technical functions discover, adopt, and get value from business technology. That covers quick consultations and fast-track solutions, go-to-market for new BizTech services, and building or buying new solutions where existing tools fall short. In the near term, you will define where Airbnb should be on AI-enabled work in two years, build the team and partnerships to get there, and make the trade-offs required to deliver it.

Success in this role is measured in business outcomes, not tool rollouts: functions that have redesigned their work around technology and AI, defined their own impact metrics, and can show the efficiency and quality gains, supported by a simpler tool landscape with fewer duplicate and unsupported tools.

A Typical Day:

• Help define and own the multi-year strategy for AI adoption and impact across Airbnb's non-technical functions, aligned with company and Tech priorities.

• Assess current gaps, existing capabilities, and emerging AI trends to anticipate how functions will need to work 18 to 24 months out, and translate that into a roadmap and investment.

• Simplify the tools business teams use by steering them to supported solutions and closing the gaps that lead them to find their own.

• Set organizational OKRs and success criteria for near and long-term initiatives, and hold teams and partners accountable for delivery.

• Make and communicate hard trade-offs across competing functional demands, platform constraints, and budget.

• Serve as the senior BizTech partner to leadership teams on AI transformation, including regular readouts to executives and senior Tech leadership.

• Establish the framework by which each function defines, measures, and reports the business impact of AI, and drive adoption of that framework as a standard.

• Build a metric-driven accountability culture: clear baselines, targets, and ownership for every function, with a single trusted source of truth for adoption and impact data.

• Tailor narratives for different audiences, from detailed methodology with data and engineering partners to concise decision framing for executives.

• Seek feedback from partner teams and use it to improve delivery; raise risks to leadership early.

• Listen actively and anticipate where change will meet resistance.

• Design and continuously refine the operating model that connects different technical functions and networks into one coordinated enablement system.

• Shape the enablement approach for AI usage so functions can build and share AI solutions at scale.

• Partner with platform and product teams to influence the AI tooling roadmap based on the needs of non-technical users.

• Direct external partner and consulting engagements, including scope, governance, and return on investment.

• Set quality, reliability, and security standards for the AI solutions the team and functions build; own operational issues in production and drive the fixes that prevent repeats.

• Make sure tech debt and the long-term upkeep of shipped solutions are prioritized across the team's roadmap.

• Lead a multi-disciplinary, globally distributed organization including managers, Business Solutions Engineers, Systems Architects, and Program Managers.

• Create a team environment that values constructive debate, risk-taking, and learning from experiments, and that fosters belonging across regions.

• Build an 18+ month talent plan and a succession pipeline, including hiring at L10 and above.

• Coach, mentor, and grow the team to communicate clearly, resolve conflict early, and build inclusive teams.

• Pilot new technologies, including AI, with business teams, and hand proven solutions to product owners for long-term support.

• Coach leaders across functions to connect AI capabilities to business value.

• Establish mechanisms that turn learnings from individual functions into reusable patterns across the company.

• Represent BizTech in company-wide AI forums and contribute to hiring committees, talent processes, and Airbnb's internal AI community.

• Role model Airbnb's core values and strengthen the company's mission through the way AI is introduced to employees.

Your Expertise:

• 12+ years of industry experience in business technology, enterprise systems, digital transformation, or technical program leadership, including 5+ years leading managers and multi-disciplinary teams.

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

• Demonstrated track record setting and delivering multi-year strategy for a company-wide technology or transformation program with executive visibility.

• Experience leading business technology consulting, solutions engineering, or IT business partnering for non-technical teams, including influencing product and vendor roadmaps.

• Experience owning the quality, reliability, and support of technology solutions in production.

• Experience building trusted relationships with, and influencing, C-level and E-Team executives, including the ability to align or challenge senior leaders on priorities.

• Deep, hands-on understanding of generative AI tools and agentic workflows, and how they change the nature of non-technical work.

• Strong analytical judgment: able to define measurement frameworks, interpret adoption and impact data, and ensure data quality and credibility at an executive level.

• Proven ability to lead through ambiguity and rapid change, including shifting org structures, evolving technology, and competing priorities.

• Experience designing operating models across multiple teams and organizations without direct authority.

• Experience attracting, hiring, and developing senior talent and managers across regions.

• Preferred: experience leading enterprise AI adoption or change management at a large technology company.

• Preferred: experience managing external consulting partners and globally distributed teams.

• Preferred: ability to travel as needed, approximately 10 to 20%.

Your Location:

This position is US - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. While the position is Remote Eligible, you must live in a state where Airbnb, Inc. has a registered entity. Click here for the up-to-date list of excluded states. This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list. If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from.

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com. Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process.

We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application.

Equal Employment Opportunity:

Airbnb values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Airbnb are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, gender, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic.

How We'll Take Care of You:

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

Pay Range

$204,000—$255,000 USD

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing.  We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

jobs.title: Plaintiff Mid-Market II / Enterprise Account Executive
jobs.description:
The Role

You'll drive Everlaw's growth by uncovering, developing, and closing net new business across both new and existing accounts within the Plaintiff space. In this role, you will lead complex sales cycles from initial discovery through contract execution, demonstrating how our platform meets the litigation and case management needs of law firms.

This is a full-time, exempt position based in our Oakland, CA office with a hybrid work schedule: in office M/W/Th, work from home on Tu/Fr.

What you'll do

• Take over an active, existing territory to build a healthy pipeline and achieve consistent quota targets via new customers and existing client upsells.

• Lead end-to-end sales cycles for Plaintiff accounts.

• Continue selling into accounts you close and already in-territory clients you adopt.

• Meet directly with prospects and existing clients via Zoom, in-person at law firms, or at industry conferences and plaintiff events.

• Collaborate with cross-functional partners across Solutions Architecture, Customer Success, Business Development, Marketing, and Legal to execute complex, multi-firm joint deals.

About You

• You have at least 2 years of successful full-cycle sales experience selling to mid-market accounts or any size law firm.

• You bring a track record of actively closing net new pipeline while collaborating with team members on joint deals.

• You are skilled in conducting thorough discovery and presenting customized proposals to senior leadership.

• You are available to travel throughout your territory and the U.S. for client meetings and industry events.

• You are authorized to work in the United States. Please note that at this time, Everlaw is not sponsoring U.S. employment visas for this role.

Bonus points

• Experience selling legal technology or selling directly to Plaintiff law firms.

• Experience upselling current client accounts.

• Experience with transactional, usage-based, or multi-year commitment commercial models.

Think you're missing some of the skills and are hesitant to apply? We do not believe in the 'perfect' candidate and encourage you to apply if you feel you can bring value to our team. We often revisit candidates who may have applied for a different role if something comes up that's a better fit.

The Team — Sales

The Sales team brings Everlaw to organizations that feel the pain of complex legal work most acutely. Across law firms, corporations, and the public sector, the team uses thoughtful discovery, tailored demonstrations, and well-managed evaluations to connect customer needs with clear, provable value. Sales is the bridge between a genuinely differentiated product and the organizations ready to transform how they uncover truth.

Total Rewards & Benefits

The annual base salary for this position is between $100,000 - $125,000, with a total On-Target Earnings (OTE) of $200,000 - $250,000. The variable component is performance-based, contingent upon attainment of specific sales objectives, which are governed by Everlaw's policies and incentive plans. The role's compensation is subject to change in the future.

Health & well-being

• Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage

• Flexible Spending Accounts for health and dependent care expenses

• Membership to Modern Health to support mental health and wellness

• Paid parental leave

• Company-sponsored life and disability insurance

Financial rewards

• Competitive equity grants, so you share in Everlaw's long-term growth

• 401(k) plan with company matching of up to 4% of eligible annual compensation

Growth & everyday perks

• 17 paid vacation days, 11 federal holidays, and paid sick leave

• Four "Everlawlidays" (additional paid company-wide days off) per year

• Annual allocation for learning & development and relevant professional membership dues

• Hybrid work with regular work-from-home days and flexibility for life's logistics

• Monthly home internet reimbursement, plus a stipend for your desk setup

• Catered lunch each workday, plus snacks and company-wide events in our offices

About Everlaw

When a lawsuit or investigation happens, teams must comb through vast amounts of electronic evidence — emails, documents, chats, files — to find what matters. That work is not a side task but the case itself, and where most of the time and money in litigation goes. Everlaw is the litigation and investigation management platform changing that, using AI to turn mountains of messy data into the handful of facts that win or lose a case, compressing weeks of work into hours.

We're the kind of place that's ranked #1 on G2 in our category and named a Great Place to Work™ by our own team. So if you want a front row seat to an industry in transformation, career-defining work you'll be proud to tell people about, and real upside at a company in control of its own destiny, we'd love to get to know you.

• #LI-Hybrid

​​About Everlaw

At Everlaw, you'll shape how AI re-wires the legal industry, at a category-leading business built on a mission to illuminate the truth.

Everlaw is an equal opportunity employer. We pride ourselves on having a diverse workforce and we do not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law. jobs.title: General Manager - Site Operations
jobs.description:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes  and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

• We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.

• Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.

• Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE:
Site Leader, Warehouse

As the Site Leader, Warehouse at Quince.com, you will play a pivotal role in overseeing our fulfillment center operations, driving performance while fostering a positive and safe work environment within a rapidly growing business and a 100,000 square foot facility. Leading a dynamic team that includes two Operations Managers, two Area Managers, and up to 1,000 hourly Associates, you'll be responsible for budget management, people development, and achieving operational objectives. You will oversee daily operations, lead continuous improvement initiatives, and ensure exceptional customer satisfaction. This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of our operations and contribute to a collaborative, results-driven team culture.

Responsibilities

• Lead and manage all aspects of site operations, including performance, quality, safety, and customer experience across inbound receiving, inventory management, and outbound fulfillment departments.

• Foster a culture of continuous improvement by implementing Lean and Six Sigma methodologies, driving process enhancements and quality initiatives that optimize throughput and accuracy.

• Set performance goals for your team, provide coaching and feedback, and ensure alignment with company objectives and network KPIs.

• Manage performance KPIs including on-time dispatch, inventory accuracy, labor productivity, and shrink, identifying and tracking key metrics to enhance operational efficiency.

• Use data-driven insights and analytics to identify areas for improvement, optimize picking and packing operations, and implement strategies to increase throughput while maintaining quality standards.

• Ensure all safety standards and compliance regulations are followed, creating a secure working environment for all team members and minimizing incidents and injuries.

• Oversee staffing, including recruitment, training, performance management, and the development of team members to build a strong operational bench.

• Cultivate positive employee relations, support career development, and promote a strong leadership pipeline within the organization.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams (HR, Finance, IT, Facilities, Logistics) to ensure resource availability and support for key projects and initiatives.

• Share best practices, operational innovations, and lessons learned with other facilities and headquarters to drive consistency and operational excellence across the network.

• Manage the operational P&L for the site, ensuring cost control, budget adherence, and working capital efficiency.

Qualifications

Required

• Bachelor's Degree in Business, Operations, Supply Chain, or a related field

• 7+ years of leadership experience in distribution, e-commerce fulfillment, or manufacturing environments, including at least 2 years in a senior management role

• Proven track record of driving operational performance, process improvement, and team development

• Experience managing performance metrics, budgets, and P&Ls in a warehouse or fulfillment setting

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, Gmail, and Excel

• Ability to manage a diverse team and provide ongoing coaching and mentorship

• Flexibility to work varying hours, including weekends, holidays, and overnight shifts as required

Preferred

• Master's Degree in Business Administration (MBA) or related field

• Certification in Lean, Six Sigma, or similar process improvement methodologies

• Experience managing both salaried and hourly workforces in a large-scale distribution or fulfillment center

• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to handle changing priorities in a fast-paced environment

• Experience with warehouse management systems (WMS) and fulfillment metrics

• Interest in long-term career development through assignments across multiple facilities

Physical Requirements

• Ability to lift and move totes up to 49 pounds each

• Frequent bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching

• Standing and walking for an average of 5 miles per day

• Ability to work in distribution/warehouse environments (e.g., noisy, unlit, unheated, non-air-conditioned)

All posted ranges are reflective of base salary and may vary depending upon experience level and location. Bonus and equity may also be provided for eligible roles.

Pay Range

$148,000—$189,000 USD

WHY QUINCE?

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY

Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds

At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.

jobs.title: Post-Implementation Consultant - Sales Territory Software (Remote)
jobs.description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
 
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
 
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
 
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.


The Role
Veeva Vault CRM Align is a field planning application for roster management, territory management, engagement planning, and integrated field feedback, and it provides future alignment and engagement plans into our agentic CRM. We are looking for a strong consultant who can serve as a trusted advisor and expert for our customers on the product.

jobs.title: Manager, Paralympics Planning and Operations
jobs.description:
LA28 does not provide relocation assistance for any positions. If you are based outside the Los Angeles area, we still welcome your application — we value talent from all geographic backgrounds and want to hear from you if you are able to work on-site in LA.

LA28 is the independent, non-profit, privately funded organizing committee for the Los Angeles 2028 Olympic and Paralympic Games. We are on a singular mission to create an Olympic and Paralympic Games that celebrate all that this city and country have to offer, delivering an unparalleled experience for athletes, fans, partners and our community.

The 2028 Games mark the return of the Summer Games to the U.S. for the first time in 32 years and Los Angeles’ third time hosting an Olympic Games and first time welcoming the Paralympic Games. This presents the unique and exciting opportunity to celebrate our legacy with the Games and push the Olympic and Paralympic Movements forward, writing a new chapter of Games history in Los Angeles.

Putting on an Olympic and Paralympic Games is a team sport. To build a Games unlike any the world has seen before, we need the best team in place–a team full of perspectives, experiences and expertise. We are guided by the following set of values and behaviors–optimism, integrity, excellence, inclusion, co-creation and boldness–and look forward to hearing about how your past experiences align with them.

Manager, Paralympics Planning and Operations

Role Purpose

In 2028, Los Angeles welcomes the Paralympic Games for the first time, and every Para athlete deserves venues shaped around the demands of their sport. As Manager, Paralympics Planning and Operations, you will help build the Paralympic sport foundations of LA28 from the ground up, making sure competition and training venues meet sport and discipline needs. You will collaborate with Sport Managers and design, Event Management and Venue Infrastructure teammates, turning specialist knowledge into practical, accessible plans that create an inclusive Games.

Key Responsibilities

• Liaise with Paralympic Sport Managers and LA28 design teams to shape the development and design of competition and training venues.

• Develop policies, procedures and operational tools that support Paralympic sport planning and delivery.

• Identify gaps and shortfalls in Paralympic sport and venue planning before they affect athletes.

• Collaborate with Sport Managers and Event Management (EVM) and Venue Infrastructure (VNI) teams on practical, cost-effective solutions.

• Support budgets and project plans with validated sport- and discipline-specific information and planning assumptions.

Required Competencies

• Minimum 5+ years of experience delivering national and international level sporting events in a leadership role, from grassroots to professional levels.

• Expertise in sport venue delivery, including International Federation (IF), IOC and IPC training venue requirements and cross-functional venue design collaboration.

• Extensive experience recruiting and leading a large and diverse event workforce, and considering diverse groups of athletes in sport planning.

• Extremely detail-oriented, organized and independent problem-solver, fluent in Microsoft Office suite products, including Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.

• Demonstrated commitment to co-creation and collaborative decision-making.

Valued Experience

• Direct sport experience at a previous OCOG or multi-sport Games.

• Extensive knowledge of IFs and the Olympic and Paralympic Movements.

• Ability to implement and manage change effectively.

• Self-starter balancing assertiveness with diplomacy.

• Innovative mindset that challenges the status quo.

What We Offer

• Help deliver the first Paralympic Games in Los Angeles, with visible athlete impact.

• Gain exposure to International Federations and global sporting events.

• Work alongside sport, venue and operations teammates, sharing every success.

• Develop transferable multi-sport venue planning skills that last beyond 2028.

What This Role Means for the Games

Para athletes will compete in Los Angeles for the first time in 2028. This role helps ensure their training and competition venues reflect how ability, gender and identity shape each athlete's experience, leaving a lasting legacy for the community.

Physical Requirements & Working Conditions

• Available to work onsite in our Downtown Los Angeles-based office.

• The majority of work will be conducted in an office setting, requiring extended periods of time using computers, phones, and other office equipment.

• The LA28 office is an open floorplan working environment; employees must be able to work efficiently in an open cubicle environment.

• Hours of work may vary, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, especially during peak event periods.

• Perform other duties as required; the role will evolve over time and may include operational responsibilities during the Olympic and Paralympic Games.

• Travel internationally once or twice yearly for one to two weeks (20% or less of working hours); a valid passport is required.

• Travel domestically up to three times yearly and locally up to twice monthly for IF and NGB events and venue visits.

Compensation

The annual base salary range for this position is $88,000 - $115,000. The pay scale provided is the range that LA28 reasonably expects to pay as starting base compensation for this role. All LA28 compensation remains subject to final determination based on individual candidate qualifications, experience, or other reasonable criteria consistent with LA28's operational business needs and applicable law.

Accommodation

LA28 is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. If you require an accommodation at any stage, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

Equal Opportunity

LA28 is committed to fair and unbiased recruitment procedures allowing all applicants an equal opportunity for employment, free from discrimination on the basis of religion, race, sex, age, sexual orientation, disability, color, ethnic or national origin, or any other classification as may be protected by applicable law. LA28 will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance and all applicable laws. We strive to build a team that is inclusive and encourage qualified candidates of all backgrounds, perspectives, and identities to apply. We assess applications based on relevant skills, education, and experience a candidate can add to our team.

jobs.title: Deburr Technician

Opportunity

Brunswick Group is seeking a curious, resourceful, and ambitious Executive to join our U.S. Digital practice.

Our Digital team helps some of the world's most influential organizations navigate complex communications challenges, build and protect their reputations, and engage the audiences that matter most in an increasingly digital world.

This is a role for a self-starter who is eager to learn, thrives in a fast-paced environment, brings intellectual curiosity and creativity to complex challenges, and is driven to deliver outstanding results. If you want to help some of the world's leading organizations navigate their most consequential challenges – from M&A and crisis to corporate positioning and reputation – Brunswick offers a platform unlike any other in our industry.

About the Role

As an Executive, you will work alongside experienced advisers to support a diverse portfolio of clients and high-stakes issues. You will contribute to research, strategic recommendations and hands-on execution, developing the skills to become a trusted digital adviser.

• Client Contribution & Handling Support the development and execution of digital communications strategies across a range of high-stakes issues, including corporate reputation, financial situations, litigation, crisis, and public affairs. Draft high-quality client materials, including strategy presentations, research reports, messaging, campaign plans, and performance updates. Analyze online conversations, media coverage, platform activity, and other sources of intelligence, translating findings into clear, actionable insights. Support the planning, implementation, and evaluation of digital campaigns across paid, owned, and earned channels. Leverage digital analytics, social listening, AI, and other research tools to support client work and uncover emerging risks and opportunities. Contribute creative ideas and practical recommendations to client discussions, brainstorms, and new business pitches. Leverage in-house AI tools and other resources to manage workload and keep deliverables on track, on time, and of the highest quality.

• Teamwork and Collaborative Approach Collaborate with colleagues across Brunswick, bringing digital expertise to integrated client teams. Proactively share relevant digital developments, emerging trends, platform changes, and new technologies with colleagues. Take ownership of assigned responsibilities, anticipate team needs, and contribute solutions without waiting to be asked. Develop strong working relationships with colleagues and clients, demonstrating professionalism, responsiveness, and discretion. Participate in and contribute to training sessions where appropriate and take advantage of the learning and engagement opportunities Brunswick provides.

What We're Looking For

At Brunswick, we seek smart and curious individuals dedicated to learning and growth. We value potential, strong work ethic, sound judgement, and excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Standout Executive candidates demonstrate:

• 1-3 years of relevant professional experience; experience in strategic communications, campaigns, digital marketing, or an agency environment a strong plus.

• Experience working on paid digital campaigns, social media management, and digital content development.

• Working familiarity with digital analytics, social listening, or audience research tools (such as Google analytics, Sprinklr, Brandwatch).

• Experience using AI and large language models to support research and analysis.

• A strong understanding of the digital media landscape, including major social and LLM platforms, online communities, the creator economy, and emerging technologies, and familiarity with online formats, features, and content conventions.

• An interest in business, current affairs, and the issues affecting major corporations and their leaders.

• Excellent research, analytical, writing, and verbal communication skills.

• Resourcefulness and proactivity, with the curiosity and agility to tackle unfamiliar challenges, learn quickly, and find creative, practical solutions.

• Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage competing priorities and deliver high-quality work in a fast-paced environment.

• A collaborative, entrepreneurial mindset.

• Sound judgment and discretion when handling sensitive or confidential information.

Why Join Us

Whether you are joining a client facing team, a core services team, or starting out on your professional career journey, joining Brunswick unlocks a range of exceptional employee benefits to support your financial future, health and wellness, family and community and continuous professional development.

The successful applicant will be eligible for the following compensation and benefits package:

Base Pay: The annual base compensation range for this role is $70,000 - $80,000. The base pay offered will be determined by factors including experience, skills, training, office location, certifications, and education.

Bonus Eligibility: Annual discretionary bonus contingent upon individual and firm-wide performance.

Benefits: Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance. Disability insurance. Employee assistance program. Flexible spending account. Health savings account. Life insurance. Commuter Benefits. Generous Paid Time Off: 25 vacation days and 10 days sick leave, as well as 11 paid company holidays. Firm-sponsored 401(k) Plan with 3% automatic company contribution of base and bonus with an additional 1.5% profit share– immediate vesting. Career training and development opportunities. Employee discounts.

Office Policy: At Brunswick, our work is a craft that thrives in teaching environments – whether in our offices or on-site with clients – through real-time observation, collaboration, human connection, clear guidance and by challenging one another to keep getting better. Our policy is that our team members are in person – either in the office or on-site with clients – at least four days each week.

The firm will provide reasonable accommodation to qualified applicants or employees, as defined by applicable law. In addition to the application, the process may include virtual and in-person interviews, as well as an assessment, which may be timed. To request an accommodation during our application and hiring process, email americasaccommodations@brunswickgroup.com.

About Brunswick

Brunswick is a global advisory firm. We help companies tackle high-stakes issues, navigate complex stakeholder relationships, and deliver high-impact outcomes.

Our clients value our ability to anticipate, shape, and respond to the key players and forces in the financial and investment arena, regulatory and geopolitical universe, NGO community, workforce and beyond. They rely on us for deep experience, fresh perspectives and original thinking. So, in Brunswick you will find an exceptional range of experience and talent with a rich mix of backgrounds. From the beginning, we have prioritized attracting, developing, and retaining the best professionals in the industry, united by a culture of inclusivity, excellence, and intellectual curiosity.

Founded in 1987 in London, the firm has organically grown to 27 offices in 18 countries across the Americas, Europe, Middle East, Africa, Asia and Australia. We operate as a “one-firm firm” with no individual profit centers. This allows us to assemble fully integrated, bespoke teams for each client, able to draw on the full resources of Brunswick anywhere in the world.

Brunswick is an equal opportunity employer.  All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, pregnancy, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law. Please read our Global Privacy Notice to understand how your data is managed.
