jobs.title: Remote Bilingual Clinical Psychologist (Spanish) – Older Adults (PhD, PsyD)
jobs.description:
Do the work you trained for, without the parts that burn you out. Sailor Health is hiring bilingual English/Spanish licensed clinical psychologists to provide telehealth therapy to Spanish-speaking older adults, fully from home. We fill your caseload, handle billing and admin, and give you real clinical support, so your time goes to patients. Don't just take our word for it: read what our psychologists say in our Indeed reviews.




🌊 ABOUT SAILOR HEALTH

Older adults are too often overlooked by mental healthcare, and those who speak Spanish face even fewer options. Sailor Health exists to change that. Through Medicare-covered therapy, care navigation, and healthcare advocacy, we help older adults move through grief, loss, isolation, and life's hardest transitions with more ease and peace of mind.

Our model is built around their needs and yours:

 - We handle everything outside the session. Care Navigators and Healthcare Advocates take on patients' non-clinical needs, so your work stays clinical.

 - You're part of a team. Clinical Quality Leads provide ongoing consultation, and our provider support team answers questions as they come up.

 - Language-concordant care by design. Spanish-speaking patients are matched with Spanish-speaking clinicians. You won't be working through an interpreter or translating for the rest of the team.




⭐ THE POSITION

Location: Fully remote, anywhere in the U.S. | Schedule: You set it, 7 days a week available

We're hiring bilingual licensed clinical psychologists (PhD or PsyD) for part-time or full-time roles, paid per session. Choose the setup that fits your life:

 - 1099 contractor: starting at 15 hours per week

 - W2 employee: starting at 25 hours per week, with full benefits




💙 WHAT WE OFFER

 - A full caseload, built for you. Share your availability and we'll match you with Spanish-speaking older adults who fit your approach. No marketing, no chasing referrals. Most clinicians have a full caseload within a few weeks.

 - Support that's actually there. A dedicated clinical lead and live admin help. Our providers tell us it's the most supported they've felt in telehealth.

 - Your schedule, your call. Work the days and hours that suit you. No on-call, no required evenings.

 - Less paperwork, more therapy. Our telehealth platform and AI documentation assistant handle the busywork.

 - Room to grow. Free CEs, geriatric-focused training, and clinical consultation with experienced directors.

 - Pay that works for you. 1099 clinicians earn competitive per-session rates, paid as full cash compensation.

 - Full benefits for W2 clinicians (25+ hours/week). Health, dental, and vision coverage, plus a 401(k) with up to 3.5% employer match.




💻 YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Provide evidence-based psychotherapy to Spanish-speaking older adults via telehealth

 - Conduct sessions fluently in Spanish, meeting patients in their language and cultural context

 - Build individualized treatment plans around each patient's goals and needs

 - Manage your own caseload and clinical decisions, with a supportive care team behind you

 - Complete documentation in our EMR, with AI-assisted notes

 - Join regular, paid case consultations with experienced clinical leaders




📋 QUALIFICATIONS

 - Must be located in the United States

 - Doctoral degree in psychology (PhD or PsyD) from an APA-accredited program

 - Active, independent license to practice psychology in the state where this role is posted

 - Fluent in English and Spanish, able to conduct full therapy sessions in Spanish

 - Experience with older adult or geriatric populations preferred

 - Comfortable with telehealth platforms and electronic health records

 - Medicare billing experience a plus (we handle billing either way)




✅ WHO THRIVES AT SAILOR

 - You care about the mission. Supporting older adults through grief, loss, and the challenges of later life feels meaningful to you.

 - You know what language access means clinically. Meeting a patient in their native language is one of the most powerful things a psychologist can offer, especially in later life.

 - You understand this population. Maybe you've spent years working with older adults, or you're later in your own career and chose this work on purpose.

 - You do your best work on a team. You want colleagues, a clinical lead, and real support, not just a login and good wishes.

 - You like independence with backup. You trust your clinical judgment and want infrastructure behind you, not oversight on top of you.




🚀 APPLY TODAY

If you want a full caseload, a flexible schedule, and a team that has your back while you serve Spanish-speaking older adults in their own language, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today, and our recruiting team will guide you through every step of the process.

Learn more: https://www.sailorhealth.com/careers/therapy

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
About Us:

Lovelace is the only provider of enterprise-scale context engines capable of analyzing trillions of real-time data points to create knowledge graphs that are usable by autonomous agents at the speed, scale, and accuracy required for mission-critical analysis. 

Lovelace’s context engine platform, Elemental, uniquely integrates data ingestion, entity resolution, and graph building into a single pipeline that empower agentic deployments, delivering 1000X the investigative power for complex queries. With its proprietary ground-breaking YottaGraph, Lovelace provides enterprises with real-time, real-world context, enabling agents to understand the impact of global intelligence on enterprise data for unmatched insights with millisecond precision. 

Founded in 2023 by Andrew Moore, former head of Google Cloud AI, dean of Carnegie Mellon’s School of Computer Science, and first AI advisor for U.S. CENTCOM, Lovelace currently works with some of the largest public and private enterprises in the world.

Job Summary:

 - As a Machine Learning Engineer, you'll own ML problems end to end, from framing an ambiguous question to shipping a production system. There's no ticket queue and no narrow scope: everyone here, including newer engineers, stands up new jobs and makes changes across the codebase without close supervision. You'll decide what data matters, which models fit, and how the system around them should work. The role is roughly half research and half engineering, on a team that reports to our Chief Scientist.
   
   At Lovelace, every engineer is a manager of AI. Our engineers work alongside AI coding agents every day, and the most valuable thing you'll bring is judgment: knowing what to build, catching when an agent gets it wrong, and owning the design decisions.
   
   We're looking for people who ramp in weeks, not months. You don't need industry experience; strong research lab backgrounds are welcome. What matters is that you've owned hard problems and can think critically about your own work and your agents'.

Key Responsibilities:

 - Frame ambiguous product needs as precise ML problems, and set your own requirements.

 - Decide what data is useful, which model types fit, and when to go beyond fine-tuning.

 - Direct AI coding agents, review their output critically, and push back when their design decisions are wrong.

 - Design the systems around your models: data pipelines, serving, evaluation, and monitoring.

 - Choose metrics that reflect real outcomes, and catch when they mislead.

 - Stand up new jobs, make changes across the codebase, and ship NLP and LLM systems to production, owning their correctness.

 - Challenge assumptions, including teammates' and your own, to get to the right answer.

Qualifications:

 - A track record of owning ambiguous problems end to end, in a research lab, a startup, or your own projects.

 - Strong ML fundamentals, from probabilistic foundations to modern deep learning and LLM architectures.

 - Experience building the system around a model, not just training it: data pipelines, evaluation, deployment, and how it behaves at scale.

 - Hands-on experience with AI coding agents, and a clear sense of where they go wrong.

 - Expert-level Python and a strong testing discipline. You understand how your code works.

 - The confidence to push back, with evidence, on requirements, teammates, and agents.

Preferred Skills:

 - NLP, knowledge graphs, entity resolution, or agentic systems.

 - Go or other systems programming experience.

 - Open-source contributions, side projects, or publications with working code.

 - Background from a strong research lab. A PhD is welcome but not required.

Benefits:

LovelaceAI offers competitive compensation packages, comprehensive benefits. We provide a supportive and inclusive work environment where your skills and expertise can make a significant impact on the safety and security of our communities.

Lovelace’s founding team includes:

Andrew Moore, who has a track record of building impactful AI systems, designing them with human rights impact assessments as a top priority, leading the AI division of one of the world’s foremost cloud companies, and actively participating in machine learning and AI research over the past two decades.

Toby Smith, well known in the Pittsburgh Tech community for his engineering leadership and design skills, and who has led many of the most ambitious and complex system infrastructure projects in Google Pittsburgh and NetApp.

Here is a note from Andrew Moore to people who are reading these Job Postings:

“Hi folks, I’m so glad you are potentially interested in Lovelace AI. This area means a lot to me because while I am an AI optimist, I also think that we technologists owe it to a rightly skeptical world to show that modern intelligent systems can actually be useful. Usefulness comes in many guises: from life sciences to education and from transportation to entertainment and many others. For many of us, security and public safety is also very high on that list. That reasoning leads to this conclusion: I’m determined to make sure that the people building Lovelace AI gain a lot from the experience, including the chance to solve fascinating problems in computer science, AI, business development, customer success and product management. I also hope that we all learn from each other in a highly enriching work environment. But my main hope is that we have a shared sense of accomplishment as we see an increasing number of national security and public safety domains made safer through sensible and robust use of advanced computer science."

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Copilot
jobs.description:
Twin Health

At Twin Health, we empower people to improve and prevent chronic metabolic diseases, like type 2 diabetes and obesity, with a new standard of care. Twin Health is the only company applying AI Digital Twin technology exclusively toward metabolic health.

We start by building a dynamic model of each person’s metabolism — drawing on thousands of data points from CGMs, smartwatches, and meal logs — that maps their personal path to better health. Guided by a dedicated clinical care team, our members have lowered their A1C below the diabetes range, achieved lasting weight loss, and reduced or even eliminated medications, all while living healthier, happier lives.

Working here

Our team at Twin Health is passionate, talented, and united by a shared purpose: to improve the metabolic health and happiness of our members. We believe in empowering every Twin to make a meaningful impact for our members, our clients, and each other, while enjoying a supportive, collaborative work environment.

Twin has been recognized not only for our innovation but also for our culture, including: Innovator of the Year by the Employer Health Innovation Roundtable (EHIR), selected to CB Insights’ Digital Health 150, and named one of Newsweek’s Top Most Loved Workplace® .

With more than $100 million raised in recent funding, including a $53 million Series E round in 2025 led by Maj Invest, and a $50 million investment in 2023 led by Temasek, Twin is scaling rapidly across the U.S. and globally. Backed by leading venture firms like ICONIQ Growth, Sequoia, Sofina, Temasek, and Peak XV, we are building the most impactful digital health company in the world.

Join us as we reinvent the standard of care in metabolic health.

Opportunity

We are seeking an Engineering Manager to lead our Copilot team. Copilot is our AI-powered platform for clinical operations: it drafts responses, routes member messages, and flags issues so care teams spend less time on administrative work and more time with members.

This is a hands-on management role. You will own the team, the delivery, and the outcomes. You'll stay close enough to the code and architecture to make good technical calls, but your main job is building a team that ships reliable AI-powered products in a regulated healthcare environment.

Responsibilities

• Lead, hire, and grow a team of full-stack engineers. Run 1:1s, set clear expectations, give direct feedback, and invest in each engineer's development and career growth.

• Own delivery for Copilot end-to-end: planning, sequencing, dependencies, and getting work into production on time.

• Partner with Product and Clinical Operations to set priorities, make tradeoffs, and guide the roadmap toward high user impact and service quality, using business impact data and platform health metrics to drive prioritization.

• Set and enforce a high engineering bar, from system architecture that scales with growth down to rigorous design reviews, comprehensive automated testing, and production-grade observability.

• Champion AI-assisted engineering practices to increase the team's impact, velocity, and quality.

• Partner with the team on architecture and design decisions, empowering engineers to own the call while offering guidance where it adds the most value.

• Coordinate with the AI Platform team and other engineering teams on shared infrastructure and integrations.

• Communicate status, risks, and tradeoffs clearly to engineering, product, clinical, and executive audiences.

• Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

• 8+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 2 years directly managing engineers (hiring, performance management, and career development).

• Track record of leading a team through end-to-end delivery of customer-facing products, from definition through launch, measurement, and iteration.

• Strong hands-on backend foundation, including microservices, API design, SQL databases, and event-driven architectures, with the credibility to lead design reviews and guide technical decisions. Python and FastAPI experience is a strong plus.

• Experience architecting and operating production systems at scale: observability, incident management, and performance optimization.

• Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development workflows.

• Experience partnering with Product, Clinical Operations, and business stakeholders, including roadmap governance and prioritization in a high-demand environment.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including explaining technical risk to non-technical audiences.

• Comfortable in a fast-moving, growth-stage environment where priorities shift.

• Experience shipping LLM agents or AI-powered products in production is a plus.

• Experience building products in healthcare or other regulated industries is a plus.

• Familiarity with AWS, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines is a plus.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field.

• This remote opportunity based out of the U.S. Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

Compensation and Benefits

The compensation range for this position is $200,000 - $220,000 annually.

Twin has an ambitious vision to empower people to live healthier and happier lives, and to achieve this purpose, we need the very best people to enhance our cutting-edge technology and medical science, deliver the best possible care, and turn our passion into value for our members, partners and investors. We are committed to delivering an outstanding culture and experience for every Twin employee through a company based on the values of passion, talent, and trust. We offer comprehensive benefits and perks in line with these principles, as well as a high level of flexibility for every Twin

• A competitive compensation package in line with leading technology companies

• A remote and accomplished global team

• Opportunity for equity participation

• Unlimited vacation with manager approval

• 16 weeks of 100% paid parental leave for delivering parents; 8 weeks of 100% paid parental leave for non-delivering parents

• 100% Employer sponsored healthcare, dental, and vision for you, and 80% coverage for your family; Health Savings Account and Flexible Spending Account options

• 401k retirement savings plan

Salary range for US jobs

US Salary Range

$200,000—$220,000 USD

We have been made aware of fraudulent interview requests being sent using the Twin Health's name. All communications will come from official Twin Health channels and a twinhealth.com email address. We will never ask you to complete a text interview or request financial details during the interview process.

jobs.title: Strategic Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
Algolia is the retrieval intelligence layer that turns intent into trusted, decision-grade outcomes. Powering more than 1.7 trillion queries a year for over 18,000 customers with millisecond latency and 99.999% reliability, we are the recognized leader for Search and Product Discovery by top industry analyst firms. The Algolia platform turns a company's products, content, and business rules into data that humans, applications and AI agents can act upon. The result is trusted customer experiences with stronger conversions for measurable business impact.

At Algolia, we are passionate about helping developers & product teams connect their users with what matters most in milliseconds!

We are looking for highly driven individuals with strong technical aptitude and natural sales instincts to join our growing sales organization. As a Strategic Business Development Representative (BDR) at Algolia, you will play a critical role prospecting and expanding both new business and expansion opportunities for our Strategic team. You will take part in a wide variety of responsibilities that will help foster, qualify, and mature our pipeline with high-profile, top logo accounts. We need someone with a hunter attitude who thrives in autonomy.

The accounts on your list are the best of the best, and they are not easy to get into. Their inboxes are crowded, their buying groups are guarded, and generic outreach gets ignored. As a Strategic BDR, your job is to earn the conversation. You will work out why this account, why this person, and why now, then show up with a sharp point of view on where Algolia can improve their search and discovery. That means studying each account's business, tech stack, and trigger events, building multi-threaded plans with your AE, and using every channel and format that cuts through, from a tailored teardown to a screencast or personal video. Our team shares what works and what doesn't, so you'll sharpen fast and help others do the same.

YOUR ROLE WILL CONSIST OF:

• Own the strategy for your Strategic accounts with your Strategic Account Executive, with regular 1:1s to agree on target buyers, entry points, and account plans

• Research each account to understand why they would buy and why now: business priorities, tech stack, search and discovery gaps, and trigger events like replatforms, new leadership, and hiring

• Build a sharp point of view for every account and persona on where Algolia can improve their search and discovery, and bring it to every touch

• Break in with multi-threaded, highly personalized outreach across email, phone, and LinkedIn, plus creative formats like tailored teardowns, screencasts, and personal videos

• Partner with Marketing, ABM, and cross-functional teams on a swarm strategy for top logos, including events and dinners

• Turn conversations into qualified pipeline and keep SFDC current on your activities and results

• Share what works and what doesn't with the team and take part in Sales Development projects

YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF YOU HAVE:

• 1.5+ years of experience in outbound prospecting and pipeline generation (SaaS experience required, Ecommerce experience preferred)

• A self-starter mindset with a competitive drive

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

• Ability to quickly learn and adapt to change

• Demonstrated success overachieving (professionally/personally)

• Comfort working strategically and autonomously alongside Account Executives on high-profile accounts

• An interest in the tech industry

#LI-hybrid

Algolia does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, military status, veteran status, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law.

The annual total cash compensation range (base salary and commission) for this role reflects market pay data within this location. The exact compensation offered for this role may vary depending on specific location and job-related knowledge, technical skills, and experience; and is only one part of our Total Rewards philosophy to compensate and recognize employees for their work.

On-Target Earnings Pay Range

$100,000—$115,000 USD

FLEXIBLE WORKPLACE STRATEGY:

Algolia’s flexible workplace model is designed to empower all Algolians to fulfill our mission to power search and discovery with ease. We place an emphasis on an individual’s impact, contribution, and output, over their physical location. Algolia is a high-trust environment and many of our team members have the autonomy to choose where they want to work and when.

We have a global presence with offices in Paris, NYC, London, Sydney and Bucharest, however we also offer many of our team members the option to work remotely either as fully remote or hybrid-remote employees. Positions listed as "Remote" are only available for remote work within the specified country. Positions listed within a specific city are only available in that location - depending on the role it may be available with either a hybrid-remote or in-office schedule.

WE’RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO CAN LIVE OUR VALUES:

• GRIT - Problem-solving and perseverance capability in an ever-changing and growing environment.

• TRUST - Willingness to trust our co-workers and to take ownership.

• CANDOR - Ability to receive and give constructive feedback.

• CARE - Genuine care about other team members, our clients and the decisions we make in the company.

• HUMILITY - Aptitude for learning from others, putting ego aside.

We’re looking for talented, passionate people to help build the world’s best search and discovery technology. We value autonomy, diversity, and collaboration. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone is respected and supported—regardless of race, age, ancestry, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, color, veteran status, disability, or socioeconomic background.

IMPORTANT NOTICE FOR CANDIDATES - Recruitment Fraud Notice

We’ve recently seen an increase in recruitment scams targeting job seekers. To help protect yourself, please keep the following in mind:

• Our open positions may appear on third-party job boards, but the best way to apply safely is directly through our careers page.

• All genuine communication from Algolia will come from an @algolia.com email address. If you receive an email from someone claiming to work at Algolia who does not have an @algolia.com email address, please do not respond or share any personal information.

• We’ll never ask for payments, purchases, or financial details during the hiring process.

READY TO APPLY?

If you share our values and our enthusiasm for building the world’s best search & discovery technology, we’d love to review your application!

jobs.title: Test Engineer - Electric Propulsion, Satellites (Starlink)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

TEST ENGINEER – ELECTRIC PROPULSION, SATELLITES (STARLINK)

The Electric Propulsion Test Engineer is responsible for ensuring the electric thrusters that propel Starlink satellites and their associated components have been tested and qualified to function in flight conditions. Our engineers specialize in test design and execution of unique development & qualification test campaigns on an accelerated schedule. This role offers a variety of diverse engineering challenges in a fast-paced, hands-on environment. Electric Propulsion Test Engineers will work on state-of-the-art electric thruster technology in an unmatched, high-rate production environment. By designing and executing test campaigns for the system, you will help sustain and improve upon the largest satellite constellation in existence! Join the team and help SpaceX provide global low-latency internet and contribute to our mission of making humanity multiplanetary.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Develop and execute rigorous tests at the system, thruster, and component-level to evaluate hardware performance and survivability during the Starlink mission.

• Repeated ownership of test campaigns, including test plan creation, new system activation, test operations, data review, and test stand/diagnostic equipment design & fabrication.

• Provide daily direction and instruction to technicians to build test articles, fabricate test stands and test stand equipment, integrate test articles and execute test processes.

• Develop and maintain test procedures, sequences, scripts, configuration files, and software.

• Operate and troubleshoot data acquisition and control systems, wiring, and instrumentation with primarily Beckhoff/TwinCat DAQ systems and python-based test software.

• Operate and troubleshoot electric thrusters and supporting equipment, including high-vacuum facilities, pressurized feed systems, avionics circuits, and thruster diagnostics.

• Design, operate, and fabricate mechanical systems for thruster ground support; these include test stand support structures, heat exchangers, vacuum pumps, tooling, and fluid/electronic components such as valves, tubing, and transient protection circuitry.

• Execute the scientific method repeatedly in a R&D context, with an emphasis on minimizing asterisks and unknowns, and maximizing clear, actionable conclusions to inform improvements in propulsion system reliability and performance.

• Manage schedules and deliverables for vehicle subsystem qualification testing; document & present results and conclusions clearly and explain technical details to wide audiences.

• Develop innovative processes to increase testing capability and rates, while maintaining quality and rigor of experimental learnings. Automate repetitive test operations to increase efficiency and safety.

• Anticipate and characterize system pitfalls and potential hazards, work to resolve problems by collaborating with design engineers on improvements for test stands and flight hardware.

• Analyze and review data to ensure that hardware is operating as expected utilizing numerical data analysis tools to interpret test results.

• Develop, maintain, and execute integration and testing process, and collaborate with design engineers to improve hardware.

• Collaborate with hardware reliability team to lead experiments to inform anomaly investigations.

• Collaborate with software teams to minimize exceptions between ground test and flight operations through safe, efficient, and readable software.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, aerospace engineering, physics, or related STEM field.

• 1+ years of hands-on hardware experience (experience from internships, clubs or other hands-on extra-curricular activities qualifies)

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Experience in production and test systems

• Hands on test and production facility, factory, or laboratory experience

• Hardware automation software experience, including DAQ setup and instrumentation networking with logic controllers

• Mechanical aptitude and experience

• Knowledge and/or experience in aerospace structural or mechanical or propulsion systems assembly and testing

• Ability to utilize test instrumentation and control components: pressure transducers, thermocouples, RTDs, strain gauges, accelerometers, flow meters, load cells, relays, solenoid valves, basic circuits

• Ability to solve problems calling for technical analysis

• Ability to read and understand technical manuals and reports

• Ability to read and understand mechanical and electrical schematics

• Knowledge of hazardous systems and safety practices - cryogenic, flammable, high-voltage, high-pressure

• Knowledge of high-pressure system design and handling

• Experience using test instrumentation and control components

• Windows Operating Systems, Intermediate skill level

• Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, OneNote), Intermediate skill level

• Python, Intermediate/advanced skill level

• CAD modeling (Unigraphics NX preferred), Novice skill level

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

Who we are

Herself Health provides primary care designed for women 65 and older. Our model addresses the needs of women later in life, including post-menopausal care, bone health, weight management, and mental, social and emotional well-being. We bring personalized care and meaningful relationships to the communities we serve.

Our Mission: We deliver exceptional, compassionate, and high value advanced primary care for the unique needs of maturing women, empower HER to live a healthier, fuller life.

How you will work

We look for colleagues who put patients first, collaborate across teams and take ownership of their work. You bring curiosity, sound judgment and a willingness to learn, using feedback and data to improve how we care for patients and support one another.

Curious, Always Learning — We ask questions, seek feedback and keep improving.

About the role

The Medical Records & Referral Coordinator manages medical records workflows and coordinates outgoing specialty referrals to support timely, accurate and compliant patient care. This role oversees Release of Information (ROI) requests, tracks incoming and outgoing records, and helps close referral loops within the electronic medical record (EMR). • Maintain organized tracking workflows to prevent gaps in care while protecting patient confidentiality.

• Support medical records audits, chart preparation and records-related quality improvement initiatives.

• Track outgoing specialty referrals through completion; coordinate with specialists and confirm patient scheduling.

• Obtain specialist consultation notes, document them in the patient chart and partner with clinical teams to close referral loops.

What you bring

Required qualifications

• High school diploma or equivalent.

• Experience with electronic medical record (EMR) systems, knowledge of HIPAA and medical records processes, and strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

• Authorization to work in the United States.

Preferred qualifications

• Experience with Release of Information (ROI) workflows or coordinating referrals and care transitions; Athena EMR experience is a plus.

jobs.title: Staff Technical Product Manager, Configuration Management
jobs.description:
At Relativity Space, we’re building rockets to serve today’s needs and tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that’s just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known.

Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven’t been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you’re in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you’ll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we’re writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it’s early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us.

About the Team:

The Reliability team at Relativity Space ensures quality is built into every stage of the Terran R design and production process, embedding reliability from the very beginning. The team works directly with design, manufacturing, test, and launch teams to stay close to the hardware, understand constraints, and proactively shape decisions. As the program moves from development into production and scaled operations, this is the time to establish the right processes, controls, and systems without slowing progress. The team plays a key role in balancing risk, fostering a culture of ownership, and making sure speed never comes at the cost of reliability. Success means creating a quality system that scales with the Terran R program and Relativity as a whole.

About the Role:

As a Staff Technical Product Manager, Configuration Management, you will own the strategy, architecture, and evolution of enterprise-wide configuration management systems and workflows supporting the Terran R program. You will drive the development of scalable solutions that ensure product configuration accuracy, engineering change control, and end-to-end traceability across design, manufacturing, test, and launch. This role combines technical product management, systems engineering, and software integration, requiring a deep understanding of complex hardware development and the ability to translate operational challenges into reliable, automated, and scalable technical solutions.

• Define and own the technical strategy, roadmap, and architecture for configuration management systems and workflows, ensuring scalability, reliability, and alignment with engineering, manufacturing, and business requirements.

• Architect and optimize end-to-end configuration management processes, including engineering change management, product structure and bill of materials (BOM) management, revision control, configuration baselines, and product lifecycle traceability.

• Lead the development and integration of enterprise systems, including PLM, ERP, and MES platforms, to establish a consistent, accurate source of product configuration data across the organization.

• Partner with engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, reliability, and software teams to translate complex technical and operational requirements into scalable software solutions that improve efficiency, data integrity, and change execution.

• Drive automation and digital transformation initiatives that streamline engineering change workflows, eliminate manual processes, and improve visibility into product configurations throughout the hardware lifecycle.

• Establish and enforce configuration management standards, data governance practices, and change control processes to ensure consistency, traceability, and compliance across the Terran R program.

About You:

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline.

• 8+ years of experience in technical product management, systems engineering, software engineering, or a related technical role within an advanced manufacturing or complex hardware development environment.

• Deep understanding of configuration management principles, including engineering change control, BOM management, product structures, revision control, and configuration baselines.

• Experience designing, implementing, or integrating enterprise systems such as PLM, ERP, or MES, with a strong understanding of how engineering data flows across manufacturing and supply chain operations.

• Proficiency in programming languages or technical tools such as Python, SQL, JavaScript, Java, or C#, with the ability to understand system architecture, data models, and integration requirements.

• Demonstrated ability to lead complex, cross-functional technical initiatives, influence stakeholders, and develop scalable solutions that balance engineering rigor with operational efficiency.

jobs.title: Remote Clinical Psychologist – Older Adults (PSYPACT)
jobs.description:
Do the work you trained for, without the parts that burn you out. Sailor Health is hiring PSYPACT-authorized clinical psychologists to provide telehealth therapy to older adults across participating states, fully from home. Your PSYPACT authorization means more patients, more flexibility, and a caseload that fills fast. We handle the rest: billing, admin, and real clinical support, so your time goes to patients. Don’t just take our word for it: read what our clinicians say in our Indeed reviews.




🌊 ABOUT SAILOR HEALTH

Older adults are too often overlooked by mental healthcare. Sailor Health exists to change that. Through Medicare-covered therapy, care navigation, and healthcare advocacy, we help older adults move through grief, loss, isolation, and life’s hardest transitions with more ease and peace of mind.

Our model is built around their needs and yours:

 - We handle everything outside the session. Care Navigators and Healthcare Advocates take on patients’ non-clinical needs, so your work stays clinical.

 - You’re part of a team. Clinical Quality Leads provide ongoing consultation, and our provider support team answers questions as they come up.

 - Demand is steady. We serve patients in all 50 states, with a consistent flow of referrals.




⭐ THE POSITION

Location: Fully remote, anywhere in the U.S. | Schedule: You set it, 7 days a week available

We’re hiring PSYPACT-authorized clinical psychologists (PhD or PsyD) for part-time or full-time roles, paid per session. You’ll see patients across PSYPACT states, so your schedule fills faster than it would with a single-state license. Choose the setup that fits your life:

 - 1099 contractor: starting at 15 hours per week

 - W2 employee: starting at 25 hours per week, with full benefits




💙 WHAT WE OFFER

 - Put your PSYPACT authorization to work. We serve older adults across participating states, so your authorization turns directly into a fuller, more flexible caseload.

 - A full caseload, built for you. Share your availability and we’ll match you with patients who fit. No marketing, no chasing referrals. Most clinicians have a full caseload within a few weeks.

 - Support that’s actually there. A dedicated clinical lead and live admin help. Our providers tell us it’s the most supported they’ve felt in telehealth.

 - Your schedule, your call. Work the days and hours that suit you. No on-call, no required evenings.

 - Less paperwork, more therapy. Our telehealth platform and AI documentation assistant handle the busywork.

 - Room to grow. Free CEs, geriatric-focused training, and clinical consultation with experienced directors.

 - Pay that works for you. 1099 clinicians earn competitive per-session rates, paid as full cash compensation.

 - Full benefits for W2 clinicians (25+ hours/week). Health, dental, and vision coverage, plus a 401(k) with up to 3.5% employer match.




💻 YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Provide evidence-based psychotherapy to older adults via telehealth across PSYPACT states

 - Build individualized treatment plans around each patient’s goals and needs

 - Manage your own caseload and clinical decisions, with a supportive care team behind you

 - Complete documentation in our EMR, with AI-assisted notes

 - Join regular, paid case consultations with experienced clinical leaders




📋 QUALIFICATIONS

 - Must be located in the United States

 - Doctoral degree in psychology (PhD or PsyD) from an APA-accredited program

 - Active, independent license to practice psychology in a PSYPACT participating state

 - Active PSYPACT Authority to Practice Interjurisdictional Telepsychology (APIT). Don’t have it yet? We’ll reimburse your initial application fees.

 - Experience with older adult or geriatric populations preferred

 - Comfortable with telehealth platforms and electronic health records

 - Medicare billing experience a plus (we handle billing either way)




✅ WHO THRIVES AT SAILOR

 - You care about the mission. Supporting older adults through grief, loss, and the challenges of later life feels meaningful to you.

 - You understand this population. Maybe you’ve spent years working with older adults, or you’re later in your own career and chose this work on purpose.

 - You do your best work on a team. You want colleagues, a clinical lead, and real support, not just a login and good wishes.

 - You like independence with backup. You trust your clinical judgment and want infrastructure behind you, not oversight on top of you.




🚀 APPLY TODAY

If you want a full caseload across PSYPACT states, a flexible schedule, and a team that has your back while you do meaningful work with older adults, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today, and our recruiting team will guide you through every step of the process.

Learn more: https://www.sailorhealth.com/careers/therapy

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Ledger
jobs.description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

What You’ll Do:

Join the Roblox Ledger team and build the system of record for a global economy. Our north star is that all movement of value on Roblox is tracked on the Ledger, and that every unit of value — virtual currency, fiat, or digital asset — is accurately tracked, perfectly balanced, and fully auditable. That makes the Ledger the trusted foundation for our users, creators, and economy.

We are the source of truth for the economy in both directions: every write of value, and every read of it. The same authoritative record that settles a transaction also has to answer the questions people ask about it — balances, history, statements, reconciliation, and analytics — so that read paths do not drift from the book of record. Robux already runs entirely on our zero-balanced, double-entry ledger, and Creator Wallets launch in December 2026. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design, build, and scale the systems that make this true, in a domain where correctness is the product rather than a feature.

You Have:

• 4+ years of backend software engineering experience, demonstrating proficiency in designing, building, and maintaining robust and scalable systems (e.g., microservices, APIs).

• Strong problem-solving skills and experience debugging complex issues in distributed systems.

• Experience in managing projects, planning and executing work across different workstreams.

• Strong collaboration skills, ability to work across teams and organizations, mentoring and guiding junior engineers.

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a similar technical field.

• Experience in financial infrastructure, ledgers, accounting, or another domain where accuracy is non-negotiable is highly desirable. Experience building a ledger or double-entry system at another company is a strong plus.

• Experience with large-scale data or analytical systems (OLAP, event-driven pipelines, or similar) is a plus but not a requirement.

You will:

• Work closely with Finance, product, and other economy engineering teams to make every movement of value correct at the source.

• Architect, design, implement, and operate the ledger services that record every movement of value on Roblox.

• Proactively identify and address correctness, performance, auditability, and operational risks in systems where a single bad entry is a financial incident.

• Design idempotent, exactly-once write paths, plus the reconciliation that proves the books balance and the precision guarantees other teams build on.

• Own both sides of the ledger: the write path that records value, and the read path that serves balances, history, and analytics from the same source of truth.

• Uphold high standards for code quality, test coverage, and maintainability, fostering the culture of engineering excellence.

jobs.description:
Tremendous is the global platform built for businesses to send thousands of payouts to anyone, anywhere, for free. We're trusted by 20,000 leading organizations like Atlassian, MIT, and United Way to deliver gift cards and money to millions of recipients worldwide.

In both our product and our workplace, we're intentional about making work more efficient, flexible, and fulfilling. Tremendous is a fully remote, high-documentation, low-meeting culture, which means more time for what matters in both your professional and personal life.

Our customers, who include researchers, marketers, HR teams, and nonprofits, rave about how fast and easy it is to use Tremendous. Check out our ratings on G2 https://www.g2.com/products/tremendous/reviews.

Tremendous is profitable and growing without outside investors.



About the role

We're looking for a GTM Engineering Manager to lead our team of GTM engineers. Our Revenue Operations team works like a product and engineering org: planners define what marketing, sales, and customer success need, and GTM engineers design and build it with LLMs, workflow tools, and code. You'll own how that team works: its standards, its infrastructure, and the growth of the people on it. You'll stay hands-on, building the systems that make the whole team faster.



What you'll do

 - Manage and develop a team of GTM engineers across marketing, sales, and platform work. Hire the next ones.

 - Set the team's engineering practices: version control, review, documentation, and ownership for every workflow, agent, and integration in production.

 - Build the team's own infrastructure, including the agents and tooling that keep work assigned, tracked, and current.

 - Partner with GTM planners on the roadmap: bring the build-side view on what's feasible and how to sequence it, and put the right builder on the right project.

 - Act as the team's ambassador to our AI enablement engineering team, and shape how work moves from a GTM engineering prototype to long-term engineering ownership.

 - Own relationships with the technical vendors the team builds on, such as Cargo.



What you'll bring

 - 7+ years across RevOps, GTM engineering, marketing or sales ops engineering, or internal tools, with real hands-on building.

 - 2+ years managing builders or technical roles, with people you've grown into stronger roles.

 - You're a capable builder yourself: AI agents, workflow tools (Cargo, Clay, n8n, Zapier, or similar), APIs, webhooks, and Git.

 - Engineering-manager instincts: you've set up review, documentation, and rollback practices on systems other people depend on.

 - Fluency across the GTM funnel: marketing, sales, and customer success.

 - Strong written communication. We're a documentation-first culture.

 - Autonomous and self-directed. Tremendous is not a great fit for people who default to waiting for instructions.

 - High empathy. You care about your teammates and the people who use what your team builds.



Nice to haves

 - HubSpot depth, especially workflows and APIs

 - Cursor, Claude, or similar AI-assisted development as a daily habit

 - SQL and Snowflake

 - Experience standing up a GTM engineering or RevOps engineering team from a few people

 - Usage-based or fintech GTM experience



What's cool about the role

 - The team already exists and is shipping. You're making a strong team faster, not starting from scratch.

 - The company is AI-forward. Cursor daily, regular AI tool evaluations, leadership fully bought in.

 - Profitable and growing without outside investors.

 - Competitive pay, equity, and benefits. Base salary: $190,000-$230,000

 - Fully remote. This role is US Remote.

 - Smart people and a great culture. See our company handbook https://handbook.tremendous.com/.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer, T&E
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Design at Brex

Design at Brex creates the experiences that make complex systems feel effortless through thoughtful, scalable design. Whether crafting interfaces, shaping product strategy, or harnessing AI to empower our users, we obsess over quality and clarity. This is a team for designers who want to build, not just talk about building. We ship constantly, use AI to move faster, and care deeply about craft. Product designers at Brex partner closely with Product, Engineering, Research, Data, and Go-to-Market teams to solve high-stakes problems for ambitious companies that rely on Brex to run their finances.

What you’ll do

As a Senior Product Designer, you’ll lead ambiguous, cross-functional product work from problem definition through shipped execution. You’ll turn complex financial workflows into clear, intuitive experiences that help customers move faster, make better decisions, and trust the systems they use every day.

You’ll be expected to operate with high ownership and low oversight: identifying what needs to be true, breaking ambiguity into actionable paths, facilitating alignment across partners, and shipping iteratively toward measurable customer and business outcomes. You’ll bring strong craft, product judgment, and systems thinking to the work — raising the quality of both the product experience and the way the team designs.

About the team

The Travel & Expenses design team designs how employees spend, report, and get reimbursed, and how finance teams set and enforce the rules behind it. Our work covers travel booking, expense management, reimbursements, and the policy and compliance tools that sit underneath them.

Most of our customers don’t think about this software until something goes wrong: a receipt is missing, a reimbursement hasn’t arrived, a trip falls outside policy. Our job is to make those moments clear and quick for employees, and to give finance teams the control and visibility they need without adding work for everyone else. We’re also building AI agents that handle the manual parts of expenses and compliance, and we design how those agents behave, explain themselves, and recover when they’re wrong.

Responsibilities

• Own the design direction for a core area of travel and expenses and set a vision and roadmap for it with Product and Engineering.

• Take loosely defined problems and decide what needs to be true, what to build first, and what to leave out. Turn them into clear scope, milestones, and shippable increments.

• Define the underlying models (states, transitions, edge cases) before designing screens, so the product behaves consistently across surfaces, and bring those models to the other teams that depend on them.

• Plan, run, and synthesize your own research, and use customer feedback and data to make and validate design decisions.

• Design AI-assisted experiences, including how an agent asks for confirmation, explains what it did, and lets people fix mistakes.

• Partner with Product and Engineering as an equal on scope, sequencing, and tradeoffs. Raise risks early and keep design involved through build.

• Work across team boundaries on shared components, policy rules, and payment flows. Resolve conflicts before they reach engineering, and represent design in cross-team planning.

• Raise the quality bar for the team through critique, clear standards for content, color, and component states, and contributions to the design system.

• Mentor other designers through feedback, pairing, and sharing how you approach ambiguous problems.

• Present work and rationale clearly to leadership, partners, and customers, and document decisions so others can build on them.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our San Francisco, Seattle, or New York City office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work.

Requirements

• Strong portfolio of shipped product work, ideally across complex workflows, systems, or customer-facing business software.

• Experience independently leading ambiguous product initiatives and turning loosely defined problems into clear, executable plans.

• Strong product thinking, including the ability to connect design decisions to customer needs, business goals, and measurable outcomes.

• High craft across UX, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, and systems thinking.

• Experience partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Research, Data, and other cross-functional partners throughout the product development process.

• Ability to facilitate discussions, synthesize inputs, communicate tradeoffs, and build alignment across stakeholders.

• Comfort operating in a fast-moving environment where priorities evolve and designers are expected to bias toward learning, iteration, and shipped impact.

• Clear communication, strong feedback habits, and a collaborative approach to improving both your own work and the work of others.

Bonus points

• Experience designing financial products, developer tools, enterprise software, or other complex B2B workflows.

• Experience using AI tools for prototyping, research synthesis, design exploration, or day-to-day workflow acceleration.

• Experience contributing to or evolving a design system at scale.

• Experience conducting or partnering on generative and evaluative research.

• Strong ability to translate complex product, technical, or business constraints into simple customer experiences.

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $192,000 - $240,000. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

jobs.title: Sr Manager, Real Estate and Workplace
jobs.description:
About ALSO.

We’re ALSO, an electric mobility company originally conceived as a part of Rivian. We’re a passionate team of builders, dreamers, doers and innovators, focused on creating entirely new (not to mention, innovative and delightful) vertically integrated, small EVs designed to meet the global mobility challenges of today and tomorrow. Our mission is to inspire everyone to ride ALSO—replacing many local car, truck and SUV miles with ones on vehicles that are more affordable, more enjoyable and 10-50x more efficient.



ALSO is seeking an execution-driven Sr Manager, Real Estate & Workplace, to lead workplace strategy, projects, programs, and teams based in our Palo Alto HQ for a global multi-site portfolio spanning office, R&D labs, commercial hubs, and retail.


This role owns team leadership, strategic planning, critical project execution, and executive-level representation alongside the Director, partnering daily with IT, Engineering, Purchasing, Finance, Legal, Insurance, People, and cross functional key stakeholders. Success requires ability to prioritize in a fast-paced environment, drive R&D projects to execution, disciplined governance, financial rigor, 3rd party management, and the ability to anticipate space and workplace service needs (ie, mail, logistics, culinary, janitorial, and moves). Onsite 3-5 days/week, with off-hours availability for time-sensitive and critical issues.



What You Will Do 

Team & Program Leadership

 - Lead the Real Estate & Workplace team (operations, facilities, mail, logistics, culinary, janitorial) as deputy lead, balancing competing priorities with long-term focus.

 - Manage projects end to end, including portfolio administration, R&D lab build-outs, workplace programs, and occupancy data.

Strategic Space Planning & Occupancy Analysis

 - Own headcount and occupancy analysis, turning hiring plans and growth into space strategy, capacity models, and scenarios.

 - Drive long-range workplace strategy and partner with Finance and Analytics on forecasting and tradeoff recommendations to leadership.

Vendor, Contract & Budget Management

 - Manage vendors, consultants, landlords, and GCs with negotiation and financial accountability.

 - Own budget tracking, forecasting, and RFPs with Purchasing and Finance, and oversee lease transactions end to end with Legal and Risk.

Cross-Functional Partnership

 - Act as the connective tissue across IT, Engineering, Purchasing, Finance, Legal/Compliance, Analytics, and G&A.

 - Support Executive Assistants on space, logistics, and events, and communicate credibly with landlords, brokers, executives, and building inspectors.

Technical R&D Project Delivery & Operations

 - Coordinate lab infrastructure and equipment installs with Engineering and vendors.

 - Partner with the IT and EHS & Security Manager on life-safety and compliance, and serve as a point of contact for after-hours facilities emergencies.

Process Governance & Data Enablement

 - Implement standard PM frameworks, ticketing, and KPI/milestone dashboards.

 - Adopt new technology and AI-assisted tools to streamline workflows as the portfolio grows.



What You Will Bring 

 - 7+ years of progressive real estate, workplace, or facilities operations experience, with demonstrated growth from individual execution into a leadership scope.

 - Track record leading teams and operating as a trusted second-in-command.

 - Comfortable partnering across IT, Engineering, Finance, Legal, and Purchasing, and communicating credibly from AHJs to executives.

 - Working knowledge of commercial leases, vendor contracts, and budget/financial management.

 - Comfortable with ambiguity and fast-changing priorities; adaptable to new technology, software, and AI-assisted tools.

 - Familiarity with EHS, physical security concepts, and specialized lab/R&D infrastructure preferred (this role partners with a dedicated EHS & Security Manager rather than owning those programs directly).

 - Experience scaling high-tech, EV, or R&D lab environments strongly preferred.

 - Able to respond to occasional off-hours emergencies.



The salary for this position ranges from $200,000 - $220,000 per year, depending on experience, qualifications, and location.


Perks and Benefits

 - Robust health coverage. Excellent health, dental and vision insurance covered up to 100% by Also. with FSA & HSA options.

 - One Medical membership and dedicated insurance advocates.

 - Rich fertility and family building benefits with Progyny.

 - Flexible time off. 

 - 401(k) match.



Why ALSO.

We’re passionate about helping the world find a better way to get there—wherever it is you’re headed.

We’re located in the heart of Silicon Valley and have brought together a world-class team from some of the biggest brands in the technology, automotive, cycling, outdoor recreation and retail spaces. 

Together we’re working hands-on to imagine, design and build an entirely new solution to a global set of transportation challenges.

🚀 About WRITER

WRITER is the AI platform built for the world’s most ambitious marketing and revenue teams, bringing the frontier of AI to the people who drive enterprise growth. With WRITER, autonomous agents work across the buyer journey, continuously executing on market signals and enterprise intelligence to grow revenue faster. Every agent action and asset is grounded in trust, built on an Enterprise Brain that unites brand, product, and company knowledge with fiduciary-grade governance and compliance.



Fortune 500 companies are transforming how they go to market with WRITER, including 3 of the top 5 US banks, 2 of the 5 largest global CPG conglomerates, and 4 of the top 5 US healthcare insurers. Founded in 2020, WRITER is backed by investors including Insight Partners, ICONIQ, Radical Ventures, Premji Invest, Balderton, B Capital, Salesforce Ventures, Adobe Ventures, Accenture, Citi Ventures, IBM Ventures, WndrCo, and others. Learn more at WRITER.com http://WRITER.com.



📐 About the role

We're looking for a proactive and highly organized administrative assistant to act as a force multiplier for our executive operations. In this role, you'll provide general administrative support across the Office of Executive Operations, with primary support to our Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) and Chief of Staff. Sitting at the intersection of security, engineering, and executive leadership, you'll help ensure our leaders move at the speed of AI by streamlining operations and anticipating needs before they arise.



You'll serve as a gatekeeper and primary contact, managing internal and external communications with the discretion required for a high-growth organization. Whether you're coordinating internal team offsites and other org-related events, coordinating agenda items and speaker presentations for all-hands meetings, or assisting with the Office of Executive Operations running smoothly, your work will directly enable our leaders to focus on scaling the future of generative AI.



This is a remote role with occasional travel to the NYC office (as-needed), working east-coast hours. You will report to the Chief of Staff and work closely with the Office of the CTO and other cross-functional team members.



🦸🏻‍♀️ What you'll do

 - Own and optimize the daily calendar for the CISO by resolving complex scheduling conflicts and ensuring he’s prepared for every commitment

 - Build and maintain seamless workflows across the EPD (engineering, product, and design) organization by managing all hands meetings, user research outreach, and special projects

 - Drive the end-to-end logistics for team events, security summits, and leadership offsites including vendor coordination and agenda preparation

 - Shape the rhythm of the business by preparing executive reports, compiling data for decks, and managing highly confidential files related to security and personnel

 - Lead the coordination between internal stakeholders and external partners to accelerate security initiatives and collaborative technical projects

 - Create a supportive environment for the CISO’s direct reports to ensure departmental alignment and operational consistency and overall contribution to the EPD

 - Ad Hoc Executive and Personal Support (Manage expense reports, assist with occasional personal & family scheduling, support additional ad hoc administrative and personal requests as needed)



⭐️ What you need

 - 3+ years of experience as an administrative assistant or executive assistant, ideally within a fast-paced technology company or high-growth startup

 - Mastery of Google Workspace and modern calendar management tools with a knack for navigating complex, shifting priorities

 - Exceptional organizational skills and the ability to juggle multiple high-priority tasks without letting the details slip

 - Strong interpersonal and communication skills that allow you to Connect deeply with stakeholders across the company

 - A proactive, builder mindset that drives you to Challenge the status quo and find more efficient ways to operate

 - High level of discretion and emotional intelligence when handling sensitive security and personnel information

 - A deep sense of accountability and the desire to Own your projects from start to finish in an ambiguous, rapid-growth environment

jobs.title: Strategic Transactions Lead
jobs.description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it. 


We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.


We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!




HOW WE OPERATE

 - Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

 - Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

 - Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

 - Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

 - Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.




THE COMMERCIAL TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

 - Close gigawatt deals faster than anyone on the planet. The customers building frontier AI need capacity now, and the ones who lock it first win. You'll take deals from first conversation to signature at a pace the market can't match.

 - Sign 10s of GW of deals by the end of the decade. Every deal is measured in gigawatts, not megawatts, and the goal is to sign more capacity this decade than anyone in the market.

 - Own everything from LOI to site mobilization. No handoffs, no dropped context. You'll run the whole process, from a signed LOI through to mobilizing the site, and keep it moving the entire way.
   
    


ROLE SCOPE

 - Close billion-dollar transactions from LOI to signature in weeks across leases, colocation deals, EPC contracts, and utility commitments.

 - Quarterback every deal across legal, finance, engineering, networking, and construction with 15+ stakeholders and 5+ workstreams running in parallel.

 - Run the daily operating rhythm of syncs, decisions, escalations, and tracker updates that keeps every workstream aligned and surfaces issues weeks before they hit the schedule.

 - Operate with full trust from the CEO and senior leadership, making commitments on Fluidstack's behalf in rooms where the company's roadmap is being set.

 - Hand off signed agreements to delivery, deployment, and construction teams cleanly with no dropped terms and no surprises six months in.
   
    


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/fluidstack/05c2e69c-42f9-4fcb-9cf0-a467aaf98f1c.

 - You've personally closed complex, multi-party deals where the precedent didn't exist and the playbook is something you wrote.

 - You've negotiated commercial terms against counterparties who don't share your urgency: utilities, EPCs, AHJs, design firms, customers.

 - You quarterback across legal, finance, engineering, and operations without losing momentum, and you're the person other teams call when a deal is stuck.

 - You write and speak clearly enough to distill a complex issue into a decision and a next step for a CEO, a counterparty, or a customer.

 - Deal tracking, documentation, and process discipline are habits, not afterthoughts. You don't lose terms in the noise of a 20-thread deal.

 - Bonus: Data center capacity deals (colo, powered shell, build-to-suit, wholesale, leases). AI infrastructure constraints. Utility and power market dynamics. EPC and design-firm contract structures.
   
    


SALARY & BENEFITS

 - Competitive total compensation package (salary + equity).

 - Retirement or pension plan, in line with local norms.

 - Health, dental, and vision insurance.

 - Generous PTO policy, in line with local norms.

 



We are committed to pay equity and transparency.

Fluidstack is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Fluidstack will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.


Applicant Privacy Notice https://fluidstack.io/legal/applicant-privacy-notice
AI Screening Notice https://fluidstack.io/legal/ai-screening-notice
Ashby Bias Audit https://fluidstack.io/legal/ashby-bias-audit



You will receive a confirmation email once your application has successfully been accepted. If there is an error with your submission and you did not receive a confirmation email, please email careers@fluidstack.io with your resume/CV, the role you've applied for, and the date you submitted your application--  someone from our recruiting team will be in touch.

jobs.title: Customer Experience Specialist, USA
jobs.description:
ABOUT HALTER

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard. 

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund https://foundersfund.com, Bessemer Venture Partners https://www.bvp.com/, BOND, https://www.bondcap.com/ DCVC https://www.dcvc.com/, Blackbird https://www.blackbird.vc/, Promus Ventures https://www.promusventures.com/, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures https://www.icehouseventures.co.nz/?utm_term=icehouse%20ventures&utm_campaign=Brand+Keywords&utm_source=adwords&utm_medium=ppc&hsa_acc=4064636360&hsa_cam=16902737884&hsa_grp=134004309485&hsa_ad=592971340272&hsa_src=g&hsa_tgt=kwd-1082530126230&hsa_kw=icehouse%20ventures&hsa_mt=b&hsa_net=adwords&hsa_ver=3&gclid=Cj0KCQjw2v-gBhC1ARIsAOQdKY0J0DepRVFDmjQlAkJPbZuQnLSA5UVzUzOXYiPxkjX-SeVa513_BhkaAr-MEALw_wcB.

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/halter-limited & Instagram https://www.instagram.com/lifeathalter/.

About the role

We’re looking for an epic Customer Experience Specialist to join our Boulder team. Customer Experience at Halter isn’t a call centre. It’s a team of problem-solvers who understand our ranchers, our product, and how everything connects. We’re the glue between customers and every part of the business - from field teams to product, engineering, and operations.



We work both reactively and proactively, jumping in fast when something’s not right, and reaching out when ranchers just need a hand or some guidance. When someone gets in touch, you’ll take ownership from start to finish, listening, understanding what’s needed, and working with teams across Halter to drive the best outcomes on ranch. You show up every day ready to make a difference - for ranchers, their animals, and your team.



This role offers the opportunity to build a deep understanding of Halter’s products and customers, with pathways for career growth across the company.



What your day could look like

 - Talking directly with ranchers through chat and phone - understanding what’s happening on ranch and helping them get things back on track fast.

 - Troubleshooting technical issues and using data, tools, and your own judgment to solve problems that matter.

 - Partnering with technical teams, translating complex issues into simple actions. 

 - Digging into Support team data, spotting patterns and raising insights that help us improve how Halter works for ranchers and animals.

 - Working closely with our Field, Onboarding, Sales, and Product teams to make sure every customer experience is seamless.

 - Taking ownership from start to finish - following up, keeping ranchers in the loop, and making sure nothing slips through the cracks.

 - Owning your performance metrics, including response times, satisfaction scores, and quality of support.

 - Getting out on ranch - seeing Halter in action and understanding the real impact of your work.
   
   

This could be for you if

 - You’ve had 3+ years of experience in customer-facing roles.

 - You are customer-obsessed and care deeply about creating better outcomes for ranchers and their animals.

 - You’re comfortable learning complex, technical systems and using new tools. The idea of learning code doesn't scare you.

 - You have a deep understanding of the ranching industry.

 - You’re curious - you don’t stop at the first answer, you dig deeper to understand why.

 - You bring calm to chaos and stay steady under pressure.

 - You bring energy and joy to your work, and you like being part of a tight team that has each other’s backs.

 - You build strong relationships - with ranchers, teammates, and the teams you work alongside.

 - You are proactive and take ownership. If something needs doing, you do it.

 - You enjoy digging through data to find insights or building AI agents to do this for you.

 - You love strengthening systems and looking for opportunities to create a world-class Support experience rather than just going through the motions.

 - You’re collaborative and enjoy working across different teams.



The details

 - Full-time, rostered across 7 days
   
   - Days off will be either Friday/Saturday or Sunday/Monday

 - Based in our Boulder office in Colorado
   

Our Office First Approach

There’s a reason you visit your friends in person, live with your family and don’t do dinners over Zoom. Humans are wired for connection. We believe a world-class, in-person office culture is the best way for high-performing teams.



Being office first is a core pillar of our culture. We believe in-person connections are key to driving your own growth, learning, impact, and building genuine long-lasting relationships. Strong relationships make it easier to disagree, give feedback, and do meaningful and aligned work. We don’t like having heaps of rules or policies, but this means having strong, trusted relationships is critical.



We’re office first, not office only. This means working from the office everyday is our default setting, but we flex when we need to. We have a high-trust culture, so everyone is trusted to do what’s best for Halter.



Our office vibe is something special, it’s hard to describe until you’re here, but people at Halter who have come from fully remote or hybrid companies say they could never go back - the high energy and spectacular people they are now surrounded by everyday makes work so enjoyable. Your growth, your learning and your impact is truly unlimited here, and a big part of that comes from being together solving problems, innovating, building context, and constantly learning from each other.




JOIN OUR TEAM

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!

If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!
