jobs.title: Head of Product, Angling
jobs.location: Bozeman, Montana, United States; Missoula, Montana, United States; Open to Remote
jobs.description:
ABOUT onX

We’re a team of builders, adventurers, and risk takers using technology to help people confidently explore the outdoors. Driven by our mission to awaken the adventurer inside everyone, we build products that optimize every outdoor experience and inspire confidence to get out and go further.

We’re a high-growth tech company. The pace is fast, the work takes grit, and ambiguity is part of the job. As the world changes around us, we adapt - continuously evolving how we build, prioritize, and deliver.

Our business moves quickly, and there’s real opportunity to shape what we build next. Each of our verticals - Hunt, Offroad, Backcountry, and Fish - is at a different stage of maturity, which means the challenges you encounter and the impact you have will vary depending on where you sit and what the business needs most.

We operate with an experimentation mindset, continually iterating and improving how we solve problems. We expect our people to use the latest tooling, including AI, thoughtfully and responsibly, pairing human judgment with technology to increase quality, speed, and impact.

Our impact comes to life through the products we build, in the stories of our customers, and in our growing commitment to land stewardship and recreational access.

ABOUT THIS OPPORTUNITY

onX is seeking a Head of Product to own the next stage of growth for Angling. You will lead a high-growth consumer product on the exponential path to scale. You will set a compelling long-term vision for how we serve all 50M North American anglers and will own turning that vision into experiences that help them discover where to fish, prepare for outings, and make better decisions on the water.

Partnering with the General Manager (GM) and Chief Product Officer (CPO), you will build the team and product capabilities to turn that ambition into results. You will start with one PM reporting to you, and as the business scales you will attract and develop talent and build a world-class product organization. This is also a hands-on role: you will directly lead a meaningful product area while increasing the impact and independence of the PMs you coach.

The ideal candidate has a record of leading a consumer product through rapid growth and developing strong product teams. You combine a passion for knowing the customer with high-level business acumen. You have a strong ability to articulate a long-term vision that inspires action. You bring extensive experience coaching PMs and leading through influence in a matrixed organization, with the judgment to balance near-term results and investments in future growth.

This position reports to the GM of Angling and works closely with the CPO and Product organization. Together, you will align on product direction, investment priorities, and the team and capabilities needed for Angling’s next stages of growth.

*Note: Externally titled Head of Product, this position maps internally to Group Product Manager II (P5).

WHAT YOU'LL DO
Essential Job Duties & Functions

• Own product vision and strategy. Set the long-term direction and roadmap for Angling. Align with the GM, CPO, and cross-functional leaders on the customer problems to solve, how onX will stand apart, and investment priorities.

• Turn customer insight into differentiated experiences. Combine direct engagement with anglers, research, product data, and market insight to identify unmet needs. Evaluate opportunities across customer segments and geographies, using experimentation to test assumptions before scaling investment.

• Manage and develop product talent. Set clear expectations, provide actionable feedback, and grow PM judgment, ownership, and independence. Partner with the GM and CPO on hiring and team structure as business needs and investment plans evolve.

• Stay close to execution. Directly lead discovery and delivery for the product, from framing opportunities through launch and iteration. Partner with marketing, content, and business development to support successful launches and sustained adoption.

• Connect product decisions to business results. Establish customer and business success measures with the GM, BI, and Finance. Use performance data and business-impact understanding to guide product investments, inform packaging and pricing decisions, and improve activation, conversion, retention, and revenue growth.

• Lead through cross-functional partnership. Align engineering, design, geospatial content, marketing, and other onX teams around clear priorities and ownership. Resolve dependencies and competing priorities, communicate tradeoffs, and balance Angling needs with broader company objectives.

• Develop the product portfolio. Define and evolve the product's packaging and tiering, informed by market segmentation, user behavior, and revenue opportunities. Partner with BI and Finance to model the business impact of packaging, pricing, and feature placement decisions.

• Exercise sound judgment amid ambiguity. Make timely decisions with incomplete information, explain the rationale and risks, and adapt as evidence changes. Partner with technical and functional leaders to address root causes and balance near-term delivery with quality and long-term scalability.

• Strengthen how teams work. Establish and improve discovery, experimentation, and planning practices that increase speed, quality, and learning. Share effective approaches across the Product and Angling teams, including thoughtful use of AI with appropriate validation.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

• Ten (10) or more years of product management experience leading software products or platforms, including demonstrated success scaling a consumer product. You can connect your product decisions to sustained improvements in customer adoption, engagement, retention, or revenue.

• Experience leading consumer mobile products and making choices that improve the core customer experience while supporting business growth.

• Two (2) or more years of experience hiring, leading, and coaching Product Managers, with a record of building high-performing product teams. Experience developing talent and evolving ownership, capabilities, and ways of working as a business scales.

• Demonstrated experience articulating a compelling long-term product vision, bringing senior and cross-functional stakeholders along, and translating that vision into strategic choices, investment priorities, and measurable results.

• Strong customer discovery and analytical skills, including customer research, experimentation, product metrics, and evaluation of commercial impact.

• Experience guiding products from early opportunity through growth and greater scale, with the judgment to balance new bets, improvements for existing customers, and the capabilities needed for continued expansion.

• Experience leading across multiple teams in a matrixed organization. You build trust, align partners outside your reporting line, resolve competing priorities, and communicate decisions and tradeoffs clearly to technical, business, and executive audiences.

• A collaborative approach to decision making: seek different perspectives, test assumptions, and propose practical solutions when constraints or disagreements arise.

• Clear written and verbal communication, sound technical judgment, and experience working with engineering and design throughout product development.

• A strong curiosity for exploring new technologies, including AI

• A shared passion for and ability to demonstrate onX’s Company Values.

• Permanent US work authorization is a condition of employment with onX.

• Ability to travel up to twice a quarter for multiple days to a corporate office or other onX strategic location, such as a Basecamp.

ADDED BONUSES

Though not required, we would be thrilled to consider candidates with any of the following:

• Experience entering new geographic markets or customer segments, from evaluating the opportunity through launch and sustained growth.

• Experience with consumer subscriptions, mapping, geospatial data, content products, or products used in the physical world.

• Experience bringing products or teams together while maintaining customer value and delivery continuity.

• Interest in fishing and a willingness to spend time learning directly from anglers.

THE ONX EXPERIENCE

onX is a distributed company with more than 400 employees across the country. We come together regularly to work in person and stay connected through regional basecamps and a culture that balances individual ownership with deep collaboration.

While we move quickly, we’re not a scrappy start-up. We operate with clear goals, structure, and frameworks that guide how we prioritize and execute. Priorities matter. While they may shift, data shapes how we evolve as our business, products, and the world around us change.

Clear priorities and structure don’t limit ownership - they make it possible. You’ll have the autonomy to define your work and make meaningful decisions within clear strategic boundaries. You’ll partner closely with others to solve complex problems and build solutions that scale across teams and platforms. Along the way, you’ll be supported with feedback, tools, and opportunities to grow your craft as you take on new challenges.

WHERE YOU CAN WORK

onX is a distributed company with employees across the U.S. We have physical offices in Bozeman and Missoula, MT, along with virtual workforce “Basecamps” in Austin, TX; Denver, CO; Kalispell, MT; Minneapolis, MN; Portland, OR; Salt Lake City, UT; and Seattle, WA. Basecamps are not physical offices; they are geographic hubs made up of remote employees who live within a 60-mile radius of the city center, creating opportunities for local connection and collaboration.

We have a strong preference for hiring candidates who live near one of our offices or within a Basecamp, and we prioritize candidates in these locations first. Candidates who live elsewhere in the U.S. may still be considered, provided they reside in a state where onX is currently able to employ team members.

At this time, we are NOT able to employ individuals whose primary work location is in: Alabama, Alaska, Arkansas, Connecticut, Delaware, District of Columbia (D.C.), Florida, Hawaii, Illinois, Kansas, Louisiana, Massachusetts, Missouri, New Jersey, New York, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, Rhode Island, South Dakota, West Virginia, and Wyoming.

HOW YOU’LL BE COMPENSATED

onX is committed to compensating all employees fairly and equitably for their contributions. For this position, applicants can expect to make between $180,153 and $225,191 upon hire. The pay range will vary based upon experience, skills, certifications, education among other factors as required in the job description. jobs.title: Senior Manager, Data Engineering
jobs.description:
About The Position

This role is responsible for creating, managing, and optimizing data engineering pipelines, managing data platform operations, and partnering closely with stakeholders to drive requirements-gathering and defining data solution architecture. This is a hands-on role that creates, drives, and tracks project plans for data platform and solutions delivery (including, but not limited to, ETL/Extract-Transform-Load, pipelines, data models, and monitoring controls) and leads sprint planning and completion to meet business needs while implementing and continuously improving solutions. The Senior Manager, Data Engineering reports to the Senior Director of Data Management & Governance.

Responsibilities

• Own and drive the end-to-end delivery of data architecture and pipeline solutions, including holistic planning, requirements-gathering, design, build, and testing strategy per assessed business needs. Design and evolve the semantic layer to be the well-governed single source of truth for business intelligence and ensure it is meeting all reporting needs.

• Lead sprint planning and operations. Manage sprint execution, release planning and release delivery, ensuring aligned planning, timely outcomes, and resolution of dependencies and blockers to drive operational excellence. Track and analyze sprint delivery metrics, sprint operational efficiency, and DevOps performance (e.g., DevOps Research and Assessment framework) to support continuous improvement.

• Design and operationalize data quality framework to ensure trust and consistency in data, with proactive monitoring, alerting, root cause analysis (including troubleshooting and resolution) with impact and sizing assessments for all critical data pipelines.

• Establish foundational capabilities for MLOps (Machine Learning Operations), Machine Learning, and feature engineering along with ML/AI platform integration as organizational needs mature.

• Manage and continuously improve data architecture and pipelines, establishing clear monitoring standards and operational controls.

• Partner closely with stakeholders on the Analytics, Application Development, Data Collection Strategy & Operations, IT Operations, Product Management, and Regional Data Systems & Strategy teams to lead communication and own, create, drive, track, and execute project plans for owned workstreams, effectively managing competing priorities to ensure data availability and accuracy for users.

• Ensure transparency into progress, risks, and dependencies through consistent tracking and communication mechanisms.

• Guide team member(s) on developing data solutions, promoting strong data quality practices and review standards, and ensuring up-to-date documentation.

• Manage and develop one or more team members (FTEs or contractors) as needed, providing clear expectations, timely feedback, and coaching to support performance and accountability for results.

Skills and Mindsets

• Mission and Student Focus: Demonstrates passion and commitment to KIPP’s mission and possesses the desire and ability to uphold KIPP’s Core Values (Focus on Excellent Results, Collective Impact, and Courageous Action)

• Self-Management: Demonstrated record of co-creating ambitious goals with their managers – and driving toward desired outcomes; Effectively monitors progress toward goals for multiple workstreams; Leverages understanding of an organization’s operating model, structure, and core operational process to effectively drive work to achieve goals; effectively works through direct reports and peers to follow through on commitments, ensuring others do the same.

• Work Management: Effectively drives work they own through clear action planning. Manages time effectively around competing priorities. Skilled in creating and executing project plans through partnership with stakeholders and effective delegation to achieve intended results on time. Skilled in knowledge management.

• Process Management: Able to build and align goals and project plans with organization priorities; leverages relevant organizational processes and systems to execute work; can build and maintain knowledge management systems; effectively develops and codifies processes to ensure efficiency, alignment with organizational processes, and to improve work quality.

• Problem-Solving: Generates solutions outside of their direct work and shrinks problems to solve independently. Shows initiative in generating and recommending ideas and solutions within their own workstreams. Anticipates risks and develops proactive solutions that support their team.

• People Management & Development: Effective at developing and coaching teammates. Skilled in setting and managing both performance and development goals. Provides timely and actionable feedback to drive teammate development and performance; demonstrates accountability for the goals of their direct reports

• Technical Proficiency: Has knowledge and skills in SQL, Spark, Pyspark, on-prem and cloud-based data platform management (SQL Server, Fabric/Snowflake, etc.) and architecture, CI/CD, ETL/data pipelines, version control, SSIS, agile sprint operations, project management tools, and machine learning principles.

Experience and Qualifications

• 8+ years of professional experience in data engineering, infrastructure engineering, or a closely related technical field.

• Experience with SQL-based data platforms (such as SQL Server) and modern cloud-based data warehouse/lakehouse platforms, such as Fabric/OneLake, Snowflake, or Databricks.

• Demonstrated experience in managing agile sprint operations, DevOps metrics, and proficiency in JIRA (or similar tool) for project and sprint planning, sprint and backlog management, sprint tracking, workflow management, and issue resolution.

• Experience with version control and CI/CD workflows using Git and platforms, such as Bitbucket, GitHub, and Azure DevOps.

• Strong technical proficiency in SSIS, Spark, PySpark, and SQL.

• Demonstrated experience managing data platform operations and building/managing ETLs and pipelines.

• Experience managing and mentoring data engineers.

• Understanding of Machine Learning (ML) workflows and ML/AI enablement for data platforms.

• Experience with SQL Server and MS Fabric/OneLake preferred.

• Bachelor’s degree in data engineering, computer science, or a related field; Master’s degree preferred.

Work Conditions

• Travel: Low Travel: 10% (20 days per year)
• Full, exempt role

Location

It is preferred, but not mandatory for this role to be based out of a KIPP Foundation office. This role also has the option of working from a remote office full-time. KIPP Foundation offices are in NYC and Chicago.

Compensation and Benefits

In compliance with local law, we are disclosing the compensation, or a range thereof, for roles in locations where legally required. Actual salaries will vary based on several factors, including but not limited to external market data, internal equity, and relevant experience. The salary range for this position is $120,000-145,000. In addition, KIPP Foundation provides a variety of benefits to employees, including:

• 25 holidays for + 18 days additional flexible PTO days (flexible PTO increases to 23 days for years 3 and 4 and to 28 days for years 5+).

• 100% paid parental leave

• 100% coverage of the premium for employee and 75% for employee + family’s medical/dental/vision plans.

• Wellness benefits such as fitness reimbursements, discounted tickets to theme parks/attractions, backup care support for children and adults/elders, and our employee assistance program

• Finance Security benefits include such as a 401K retirement plan with 4% match, employer-sponsored legal plans, life/disability insurance, and flexible spending accounts

KIPP Foundation embraces the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects the diversity of the students and communities with whom we work and the world that’s around them. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit, without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, mental or physical disability, and genetic information, marital status, citizenship status, military status, protected veteran status or any other category protected by law.

jobs.description:
At Qualtrics, we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high-performing teams, and design products people love. But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally. Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention—but most of all it requires close-knit, high-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers.

When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the mic and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.

Technical Program Manager - Public Sector

Why We Have This Role

The Technical Program Manager plays a pivotal part in Qualtrics' success by leading the design, delivery and ongoing success of customer’s experience programs, focused on driving measurable business impact. In this role, you will partner with customers throughout their lifecycle - from program delivery and onboarding to ongoing optimization, adoption and value realization.  You will act as the primary technology trusted advisor for your portfolio, leading medium and large-scale software implementations and optimizing our technology to address individual challenges, ultimately building our customers into lifelong Qualtrics champions.

How You'll Find Success

You will find success by blending exceptional customer and project management skills with a focus on technical platform adoption, renewals, and expansion. You will lead project teams to deliver complex programs within our specific Industry Verticals and Region, ensuring your customers deepen and broaden their usage of the platform. By influencing customers to shape their feedback programs and being resourceful when facing challenges, you will drive leading indicators of success, value realization, and Net ARR growth.

How You’ll Grow

Key Responsibilities

Help Customers Grow

• Build and maintain strong customer stakeholder relationships to deeply understand the context, ambition and strategic business goals for the customers within your portfolio

• Define and execute your strategy for retaining, maturing and expanding customer accounts; including assessing customer usage and implementing new capabilities to enhance their programs

• Develop success plans aligned with customer business goals and technology roadmaps

• Monitor customer health, platform utilization and adoption metrics to identify opportunities for increased value

• Contribute to a culture of accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement to drive high quality customer outcomes

Provide Technical & Execution Expertise

• Develop and maintain technical competence on the Qualtrics platform, ensuring a deep understanding of the leading indicators of customer adoption, ACV retention and value realization

• Utilize experience and best practices in order to understand the customer and communicate effectively how the Qualtrics platform will support the delivery of value driving outcomes and enhance their program

• Lead specific project implementations for new customers to your portfolio and existing customers; including cross functional / cross team project teams consisting of Technical Services Consultants and XM Advisors, with the objective to deliver on project goals and objectives

• Conduct regular risk planning, monitoring, mitigation and reporting to stakeholders both during project delivery and account lifecycle

Demonstrate Operational Rigor

• Execute implementation and account management activities in accordance with global standard practices, ensuring rigorous account and project tracking and proactive risk and issue management

• Ensure all project and account documentation and artifacts are developed, maintained

• Stay current with product and strategic customer journey enhancements

Key Success Measures

For customer accounts within your portfolio over a 12 month period:

Customer Value

• Net ARR

• Customer adoption and maturity of customer account

• Customer satisfaction and advocacy

Successful Execution

• Billable Utilization attainment

• Time to Value for customers following delivery of new capabilities (measured by level of consumption 60 days following go-live milestone)

• Time to Deliver new capabilities for customers in your portfolio

• Rigorous scope management measured by level of Variance on Completion (VAC) of specific project deliverables

Things You'll Do

• Portfolio Leadership: Own the success of a portfolio of customer accounts, serving as the primary technology advisor throughout the customer lifecycle

• Portfolio Performance: Monitor portfolio performance using customer health, adoption, maturity and value realisation to proactively manage risk and identify growth opportunities

• Account Growth & Maturity: Define strategy to expand program adoption and maturity across our customer accounts, driving Net ARR and portfolio performance

• Strategic Project Management: Partner with customers to provide expertise leading to the alignment of project goals and timely execution

• Risk & Quality Management: Plan, monitor, and mitigate project risks while developing quality management plans aligned with business requirements

• Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate with internal teams to support your customer’s experience and maintain account health

What We're Looking For On Your Resume

The ideal candidate combines technical expertise, consulting skills and a passion for helping customers transform their business through technology.

• 3+ years of experience: Successfully working with large, complex organizations to execute and advise on customer facing programs that deliver sustainable business outcomes

• Technical Aptitude: High interest in learning the Qualtrics platform and new technologies and deployment of technical expertise with customers at scale

• Consulting & Program Management: Proven ability to plan and execute multiple concurrent projects on time and budget, with a blend of consulting and internal-customer experience. Collaborating with project managers, consultants, architects and product teams to support delivery of specific outcomes

• Customer Engagement: Ability to lead workshops, knowledge transfer sessions, utilize data and metrics to communicate understanding and produce high quality customer facing documentation

• Stakeholder Influence: Ability to build relationships with senior customer program owners and decision makers

• Industry Experience: Good understanding of significant industry shifts taking place in experience management in one or more specific industries.

• Entrepreneurial spirit: High tolerance for ambiguity and complexity. Ability to be efficient with limited resources, to understand business needs and to communicate and present to Senior Management effectively.

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in science, technology, engineering, or business-related field.

• Willingness to Travel: Able to travel up to 25% to engage with clients and teams.

What You Should Know About This Team

• End-to-End Strategic Advisors: The team serves as the primary technical advisors for public sector clients across their entire lifecycle—from onboarding and technical delivery to ongoing optimization, adoption, and value realization.

• Cross-Functional Implementation Leaders: Team members orchestrate medium- and large-scale software implementations, directing cross-functional groups of Technical Services Consultants and XM Advisors to deliver complex, multi-stakeholder programs on time and within scope.

• Driven by Commercial & Customer Outcomes: Success on this team is tied directly to measurable business impact, including Net ARR growth, ACV retention, time-to-value, billable utilization, and client maturity.

• High-Rigor, Consultative Culture: The team operates with an entrepreneurial mindset, blending technical platform expertise with operational discipline, proactive risk mitigation, and executive-level stakeholder management.

Our Team’s Favorite Perks and Benefits

• Comprehensive Health & Wellness: Robust medical, dental, and vision insurance packages for you and your dependents.

• Professional Growth & Mentorship: Structured onboarding, product training, and clear pathways for career advancement.

• Paid Time Off & Holidays: Generous paid vacation, sick leave, and paid company holidays.

• 401(k) Retirement Plan: Competitive matching company contributions to help secure your financial future.

The Qualtrics Hybrid Work Model: Our hybrid work model is elegantly simple: we all gather in the office three days a week; Mondays and Thursdays, plus one day selected by your organizational leader. These purposeful in-person days in thoughtfully designed offices help us do our best work and harness the power of collaboration and innovation. For the rest of the week, work where you want, owning the integration of work and life. #hybrid

jobs.title: Quality Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
WelbeHealth is a value-based healthcare organization that’s transforming the future of senior care by providing an all-inclusive care option to our most vulnerable senior population. We step in as the care provider and care planner that work to keep our participants within their communities, out of institutions, and cared for like family, all while receiving the healthcare and social services needed to thrive.

Under the supervision of the Quality Operations Supervisor (QOS), the Quality Operations Coordinator (QOC) is accountable for delivering excellent support and service to our PACE market operations through a process of record review to ensure a complete and accurate participant medical record. Responsibilities will include collecting data, auditing participant electronic health records by utilizing comprehensive tools specific to the area of quality improvement, complete reporting, and confirming all regulatory required elements.

This role is different because the Quality Operations Coordinator at WelbeHealth:

• Directly supports the quality and accuracy of participant care records, helping ensure vulnerable seniors receive coordinated, compliant, and high-quality care

• Plays a hands-on role in quality operations by auditing medical records, supporting regulatory readiness, identifying documentation gaps, and helping improve data integrity across the organization

• Collaborate with interdisciplinary teams (IDTs) and stakeholders across the enterprise in a mission-driven healthcare environment where attention to detail and problem-solving skills have a direct operational impact

We care about our team members. That’s why we offer:

• Medical insurance coverage (Medical, Dental, Vision)

• Work/life balance - We mean it! 17 days of personal time off (PTO), 12 holidays observed annually, and 6 sick days

• 401K savings + match

• Comprehensive compensation package including base pay and bonus

• And additional benefits!

On the day-to-day, you will:

• Identify potential deficiencies, facilitate, and monitor appropriate corrections to ensure data integrity in the EHR

• Monitor participant medical records for complete and timely documentation, promptly reporting to the QOD when policies and procedures are not being followed

• Participate in team documentation, process improvements, and other QO team initiatives

• Conduct medical records audits to ensure all required documentation is timely and accurate

• Assist with WelbeHealth audits by preparing documents for desk review submission (universe lists), as well as assist with EMR navigation and impact analysis

• Review and reconcile assigned regulatory logs and complete required investigations and notifications

Job requirements include:

• Associate’s degree preferred; three (3) years of experience may be substituted

• Minimum of two (2) years of experience in a healthcare setting

• PACE experience preferred

• Excellent communication, listening, and organization skills

• Extensive MS office suite experience

• Strong data gathering skills and health information management expertise

• Demonstrated ability to multi-task and prioritize in a fast-paced environment

jobs.title: Project General Manager, Strategic Shuttle Programs
jobs.description:
CharterUP is transforming the $365 billion global group transportation and mobility market with an AI native platform that powers modern charter, shuttle, and emerging autonomous vehicle operations. Trusted by many Fortune 500 companies, CharterUP connects enterprises, institutions, and event organizers with thousands of vehicles nationwide, while increasingly serving as the operating system for large scale shuttle and transit programs across airports, campuses, industrial sites, and major events.

Through real time availability, transparent pricing, intelligent routing, and AI driven dispatch and optimization, CharterUP replaces a fragmented and opaque industry with automation, accountability, and scale.

Why Join Us

• Innovative Impact: Be part of the team that's revolutionizing group travel, setting new standards in an industry overdue for change.

• Growth Opportunities: As a hyper growth company and one of the fastest-growing companies recognized by Inc., there’s no better time to join our dynamic, growth-stage organization.

• Driven Team: Collaborate with some of the most driven minds in tech, all while working in a remote-first environment with a tech hub in Austin, TX.

• Funding and Stability: Our $60 million Series A funding was just the start—we’re poised for even greater expansion, and you can be part of this exciting journey. CharterUp has achieved this growth profitability and efficiently, ensuring long-term stability.

Title:  Project General Manager

Reports to: Market General Manager

Location:  Memphis, TN / Southaven, MS (onsite at project locations)

About the Role

CharterUP is seeking a Project General Manager to lead complex, large-scale shuttle programs, such as workforce transportation for data centers and major construction projects. As the primary operational lead onsite, you’ll own the program end to end—from launch and daily execution to client relationships, transportation partner performance, reporting, and continuous improvement.

Working across clients, transportation partners, and internal teams, you’ll ensure safe, reliable service and deliver on program commitments. Success requires strong operational leadership, the ability to manage across organizational boundaries, and a hands-on approach to resolving issues and driving results.

Compensation includes a competitive base salary and performance-based bonus tied to program launch, service continuity, and client satisfaction.

CharterUP is also hiring Market and National General Managers. Candidates may be considered for the level best aligned with their experience.

What You'll Do

Lead On-Site Operations

• Own daily shuttle program execution, including route readiness, vehicle coverage, staging, passenger loading, and coordination across operating shifts.

• Validate transportation partners’ staffing, fleet readiness, dispatch coverage, and contingency plans.

• Lead service recovery during delays, missed trips, vehicle breakdowns, staffing shortages, and unexpected demand.

• Develop and maintain operating procedures, escalation protocols, site instructions, and business continuity plans.

• Lead assigned CharterUP site personnel, where applicable, and establish clear responsibilities and shift handoffs.

• Validate daily and upcoming transportations schedules with operating partners to ensure alignment with client requirements, workforce shifts, anticipated ridership, and changing site conditions.

• Establish and maintain a structured daily operating cadence, including operator coordination calls, onsite huddles, operational readiness reviews, and documented follow-up on outstanding commitments.

• Oversee implementation and ongoing maintenance of CharterUP branding requirements across assigned vehicles, including signage, decals, vehicle presentation standards, and timely resolution of branding deficiencies in coordination with transportation partners.

Own the Client Relationship On Site

• Serve as CharterUP’s primary on-site operational contact and build trusted relationships with client site leadership, facilities, security, and other stakeholders.

• Proactively communicate service conditions, resolve concerns, and follow issues through to closure.

• Lead regular operational meetings, presenting performance, corrective actions, and improvement recommendations.

• Anticipate changes in workforce schedules, site activity, and transportation demand.

• Share client insights and growth opportunities with your Market General Manager and CharterUP’s commercial team.

• Participates in client and site coordination meetings to proactively identify changes in workforce headcount, construction schedules, site access, parking arrangements, and transportation requirements.

• Maintain a centralized action-item tracker for client requests, operational commitments, and outstanding issues, ensuring timely follow-through and resolution.

Manage Transportation Partner Relationship and Performance

• Develop strong, collaborative relationships with transportation partner leadership while maintaining accountability for contracted service levels, vehicle standards, staffing commitments, and reporting requirements.

• Monitor actual service delivery through field observations, platform data, trip records, and client feedback.

• Conduct daily operational check-ins with transportation partners, regularly review performance against contractual KPIs, and drive documented corrective actions through resolution.

• Escalate persistent deficiencies and capacity needs so supplemental or replacement service can be secured.

• Ensure client requests and service changes are documented and managed through CharterUP.

• Serve as the projects relationship owner for assigned transportation partners, fostering open communication, resolving operational friction, and proactively collaborating on service improvements, resource planning, and long-term program success.

Support Service and Billing Accuracy

• Track service hours, vehicle utilization, and trip completion against contractual commitments.

• Validate delivered service and flag discrepancies across operational records, partner invoices, and client billing.

• Identify client requests that fall outside the agreed scope and route them for pricing and approval before additional service is committed.

• Recommend operational improvements that increase reliability and reduce waste.

Drive Safety, Visibility, and Improvement

• Partner with CharterUP's Legal, Safety, and Compliance teams to verify transportation partner adherence to applicable federal, state, and local regulatory requirements, including prevailing wage laws, labor classifications, collective bargaining obligations, and contract-specific compliance requirements.

• Monitor transportation partner adherence to applicable DOT, FMCSA, and state transportation safety requirements, including driver qualifications, vehicle inspections, insurance coverage, hours-of-service compliance, and established safety procedures, coordinating corrective actions with CharterUP's Safety and Compliance teams.

• Lead onsite coordination of operational and safety incidents, ensuring immediate response, appropriate onsite support, timely escalation, and coordination with transportation partners, emergency responders, CharterUP leadership, and client stakeholders as applicable.

• Deliver daily program reports and escalate issues promptly to CharterUP leadership and the client.

• Maintain accurate operational records and service reports, ensuring all incidents are properly logged, documented, and tracked through investigation, corrective action, and closure.

• Use GPS, ridership, trip-completion, and passenger feedback data to improve routes, capacity, reliability, and rider experience.

• Ensure CharterUP systems provide an accurate, current record of program activity and performance.

• Establish and maintain standardized daily ridership collection and reconciliation processes to ensure accurate passenger counts, trip activity, and capacity utilization.

• Maintain a centralized program performance dashboard tracking service reliability, ridership, safety incidents, operational deficiencies, and corrective action status.

• Coordinate the collection, validation, and tracking of required labor compliance documentation, including certified payroll records, applicable wage determinations, fringe benefit documentation, and union-related requirements, escalating discrepancies to CharterUP's Legal and Compliance teams.

• Establish recurring compliance verification procedures with transportation partners, including confirmation of required vehicle inspections, active insurance coverage, driver eligibility, and daily and weekly hours-of-service compliance, escalating deficiencies and potential service risks before they impact operations.

• Ensure incidents are reported through required internal and external channels within established timelines, including appropriate notifications to CharterUP leadership, Safety and Compliance teams, clients, and transportation partners, while monitoring incident resolution and follow-up actions.

What You’ll Bring

• Three or more years of operations experience, including on-site leadership of a shuttle, transit, airport, campus, workforce transportation, or comparable field program.

• Passenger transportation experience strongly preferred; experience in trucking, construction logistics, or other large-scale field operations will be considered.

• Experience serving as the primary point of contact for a client on a live project and resolving service issues directly.

• Experience coordinating third-party transportation providers or subcontractors at a job site and enforcing service commitments.

• Strong working knowledge of dispatch, route planning, fleet readiness, staffing coverage, and transportation safety practices.

• Understanding of motorcoach and passenger carrier operations, including driver hours-of-service limits, and the confidence to push back on client requests that are not operationally sound.

• Ability to produce clear daily reporting and use operational data to improve service.

• Proficiency in Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, and/or project management tools.

• Highly self-directed, with demonstrated ability to independently establish operational structure, manage competing priorities, and drive accountability in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong communication, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills.

• Ability to make sound decisions under pressure and coordinate multiple stakeholders during service disruptions.

• Willingness to work on-site 8-10 hours daily, with flexibility to support critical operating periods and escalations outside standard business hours.

• Experience implementing or managing operational technology platforms, including GPS tracking, ridership reporting, and performance dashboards.

• Bachelor’s degree preferred; equivalent relevant experience welcomed.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience supporting data center, large-scale construction, or other complex job-site environments.

• Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) or hands-on technical knowledge of vehicles and fleet inspection.

• Experience launching a new transportation program or site operation.

Recruiting Process

• Step 1 - Video call: Talent Acquisition interview

• Step 2 - Video call: Hiring Manager interview

• Step 3 - Video call: Team interviews

• Step 4 - Offer & reference check

• Welcome aboard!

Global Benefits & Perks at CharterUP

We believe great people can live anywhere—and they deserve great benefits, too. While offerings may vary slightly by location, we prioritize hiring near our hubs in Austin, Atlanta, and Miami as we grow our global team.

• Flexible Work Model: CharterUP operates as a remote-first company, with select roles requiring regular, in-office presence based on team and business needs. Role-specific expectations will be shared during the hiring process. U.S.-based employees may reside in any of our 19 approved states.

• Comprehensive Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, mental health support, virtual care, gym discounts, and family-building benefits. In the U.S., we cover 100% of premiums for employees. International benefits align with local standards.

• Time Off to Recharge: Paid time off so you can truly unplug. U.S.: 15 PTO days (increasing to 20 after 2 years) + 8 paid holidays. International policies vary by country.

• Financial Peace of Mind: Company-paid life, short-term, and long-term disability insurance where available.

• Performance-Driven Culture: Join a fast-moving, ambitious, and collaborative team that wins together.

• Referral Rewards: Earn bonuses for bringing top talent to the team.

• Planning for the Future: Long-term financial planning support. U.S.: 401(k) plan. International: region-specific savings programs where applicable.

• Top-Tier Tech: Choose a Mac or PC, plus monitor, keyboard, and mouse to hit the ground running.

CharterUP is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive, accessible, and respectful workplace. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, ancestry, disability, medical condition, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws in the United States and Canada. If you require accommodation during the recruitment process, please let us know. CharterUP is committed to providing reasonable accommodations during the hiring process. If you need assistance or an accommodation, please contact your recruiter.

Hiring Locations: CharterUP U.S.-based candidates and employees must reside in one of the following states: Arizona, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Mississippi, Missouri, North Carolina, New Hampshire, Nevada, New York, Oklahoma, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Washington, and Wyoming.

We hire in the U.S. and Canada and are actively expanding our global footprint.

jobs.title: QA Manager
jobs.description:
Nex is on a mission to help families rediscover the joy of movement. Created by parents for parents, Nex combines technology and play to deliver fun, social, and interactive experiences powered by natural body motion, encouraging kids and adults to move more, play more, and have fun together. Nex Playground, the company’s award-winning active play system, is purpose-built to get families moving year-round, with safety and privacy as core considerations in its intentional design. It is certified kidSAFE+ COPPA compliant and built to support healthy, active play for all ages and abilities.

Nex Playground features a growing library of 50+ experiences, including motion and dance games, fitness and educational experiences, and Nex Originals. Content includes collaborations with partners like Hasbro, Sesame Workshop, and NBCUniversal. Nex has been recognized by Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, TIME’s Best Inventions, and Parents’ Best Entertainment System for Families, and has earned Red Dot, IDEA, and Core77 international design awards. We encourage you to explore Have Fun and Is Motion Gaming Back?, as they offer a deeper look into our culture, values, and explain how our approach to motion gaming differs from previous generations.

Nex employees may be expected to collaborate with colleagues across different time zones. Depending on the role and location, occasional travel may also be required for company events, external meetings, and other business-related activities.

Important Notice: ⚠️ To protect yourself from recruitment scams, please note that Nex communicates through official company emails ending in @nex.inc. If you receive a suspicious email or message, please do not respond and report it immediately to us.

Location: Remote US

Annual salary: $150,000 - $185,000 USD (Final base salary within this range will be determined based on job-related factors, including the candidate’s experience, skills, qualifications, and geographic location)

Type: Full Time

Reports to: Director of QA

The role

We’re looking for a QA Manager to own end-to-end quality across hardware, firmware, PlayOS, and game experiences for Nex Playground. This is a role for someone who enjoys hands-on testing and debugging while also shaping test strategy, release criteria, and the overall quality bar.

Your mission is to ensure every hardware revision works seamlessly with PlayOS and our games—delivering a stable, responsive, compatible, and delightful experience in real-world conditions. You’ll partner closely with the engineering team and game cells to identify risk, prevent regressions, and support confident release decisions.

Key responsibilities

Hardware compatibility & system validation

• Own validation for hardware bring-up and ongoing compatibility across hardware revisions, PlayOS versions, and game builds.

• Develop and maintain risk-based test plans across EVT, DVT, and PVT—or equivalent development stages—including: boot, update, rollback, and recovery flows input, tracking, peripherals, and connectivity long-session stability, power cycles, and intermittent failures storage integrity and save-data behavior

• Maintain a clear compatibility matrix covering hardware revisions, PlayOS versions, firmware versions, and game builds.

• Partner with engineering teams to isolate hardware–software issues and verify fixes.

Firmware quality & release gating

• Own the test strategy for firmware and PlayOS updates, including upgrade and downgrade paths, interrupted updates, failure scenarios, sleep/wake behavior, backgrounding, resume, and recovery.

• Define manual validation and integrate automated checks into OTA release workflows where appropriate, covering installation, staged rollout, rollback, interruption handling, and recovery.

• Establish quality gates, entry and exit criteria, and evidence-based go/no-go recommendations for hardware and firmware releases.

• Assess release risk, track critical issues, and ensure regressions are understood before rollout.

Performance, reliability & real-world readiness

• Validate system compatibility across PlayOS and game releases, including input, tracking, performance, save data, and update-related regressions.

• Define and validate measurable quality targets such as frame-rate stability, responsiveness, latency, memory usage, thermal behavior, and crash-free sessions.

• Execute long-run, stress, and recovery testing to identify memory leaks, degradation over time, and intermittent failures.

• Test representative user environments, including network variability, display configurations, device states, user flows, and edge conditions.

Automation & tooling

• Build and maintain reliable automated regression coverage across device, firmware, OTA, system-integration, and game-compatibility workflows where appropriate.

• Integrate high-value automated checks into release workflows and make failures easy to diagnose.

• Develop lightweight tools and scripts that accelerate setup, validation, data collection, and troubleshooting.

Communication, vendor management & cross-functional leadership

• Produce actionable bug reports with clear reproduction steps, environment and build details, logs, impact, and supporting evidence.

• Drive defect triage and prioritization with engineering and product partners, particularly during release cycles.

• Manage external vendors, including scope, capacity, priorities, deliverables, acceptance criteria, quality standards, and performance.

• Communicate quality status and release risk clearly, helping teams make informed tradeoffs and decisions.

• Champion consistent testing practices and raise the quality bar across teams through influence and collaboration.

Key Requirements

• Strong hands-on QA experience in system-level testing, firmware or OS validation, or hardware–software integration.

• Demonstrated ability to design risk-based test strategies and execute thorough exploratory testing.

• Experience validating firmware or OTA update flows, including failure handling, rollback, and recovery.

• Experience investigating performance, reliability, and intermittent issues using logs, traces, crash data, and other diagnostic evidence.

• Ability to create maintainable automated tests, tools, or scripts in at least one programming or scripting language.

• Experience coordinating external QA partners or vendors and holding deliverables to clear quality standards.

• Clear written and verbal communication, sound judgment, and strong cross-functional collaboration.

Nice-to-have

• Experience with consumer electronics, hardware bring-up, EVT/DVT/PVT, or manufacturing test concepts.

• Experience with game or platform QA, graphics and performance profiling, input or motion-tracking systems, or observability tooling.

• Familiarity with Android or Linux debugging, ADB, CI/CD systems, device logs, traces, and crash dumps.

• Experience building test infrastructure, managing device labs, or validating staged software rollouts at scale.

We Offer

• Competitive compensation package.

• Flexible working hours and vacation policy.

• Product-driven culture that treasures talents and individual growth.

• Front-row seat and hands-on experience with cutting edge technologies in the evolving gaming field

Nex is located in San Jose, California, USA and Hong Kong. Learn more about us at https://www.nexplayground.com/about.

We encourage applications even if you don’t meet more than 50% of the requirements — we believe that experience comes in many forms!

jobs.title: Lead Bioinformatics & Machine Learning Scientist
jobs.description:
Natera is seeking a Lead Bioinformatics & Machine Learning Scientist to join our Bioinformatics Research team and help build the machine learning models behind Natera's tissue-free, methylation-based assay. These will be the models that detect cancer in the minimal residual disease (MRD) setting and help inform treatment selection. The ideal candidate brings a strong background in algorithm development, genomics, sequencing data processing, and applied machine learning.

Primary Responsibilities:

• Develop, train, and evaluate machine learning models, driving algorithm design decisions that support cancer detection in the MRD setting.

• Own end-to-end research analyses, from ideation through implementation (scripts and notebooks), troubleshooting, and performance evaluation, including developing new features within existing pipelines.

• Translate between wet-lab experimental design and computational analysis, navigating ambiguity as assay requirements evolve and maintaining rigorous quality control across high-volume sequencing data spanning multiple cohorts, vendors, and clinical protocols.

• Communicate findings and model performance to both technical and cross-functional stakeholders, and contribute to establishing standards for code quality and reproducibility.

Qualifications:

• PhD in Computer Science, Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, or a related quantitative field with a strong emphasis on cancer epi/genomics and 4 to 8+ years of experience post-PhD.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

• Deep theoretical and practical understanding of high-throughput DNA sequence data analysis, including mapping, sequence alignment, and variant calling workflows.

• Experience in algorithm development and data analysis, including applying and evaluating statistical methods.

• Demonstrated experience in developing core ML models, including generalized linear models, kernel methods, tree-based algorithms, and neural networks, with a focus on biological data (e.g., DNA sequencing data)

• Strong quantitative reasoning and data analysis skills, with a demonstrated ability to apply them effectively to relevant scientific problems.

• Experience with Python and Linux command-line tools, including writing shell scripts. Strong computational and programming skills, including thorough experience with Python statistical packages (NumPy, Matplotlib, Pandas).

• Familiarity with public databases such as TCGA, COSMIC, or OncoKB.

• Ability to visualize findings and summarize results in oral and written form for both technical and non-technical audiences.

• High scientific rigor, with eagerness to teach and learn new computational methods and biology.

• Ability to work on a cross-functional team in a highly collaborative environment, partnering with both computational and experimental scientists.

The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for.

About the Role

The Samizdat team manages the New York Times' GraphQL platform. Our mission is to provide a API layer powering our products and internal systems. We are in an exciting period of modernization, driving scale and reliability as our upstream data complexity grows. We are looking for a GraphQL and Developer Experience enthusiast to join our team and contribute to our mission-critical distributed platform.

Responsibilities

• Develop new platform offerings while ensuring the reliability, scalability, and performance of our GraphQL platform as it continues to grow.

• Lead by example in establishing and enforcing GraphQL schema design and governance best practices, participating in platform-wide schema working groups, and reviewing/mentoring cross-team contributions.

jobs.title: Financial Planning & Analysis Lead
jobs.description:
Flodesk is recognized in the Inc 5000 as one of the world's fastest-growing email marketing companies, built to help entrepreneurs sell online and design emails that people love to get. We're committed to giving small businesses simple and intuitive tools that help them grow, nurture, and monetize their email list.

We’re a remote-first company headquartered in San Francisco with a globally distributed team, including in-person hubs in Da Nang (Vietnam), Barcelona (Spain), and Menlo Park (California). Our team reflects the diversity and creativity of the people we serve. Join our mission to level the playing field for small business owners through good design.

About the role

Flodesk’s finance team is building a modern FP&A function, and you’ll help shape it from the ground up.

You’ll own the financial model, the forecast and planning cycle, and the analysis behind our biggest decisions. You’ll report to our CFO who will work alongside you, shaping priorities and strategy while relying on your recommendations and point of view. You’ll also raise the bar on board reporting and become a go-to partner for teams across the company.

This role is for someone with deep subscription modeling expertise who thinks like an architect by designing models and workflows to be modular and auditable. We'll be a great match if you've led finance teams (either human or AI agent) and influenced an organization to make more precise decisions.

What you'll do:

Company forecasting & planning

• Own the modeling and mechanics of the company-wide forecast (P&L and balance sheet), partnering with the CFO on key assumptions and priorities

• Build driver-based and scenario models that support strategic decisions

Subscription & revenue modeling

• Own modeling of billings, deferred revenue, and cash across monthly and annual plans

• Analyze renewal rates, churn, subscriber mix, and cohort behavior

• Partner cross-functionally on CAC/LTV analysis and unit economics

Board & executive reporting

• Build the financial analysis and materials for board meetings, working alongside the CFO, who shapes the overall narrative

• Form your own point of view on what the numbers mean and bring recommendations, not just reports

Systems, automation, and AI

• Design and own the FP&A data and automation layer, including how AI supports forecasting, variance analysis, and board reporting

• Redesign recurring workflows (forecast refresh, variance commentary, reconciliations) with automation and AI, with review controls built in

• Drive innovation by integrating AI and emerging technologies to improve forecasting workflows, controls, and documentation.

• Own the FP&A calendar and strategic roadmap that prioritizes initiatives and guides how you and the CFO spend FP&A time

Ad hoc reporting

• Deliver ad hoc analyses and reporting that support executive and cross-functional decisions

• Assess and prioritize incoming requests to keep them aligned with FP&A's priorities and your capacity

What you bring:

• 6-10 years of experience in FP&A or corporate finance, ideally at a SaaS or subscription-based company

• You’ve rebuilt a recurring finance process (variance commentary, forecast refresh, board pack drafting, reconciliations) with AI or automation, and can explain what you changed, how you validated it, and what it saved

• You know where AI is reliable in finance and where it isn’t, and you build in reconciliation checks, review steps, and audit trails

• Fluency in subscription and SaaS metrics (ARR, churn, renewal rates, CAC, LTV) and how they connect to the broader P&L, and balance sheetA strong technical finance foundation: you can build a driver-based, three-statement model from scratch and defend every assumption in it

• Comfort with SQL or Python, or a demonstrated willingness to learn, to pull and shape subscription data from billing, CRM, and ERP systems

• You design how models, data, and workflows fit together: assumptions separated from calculations, consistent metric definitions, clear documentation

Extra points if you have:

• Experience modeling headcount and operating expenses alongside revenue

• Background in FP&A tooling beyond Excel (Adaptive Insights, Anaplan, Power BI, or similar)

• Experience supporting board reporting or fundraising materials directly

• $130,000 - $180,000 base salary, depending on your location and experience Tier 1 city residents: $150,000 - $180,000 All other locations: $130,000 - $160,000

jobs.title: Senior/Staff Infrastructure & Security Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT CIVILGRID

CivilGrid is the trusted civil design platform powering affordable infrastructure renewal and growth. We give utilities, civil engineers, and municipalities a single, collaborative source of truth for what's underground so teams can plan, design, and build faster, smarter, and safer.



Our platform consolidates utility records, geotechnical and environmental data, paving moratoriums, and jurisdictional requirements directly from 3,000+ utilities, agencies, and municipalities with full chain-of-custody documentation. Teams at PG&E, Mark Thomas, and dozens of leading engineering firms use CivilGrid to cut research time by up to 88%, reduce project costs, prevent dig-ins, and accelerate delivery on the projects that keep communities running.



We're a venture-backed Series A startup tackling a $4.7T US infrastructure market that has been underserved by software for decades. Founded by industry insiders, each with 10+ years in utilities and civil engineering, we move fast, ship work that matters, and stay close to the customers and field teams we build for.



WHY THIS ROLE

We're looking for a Security & Infrastructure Engineer to own our security posture and assist in supporting our cloud platform and reliability as we scale into large utilities and civil engineering firms. You'll take over and grow our security program, working across engineering, IT, and leadership. The role is on the Systems team that spans DevOps, SRE, and security. Your focus is security but you will contribute across the team.



This role reports to the Head of Engineering. It is a hybrid role with expectations that you are working from our Boston, MA office at least 3 days per week if hired.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Partner with engineering to embed reliability and security into the SDLC and infrastructure decisions

 - Run our security program: SOC 2 readiness and audits, vendor reviews, access controls, endpoint security, and threat modeling

 - Define and enforce policies for identity, secrets, data handling, and production access across the company

 - Lead incident response for both security events, and some reliability events, from detection through resolution and follow-up

 - Harden and monitor our GIS servers (Windows Server) alongside our AWS platform

 - Build and maintain our Trust Center, and lead security reviews with customers

 - Contribute to our AWS environment end to end: VPC architecture, ECS, RDS, secrets management, IAM, networking, and cost optimization

 - Contribute to improving reliability practices: SLOs, observability, alerting, on-call rotation, runbooks, and blameless post-incident reviews

 - The tech:
   
   - AWS ECS, Postgres on RDS managed with CDK
   
   - GitHub, Datadog, Slack, Notion, Drata



WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - At least 5-8 years of experience across  product security, platform security, or security engineering, with hands-on experience with DevOps or SRE of production AWS infrastructure

 - Experience running or supporting a SOC 2 program, including evidence collection, control design, and auditor coordination

 - Deep working knowledge of AWS (VPC, ECS, RDS, IAM, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch) and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CDK, or equivalent)

 - Experience running vulnerability management, from scanner findings and outside reports to fixes shipped

 - Track record of improving reliability in production: defining SLOs, building observability, running on-call, and leading post-incident reviews

 - Startup ready: autonomous, moves fast, takes initiative without being asked

 - Strong verbal and written communication, able to articulate ideas clearly and collaborate effectively

BONUS POINTS

 - Experience supporting B2B products sold into regulated industries (utilities, energy, public sector)



HOW WE WORK

We're a small, but rapidly growing team that ships. Expect direct feedback, real ownership from day one, and proximity to customers — huge utilities, public agencies, and engineering firms whose work depends on what we build. We default to in-person collaboration where it matters and remote-friendly flexibility otherwise. We hire people who care deeply about their craft and the communities our customers serve.



COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

The base salary range for this role is $137,318 - $192,960.



Base salary is only one part of your total compensation package at CivilGrid, which also includes meaningful early-stage equity, comprehensive benefits, and the opportunity to shape a category-defining company. The base salary range listed above may encompass various levels and/or geographic locations; final offers are determined based on the candidate's experience, skills, level, and work location.



In addition to base and equity, we offer:

 - Company-funded medical, dental, and vision insurance — including medical plans at no cost to the employee

 - FSA (health and dependent care)

 - Unlimited PTO and a culture that expects you to actually use it

 - 401(k) plan

 - Flexible, remote-friendly work environment

 - A high-trust team, real ownership, and the chance to do the most meaningful work of your career



EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

CivilGrid is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. Employment decisions at CivilGrid are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications. If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, please contact us — we're happy to help.

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As an Enterprise Account Executive, you will drive regional revenue by executing a sophisticated, channel-centric sales strategy that leverages deep partnerships with VARs and MSPs. You will own the entire sales lifecycle from aggressive pipeline generation via the MEDDPICC methodology to navigating complex procurement processes positioning SentinelOne’s security solutions as the premier choice in a highly competitive market. By combining a deep understanding of the cybersecurity landscape with close internal collaboration, you will align our cutting-edge product offerings with the mission-critical security needs of enterprise customers across the northern Florida region. Location: must be based in Texas.

What will you do?

Primary responsibilities include:

• Run a sophisticated sales process from prospecting to closure in collaboration across the organization

• Partner with our channel team to drive both net-new and recurring revenue

• Partner with channel managers to build pipeline and grow revenue for the assigned territory

• Be an influential partner for customers within the cybersecurity industry and become an expert of SentinelOne products

• Stay well educated and informed about SentinelOne's competitive landscape and how to sell the value of our solutions and competitive differentiation

• Prepare and provide accurate forecasts to management on a weekly basis

• Consistently meet, or exceed sales quotas

What skills and knowledge you should bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

• 8+ years of previous experience selling to Enterprise accounts, ideally in a MEDDPICC, business-to-business SaaS environment

• 5+ years of above-quota sales experience, preferably as a Sales Executive/Manager

• Strong communication and presentation skills, both internally and externally; ability to engage with a variety of technical and business leaders

• Experience closing deals with an average deal size of $500k+

• Passionate about sales, the cybersecurity industry, and technology

• Experience in a hypergrowth environment, preferred

• Experience building new pipeline of customers while fostering relationships with existing customers

• Deep understanding of the cybersecurity solutions sought by Enterprise customers, CISO and other C-Suite Officers

• Ability to identify and articulate competitive differentiation and customer value proposition

• Superb organizational and reporting skills, Salesforce experience preferred

• Leadership skills that drive results - Fostering an ecosystem of people including sales engineers, channel, marketing, executive sponsors, immediate management, procurement, etc. to effectively advance enterprise sales campaigns to close

• "Whatever it takes" attitude and drive to deliver above-quota performance

• Self-motivated, constant learner, and ability to receive feedback

• Experience working with channel and alliance partners and a strong understanding of a channel-centric GTM approaches

• Receptive to feedback and eager to learn

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.
