jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Tokenization
jobs.description:
At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. It’s big, it’s bold, and we’re already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs.

If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.

THE WORK:

Capital markets still settle on infrastructure built decades ago. Trillions of dollars in fund assets sit idle in settlement delays and collateral buffers because no rail can move legal title in real time. We are building that rail on the XRP Ledger, and it is already live: tokenized funds exist on XRPL today as Multi-Purpose Tokens (MPTs), moving as collateral across issuance, distribution and repo with some of the world's largest asset managers and custodians.

You will own the two protocol workstreams that decide how far this goes.

Token standards. MPTs need to grow from a fund token into a complete issuance framework for institutions: asset restrictions, corporate events, programmable behavior. Get this right and the next wave of assets (commercial paper, commodities, bonds, equities) can be issued, held and mobilized natively on a public ledger. Each asset class brings its own rules, and you will determine what fits within the protocol and what remains outside it.

Privacy. Institutions will not trade on a ledger where every position is visible. Confidential MPT brings capital-markets-grade confidentiality to a public chain. You will be responsible for its progress from initial rollout to enterprise-wide adoption. This covers keeping up with new emerging technologies and industry trends, and working with custodians and wallets supporting development into vaults and payments. These are open problems across the industry. Few teams anywhere in the world are working on all of them at once.

This is a role where you witness your impact directly. The specifications you write become amendments to an open-source ledger, adopted by the XRPL validators community and used by real institutions moving real money. You will work alongside protocol engineers, cryptographers, custodians and issuers, with the backing of a team that has already brought the first institutional funds on-chain.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

• Lead the tokenization roadmap for XRPL: MPT evolution, transfer controls, corporate actions and programmable tokens, and decide what belongs in the protocol versus above it.

• Lead the privacy roadmap: take Confidential MPTs from mainnet launch to institutional scale, including key rotation and recovery, performance targets and confidential vaults.

• Generate new feature specifications and build the consensus behind them, working with Ripple engineering, XRPL validators and open-source contributors to carry proposals from concept to amendment.

• Set the requirements and priorities for each new asset class, and shape the go-to-market that brings capital markets participants onto XRPL.

• Make new primitives usable, not just live: bring hardware wallets, custodians and issuer platforms along so institutions can adopt on day one.

• Scope the compliance capabilities that regulated issuers need to meet their obligations on XRPL.

• Partner with developer growth and documentation teams so institutions can originate assets on XRPL without a Ripple engineer in the room.

• Define the metrics that show the work is landing: XRPL's share of tokenized assets, issuance volume and ecosystem integrations.

In your first 90 days, you will take charge of a single roadmap across tokenization and privacy and know every open item on it. By the end of your first year, you will have successfully delivered the next generation of tokenization capabilities. And outlined what institutional privacy on XRPL entails.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

• Experience shipping technical platform or protocol products as a product manager, typically six or more years, with a record of taking complex things from idea to adoption.

• Comfort with protocol-level design: you can work through ledger internals, token standards and cryptography-adjacent questions (confidential transactions, key management) alongside engineers, and you enjoy learning the parts you do not know yet.

• Clear writing: specifications, requirements and positioning that bring engineers, partners and executives to the same page.

• A collaborative way of working: you build alignment across distributed teams and partners, and you are comfortable shaping the roadmap when the answers are not yet known.

Nice to have:

• Capital markets experience: funds, issuance, collateral and settlement workflows, or the regulatory considerations institutional issuers work with.

• Experience with open-source, standards or community governance processes.

For positions that will be based in NY, the annual salary range for this position is below. Actual salaries may vary based on numerous factors including, among other things, an individual applicant’s experience and qualifications for the position. This range does not include equity or additional compensation, such as bonuses or commissions.

NY Annual Base Salary Range

$180,000—$225,000 USD

WHO WE ARE:

Do Your Best Work

• The opportunity to build in a fast-paced start-up environment with experienced industry leaders

• A learning environment where you can dive deep into the latest technologies and make an impact. A professional development budget to support other modes of learning.

• Thrive in an environment where no matter what race, ethnicity, gender, origin, or culture they identify with, every employee is a respected, valued, and empowered part of the team.

• In-office collaboration for moments that matter is important to our culture, and we give managers and teams the flexibility to decide which 10+ days a month they come in.

• Bi-weekly all-company meeting - business updates and ask me anything style discussion with our Leadership Team

• We come together for moments that matter which include team offsites, team bonding activities, happy hours and more!

Take Control of Your Finances

• Competitive salary, bonuses, and equity

• Competitive benefits that cover physical and mental healthcare, retirement, family forming, and family support

• Employee giving match

• Mobile phone stipend

Take Care of Yourself

• R&R days so you can rest and recharge

• Generous wellness reimbursement and weekly onsite & virtual programming

• Generous vacation policy - work with your manager to take time off when you need it

• Industry-leading parental leave policies. Family planning benefits.

• Catered lunches, fully-stocked kitchens with premium snacks/beverages, and plenty of fun events

Benefits listed above are for full-time employees.

Ripple is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We do not discriminate against qualified employees or applicants because of race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, sexual identity, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, marital status, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, military status, or any other characteristic protected by local law or ordinance.

jobs.title: Product Lead, CodePath EDU
jobs.description:
CodePath is the largest educator of college computer science students in the country. We've trained over 50,000 students from more than 1,000 universities. Our partners include Amazon, Google, and other leading technology companies. After nearly a decade of training technical talent, we launched a $150M initiative with Anthropic to prepare people for careers in AI.

We're expanding into new markets and growing our team as AI changes the workforce. People joining CodePath now will help shape this next stage of our work.

We believe technical skills create opportunities. Our goal is to train millions of learners and create lasting economic impact. If you want to build something new, take ownership, and see the results of your work, this is a place to do it.

About the Role

Location: Remote (US)
Role Type: Full-Time
Reporting to: Chief Executive Officer
Total Compensation: $200,000 - $232,000

CodePath EDU is how universities bring CodePath into their own computer science departments. Faculty at partner universities teach CodePath courses, often for credit, using our curriculum, our platform, and our support. As AI changes what a computer science degree has to deliver, universities need a partner that helps their faculty teach AI-native software engineering.

The Product Lead, CodePath EDU owns the products faculty and administrators use to do that. The current vision is a comprehensive offering that helps instructors deliver the most effective computer science courses.

Today, our growth comes primarily from student word of mouth. The goal for CodePath EDU is for faculty to drive deeper institutional adoption: solve a faculty need, grow adoption across the department, and create the case for an institution-wide partnership.

What you'll do

• Own the CodePath EDU product end-to-end

• Talk with faculty and administrators every week, and turn what you learn into a prioritized roadmap tied to adoption, retention, and growth

• Take our LMS integrations with key higher education tools like Canvas and Blackboard to maturity

• Use AI across your entire workflow to compress weeks into days: prototypes, requirements, evals for the AI features you ship, and your own analysis of usage data

• Partner with Higher Education Partnerships on what each campus needs to adopt, expand, and move to a deeper partnership, and give that team the product evidence they bring to university leaders

• Define the metrics that prove the product works at scale, including active instructors, semester-over-semester instructor retention, students reached through partner faculty, and hours saved per instructor

• Set a high bar for design quality, because faculty adopt tools that feel simple on the first try

Who you are

You are a builder who has taken a product from 0-to-1 and then made it work at scale, and you have done it in more than one kind of environment. You are deeply AI-Native, and you have shipped AI features yourself. Education experience is welcome and not required. We care most that you have built products busy professionals adopt by choice.

Required

• You have taken a product from zero to one and scaled it, in more than one kind of environment, such as a large company and a startup

• You have shipped AI features to production and have written and shipped code regularly over the past year, with or without AI

• You have built software for professional users who adopted it because it saved them time

• You have owned more than your title said, and done work nobody asked for

• You run without a playbook or much management, and set your own priorities and roadmap

• You hold strong opinions, change course on evidence, and can sell a product strategy to engineers, faculty, and university leaders alike

Preferred

• Fluency with the modern product management toolkit: product analytics, Figma, SQL, and AI coding tools like Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor

• Founder experience, or early-employee time at a hyperscaling company

• Products you built that individual users adopted first and organizations bought later

• Learning management systems, LTI integrations, or other edtech infrastructure

• Systems that integrate with institutions, such as universities

Full-Time Employee Benefits

This is a remote position—work from anywhere in the US! CodePath prioritizes employee well-being with a competitive benefits package to support your health, financial security, and work-life balance.

• Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance (90% employer-covered for employees and dependents), employer-funded healthcare reimbursement, FSAs, and Employee Assistance Program

• Financial Security: 401(k), employer-paid life & disability insurance, and identity theft protection

• Work-Life Balance: Generous PTO, paid holidays, 10 weeks of fully paid parental leave, and an annual year-end company closure (Dec 24 – Jan 2)

• Professional Growth: $1,000 annual professional development stipend and home office setup support

• ​​Student Loan Forgiveness: CodePath is a qualifying employer for Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF), helping employees manage student loan debt

• Additional Perks: Pet wellness plans, legal services, home/auto insurance discounts, and exclusive marketplace savings

Pay range

$200,000—$232,000 USD

jobs.title: Territory Manager (West Idaho)
jobs.description:
ABOUT HALTER

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard. 

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund https://foundersfund.com, Bessemer Venture Partners https://www.bvp.com/, BOND, https://www.bondcap.com/ DCVC https://www.dcvc.com/, Blackbird https://www.blackbird.vc/, Promus Ventures https://www.promusventures.com/, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures https://www.icehouseventures.co.nz/?utm_term=icehouse%20ventures&utm_campaign=Brand+Keywords&utm_source=adwords&utm_medium=ppc&hsa_acc=4064636360&hsa_cam=16902737884&hsa_grp=134004309485&hsa_ad=592971340272&hsa_src=g&hsa_tgt=kwd-1082530126230&hsa_kw=icehouse%20ventures&hsa_mt=b&hsa_net=adwords&hsa_ver=3&gclid=Cj0KCQjw2v-gBhC1ARIsAOQdKY0J0DepRVFDmjQlAkJPbZuQnLSA5UVzUzOXYiPxkjX-SeVa513_BhkaAr-MEALw_wcB.

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/halter-limited & Instagram https://www.instagram.com/lifeathalter/.


ABOUT THE ROLE

Ever dream about being in tech but aren’t quite ready to trade in your cowboy boots? Look no further than Halter! As the leading provider of virtual fencing technology, Halter is on a mission to enable 50% of the world’s landmass to be more productive and sustainable. This role is paramount for our growth aspirations and will enable us to continue making an impact on ranches across the US.

As a Territory Manager at Halter, you will play a critical role in driving new business growth and ensuring customer success within your designated territory. You will be responsible for executing sales strategies, building strong customer relationships, and meeting ambitious growth targets, all while acting as Halter’s on-the-ground representative. This role requires a proactive and hands-on approach, with a focus on both expansion and long-term customer satisfaction. In this role, you will prioritize daily efforts that optimize performance and drive value for your customers. Working closely with cross-functional teams, including Product, Support, and Customer Onboarding, you’ll share field insights to ensure Halter’s technology continues to meet the needs of US farmers.

Your day-to-day could include being on horseback, helping customers gather their cattle, on a side-by-side traversing their pastures, talking about how Halter could benefit their pastures, or attending industry events like CattleCon or your local Livestock Association meetups.




WHAT YOUR DAY COULD LOOK LIKE

 - Prospecting New Business: You’re driving up driveways, attending local cattle auctions, meeting with your local Livestock, Cattleman's, Stockman's associations, building your new business pipeline through outbound lead generation efforts. You’re fielding inbound leads in a timely manner, prioritizing administrative tasks with your in-field activities.

 - In-Field Sales: You don’t mind getting your hands and boots dirty. Halter is best discussed over a coffee at a kitchen table, in the horse saddle, or on a side-by-side in a pasture. You’re out on the ranch helping potential customers before diving into the value of Halter. You’re dropping off coffee during calving season. You value the magic moments that make all the difference to our customers.

 - Expanding Existing Opportunities: You’re always looking for new opportunities, and that includes expanding your existing customers with Halter. You find value in expanding relationships and finding new ways to increase value over time. Not every rancher will collar all of their cows, so you see this as a unique opportunity to meet your goals.

 - Hitting Sales Targets: High-growth sales targets don’t scare you; you step up to a challenge and like shooting high. You’re an expert pipeline manager and don’t second-guess unqualifying a lead. You’re able to manage today’s deals while keeping next month in your sights.

 - Customer Account Management: Building relationships is more than just making the sale to you. After the sale, you aim to maintain close relationships with your customers to ensure their ongoing satisfaction, provide support, and address any challenges they face with Halter’s products. You’ll also ensure a smooth handoff from sales to customer onboarding and deployment of Halter, helping customers get the most value from Halter’s solutions.

 - Territory Ownership: You have a high level of ownership and take pride in what you build. Owning an entire territory means giving treatment to every corner and leaving no stone unturned. You value being the face of your territory, meeting with high-level stakeholders from various local, state, and federal agencies to build lasting relationships with regional agricultural groups.

 - Customer Onboarding: Your high level of ownership doesn’t stop after the sale. You dive in to make sure your customers have the very best onboarding experience possible. You actively own the end-to-end customer experience during onboarding and deployment of Halter’s product, ensuring a smooth transition from sales to implementation even when you’ve handed off the customer to different teams across Halter.

 - Field Learnings & Feedback: Feedback is not only paramount to the companies you want to work for, but it’s also ingrained in how you would own your territory. Serving as the primary point of contact for gathering customer feedback in your territory, you work tirelessly to advocate for what your customers need.

 - Collaborating with Support Teams: You’re a natural collaborator, seeking out partners across Halter to resolve any issues your customers encounter, and quickly. You escalate problems as needed and ensure that customers in your territory feel fully supported.

 - Attending Industry Events: You leverage opportunities at relevant industry and Halter events to generate leads and deepen relationships with existing customers. You’ll participate in demonstrations and network to expand Halter’s influence in the market.

 - Contributing to the US Sales Strategy: You strongly believe that a team can only be stronger when they work together. You strive to work with the broader team to optimize and evolve the sales process, ensuring it fits the US market. As we scale, your input will help drive greater efficiencies.



YOU’LL BE GREAT IF YOU EXHIBIT

 - Driven Attitude & Communication skills: Results-driven, motivated, and adaptable, you excel in high-stakes environments. You’re well-prepared and skilled at communicating with customers and internal teams alike. You are proactive and do not wait to act.

 - Ranching / Cattle Experience: You know the ropes (and the reins) of ranching or cattle operations, understanding the unique challenges of the industry. This experience allows you to connect meaningfully with customers about what matters most.

 - Sales & Customer Success Expertise: You have a strong history of creating new business opportunities, negotiating a value-based sales conversation, and have a background in building lasting customer relationships. You build relationships versus transactional sales, aiming for the long-term success stories and can expand existing relationships through upsell opportunities.

 - Territory Management experience: Experience managing a large territory with a balanced focus on sales and customer success, ideally within agriculture or technology.

 - Problem Solving & Collaboration ability: Resourceful and quick-thinking, you work well with cross-functional teams to address challenges and drive solutions.

 - Willingness to Travel: Frequent travel within your territory to engage with customers and prospects.



BONUS THINGS YOU COULD BRING ALONG TO THE ROLE

 - Familiarity with precision agriculture or virtual fencing technologies.

 - Background in customer-facing roles within agriculture technology.

 - Background in selling software (SaaS) solutions in a B2B environment.



OUR BENEFITS

 - Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP): Own a part of Halter and share in our growth and success

 - 401(k): 100% match on the first 3% contributed, plus 50% match on the next 2% (up to a 4% employer match), with immediate vesting

 - Comprehensive health benefits: Medical, dental, and vision coverage starting the first day of the month after you join (with most premiums covered, including 100% of employee-only health premiums on select plans)

 - Employee Assistance Program (EAP) & paid wellness leave: Access confidential support through JustWorks plus 3 paid wellness days per year

 - Personal growth fund: $750 USD per year to support learning, development, or personal growth goals

 - Unlimited PTO: Take time off when you need it—no accrual required, available from day one

 - Parental leave: 16 weeks paid leave for birthing parents and 8 weeks paid leave for non-birthing parents

 - Onboarding travel to New Zealand: Fly to NZ for onboarding at Halter HQ in Auckland—meet the team, visit a test farm, and immerse yourself in all things Halter

The annual OTE salary range for this role is $140,000 - $165,000. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Halter and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location.


JOIN OUR TEAM

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!

If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!

Please also feel free to check out the careers page https://www.halterhq.com/careers for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/halter-limited & Instagram https://www.instagram.com/lifeathalter/.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, AI
jobs.description:
PermitFlow is redefining how America builds. We’re an applied AI company serving the nation’s builders, tackling one of the largest information challenges in the economy: understanding what can be built, where, and how. Our AI agent workforce helps the fastest-growing construction companies navigate everything from permitting and licensing to inspections and project closeouts – accelerating housing, clean-energy, and infrastructure development across the country.

Despite being a $1.6T industry, construction still suffers from massive delays, wasted capital, and lost opportunity. PermitFlow has already delivered unprecedented speed, accuracy, and visibility to over $20B in development, helping contractors reduce compliance time, de-risk projects, and scale with confidence.

As the U.S. enters a new capex supercycle across data centers, factories, housing, and renewables, joining PermitFlow means building the AI infrastructure at the core of every construction project driving the next wave of reindustrialization.

We’ve raised over $90M, most recently completing our Series B, https://www.permitflow.com/blog/permitflow-series-b from top-tier investors including Accel, Kleiner Perkins https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7401703305569275904/, Initialized, Y Combinator, Felicis, and Altos Ventures, with backing from leaders at OpenAI, Google, Procore, ServiceTitan, Zillow, PlanGrid, and Uber.

 

Our HQ is in New York City with a hybrid schedule (3 in-office days per week). We prefer NYC-based candidates or those open to relocation.

 


ROLE OVERVIEW

We're hiring a Staff/Principal Engineer to build PermitFlow's core product AI Assistant, infrastructure, and workflow agents. This is a role that will require UX and technical acumen to deliver high quality agents in a genuinely complex domain, while also up-leveling our core agentic infrastructure and data flywheel.

Submitting a permit means comprehending construction documents, extracting project details, confirming every requirement has been met and often filling in pdf forms. Errors compound across steps and a failed submission adds real cost for our customers as projects slow.

The ideal candidate will mix an exceptional history of product delivery with true experience building AI and Agentic infrastructure from the ground up. You ship quickly, instrument everything, hold a high quality bar, and stay close to the users of what you build.

This role reports directly to our VP of Engineering. We're hiring at Staff or Principal, with the level based on past experience and interview performance.

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the agent architecture. Design the reasoning loop, planning and decomposition strategy, state and session model, and recovery behavior for long-running tasks.

 - Build the context layer. Retrieval, memory, and context-window management over project documents, jurisdictional requirements, prior submissions, and customer-specific conventions.

 - Design the action surface. Define the tools the assistant can call, the permissions model around them, and the human-in-the-loop checkpoints for actions that are expensive or irreversible.

 - Make evaluation the engine of progress. Stand up offline and online eval harnesses that measure task completion and failure modes. Build the iteration loop that lets the whole team improve agent quality on evidence.

 - Set the bar for the org. Establish the abstractions, SDKs, and review standards other engineers build agentic features on.

 - Stay close to the customer. Sit with permit coordinators and builders, watch the assistant fail in real conditions, and bring that back into the system design.

 


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - You've shipped an assistant or agentic product at meaningful scale

 - Deep, current knowledge of the agentic stack (tool calling and tool design, context engineering, memory, retrieval, orchestration patterns, etc)

 - You’ve built eval harnesses that changed what a team worked on, and you can articulate what makes an eval trustworthy.

 - You are a genuinely strong software engineer, not an AI specialist who needs someone else to make it production-ready. You’ve owned services in production and you write code that other people are glad to inherit.

 - You operate with earned authority. You influence through demonstrated judgment, working code, and clear writing rather than title or mandate.

 - 10+ years of software engineering experience with recent time spent building LLM-powered products.

 


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a high-growth company

 - 100% company-paid base medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees + healthcare FSA

 - 401(k) savings plan

 - Unlimited PTO and paid family leave

 - Home office & equipment stipend

 - Daily in-office lunch and dinner provided

 - Commuter benefits (pre-tax transit and parking)

We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities. All employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Growth
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion’s mission is to help everyone build beautiful tools for their life’s work. Notion's Growth Engineers make the everyone part of that happen with a combination of creativity and data to unlock business growth. This team accelerates the value Notion provides to an increasing audience of users. We are owners of the ins and outs of our business, using a blend of data, qualitative research, and product intuition to drive business growth.

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Build technical foundations that help the broader team and coding agents experiment, build and ship more.

 - Drive technical and product vision as an engineering leader within the org, building alignment with other eng teams and cross functionally, bringing clarity to the roadmap.

 - Deliver experiments end-to-end, from ideation to analysis, that balance the dimensions of product and the business appropriately.

 - Get to know the Notion customer to understand key points in the customer journey and uncover insights that will drive activation and engagement




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Finding the problems worth solving: You don't wait to be handed a roadmap. You dig into growth data, customer research, and the codebase to find the highest-leverage opportunities, then make the case for them and drive alignment on what to pursue.

 - Data and experimentation as a practice: You have Growth Engineering experience at another company, and you've built experimentation into how a team works: defining success criteria, running A/B tests, and turning results into decisions others follow.

 - Shipping polished user interfaces: You build fast, well-crafted web experiences with React and modern web technologies, and you know what it takes to keep them working as usage grows.

You know how to build systems for agents and treat the system as the deliverable, improving it continuously for accelerated impact.

 - Putting users first: You think critically about the implications of what you're building, and how it shapes real people's lives. You understand that reach comes with responsibility for our impact, good and bad.

Our goal is simple: double the output of our entire organization while raising the quality bar. The scope is the whole platform. You’ll work across infrastructure, shared services, and product code, and step in as a product engineer anywhere in the stack when that is the fastest way to move.

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Analyst
jobs.description:
The Cybersecurity Analyst supports day-to-day Security Operations and Incident Response by monitoring and investigating threats, coordinating incident response, conducting threat intelligence and threat hunting, managing operational vulnerability workflows, and maintaining accurate cases and security metrics. Security Engineering owns security-platform engineering and vulnerability-scanning platforms, while technology and application owners execute remediation.

This is a remote position open to candidates anywhere in the United States based in EST. Candidates based in the greater Seattle area will work a hybrid remote/in-office schedule from our casual, pet-friendly office at least three days a week.

Responsibilities:

Security Monitoring & Incident Response

• Monitor and triage alerts across identity, endpoint, email, network, cloud, application, vulnerability, and data-protection technologies.
• Validate, enrich, classify, and prioritize security events and investigate phishing, account compromise, malware, ransomware, unauthorized access, data exposure, insider threat, and third-party events.
• Execute approved containment actions within assigned permissions and coordinate infrastructure-level or production changes with Technology Operations.
• Collect and preserve evidence, identify affected users, devices, accounts, systems, repositories, and data, and support eradication, recovery validation, heightened monitoring, and closure.

Threat Intelligence & Threat Hunting

• Collect and evaluate intelligence from commercial, government, industry, open-source, MDR, vendor, and internal sources.
• Analyze threat actors, campaigns, tactics, techniques, procedures, indicators, exploited vulnerabilities, and targeted technologies for relevance to Trupanion.
• Create tactical and operational intelligence products and operationalize findings through investigations, detections, hunting queries, watchlists, blocking actions, phishing simulation scenarios, and runbook updates.
• Conduct hypothesis-driven hunts across identity, endpoint, email, network, cloud, and application telemetry using MITRE ATT&CK and document scope, queries, evidence, findings, and follow-up actions.

Vulnerability Management Partnership

• Validate vulnerability findings, assess risk and business exposure, prioritize remediation using threat intelligence and incident telemetry, identify indications of exploitation, and escalate urgent vulnerabilities.
• Perform threat hunts against affected technologies and recommend temporary containment or monitoring when active exploitation or incident correlation is identified.
• Partner with Security Engineering, which owns vulnerability-scanning platforms, integrations, technical configuration, and platform reliability.
• Coordinate remediation assignments with technology and application owners, maintain the vulnerability ticket flow, track progress against defined service levels, report overdue exposure, and escalate ownership or delivery issues through the established governance process.
• Maintain operational oversight of vulnerability validation, prioritization, ticketing, remediation follow-up, SLA reporting, and escalation; remediation execution remains with the technology or application owner responsible for the affected asset or service.

Automation, Forensics & Case Management

• Develop and maintain approved automation workflows, scripts, and playbooks for alert enrichment, investigation, authorized response, and case consistency.
• Preserve identity, endpoint, email, cloud, network, application, and audit-log evidence under approved forensic, legal-hold, integrity, and chain-of-custody procedures.
• Maintain complete case records covering severity, affected assets, evidence, analysis, actions, decisions, communications, and closure rationale.
• Validate incident containment and corrective actions through available telemetry, testing, or monitoring.

Breach, Identity, Third-Party & AI Investigations

• Support breach investigations by identifying affected repositories, records, data types, individuals, business entities, and jurisdictions for Legal and Privacy review.
• Investigate token theft, MFA changes, privilege escalation, malicious application consent, mailbox manipulation, and compromised user, privileged, service-principal, or workload identities.
• Investigate third-party, supply-chain, and AI-related security notifications or suspected misuse and document potential Trupanion exposure.

Operating Model & Continuity

• Execute alert triage, investigations, MDR service monitoring, threat-intelligence analysis, threat hunting, vulnerability validation and prioritization, remediation follow-up, security metrics and reporting, case documentation, and authorized security-tool actions.
• Escalate architecture, complex integration, detection-platform design, routine vulnerability-management administration, and permanent engineering needs to Security Engineering.
• Provide structured handovers of active alerts, incidents, intelligence, investigations, and urgent exploitation-driven vulnerability exposures across operating regions.
• Provide technical evidence to Legal and Privacy and do not independently determine legal privilege, regulatory interpretation, or notification obligations.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, Digital Forensics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
• 3+ years of experience in cybersecurity operations, incident response, IT operations, system administration, network security, or a related area.
• Experience investigating alerts using SIEM, EDR/XDR, identity, email, cloud, network, or vulnerability technologies.
• Knowledge of common attacker techniques, phishing, malware, account compromise, privilege misuse, lateral movement, exfiltration, and vulnerability exploitation.
• Demonstrated experience applying threat intelligence and incident telemetry to vulnerability prioritization and exploitation assessment.
• Experience with security automation or scripting, digital-evidence handling, identity investigations, third-party incident analysis, and structured case management.

Skills:

• Experience with Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft 365, Azure, identity security, privileged access management, cloud security, and endpoint environments.
• Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK and common detection, threat-hunting, and incident-response methodologies.
• Understanding of vulnerability scanning and remediation workflows and the division of responsibility between vulnerability-program governance, threat-led escalation, and asset-owner remediation.
• Knowledge of NIST CSF, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, NYDFS cybersecurity requirements, or privacy and breach-response obligations.
• Relevant certification such as Security+, CySA+, SC-200, GCIH, GCIA, or equivalent experience is preferred.

Additional Requirements:

• Ability to support defined US business-hour coverage and participate in an escalation or on-call rotation.
• Availability to assist with high-severity incidents outside normal working hours when required.
• Ability to handle confidential, legally sensitive, and security-restricted information appropriately.

Compensation:

• The base salary range for this position is $120,000 - $140,000 on a full-time schedule.
• Along with base compensation, Trupanion employees are currently eligible for monthly bonuses.
• We want all employees to be invested in Trupanion’s success, so we grant Restricted Stock Units to all new team members. Our new hire grants vest over 4 years.

#LI-HYBRID

Benefits and Perks:

• Full medical, dental, and vision benefits at no cost to the employee
• Four weeks of paid time off and 9 paid float holidays (you can decide which days are most important to you!)
• Five-week sabbatical after five years of employment
• Open, casual, pet-friendly, and fun office environment
• Free medical health insurance for your pet (1 dog or cat)
• Paid time off to volunteer at nonprofit organizations
• Seattle Office Amenities: Free on-site gym, free dog walking services for office pets during business hours, free parking, and paid ORCA cards.

For more information about Trupanion, visit https://trupanion.com/about

Learn more about how Trupanion has revolutionized our industry and the reimbursement model: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vdWZ4KHiPTQ

jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description:
At Two Six Technologies, we build, deploy, and implement innovative products that solve the world’s most complex challenges today. Through unrivaled collaboration and unwavering trust, we push the boundaries of what’s possible to empower our team and support our customers in building a safer global future.

Overview of Opportunity

We are looking for a Full-Stack Software Engineer to join one of our Stream-Aligned feature teams. In this role, you will own customer-facing product features end-to-end within a single, unified monorepo. We operate on a T-shaped engineering philosophy: we expect you to bring deep expertise in your favorite area of the stack, combined with the technical curiosity and empathy to navigate the other layers. You will work alongside a team of cross-functional full stack developers, taking features from initial concept down through the database schema, API logic, and user interface in a single pull request.

What You Will Do:

• Deliver Vertical Product Value: Own the technical design, implementation, and deployment of features end-to-end. You will solve complex problems and write code across the user interface, API endpoints, and database models to ship complete slices of user value, incorporating AI tools to enhance your workflow and support your decision-making.

• Practice Full-Context Code Reviews: Review your teammates’ full-stack pull requests. You will look at the entire feature context rather than just a single layer to ensure overall code readability and maintainability.

• Incorporate Automated Quality: Write automated unit and integration tests alongside your feature code as part of your standard development loop, ensuring your features are safe and resilient before deployment.

• Contribute to Shared Frameworks: Identify common patterns in your feature work and work to contribute reusable components or helpers to the shared development platform.

• Collaborate and Swarm: Participate in daily team huddles focused on moving shared objectives forward. You will pair-program and swarm with teammates to clear blockers and solve challenging problems.

• Shape Global Architecture: Represent your team's technical insights by actively participating in our cross-functional architecture guilds to guide standard company patterns.

What We Are Looking For

• T-Shaped Engineering Mindset: At least 1 year of software engineering experience with a recognized anchor specialty (e.g., strong frontend capabilities or backend architecture) paired with a solid working knowledge of the rest of the stack.

• Full-Stack Capability: Comfort modifying relational database schemas, writing API endpoints, and assembling modern component-driven user interfaces.

• Systems Thinker: A strong understanding of continuous delivery principles. Success for you means shipping value in small, frequent, and stable increments.

• Technical Humility: A passion for peer mentoring and pairing. You care more about team velocity and clean communication than proving a single technical point

• Security Clearance: Eligibility and willingness to obtain and maintain a DoD Security clearance up to TS/SCI

Our Tech Stack
You don’t need to be an expert in all of these, but you should be excited to work with them daily!

• Frontend: TypeScript, Ember.js

• Backend & APIs: Python, FastAPI

• Database: PostgreSQL, Avro schema

• Infrastructure & Platform: Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins

Why This Role is Unique
You will not be confined to a functional silo or forced to pass your code over a wall to a separate backend, database, or testing department. You will have full ownership of your domain's codebase. Backed by a self-service Platform Team providing you with the tools you need to thrive, you will have the freedom and resources to build, test, and ship your own ideas while expanding your breadth of knowledge across the stack.

jobs.title: Senior Commercialization Process Engineer
jobs.description:
Natera is seeking a Senior Commercialization Process Engineer to serve as the critical bridge between assay development and scalable lab production. This bench-level role is embedded early in the NPI process, working alongside Molecular Assay Development, Bioinformatics, Engineering, and Lab Operations teams to ensure that new oncology products are designed for production from day one, not retrofitted for scale after launch.

This is not a steady-state production role. This person thrives in the ambiguous, fast-moving space between R&D and operations, identifying workflow gaps, bridging informatics and lab systems, and ensuring that what gets built can be run at commercial scale reliably and repeatably.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Embed within New Product Introduction (NPI) programs from feasibility through design transfer, providing bench-level lab operations perspective on workflow design, automation feasibility, and scalability requirements

• Partner with Molecular Assay Development, Pathology, Automation, Software Engineering, and other teams to evaluate molecular workflows (WES, WGS, RNA-Seq) and tissue-based workflows (histology, H&E, IHC) for operational readiness, identifying design decisions across multiple disciplines that could create production risk or technical debt prior to launch.

• Serve as the Lab Ops liaison to informatics and LIMS teams, ensuring software systems, sample tracking, and data pipelines are production-ready and validated before Process Validation begins

• Perform hands-on and modeling workflow assessments, identifying bottlenecks, manual steps, and failure modes that should be resolved during development rather than post-launch

• Contribute Lab Operations perspective to User Needs documentation, FMEA, and process risk assessments at each NPI stage gate

• Collaborate with Engineering on instrument qualification and automation integration to ensure new platforms are operationally ready at launch

• Document workflow findings, improvement recommendations, and operational requirements in a structured format that feeds directly into the NPI Launch Playbook

• Support E2E testing in production environments, ensuring test conditions reflect real launch-state systems and volumes

• Perform other duties as assigned

QUALIFICTAION

• B.S. or M.S. in Bioengineering, Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Biomedical Engineering, or a closely related discipline (equivalent combination of education and experience considered)

• Bachelor’s degree plus 10 years of relevant experience OR a Master’s degree with 7 years of experience OR PhD with 4 years of experience.

• Strong scientific background in molecular and cell biology, biotechnology, or biochemistry

• Working knowledge of CAP, CLIA, NYSDOH, and applicable GxP requirements, with the ability to follow and establish SOPs

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS and ABILITIES

• Familiarity with WES, WGS, or RNA-seq and other scientific workflows at a bench level, able to execute, troubleshoot, evaluate, and implement for scalability

• Experienced with NPI, product development, or assay launch processes

• Experience working at the intersection of lab operations and informatics or LIMS

• Strong working knowledge of laboratory systems, automation, software integration, with demonstrated success implementing process optimization projects

• Proficiency with data analysis tools (Excel required; Python, SQL, or AI enabled tools a plus) with basic statistical analysis

• Strong written and verbal communication skills with ability to draft technical reports, SOPs, and training documentation

• Strong team player with a proven ability to work cross-functionally across scientific, engineering, and operational teams to achieve shared goals

• A flexible, self-starter with the ability to manage multiple priorities drive tasks to completion and operates effectively in fast-paced environments

Compensation & Total Rewards

This range reflects a good-faith estimate of the base pay we reasonably expect to offer at the time of  hire. Final compensation will vary based on experience, qualifications, and internal equity considerations.

This position is also eligible for additional compensation and benefits through Natera’s robust Total Rewards program, including:

• Annual performance incentive bonus

• Long-term equity awards

• Comprehensive health benefits (medical, dental, vision)

• 401(k) with company match

• Generous paid time off and company holidays

• Additional wellness and work-life benefits

Compensation Range

$141,636—$177,045 USD

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!

For more information, visit www.natera.com.

We are committed to ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace environment, and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. Inclusive collaboration benefits our employees, our community and our patients, and is critical to our mission of changing the management of disease worldwide.

Email communications from all other domain names are not from Natera or its employees and are fraudulent. jobs.title: Leasing Consultant - Alternative Schedule

We have a fantastic Leasing Consultant opportunity available!

Weinstein Properties, headquartered in Richmond, Virginia owns and manages over 60 apartment communities in Virginia, North Carolina, Texas, Tennessee, and Georgia. Still owned and operated by the Weinstein family after 70+ years, our continued success is attributed to our hands on approach to daily operations and our focus on the customer experience.

Location: Bexley Mt. Juliet  - Mt Juliet, TN

Pay: Hourly rates are competitive (starting at $21/hour) and increasing based on experience + Quarterly Bonuses

Schedule: Must be available to work Saturdays and occasional evenings for resident events

Do you have a flexible schedule? If so, our alternative schedule leasing consultant position will give you an additional $80 per pay period bonus! This schedule is set the same each week and consists of 5 days each week working (including Saturdays) with the same 2 days off per week (Sundays and one weekday).

Example: Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, Friday and Saturday - with Sundays and Wednesdays off. If you need a different weekday off we can be flexible.

Hours are: Weekdays 9-6 Saturdays 9-5 Sundays Off

Who We Are:

At WP, we do things differently. We invest in people, not just resumes. We believe in training talent from the ground up, and many of our best Leasing Consultants didn’t come with industry experience — they came with drive, a great attitude, and a genuine desire to serve people. If you’re energetic, friendly, adaptable, and eager to learn, we’ll teach you everything you need to know to thrive in this role.

What You’ll Do:

As a Leasing Consultant, you’ll be the first impression and voice of our community. You’ll guide prospective residents through their leasing journey while building strong relationships with current residents and your team. You’ll juggle customer service, sales, and administrative tasks — and we’ll provide you with all the training and support you need to excel.

Who You Are:

• You don’t need leasing experience to succeed here — but you do need the right mindset.

• Strong Communication Skills: You're a great listener, and you can confidently and warmly connect with others, both in person and in writing.

• Customer-First Mindset: You love helping people and solving problems, even when things get tough.

• Positive Energy: You show up with enthusiasm and a can-do attitude — every day, no matter what ends up being thrown your way.

• Team Spirit: You pitch in wherever needed and care about team success over individual credit. You are game to help, even if something does not fall under your job description.

• Motivation & Drive: You’re goal-oriented, organized, and eager to grow.

• Adaptability: You can manage interruptions, shifting priorities, and fast-paced days with ease and grace.

• Initiative: You’re not afraid to jump in — whether it’s greeting someone at the door or taking ownership of a task.

What You Should Know Before You Start:

• We have high expectations — and a hands-on training program that will set you up to meet them.

• This is not a desk job — expect to be on your feet, engaging with prospects, walking the property, inspecting homes, and so much more.This job is about more than just sales – you will be expected to handle administrative tasks, address resident concerns, and help with property appearance. Everyone does a little bit of everything.

• You’ll be part of a high-performing, highly collaborative team — recognition and promotion come from commitment and results.

• This job is about more than just sales – you will be expected to handle administrative tasks, address resident concerns, and help with property appearance. Everyone does a little bit of everything.

• You’ll sometimes work outside standard hours to support resident events or assist during weather challenges.

Why Weinstein?

jobs.title: Senior Financial Analyst, Headcount & OpEx Planning
jobs.description:
Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.



We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.



We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.



If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.



About the Role:

Crusoe's Finance team is looking for a Senior Financial Analyst to own headcount and operating expense (OpEx) finance across the company. This role is the single source of truth for how many people we have, how many we're planning to hire, and what we're spending outside of capital projects — and it's responsible for the planning, budgeting, forecasting, and actuals reporting that keeps leadership and the business aligned on both. You'll partner with People, Recruiting, and department leaders on headcount planning, own the OpEx budget process end-to-end, and make sure monthly actuals tell an accurate, timely story against plan. This is a highly visible role for someone who wants to bring structure and rigor to how a scaling company manages its people and operating costs.



What You'll Be Working On:

 - Headcount Planning & Tracking: own the headcount plan and forecast across the company, partnering with People and department leaders to track open reqs, hiring pace, and attrition against plan

 - OpEx Budgeting/forecasting: lead the annual budgeting and in-year OpEx forecasting process across departments, working with budget owners to build defensible, well-documented plans

 - Actuals Reporting & Variance Analysis: own monthly and quarterly actuals reporting for headcount and OpEx, identifying variances to plan and partnering with budget owners on root cause and corrective action

 - Forecast Management: maintain rolling headcount and OpEx forecasts, updating for approved changes, hiring plan shifts, and in-year business decisions

 - Business Partnering: serve as the go-to finance contact for department leaders on headcount and OpEx questions, helping them understand their budgets and make informed trade-offs.  Partner with HR on new or changing benefit ideas to improve employee’s experience.  Additionally, partner with Marketing and other leaders on OPEX budgets / plans and associated ROI

 - Process & Systems Improvement: improve the tools and processes used to plan, track, and report on headcount and OpEx, reducing manual reconciliation and increasing self-serve visibility for stakeholders

 - Executive & Board Reporting: prepare clear, accurate headcount and OpEx reporting packages for executive leadership and the board



What You'll Bring to the Team:

 - 3+ years of progressive finance experience, including meaningful ownership of headcount and/or OpEx planning and reporting

 - Strong financial modeling skills, with advanced proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and experience with planning tools (e.g., Anaplan, Adaptive, Workday, or similar)

 - Demonstrated ability to partner with People/Recruiting teams and translate hiring plans into financial impact

 - Track record of owning a budgeting and actuals reporting process end-to-end, including variance analysis and stakeholder communication

 - Excellent attention to detail and a strong sense of ownership over data accuracy — headcount and OpEx numbers get scrutinized by leadership every month

 - Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain budget and variance drivers clearly to non-finance stakeholders

 - Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field; MBA a plus



Benefits:

 - Competitive compensation and equity packages

 - Restricted Stock Units

 - Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs

 - Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

 - Employer contributions to HSA account

 - Paid parental leave

 - Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

 - Professional development & tuition reimbursement

 - Mental health & wellness support

 - Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

 - Cell phone stipend

 - 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

 - Volunteer time off

 - Global travel insurance & emergency assistance

 - Daily meals allowance

 - Additional perks & programs specific to location



Compensation Range

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $130,000 - $160,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

jobs.title: Manager of Logistics Engineering (Supply & Marketplace)
jobs.description:
Schedule: Full Time

Job Type: Hybrid/

Salary Type: Salary

Req #: 3458

**No immigration sponsorship or transfer available for this role.**

About the Role

Uber Freight Engineering & Procurement partners with enterprise Transportation Management (TM) clients to solve complex supply chain challenges and execute strategic sourcing initiatives. In this role, you will serve as the Procurement Engineering Lead for our Greensboro Center of Excellence (COE), directing fast-paced, high-impact sourcing initiatives across key 4PL accounts.

Sitting at the intersection of client engagement, analytics, and operational execution, you will oversee a portfolio of approximately 30 annual procurement events representing ~$650M in transportation spend and 1.5M annual shipments. In addition to leading complex project execution, you will manage, coach, and scale a team of Logistics Engineers, optimizing team capacity, standardizing analytical workflows, and driving cross-functional collaboration across Operations, Carrier Management, Strategy, and enterprise TM Customers.

What You Will Do

Project Management & Sourcing Strategy

• Direct end-to-end 12-week procurement and sourcing cycles from initial project scoping through post-implementation reviews for high-visibility TM accounts.

• Analyze complex TMS datasets, design and configure JAGGAER ASO procurement events, run advanced optimization scenarios, and set up constraint models balancing cost, service reliability, and lead time.

• Host regular executive updates with key client and internal stakeholders, lead route guide optimization and network design workshops, and manage rate/SRG template uploads.

• Collaborate closely with 3PL, brokerage, and carrier management teams to strategically position network opportunities during active sourcing events.

People Leadership & Team Development

• Directly lead, mentor, and develop a team of Logistics Engineers, establishing clear goals, managing workload delegation, and conducting regular performance coaching.

• Oversee team capacity and ensure strict compliance with standard operating procedures and data governance frameworks across all procurement activities.

• Build a collaborative team culture focused on developing technical subject matter experts and future logistics leaders.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Analytics

• Serve as the primary procurement engineering contact and escalation lead for the Greensboro COE account teams.

• Build and maintain high-impact KPI dashboards, executive reporting frameworks, and Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) models using Excel and Tableau.

• Partner cross-functionally with Client Engagement, Operations, Carrier Pricing, Contracting, Network Dynamics, Data Science, and Legal to streamline procurement workflows.

Work Setup & Location

• Location: Hybrid (3 days in-office / 2 days remote). Flexible location arrangements will be evaluated based on candidate qualifications.

• Schedule: Standard business hours (Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM), with occasional peak-season operational flexibility.

Basic Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Data Analytics, Finance, or a related field (or 4+ years of relevant industry experience in lieu of a degree).

• 3+ years of professional experience in procurement operations, sourcing analytics, supply chain engineering, or transportation management.

• 2+ years of direct operational experience running, configuring, and modeling sourcing events within JAGGAER ASO (Advanced Sourcing Optimizer).

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (complex scenario modeling, nested logic, TCO models) and working knowledge of Tableau, MS Access, or Google Workspace.

• Demonstrated experience in project leadership, team mentorship, or informal peer management (e.g., project lead, onboarding/coaching junior engineers, leading cross-functional teams).

• Experience leading customer-facing presentations, stakeholder workshops, and executive-level decision-support discussions.

Preferred Qualifications

• Prior experience within a 3PL/4PL transportation management or managed services organization.

• 5+ years of professional experience in procurement operations, sourcing analytics, supply chain engineering, or transportation management.

• 4+ years of direct operational experience running, configuring, and modeling sourcing events within JAGGAER ASO (Advanced Sourcing Optimizer).

• Demonstrated success winning strategic RFPs and driving executive alignment across complex, high-impact customer accounts.

• Deep knowledge of carrier procurement dynamics, spot vs. contract rate modeling, route guide architecture, and network optimization principles.

Benefits & Compensation for U.S. Employees

Employees working more than 30 hours in the US at Uber Freight are eligible for benefits like a company sponsored health plan, dental and vision benefits, 401k match, financial and mental wellness benefits, parental leave, short- and long-term disability coverage, life insurance and more.  US based employees may also be eligible for a performance or sales incentive bonus program, participation in Uber Freight equity awards, and other types of compensation depending upon the role.

About Uber Freight

Uber Freight helps companies move goods more reliably and efficiently. We bring together the technology, people, and transportation capacity they need, using real‑time data from millions of shipments to guide smarter decisions. That helps customers spot issues early, avoid costly surprises, and deliver on time. Uber Freight works with 1 in 3 Fortune 500 shippers across North America and manages over $17B in freight. Learn more at www.uberfreight.com.

Candidate Privacy Notice

Uber Freight is committed to protecting the privacy of our candidates. We collect and process personal data in accordance with applicable data protection laws. For detailed information on how we handle candidate data, please review our Candidate Privacy Notice.

EEOC

Uber Freight is proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regards to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

jobs.title: Lead Technical Project Manager, GTM Systems
jobs.description:
At Klaviyo, we value the unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives each Klaviyo (we call ourselves Klaviyos) brings to our workplace each and every day. We believe everyone deserves a fair shot at success and appreciate the experiences each person brings beyond the traditional job requirements. If you’re a close but not exact match with the description, we hope you’ll still consider applying. Want to learn more about life at Klaviyo? Visit klaviyo.com/careers to see how we empower creators to own their own destiny.

Klaviyo's GTM Systems team builds and runs the systems that power marketing, sales, partnerships, customer success, and services. We're looking for a Lenior Technical Project Manager with 8+ years of experience delivering complex SaaS GTM and revenue systems programs, who understands both how the systems work and how the business runs on them, and who is excited to bring AI into how we plan, deliver, and operate.

About the team

Our GTM Systems team sits at the center of Klaviyo's GTM engine, connecting Salesforce, CPQ, billing and finance systems, customer success and support platforms, and professional services tooling. We own the roadmap that lets our teams move quickly, trust their data, and focus on helping customers grow. As we scale, we're rebuilding parts of that stack around AI and agentic workflows as the operating model, not a bolt-on experiment, and we need a program leader who can deliver that change reliably.

About the role

As Lead Technical Project Manager, you own delivery of our highest-impact, highest-complexity GTM systems programs from intake through hypercare. Think CPQ replacement, quote-to-cash changes, customer success and support platform upgrades, and AI-enabled workflows that cut across Sales, Customer Success, Services, Finance, and Internal Audit. You turn ambiguous business goals into clear plans, sequence work across many teams shipping into the same core systems, and keep leadership informed with an honest view of commitments, risks, and progress.

You'll work hands-on with business systems analysts, developers, architects, vendors, and finance and audit partners, and you'll regularly present to senior and executive leadership. You use AI yourself to run programs faster and better, and you help bring it into the way our teams work.

How you'll make an impact

• Own program delivery end to end: intake, prioritization, scoping, sequencing, status, and operating cadence for a multi-quarter GTM systems roadmap, from discovery through launch and hypercare.

• Lead cross-functional programs at scale: manage dependencies across Sales, Deal Desk, RevOps, Customer Success, Services, Finance, Legal, Security, and Engineering, including teams that don't report to you.

• Drive technical decisions with engineers and architects: weigh trade-offs, build-vs-buy calls, integration patterns, and vendor evaluations, and make sure decisions are documented and defensible.

• Deliver with controls built in: partner with Finance, Internal Audit, and Security on revenue-impacting systems work (SOX/ITGC, access, change management, audit traceability) so controls are designed in, tested, and evidenced.

• Manage vendors and implementation partners: run joint project plans, steering committees, decision logs, and risk reviews, and hold partners to commitments.

• Bring AI into GTM and into how we deliver: help scope and ship AI and agentic workflows into production, and use AI tooling to improve planning, status reporting, testing, and documentation.

• Build the operating model: establish intake, planning, release management, and reporting practices that hold up as the portfolio grows, and mentor teammates on program craft.

• Communicate with clarity: give GTM Systems, GTM, Finance, and executive leaders a crisp view of scope, timeline, cost, risk, and decisions needed, in the room and in writing.

What makes you a great fit

• 8+ years of technical program or project management, business systems delivery, or GTM/revenue systems experience at a SaaS company, with a track record of owning large, multi-team programs end to end.

• Deep working knowledge of GTM systems and processes: lead-to-opportunity, quote-to-cash, renewals and amendments, customer success and support, and professional services delivery, and how objects, data, and approvals flow between Salesforce, CPQ, billing/ERP, contracting, and support tools.

• Experience delivering in a Salesforce-centric environment where multiple teams ship into a shared core system on a common release process.

• Experience partnering with finance, audit, or compliance functions on revenue-impacting systems and controls.

• Strong technical fluency: you can read an architecture diagram, discuss integration and data-model trade-offs with developers, and spot delivery risk early.

• Hands-on curiosity about AI: you use LLM tools in your own work, can talk credibly about where AI and agents help GTM workflows and where they need guardrails, and want to help teams adopt them responsibly.

• Exceptional stakeholder management and executive communication; comfortable driving outcomes through influence in fast-moving, ambiguous environments.

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

Nice to haves

• Experience with CPQ implementations or replacements, quote-to-cash redesign, or billing/ERP integrations (for example NetSuite).

• Experience with customer success, support, or services platforms (for example Gainsight, Zendesk, Certinia) and contracting tools (for example Ironclad).

• Familiarity with SOX ITGC, revenue controls, or SOC reporting for vendor-hosted systems.

• Experience standing up release management or CI/CD for a Salesforce org.

• Exposure to agentic AI frameworks or MCP-based integrations in a business systems setting.

• PMP, Salesforce, or similar certifications (or equivalent demonstrated experience).

• Prior experience at a high-growth software or AI company.

Why this role matters at Klaviyo

• Your programs directly affect how Klaviyo sells, bills, renews, and supports customers, with real visibility to senior GTM, Finance, and executive leadership.

• You'll lead work that sits at the intersection of GTM systems, finance controls, and AI, a combination that is rare and increasingly valuable.

• You'll help shape an AI-first delivery and operating model for GTM Systems, setting practices that outlast any single project.
