jobs.title: Manager, Global Technology - Accounting in the ECP
jobs.description:
Why This Role Matters

This Manager role leads a software engineering team responsible for centralizing enterprise accounting data within Expeditors’ Enterprise Core Platform (ECP). This role delivers scalable, reliable, secure, and compliant accounting data capabilities that support the modernization of exp.o Accounting and the controlled retirement of Expeditors’ legacy accounting system.

The Manager balances near-term delivery with operational stability, strong internal controls, employee development, and the long-term transition of centralized accounting data management from Global Financial Reporting (GFR) to ECP.

Team and Technology

This role leads the engineering team responsible for establishing ECP as the authoritative platform for centralized enterprise accounting data and accounting-driven business processes. The team delivers centralized Open Item accounting data, including Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, and Provisions, while expanding centralization to General Ledger balances, detailed General Ledger transactions, and File GL Balances used for revenue reporting.

The Manager partners with Accounting, ECP Administration, Product, Architecture, Security, Compliance, and downstream data consumers. The role also oversees deployment-related processes across Accounting-owned systems and helps transition delivery from waterfall-based change management toward automated CI/CD practices.

What Success Looks Like

• Build a prioritized roadmap for Open Item and General Ledger data centralization.

• Establish a healthy, accountable engineering team with clear expectations and effective coaching.

• Deliver production-ready Accounts Receivable data for the ARC replacement integration.

• Establish a future-state direction for Accounting deployment pipelines and CI/CD modernization.

• Improve delivery through automated, repeatable, auditable practices and reduced manual production activity.

Key Areas of Impact

Coaching for Growth

• Lead and develop a team of technical employees through clear expectations, regular coaching conversations, feedback, career development, knowledge sharing, and cross-training to strengthen team capability and support ECP-based accounting initiatives.

• Foster career growth by helping team members build the skills needed to support centralized accounting data capabilities and long-term team success.

Delivering on Commitments

• Deliver centralized Open Item and General Ledger accounting data while managing dependencies, risks, controls, and stakeholder commitments to support business objectives.

• Improve engineering and operational effectiveness through automated, repeatable, and auditable delivery practices while balancing delivery commitments with operational stability and maintainability.

Technical Depth and Delivery

• Ensure accounting data solutions support enterprise reporting, reconciliation, analytics, regulatory compliance, data quality, traceability, security, reliability, and required internal controls.

• Lead modernization of deployment-related processes, including future-state deployment pipelines, CI/CD practices, automation, observability, and reduced reliance on manual production activities.

Architectural Scale

• Establish ECP as the authoritative platform for centralized enterprise accounting data and accounting-driven business processes while supporting the modernization of exp.o Accounting and retirement of legacy accounting systems.

• Partner with architects, engineering teams, and technical stakeholders to evaluate modernization approaches, deployment pipeline requirements, and long-term accounting data architecture decisions.

Team Collaboration Scale

• Partner with Accounting, ECP Administration, Product, Architecture, Security, Compliance, and downstream data consumers to establish priorities, resolve dependencies, and align delivery outcomes.

• Collaborate across Accounting engineering teams to assess deployment practices, identify modernization gaps, and coordinate roadmap priorities supporting centralized accounting data management.

Influence and Advocacy

• Communicate plans, progress, risks, controls, and modernization objectives while supporting shared decision-making across technical and business stakeholders.

• Promote consistent, repeatable, and auditable release practices that improve deployment reliability, support internal controls, and advance modernization goals.

Scope of Vision

• Build and maintain a prioritized roadmap for Open Item and General Ledger data centralization, ensuring dependencies, risks, controls, and stakeholder commitments remain visible.

• Balance near-term delivery priorities with the long-term transition of centralized accounting data management from Global Financial Reporting (GFR) to ECP.

Scale of Business Understanding and Impact

• Enable accounting information to be governed and made available for authorized business processes, reporting, reconciliation, analytics, and regulatory requirements.

• Support Accounting modernization efforts by delivering scalable, reliable, secure, and compliant accounting data capabilities that improve business outcomes and operational effectiveness.

This position is on-site and will reside in the greater Seattle, WA. area at one of the following locations depending on availability. Candidates must be local or willing to relocate. Relocation assistance is not offered for this position.

• Downtown Seattle
• Federal Way
• Lynnwood
• Bellevue (Factoria)

Qualifications for Success

Required

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent education and experience.

• Minimum three years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, technology delivery, or a related technical discipline.

• Minimum three years of experience leading technology teams, technical initiatives, products, platforms, or services.

• Experience coaching and developing technical employees.

• Experience coordinating work across stakeholders and managing competing priorities.

• Experience delivering technology solutions that support business objectives.

• Experience working in a collaborative, cross-functional environment.

• Strong leadership, communication, stakeholder management, problem-solving, analytical, and organizational skills.

• Ability to balance technical, operational, and business considerations when making decisions.

• Experience with Agentic AI development processes and practices.

Preferred

• People management experience in a technical or logistics environment.

• Experience with accounting systems, enterprise accounting data, or financial controls.

• Experience delivering data platforms, enterprise integrations, APIs, event-driven solutions, or distributed technology capabilities.

• Experience modernizing legacy enterprise platforms while maintaining operational continuity and managing migration risk.

• Experience leading CI/CD, DevOps, release automation, or change-management modernization across engineering teams.

• Experience with cloud-based data platforms, observability, and automated delivery practices.

• Experience applying secure engineering, data governance, operational readiness, and internal control requirements throughout the delivery lifecycle.
• Experience leading regulated, SOX-relevant, or otherwise controlled financial technology environments.

jobs.title: Director, Product - Post-Funding & Payment Strategies
jobs.location: Virginia - Remote, Maryland - Hybrid, Washington DC - Hybrid
jobs.description:
Attention: Kapitus is aware that individuals posing as recruiters may be communicating with job seekers about supposed positions with Kapitus. Kapitus has received reports that the content and method of communication can vary, but messages may contain requests for payment (e.g., fees for equipment or training) and/or for sensitive financial information.

Kapitus will never ask a candidate for employment for payment or financial information during the initial application or interview process. All open positions are posted in location specific employment portals available at www.kapitus.com/careers   All legitimate Kapitus job postings on employment sites will direct candidates to complete an application through these portals before completion of the hiring process.

Candidates with additional questions or concerns regarding any recruiting communications or Kapitus’ recruiting process in general should email recruiting@kapitus.com

Are you a transformative product leader who thrives on building seamless, high-impact financial ecosystems?

At Kapitus, we understand that our work isn't done when a deal closes—it’s just beginning. We are seeking a highly motivated and strategic Director of Product to lead the product vision and delivery for our post-funding experiences, encompassing treasury, payment strategies, customer service, and collections functions.

In this role, you will bridge the gap between strategic treasury management and thoughtful asset recovery. This is not a maintenance role; it is a high-visibility opportunity to pioneer digital transformation, integrate AI, and scale our operational capabilities in a highly competitive market.

What You’ll Do:

• Empower & Lead a Product Team: Manage and mentor a dedicated team of Product Owners, fostering an outcome-driven mindset and strong business acumen. You will guide them in building seamless product experiences, managing roadmaps, business case development, prioritization strategies and ensuring high-quality, on-time delivery alongside engineering, QA, and UX teams.

• Drive Strategic Transformation: Partner closely with leaders across Product, Finance, Treasury, Accounting, Collections, Customer Service, and Legal to identify and introduce enhancements that fundamentally advance Kapitus's operational and financial capabilities.

• End-to-End Product Ownership: Take full ownership of product initiatives—from feature definition, build-vs-buy assessments, and vendor integration to execution planning, change management, and post-launch optimization.

• Navigate & Capitalize on Ambiguity: Champion continuous discovery to understand customer behavior, market trends, and emerging financial innovations. Translate complex, ambiguous business needs and technologies into a clear, prioritized product roadmap.

• Deliver Measurable Value: Set the standard for success by defining and monitoring key product metrics. Gather user feedback, evaluate performance, and pivot strategies nimbly to maximize business value and user satisfaction.

• Ensure Compliance & Security: Keep Kapitus ahead of the curve by ensuring all financial products and requirements strictly adhere to industry standards and financial regulations.

What We’re Looking For

• Experience: 7–10+ years of robust product management experience, with at least 3 years in a leadership/people management role within Fintech, Payments, or Small Business (SMB) Lending.

• People Leadership: Committed to people and team development. Mentor, coach and guide Product Owners in pursuit of individual and organizational goals. You empower team members to operate independently, but remain ready to roll-up your sleeves alongside the team when necessary.

• Domain Expertise: Deep understanding of complex payment workflows, including orchestration, authorization, settlement, exception handling and controls. You have a working knowledge of payment rails and experience owning product requirements for payment infrastructure. Familiarity with cash/liquidity management and collections workflows.

• Technical Acumen: Strong conceptual understanding of Event-Driven Architecture and API integrations and core processing rails (e.g., ACH, wire, card, instant payments)

• Intellectual Agility: You don't need a perfectly drawn map to navigate. You excel at exercising sound business judgment, making principles-based trade-offs, and charting a strategic course through uncharted territory.

• Cross-Functional Influence: Proven ability to engage, influence, and align executive leaders, technical teams, and external partners around product direction and strategy.

• Communication & Analytical Skills: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills paired with a data-driven, detail-oriented approach to problem-solving. Business case fluency with the ability to structure and build business cases that quantify costs, benefits and risk tradeoffs.

What Will Make You Stand Out:

• Expertise in leveraging automation, AI, and digital transformation for process optimization in finance, treasury or collections.

• Experience with complex system conversions, particularly migrating existing products and in-flight accounts to new operating systems.

• Familiarity with financing securitization processes and collections technology.

Kapitus Total Rewards Package Includes:

• Competitive Base Salary Range of $157,100-$252,000 annually. Kapitus provides this as a good faith salary range to comply with applicable law. The applicant's final salary will depend on a number of factors including the applicant's geographic location, skills, and experience.

• Annual Incentive Compensation Eligibility - up to 15% annually

• Health Insurance: Comprehensive medical, dental, and employer-paid vision plans through UnitedHealthcare (UHC), with various coverage levels available to meet the needs of our employees and their families. Additional perks through UHC include: Sweat Equity, free subscription to the Calm App, UHC rewards, Real Appeal, and Quit For Life.

• Flexible Spending Account: Set aside pre-tax dollars from your paycheck to pay for qualified out-of-pocket medical, dental, vision, pharmacy or dependent care expenses.

• Lifestyle Spending Account: Employer sponsored post-tax benefits that allow reimbursement for expenses related to physical, mental and financial well-being.

• 100% Company Paid Insurances: Kapitus fully covers the cost of basic short-term and long-term disability insurance, as well as vision insurance, ensuring our employees have comprehensive protection without any personal expense.

• Voluntary Insurance: Supplemental life insurance as well as enhanced short- and long-term disability coverage are available through Mutual of Omaha, providing additional security for our employees. Additionally, Colonial Accident and Hospitalization insurances are also available, offering further protection against unforeseen events.

• Paid Maternity and Parental Leave: Beyond state-mandated leave policies, Kapitus provides company-paid maternity and parental leave, supporting our employees during important family milestones.

• Commuter Benefits: We offer pre-tax benefits on parking and commuter expenses to cover travel to and from work.

• LifeBalance Program: Enhance your lifestyle with our LifeBalance membership, which offers discounts on outdoor activities, the arts, health, and fitness. Additional benefits include: Pet and car insurance discounts. Financial services such as LegalShield. Relaxation and stress management tools.

• Plum Benefits Discount Program: Access exclusive discounts on shows, travel, car rentals, and more, enriching your personal and family life.

• Tuition Reimbursement: Pursue further education with up to $5,000 annually in tuition reimbursement, plus opportunities to attend relevant conferences and career development events. Managed through our LSA plan, Kapitus Academy.

• Travel Reimbursement: We also offer travel reimbursement for all work-related travel, supporting your involvement in career and personal development activities.

• Paid Time Off and Sick Time.

• Retirement Benefits: Our 401K plan is managed through Fidelity. To support your long-term financial goals, the company provides a 25% match on your contributions, up to 6% of your annual salary.

About Kapitus:

Kapitus is one of the most reliable and respected names in small business financing. As both a direct lender and a marketplace built with a trusted network of lending partners, we can provide small businesses with the financing they need when, and how it is needed. We have spent our entire existence building a culture that makes us excited to come to work in the morning. Our company is fast paced, teammates need to be self-directed and have an internal motivation to do the right thing, even when the right thing takes a lot of hard work. We show our teammates our appreciation by offering great benefits, competitive pay and solid opportunity for growth.

Company Mission: At Kapitus, our mission is to help small business owners grow their organizations by providing tailored, transparent, and ethical financing solutions. We invest in every business owner’s story and we are dedicated to building lasting relationships to champion their goals. We promise to keep the best interests of our clients at the center of the financing process by operating with transparency, fairness, and integrity.

Consideration will be given to qualified remote candidates residing in states where Kapitus and/or one of its subsidiaries has an established physical presence.

jobs.description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a Senior Project Manager, Professional Services Public Sector to join our team. This is a US Based Remote (US Citizen required) role reporting to the Senior Manager, Professional Services Public Sector in the Professional Services Public Sector department. In this role, you will lead high-impact SLED and Federal customer deployments of the Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform from kickoff through project closure, acting as the primary trusted advisor and orchestrating cross-functional technical teams to deliver seamless, secure business outcomes.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

• Take full accountability for the end-to-end delivery lifecycle of concurrent, complex customer deployments, covering planning, execution, governance, risk management, and formal project sign-off

• Lead multiple concurrent customer engagements spanning Zero Trust deployments, legacy security tool migrations, architecture assessments, and ongoing optimization programs

• Define, track, and report on deployment success criteria, metrics, milestones, and timelines to ensure projects stay on schedule, within scope, and aligned to business outcomes

• Develop and maintain rigorous project documentation, including project plans, rollout schedules, risk and issue logs, meeting minutes, and executive status reports tailored to diverse stakeholder audiences

• Partner closely with internal specialists and customer stakeholders to proactively identify roadblocks and resolve escalations to ensure forward momentum

Who You Are (Success Profile)

• You are customer-obsessed. You build deep empathy for the customer, both internal and external, and anchor your decisions in solving their real-world problems. You champion their needs from start to finish, knowing their success is our success.

• You operate with urgency. You understand that in a high-growth environment, speed and quality are not mutually exclusive. You have a relentless focus on execution and a bias for action, delivering high-impact results quickly to win for the customer and the team.

• You lead with integrity. You do the right thing, even when it’s hard. You hold yourself and others to a high standard of accountability and build trust by matching your words with consistent, transparent action.

• You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team's collective success, embracing clear communication, constructive candor, and bidirectional feedback to build lasting trust.

• You are a learner. You bring a dedicated growth mindset, continuously developing yourself and expanding your technical and domain expertise to sharpen your delivery craft.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

• U.S. citizenship is required for this position due to the nature of the assigned customer base

• Demonstrated experience navigating State, Local, Education, or Federal domains with in-depth knowledge of their operational complexities and unique challenges

• Track record of formal project or program management experience delivering customer-facing technical solutions within a professional services, consulting, or enterprise SaaS deployment environment

• Active Project Management Professional (PMP), PRINCE2, or equivalent recognized project management certification

• Practical understanding of foundational networking and security concepts, including firewalls, proxies, secure web gateways (SWG), and VPN architectures

• Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

• Direct experience managing large-scale deployments of Zero Trust architecture, SASE, or enterprise cloud security platforms (e.g., ZIA, ZPA, ZDX)

• Hands-on proficiency with Professional Services Automation (PSA) and work management platforms such as Salesforce, Jira, Confluence, and Smartsheet along with comfort and experience using generative AI tools to streamline research, data analysis, and work flows

• Active or recent (within the last 10 years) DoD/DoW security clearance (SECRET or TS)

jobs.description:
Who is Boulevard?

Boulevard provides the first and only client experience platform for appointment-based, self-care businesses. We empower our customers to give their clients more of the magical moments that matter most.

Before launching in 2016, our founders spent months interviewing salon managers and working behind front desks to understand their pain points so we could design a modern, user-friendly platform that meets the unique needs of their business. Our roots may be in hair salons, but we are built for the broader self-care industry, including many types of salons, spas, medspa, barbershops, and more. Our technology not only helps our customers survive but thrive. Take a look at how we (and YOU) can make that happen.

We have an insatiable curiosity and embrace experimentation. We believe that simple solutions require the most sophistication, and we design each and every detail to maximize potential, power, and impact. Do our values match? Read through our story and what we value the most.

Our team values and celebrates our diverse backgrounds. Being open about who we are and what we do allows us to do the best work of our lives. We believe in equal opportunity for all, and you should too.

Come do the best work of your life at Boulevard.

We’re looking for a Staff Product Analyst to build Boulevard’s Product Intelligence function and own its core responsibilities. You’re deeply experienced in data and analytics, and you love turning complex datasets into product stories that clarify what’s happening, why it matters, and what to do next. There’s no well-worn path here. You’ll define the questions, build the infrastructure to answer them, and chart the course forward, often without perfect information. For the right person, that’s the whole appeal.

Boulevard is at an inflection point: we’re scaling upmarket, expanding our product surface, and making bigger bets on where the business goes next, and each one needs a trusted picture of what’s happening in the product. This is foundational work that compounds. What you build in your first year will shape how we make product decisions for the next five, and you’ll bring a team builder’s mindset, creating processes and documenting best practices so the function scales from day one.

What you’ll do here:

• Build Boulevard’s product data foundation: work across Product Development to define what we capture and how, and design the models that turn raw data into clean, reliable, analysis-ready assets with data engineering.

• Partner tightly with Product to turn data into recommendations that drive action, using clear narratives and visualizations suited to the audience, from individual contributors to executives.

• Build self-serve dashboards that let teams explore data on their own, and help stakeholders interpret data and act on it with confidence.

• Own deep-dive analyses like funnels, retention curves, cohort behavior, and feature adoption, surfacing insights proactively to influence product direction.

• Be the bridge between product data and the rest of the company, so insights shape cross-functional decisions.

• Create team processes and analytical workflows that keep data accurate as the function grows, and advocate for the tooling the team needs.

What you’ll need to thrive:

• 8+ years in data or product analytics in a B2B SaaS or high-growth tech environment, including meaningful time in early-stage or low data-maturity settings where you built the foundation yourself.

• Fluency with SQL, dbt, Python, Jupyter notebooks or similar, Snowflake, and Sigma, plus strong data modeling, with an understanding of the pros and cons of different design approaches.

• Direct experience designing and executing product instrumentation strategies.

• Expertise building dashboards and visualizations in Sigma, Looker, Tableau, or similar, with a track record of self-serve tools that teams actually use.

• Significant experience working with product managers and leaders, plus deep-dive analysis across the product lifecycle (funnel diagnostics, cohort and retention modeling, behavioral segmentation), turned into clear, decision-ready narratives.

• A basic understanding of quantitative techniques like regression and logit, and experience using Claude Code to perform analytics.

• Clear, confident communication with stakeholders at any level, including a narrative that lands with a PM or the executive team.

• Strong ownership: you manage projects end to end, navigate ambiguity, build processes that scale, and influence leadership decisions across go-to-market, customer success, and product, while staying direct, generous with knowledge, and consistent.

• A plus: experience evaluating or implementing product analytics tooling such as Amplitude or Mixpanel.

How we’ll take care of you:

AAt Boulevard, we work hard to structure compensation in a way that balances internal equity with local market competitiveness, and we're happy to share a good-faith estimate of the base salary range for this role. For candidates in NYC, the SF Bay Area, and Seattle, the anticipated base salary range is $138,600 - $173,200 per year. For all other U.S. locations, the anticipated base salary range is $120,400 - $ 165,600 per year. In addition to this base compensation, this role may be eligible to participate in a variable compensation program. Final compensation will vary based on a variety of factors which include but are not limited to applicable experience, location, and final leveling.

How we take care of our team

Our business is deeply immersed in an industry that’s centered around helping people feel their best, so we know that taking care of yourself isn’t selfish; it’s essential. That’s why our culture pairs high standards with genuine care. We don't glorify burnout or wear ‘always on’ as a badge of honor. Instead, we’ve created benefits designed to support you inside and outside of work, so you can bring your best self to both.

Here’s how we support you:

• Competitive base pay and performance bonus eligibility because you deserve to be rewarded for your impact.

• Equity participation for all full-time employees because we believe the people helping build Boulevard should share in our long-term success.

• Comprehensive medical coverage with up to 100% employee premium coverage and 75% dependent coverage to help take care of you and your loved ones.

• An annual $1,200 HSA employer contribution for eligible plans to help support healthcare costs and future planning.

• 100% covered dental, vision, life, and disability insurance, ensuring you stay healthy, protected, and ready for whatever life brings.

• 12 weeks of fully paid U.S. parental leave supporting all new parents equally as they take the time to bond, adjust, and be present when welcoming a new family member.

• Flexible paid time off, plus 10 U.S. company holidays, where you are encouraged to rest, recharge, and take the time you need, guilt-free.

• Fully remote with support, including a $200 home office setup allowance and a $50 monthly WFH reimbursement so your workspace is set up for success.

• $200 quarterly Boulevard Bucks to prioritize your well-being and stay connected to the industry we serve.

• And other perks like One Medical membership and Employee Assistant Program.

All employment decisions at Boulevard Labs, Inc. are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.

Boulevard serves the beauty, wellness, and self-care industry, and many of our employees have access to our customers' business and client data. Disclosure is a normal part of our process and is not by itself a barrier to being hired. Employees in Tier 1 Restricted Roles may not hold concurrent employment, ownership, or an advisory role with a beauty, wellness, self-care, or med-spa business, or with a company that competes with Boulevard. jobs.title: Director of B2B Employer Marketing (Remote)
jobs.description:
We believe that mental health is just as important as physical health. We recognize that mental health issues can be complex and multifaceted, and we are dedicated to treating the whole person, not just the symptoms.

We aim to create a world where mental health is no longer stigmatized or marginalized, but rather is embraced as an integral part of one's overall well-being. 

We believe that by providing quality care that is both evidence-based and compassionate, we can empower individuals to take charge of their mental health and achieve their full potential. We are passionate about making a positive impact on the lives of those struggling with mental health issues and we strive to be a force for positive change in the field of mental healthcare.

Rula is a remote-first company. We currently hire in most U.S. states, with the exception of Hawaii.

About the Role

We are seeking a Director of B2B Employer Marketing to lead Rula’s Activation Marketing team from a content-production focus to an intelligence-gathering and multiplier engine. This dynamic leader will be responsible for driving patient starts from commercial referral channels by building scalable systems and repeatable playbooks. You will apply advanced data-driven strategies and deploy MarTech architecture to ensure the team is tracking towards every marketing event being tagged, measured, and automated for scale. In detail, this role will be responsible for:

 - Increasing marketing-attributable patient starts and build scalable systems with repeatable playbooks

 - Defining data-driven strategy for marketing touchpoints on from commercial referral audiences (Health Plans, Employers and Primary Care Providers) to maximize patient starts

 - Leading the plan to define attribution criteria and process for marketing-driven campaigns, in partnership with the commercial, product and analytics teams

 - Leading a team that establishes a testing and experimentation approach: A/B or multi-variant testing campaigns (both creative and the campaign component levels) to determine what works, and incrementality tests to understand impact vs holdouts

 - Identifying optimization through automation areas, reducing manual campaign execution, and content building using AI agents and tools

 - Driving the roadmap to templatize activation campaign approach, and open capacity for more innovative testing at scale

Required Qualifications

 - 10+ years of related professional experience in Marketing, Growth, Product Marketing and/or Business Operations with a focus on user activations

 - Direct experience scaling teams by leveraging AI and ML-driven automation to solve high-stakes challenges in attribution and incrementality

 - Demonstrated cross-functional influence and high quality executive communications to align senior stakeholders across Commercial, Analytics, and Product teams

 - Proven expertise leading teams through both people managers and individual contributors, with a track record of hiring, developing, and retaining high-performing marketing or growth talent

 - Hands-on proficiency managing a MarTech stack (i.e. Hubspot, Salesforce, Redshift, Amplitude, etc.) and data pipelines specifically for marketing attribution

Preferred Qualifications

While having the preferred qualifications enhances your candidacy, having all of them is not mandatory. We encourage all interested applicants to apply, even those who may not meet every preferred requirement.

 - 3+ years experience at a high-growth start-up or in a tech-forward healthcare/pharma company

 - Deep healthcare ecosystem knowledge, with practical understanding of operational workflows of PCPs, Health Plans, and Employers, particularly within the behavioral health or telehealth space

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Applied AI
jobs.description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.




COMPANY OPERATING RHYTHM

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.



Team Overview

The Applied AI team takes on the voice AI problems that don’t have off-the-shelf answers. We work directly with enterprise customers and technology partners, from conversational AI and customer experience platforms to restaurant brands, and much of the work is zero to one. Current focus areas include robust ASR in noisy outdoor environments, self-service fine-tuning and model adaptation, domain-aware voice agents for drive-thru and phone ordering, agent scoring and evaluation, real-time operational analytics, and on-site hardware integration. We’re a small team that works in person in San Francisco, ships to production quickly, and stays close to the customers we build for.

Key Goals

 - Ship production features in live voice agent products, such as drive-thru and phone ordering, within your first quarter.

 - Own customer problems end to end: hear the issue, find the root cause, and get the fix into production.

 - Help build reusable agent modules, like ordering and reservations, so new customers and industries launch faster.

 - Make agents more accurate on real-world menus and catalogs, keeping structured data consistent across hundreds of locations.

 - Contribute to fine-tuning and model adaptation so customers get accurate results on their own vocabulary and domains.

 - Spot problems across the product before anyone asks, then fix them or bring a proposed solution.

 - Run experiments that show whether new functionality improves outcomes for customers.

Minimum Skills, Knowledge & Capabilities

 - Experience building and shipping backend services that run in production in the cloud.

 - Operates AI-native: you build with modern AI coding tools as your default way of working, not occasionally, and use them to move fast without lowering the quality bar.

 - Learns quickly and takes on unfamiliar parts of the stack with little ramp-up.

 - Finds work instead of waiting for it: you recognize problems, propose solutions, and follow them through.

 - Has taken something from idea to production, at work or on your own time.

 - Communicates clearly with teammates and is comfortable working directly with customers.

 - Builds for the customer’s outcome, with a high bar for quality and no over-engineering.

 - Comfortable working across languages. Our stack is mainly Kotlin and Python, with TypeScript on the front end.

Preferred Qualifications (nice-to-have)

 - Hands-on experience training, fine-tuning, or adapting models, through work, research, or substantial projects.

 - Experience building evaluation or scoring for models or agents.

 - Experience with audio, speech-to-text, or text-to-speech.

 - Experience as a founder or early startup engineer, or taking a system from zero to one.

 - Typically 2+ years of engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated experience.

Notice: We're aware of individuals impersonating Deepgram recruiters. All legitimate Deepgram recruiting communication comes from an @deepgram.com http://deepgram.com email address. If you've received a message claiming to be Deepgram, please forward it to careers@deepgram.com.

jobs.title: Electrical Integration and Test Engineer II
jobs.description:
Voyager is an innovative space, defense, and national security technology company committed to advancing and delivering transformative, mission-critical solutions. We tackle the most complex challenges to unlock new frontiers for human progress, fortify national security, and protect critical assets to lead in the race for technological and operational superiority from ground to space.

Forge the Future: Join Voyager Technologies

The future belongs to those who build it. At Voyager Technologies, we’re building technologies that protect lives, expand frontiers and prepare us for what’s next. And we’re doing that with people who are wired to solve, build, adapt and lead. These roles are not for the faint of heart.

You’ll help lay the foundation for humanity's future. Join a culture where innovation thrives, curiosity is rewarded, and impact is real. We’re a company of doers, thinkers and builders, united by purpose and grounded in reality.

If you want to put your skills to work where the stakes are real and the mission is bigger than any one person, forge the future with Voyager.

The Electrical Integration & Test Engineer for Voyager Lunar Systems is responsible for test operations, ownership of test electrical systems, and development of integration and test procedures.

The position reports to the Electrical Integration & Test Lead and is part of the Manufacturing, Integration, and Test (MI&T) team based in Pittsburgh, PA. This role is onsite based in Pittsburgh, PA.

Responsibilities

• Perform mechanical, electrical, network, and software integration of the FlatSat test platform; our Hardware-in-the-loop (HITL) system(s) for lunar missions.

• Define the architecture, configuration, and roadmap for the FlatSat environment.

• Develop system-level integration plans for hardware, avionics, software, and ground interfaces.

• Ensure the FlatSat accurately represents mission configuration and operational scenarios.

• Establish infrastructure to support full mission simulations and end-to-end testing.

• Independently troubleshoot and resolve issues related to the software and electrical systems to meet the test schedule.

• Design and build electrical test fixtures and ground support equipment (GSE) for both component and system-level testing.

• Write test plans and procedures to verify functionality of spacecraft components and subsystems responsible for guidance, navigation and control (GNC), RF communications, power distribution, and thermal and propulsion control.

• Automate test execution and data collection using Python, LabVIEW, and related software tools.

• Conduct integration and testing of flight and non-flight electrical systems at the component, subsystem, and spacecraft level.

• Provide test execution support at outside test facilities.

• Generate and support discrepancy documentation and ensure test processes and test disciplines are being followed during integration and test execution.

Required Qualifications:

• 3+ years relevant integration and test experience.

• Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering or related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

• Background in testing and troubleshooting complex electrical systems.

• Experience writing and reviewing test documentation including test plans, procedures, and reports.

• Experience writing, debugging, and executing scripts in Python or a similar programming language.

• Operational knowledge of common electrical test equipment such as bench power supplies, digital multimeters, oscilloscopes, and data acquisition systems.

• Ability to work in cross-functional teams including electrical, mechanical, and software engineers.

Desired Qualifications:

• Experience testing safety-critical hardware and software systems.

• Experience reviewing and modifying technical drawings using Altium or similar electronic design software.

• Experience with environmental testing campaigns such as thermal vacuum, EMI/EMC, and vibration testing. Knowledge of relevant MIL-STD or NASA GEVS standards for testing.

• Experience designing electrical test fixtures or ground support equipment.

• Experience with integration and test campaigns for a spacecraft/satellite project.

• Knowledge of avionics manufacturing processes such as PCB assembly, harness fabrication, and inspection processes.

• Adaptable to startup environment, able to self-start with minimal guidance.

• Experience in a 100K or ISO8 class cleanroom environment.

• IPC-A-610 or IPC-A-620 certification.

jobs.title: Director of Sales & Marketing
jobs.description:
Your Mission / What you will be accountable for

As Director of Sales & Marketing, you are the visionary force behind the hotel’s sales revenue strategy, the voice of its positioning and the guardian of its desirability. You orchestrate all Sales and Marketing initiatives with precision, creativity, and purpose to elevate the hotel’s reputation and optimize its performance. You join the hotel as we debut a complete renovation of all 398 guest rooms and suites and debut as the future US flagship for the Sofitel brand.

This position is on-site.

Reporting directly to the General Manager, and in close collaboration with Revenue Management and Ecommerce teams, you design and implement a refined and ambitious strategy that positions the property as a market leader — in Rooms, F&B, MICE, Wellness and beyond.

With a deep understanding of the luxury landscape, you know how to craft compelling narratives, unlock new business opportunities, and attract discerning clientele. You lead a talented team with charisma and clarity, nurturing excellence and accountability at every level.

Role Description / What you will do

Sales Leadership

• Play a key role in the budget planning process and launch post renovation by defining ambitious targets per segment and feeder market. Develop and execute an annual sales strategy aligned with these objectives to drive performance across all key revenue streams
• Nurture key partnerships in coordination with Accor global sales office, with luxury travel advisors (Amex FHR), consortia (Virtuoso, Signature), and corporate clients.
• Represent the hotel at industry events, trade shows, and networking functions to promote the property and generate qualified leads.
• Organize and participate in sales missions, fam trips, client meetings, and promotional activities to enhance hotel visibility and attract new business opportunities.
• Coordinate cross-functional internal teams to ensure every event is flawlessly executed and becomes a memorable, impactful experience for clients.

Marketing & Communication Strategy

• Bring the brand promise to life within the hotel, turning it into a seamless, elevated, and emotionally engaging guest experience at every touchpoint
• Develop and implement a comprehensive hotel positioning and communication strategy to grow the hotel’s visibility, desirability, and reputation across key markets.
• Oversee the Marketing manager’s action plan including public relations, social media, advertising and digital marketing in connection with the Ecommerce director.
• Collaborate with brands and creative external teams to ensure visual identity and messaging along with the hotel luxury positioning.
• Ensure consistency of storytelling and visual identity across all content and activations, fully aligned with brand guidelines
• Generate strong local, regional, and international visibility through proactive media relations, influencer collaborations
• Build strategic partnerships with luxury brands and cultural players to create exclusive events, co-branded campaigns, and high-value activations.

Revenue & Business Intelligence

• Drive the sales team performance through data-driven decision-making and regular business reviews.
• Analyse market trends, competitive benchmarks and guest insights to identify new opportunities.
• Collaborate with the General Manager, Revenue, and Ecommerce Leaders to define the optimal business mix and contribute to monthly forecasts to improve accuracy, while developing targeted strategies for varying demand periods.

Team Development

• Recruit, train and mentor a high performing sales and marketing team.
• Foster a culture of excellence, accountability and guest-centric service, in full alignment with the brand’s SOPs.

Levers / How you will drive results

Client relationships (Direct & Indirect), B2B loyalty programs, B2B CRM tools and sales analytics (ANAIS), Online RFP platforms, MICE preferred agreements, TMC and consortia preferred agreements, Corporate & leisure FIT, Online leisure groups, PR, Marketing campaigns, Famtrip, Sales missions, Photoshoot

Deliverables & KPIs / How success will be measured

RevPAR, ADR, Total Revenue, RGI, Sales & Marketing roadmap, Monthly business review, B2B revenues, B2B loyalty contribution, ROI and incremental business, Conversion rate, Lead response time, RPS, LQA, Loyalty members RPS

Experience & Qualifications / What you will bring

• You have 7 to 10 years of experience in sales and marketing in luxury hospitality.
• You have been part of an opening or luxury repositioning team for a luxury hotel generating $50m in annual revenues.
• You are data-driven with a strong business sense.
• You are curious: you like being up to date with best practices and trends.
• Strong business acumen with the ability to think critically, make strategic decisions, and contribute effectively to budgeting processes
• Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to build strong relationships with internal stakeholders, external partners, and luxury clientele.
• Energized by teamwork with Sales, Marketing, and with the revenue and ecommerce teams
• Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Sales, Hospitality, or Business
• You have a strong interest in the Luxury & Hospitality industries.
• You have very good verbal and written communication skills in English. Proficiency in French is desired.
• You are bold, agile, collaborative and performance-driven. You lead with impact and empower your teams to go further, together.
• You are legally eligible to work in the United States
• You understand this is not a remote position and is based on property

Conditions / What we offer you

• Full time and permanent contract
• Reporting to the General Manager
• This position is based at $180-195k salary and is bonus eligible up to 20%

Our Culture / Be ALL you are with ALL your Heart

At Accor, we are committed to diversity. Each individual, each personality, and each experience has its place to grow and make us grow collectively. Everything we do, we do with heart. We are creators of emotions, professionals of the human experience, open to others and the world around us.

• Our culture is inclusive. We value the richness of the 120 nationalities, the different backgrounds, the different stories that make up our company.
• We care for the world around us: our teams, our guests, our establishments, our environment are at the heart of our concerns. Our mission is human, essential: to bring cultures together, to open windows on the world, to provide unforgettable experiences, day after day.
• All our heartists are talents in the making, they are the future of our group and our hotels. Helping them grow professionally and develop personally according to their wishes and ambitions is our priority.
• Together, we imagine your future. Our group is large, with many opportunities, and the experiences are infinite.
• We dare to question the status quo. We challenge ourselves to always do better. We take risks, we dream the impossible and make it possible.
• Hospitality is teamwork, and we are stronger together. We believe in caring, we respect our differences and value all voices. We work as a team, saying what we do and doing what we say.

jobs.title: Hardware Systems Engineer, Hardware Tools / Firmware
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: Austin, Texas | Lisbon, Portugal

About The Department

Cloudflare’s Infrastructure group is responsible for building our global network. Our Hardware Engineering team helps research, develop, test, and deploy new equipment enabling 20% of the world’s internet traffic to be served smoothly. Deployd across 330 cities in 120+ countries, the hardware we select helps improve the security, reliability, and performance of the Internet.

About the Role

Cloudflare’s Hardware Team is hiring a Systems Engineer, with a firmware focus, in the U.S. to help deliver the Hardware team’s security goals and projects in 2027 & beyond.

What You'll Do

• Maintain and improve OpenBMC firmware Design and develop features based on various industry standards such as OCP and DMTF Standards

• Be able to engage with vendors & guide them through our requirements

• Design solutions for observability and configurations appropriate for various server subsystems e.g. DIMMs, NICs etc.

• Be able to partner with teams internally to understand HW security reqs and build a set of features / roadmap for Cloudflare

• Able to contribute in building/improving the HW provisioning in HW Lab, especially the steps related to BIOS, FW, settings, and HW tools.

• Developing and reviewing requirements/code/tests/design documents

• Own some of their team’s Future FW or HW security tasks / goals and are responsible for delivering these goals on time with a high standard of quality

• Build simple, well-defined plans that are easily adapted without accruing additional complexity over time

• Expected to engage internally as domain experts in server hardware; collaborate with other teams on defining new server requirements, explain new technologies thru Wiki’s and spec sheets, and be the liaison between vendor & internal customers

Examples Of Desirable Skills, Knowledge And Experience

• Experience developing firmware and/or embedded SW

• Knowledgeable about servers, enterprise systems and hardware interfaces

• A good understanding of hardware security for servers

• Familiarity with Redfish standards

• Curious and very eager to learn

• Great communication, collaboration and detail oriented

• Can build firmwares from open source codes, build demos & POCs, setup systems & run synthetic tests, and debug complex firmware problems as needed

• Can create python/bash scripts and edit firmware/driver source code

Bonus Points

• Experience with Yocto or Buildroot is desirable

• Experience with UEFI development desirable

Compensation

Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.

• For Lisbon based hires: Estimated annual salary of €54,000 - 68,000

Equity

This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.

Benefits

Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.

Health & Welfare Benefits

• Medical/Rx Insurance

• Dental Insurance

• Vision Insurance

• Flexible Spending Accounts

• Commuter Spending Accounts

• Fertility & Family Forming Benefits

• On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program

• Global Travel Medical Insurance

Financial Benefits

• Short and Long Term Disability Insurance

• Life & Accident Insurance

• 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan

• Employee Stock Participation Plan

Time Off

• Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave

• Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

jobs.title: Principal Analog/Mixed-Signal ASIC Design Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

Born at X, Google's Moonshot Factory, Taara is on a mission to connect billions of people who lack abundant and affordable internet by pioneering high-throughput, long-range free-space optical communication (FSOC). Our links use eye-safe lasers propagating between two terminals to transmit high-speed data wirelessly. Lead the charge in bringing our groundbreaking wireless optical communication to the world. Join us to light the way toward bridging the digital divide and illuminating the future.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Taara is seeking a Principal Analog/Mixed-Signal ASIC Design Engineer to work on the next generation of co-integrated electronic and photonic modules. You will be part of an R&D team developing cutting-edge wireless optical communication systems based on integrated optical phased arrays.

The successful candidate will own ASIC design blocks and contribute to the tape-out, delivery, and validation of ASIC dies, working with a small team of ASIC design, layout, and test engineers. The role involves hands-on contributions to Analog/Mixed-Signal (AMS) ASIC design, verification, and layout. It also requires extensive ASIC design experience—including multiple ASIC tape-outs at leading commercial foundries—and deep expertise in high-precision AMS circuits such as analog-to-digital and digital-to-analog converters.

We are looking for a highly motivated individual who thrives in ambiguity, enjoys working in a small, dynamic team environment, and has a passion for solving challenging problems that lead to high-impact technological advances.




HOW YOU WILL MAKE A 10X IMPACT

 - Own and deliver custom ASIC blocks for co-integration with large-scale photonic integrated circuits to form record-breaking integrated modules.

 - Contribute to chip architecture, system-level optimization, and product strategy.

 - Demonstrate a strong motivation to improve the world through technology and a desire to be part of the team making it happen.


WHAT YOU SHOULD HAVE

 - Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering or a related field.

 - 10 or more years of relevant industry experience with demonstrated achievements in analog/mixed-signal circuit design and implementation in modern CMOS technologies.

 - Deep design expertise in high-precision circuits such as analog-to-digital and digital-to-analog converters, bandgap references, voltage regulators, amplifiers, and other supporting circuitry.

 - Tapeout experience in high voltage Bipolar-CMOS-DMOS (BCD) technology including successful silicon bring-up and characterization.

 - Extensive background in the integration and co-simulation of analog and digital circuits in the context of mixed-signal design and verification.

 - Hands-on experience contributing to multiple ASIC tape-outs at commercial foundries including chip top-level ownership.

 - Hands-on experience with Design Rule Checks (DRC), Layout Versus Schematic (LVS), Power Integrity (PI), and Signal Integrity (SI) verification."


IT WOULD BE GREAT IF YOU ALSO HAD

 - Expertise in planning and executing the verification of large Systems-on-Chip (SoCs) that incorporate complex digital logic and numerous custom-designed blocks.

 - Fluency in hardware description languages, such as Register-Transfer Level (RTL) code, and RTL-to-GDS design flows using industry-standard EDA tools.

 - Experience with versioning tools such as SOS and Git.

 - Proficiency with commercial layout verification software (Calibre or equivalent).

 - Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to work effectively with senior external partners.

 - A track record of advancing a product from the prototype phase to the final production stage.


LOCATION & COMPENSATION

A hybrid or onsite setup in Sunnyvale, CA, is preferred, though remote work can be considered. Relocation assistance can be provided.

The US salary range for this full-time position is $258,000 - $294,000 (inclusive of bonus at target) + equity + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your location during the hiring process.

jobs.location: New York, New York, United States; San Francisco, California, United States; Washington, District of Columbia, United States
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE JOB

The ACLU seeks applicants for the full-time position of Investigator in the National Prison Project of the ACLU’s National office in Washington, DC, San Francisco, CA, or New York, NY. This is a hybrid role that has in-office requirements of two (2) days per week or eight (8) days per month. This is a two-year term-limited position.

The National Prison Project works to ensure that conditions in prisons, jails, juvenile detention centers, and immigration detention facilities comply with the Constitution, domestic law, and international human rights principles. The Project has successfully litigated on behalf of incarcerated people in more than 25 states, and is the only organization litigating conditions of confinement cases nationwide. Our priorities include reducing overcrowding, improving health care, eliminating violence and maltreatment, and increasing oversight and accountability in prisons, jails, and other places of detention. We also work to reverse the policies that have given the United States the highest incarceration rate in the world and led to extreme over-representation of people of color in the incarcerated population.

This position is part of a collective bargaining unit. It is represented by ACLU Staff United (ASU).

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Reporting to the Deputy Project Director for Immigration Detention, the Investigator will conduct investigations, interviews, facility visits, and research to support the Project's litigation and advocacy efforts, with a particular focus on immigration detention.

YOUR DAY TO DAY

• Plan and conduct investigations of conditions and compliance in detention facilities, including visiting and inspection of facilities

• Interview incarcerated individuals, detention facility administrators and staff, and other stakeholders, both in-person and remotely

• Correspond with people in detention facilities, jails and prison, identify any areas related to our class action cases and areas of concern, suggest responses to correspondence, and under the supervision of an attorney, draft outgoing correspondence and advocacy

• Draft surveys and interview guides to assess detention facility conditions and programs

• Locate, review, and analyze correctional and medical records and other documents and conduct other relevant factual research to support investigations and litigation (e.g. review production of government documents in Freedom of Information Act cases)

• Draft and edit reports about investigation findings

• Develop and maintain comprehensive knowledge of case details

• Attend and participate in case meetings

• Work with attorneys in supporting the work of experts in our matters

• Review and provide feedback on draft correctional policies, memoranda, and other documents

• Draft advocacy letters on behalf of clients and class members under the supervision of an attorney

• Provide training and onboarding support for employees as needed (e.g. train attorneys and/or co-counsel to conduct class member interviews)

• Provide administrative and logistical support related to investigations and facility visits, including coordinating travel, organizing documents, and preparing materials, and assisting with processing outgoing mail and surveys as needed

FUTURE ACLU'ERS WILL

• Be committed to advancing the mission of the ACLU

• Center and embed the principles of equity, inclusion and belonging in their work by demonstrating commitment to diversity with an approach that respects and values multiple perspectives

• Be committed to work collaboratively and respectfully toward resolving obstacles and conflicts

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

• Excellent research and analytical skills, including the ability to gather, review, and synthesize information from multiple sources and identify key findings.

• Effective interpersonal and interviewing skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with individuals from diverse backgrounds and navigate sensitive conversations

• Strong written communication skills, including the ability to clearly document findings, prepare reports, and adapt writing for different audiences

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage large volumes of information, records, and correspondence accurately

• Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion and professionalism

• Ability to work independently, anticipate needs, and manage competing priorities while collaborating effectively with colleagues and external partners

• Ability to receive and incorporate constructive feedback and maintain respectful, professional relationships with colleagues, clients, and other stakeholders

• Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, Salesforce, and other standard computer applications

• Willingness and ability to travel regularly to detention facilities and other locations for investigative assignments

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Familiarity with issues related to conditions of confinement preferred

• Proficiency in Spanish preferred

• Prior experience conducting research, investigations, interviews, or related work is a plus.

• Associate's or Bachelor's degree in a relevant field, or equivalent experience, is a plus

COMPENSATION

The ACLU is committed to equity, transparency, and clarity in pay. Consistent with our compensation philosophy, there is a set salary for each role based on geographic work location. The annual salary for this position is $99,493 (Level I), reflecting the salary of a position based in New York, NY.  Salaries are subject to a regional pay adjustment if authorization is granted to work outside of the location listed in this posting.

For details on our pay structure, please visit: https://www.aclu.org/careers/ACLU_Geographic_Pay_Structure-July_2024.pdf

WHY THE ACLU

For over 100 years, the ACLU has worked to defend and preserve the individual rights and liberties guaranteed by the Constitution and laws of the United States. Whether it’s ending mass incarceration, achieving full equality for the LGBTQ+ community, establishing new privacy protections for our digital age, or preserving the right to vote or the right to have an abortion, the ACLU takes up the toughest civil liberties cases and issues to defend all people.

We know that great people make a great organization. We value our people and know that what we offer is essential not just their work, but to their overall well-being.

At the ACLU, we offer a broad range of benefits, which include:

• Time away to focus on the things that matter with a generous paid time-off policy

• Focus on your well-being with comprehensive healthcare benefits (including medical, dental and vision coverage, parental leave, gender affirming care & fertility treatment)

• Plan for your retirement with 401k plan and employer match

• We support employee growth and development through annual professional development funds, internal professional development programs and workshops

OUR COMMITMENT TO ACCESSIBILITY, EQUITY, DIVERSITY & INCLUSION

Accessibility, equity, diversity and inclusion are core values of the ACLU and central to our work to advance liberty, equality, and justice for all. For us diversity, equity, accessibility, and inclusion are not just check-the-box activities, but a chance for us to make long-term meaningful change.  We are a community committed to learning and growth, humility and grace, transparency and accountability. We believe in a collective responsibility to create a culture of belonging for all people within our organization – one that respects and embraces difference; treats everyone equitably; and empowers our colleagues to do the best work possible. We are as committed to anti-oppression, anti-ableism, and anti-racism internally as we are externally. Because whether we’re in the courts or in the office, we believe ‘We the People’ means all of us.

With this commitment in mind, we strongly encourage applications from all qualified individuals without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, marital status, citizenship, disability, veteran status and record of arrest or conviction, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

The ACLU is committed to providing reasonable accommodation to individuals with disabilities. If you are a qualified individual with a disability and need assistance applying online, please complete the Accommodation Request Form

If you are selected for an interview, you will receive additional information regarding how to request an accommodation for the interview process.

Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Manager
jobs.description:
About Critical Energy
Critical Energy is an innovative, early-stage, venture-backed cleantech company on a mission to accelerate the global energy transition through abundant, low-cost clean energy. Founded by an ex-SpaceX engineer, Critical Energy designs and manufactures factory-built, modular power plants. These rapidly deployable systems convert heat into electricity using a closed-loop thermodynamic cycle and can be installed in just weeks.

Critical Energy’s technology delivers high-efficiency, 24/7 power for geothermal applications and waste heat recovery (including from data center gas turbines), making clean energy practical and cost-effective for demanding sectors like AI hyperscalers and data centers. Backed by top climate and technology investors, Critical Energy is scaling rapidly.

 

Our Mission:

To build an abundant, low-cost, 100% clean energy future through groundbreaking geothermal innovation.

We are a team of passionate engineers, designers, and visionaries building cutting-edge solutions to meet the world’s energy needs with 100% clean energy. We are in the initial stages of development and building our team. This is your chance to join on the ground floor of something big! If you are ready to work at a fun, fast-paced, groundbreaking organization that is positioned to revolutionize geothermal energy, apply today!

About the Role:
Critical Energy is hiring a Senior Supply Chain Manager to own our vendor relationships and run inventory and receiving for our manufacturing operation. You’ll source and negotiate short- and long-term vendor agreements, hold suppliers to their lead times, and build a reliable US-based supply base that keeps up with our production ramp.

This is a hands-on, senior individual contributor role reporting to the Head of Manufacturing. You’ll work closely with Manufacturing, Engineering, and Operations to turn build schedules into supply plans. Supply chain experience in aerospace, energy, or fast-moving hardware manufacturing is a strong plus.


Responsibilities:

 - Own vendor relationships across our manufacturing supply base, and expand and qualify US-based suppliers as production scales

 - Hold vendors to committed lead times, and escalate and resolve delays before they reach the floor

 - Negotiate short-term agreements and POs that secure capacity, pricing, and delivery for near-term builds

 - Structure long-term supplier agreements that lock in reliability and supply continuity as volume grows, and keep improving terms without giving up quality, lead time, or flexibility

 - Own inventory end to end, including planning, receiving, accuracy, and flow into production

 - Set up and run receiving processes that move material cleanly from dock to line

 - Translate production needs into supply plans with the Head of Manufacturing, matching material availability to build schedules and ramp goals

 - Work with Engineering and Operations on make/buy decisions, alternate sources, and risk mitigation for critical parts

 - Build simple, durable processes that scale with the company


Qualifications:

 - Proven ownership of vendor management in a hardware, aerospace, or complex manufacturing supply chain

 - Hands-on experience managing inventory and receiving in a production environment

 - Track record negotiating both short-term POs and long-term supplier contracts

 - Experience holding vendors to lead-time commitments and recovering when they slip

 - Experience building or running a primarily US-based vendor base

 - Comfortable as a senior individual contributor in a fast-paced startup with real ambiguity

 - A bias toward action, clear communication, and a steady hand keeping the floor supplied

 - Supply chain experience in aerospace, energy, or high-velocity hardware manufacturing


Compensation
Base salary ranges from $150,000 - 230,000

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

Critical Energy is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures and throughout employment. If you need assistance or any accommodation, please let us know.

As a global leader in data quality, data enrichment, and location intelligence, Precisely helps thousands of the world's most trusted brands make confident decisions with data they can rely on.
