jobs.title: Senior Manager - Product Integrity - Water, Kitchenware & Cookware
jobs.description:
About Us

SharkNinja is a global product design and technology company, with a diversified portfolio of 5-star rated lifestyle solutions that positively impact people’s lives in homes around the world. Powered by two trusted, global brands, Shark and Ninja, the company has a proven track record of bringing disruptive innovation to market and developing one consumer product after another has allowed SharkNinja to enter multiple product categories, driving significant growth and market share gains. Headquartered in Needham, Massachusetts with more than 4,100 associates, the company’s products are sold at key retailers, online and offline, and through distributors around the world.

AI at SharkNinja

At SharkNinja, we’re building an AI-native culture. We’re not waiting for the future; we’re creating it. Our people are expected to experiment boldly, adopt new tools, and continuously raise what’s possible to create meaningful impact for our consumers. If you believe the best way to do your job hasn’t been invented yet, you’ll fit right in.

This is a team leadership role at the intersection of product quality, consumer excellence, and new product development. As Senior Manager, you will own the 5-star standard across your assigned NPD programs — embedding yourself deep in the work, leading a small team of quality professionals, and holding the line on quality with Engineering, Product Development, and Marketing at every stage of the pipeline.

Product Excellence's mandate is clear: every product SharkNinja creates should earn and sustain 5 stars. Achieving that standard requires someone who combines deep technical credibility with the confidence to challenge cross-functional peers, the rigor to run structured quality processes without dropping the ball across multiple program, and the leadership presence to bring a team with them.

You will be both a practitioner and a people leader. You will run EB0 reviews, lead Pre-MP VEGA Hacks, build and apply predictive models, and own the quality and completeness of DFMEAs ahead of TRA — while also coaching and developing the team members who support these activities. You are the one who finds issues before the consumer does, and who drives the cross-functional action needed to resolve them.

You report into the Director or VP, In-Market Product Quality & Customer Excellence, and work in close day-to-day partnership with Engineering and Product Development leads across your program portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

5-Star NPD Standard

Own the 5-star quality standard across your assigned NPD program — maintaining a clear, evidence-based view of risk and trajectory for each and escalating early when a program is not on track.

Lead quality input into build reviews, bringing structured, actionable perspectives that go beyond flagging issues to proposing specific improvements with clear consumer rationale.

Act as a quality coach and challenger to Engineering and Product Development counterparts — building relationships that allow for constructive challenge and faster resolution of quality risks.

Team Leadership

Lead and develop a small team of NPD quality professionals — setting clear expectations, supporting their growth, and creating the conditions for high-quality work across the portfolio.

Own the day-to-day direction of your team — managing workload, reviewing outputs, and ensuring rigor and consistency across programs.

Contribute to hiring and capability development within the broader Product Excellence function, helping to build a team that raises the bar over time.

EB0 and Pre-MP VEGA Hacks

Lead quality input into EB0 build reviews, ensuring all product excellence requirements are visible and tracked from the earliest engineering build.

Plan and lead Pre-MP VEGA Hacks — running structured sessions to surface and resolve quality and consumer experience issues before mass production lock.

Ensure findings are documented, tracked to resolution, and fed back into the engineering and design process as repeatable learnings for future programs.

Predictive Modelling for 5-Star Performance

Build and apply predictive models at each build stage to forecast in-market rating performance, identifying the consumer experience factors most likely to drive or suppress 5-star outcomes.

Translate consumer validation results and IHUT data into structured, prioritized recommendations for Engineering, Product Development, and Marketing — making the case for change with evidence, not opinion.

Track model accuracy over time and refine the approach as new consumer data becomes available, building a methodology that improves with every program cycle.

Testing, Safety, Regulatory, and Certification

Ensure Testing has built comprehensive testing plans and protocols for each NPD program, covering performance, durability, safety, and consumer experience — and identify gaps and competitive opportunities.

Maintain active oversight of safety, regulatory, and certification delivery across your programs, partnering with Engineering, Testing, and external labs to keep everything on track and escalating blockers before they become program risks.

Pre-TRA DFMEA Quality

Own the quality and completeness of DFMEAs ahead of TRA for your programs — reviewing, challenging, and improving outputs to ensure all failure modes are identified, assessed, and have credible mitigation actions in place.

Push Engineering counterparts to ensure DFMEAs reflect real-world consumer use, not just theoretical design intent.

Track open actions through to closure, ensuring nothing reaches TRA without a clear resolution plan and a named owner.

Who You Are

Required:

• 7+ years of experience in product quality, product development, or a related engineering or consumer insights function — ideally within consumer electronics or home appliances.

• Early people leadership experience — you have managed or mentored others and are ready to take on formal team leadership responsibility at scale.

• Strong working knowledge of DFMEA methodology — able to lead, challenge, and improve DFMEA quality across multiple programmes simultaneously.

• Solid knowledge of safety testing, regulatory standards, and certification processes across at least one major market (US, EU, or UK), with exposure to others.

• Analytically strong — comfortable building predictive models, working with IHUT data, and translating findings into actionable engineering recommendations.

• A confident, evidence-based communicator who can challenge peers and senior stakeholders constructively and follow through to resolution.

• Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage a complex portfolio of NPD programmes without losing quality rigour on any of them.

Strongly Preferred:

• Experience leading or playing a senior role in VEGA Hacks or equivalent structured pre-production quality events, with measurable impact on launch quality outcomes.

• Experience building or applying predictive quality models from consumer research or IHUT data.

• Claims development experience, with an understanding of the interface between testing, legal, and marketing.

• Multi-market regulatory knowledge across consumer electronics or home appliance categories.

• A track record of driving quality improvements in fast-paced, commercially driven NPD environments.

Salary and Other Compensation: The annual salary range for this position is displayed below. Factors which may affect starting pay within this range may include geography/market, skills, education, experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate.

The Company offers the following benefits for this position, subject to applicable eligibility requirements: medical insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts (HSA) with company contribution, 401(k) retirement plan with matching, employee stock purchase program, life insurance, AD&D, short-term disability insurance, long-term disability insurance, generous paid time off, company holidays, parental leave, identity theft protection, pet insurance, pre-paid legal insurance, back-up child and eldercare days, product discounts, referral bonus program, and more.

Pay Range

$117,000—$140,000 USD

Our Culture

At SharkNinja, we don’t just raise the bar—we push past it every single day.  Our Outrageously Extraordinary mindset drives us to tackle the impossible, push boundaries, and deliver results that others only dream of. If you thrive on breaking out of your swim lane, you’ll be right at home.

What We Offer

We offer competitive health insurance, retirement plans, paid time off, employee stock purchase options, wellness programs, SharkNinja product discounts, and more. We empower your personal and professional growth with high impact Learning Programs featuring bold voices redefining what’s possible. When you join, you’re not just part of a company—you’re part of an outrageously extraordinary community. Together, we won’t just launch products—we’ll disrupt entire markets.

At SharkNinja, Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion are vital to our global success. Valuing each unique voice and blending all of our diverse skills strengthens SharkNinja’s innovation every day. We support ALL associates in bringing their authentic selves to work, making an impact, and having the opportunity for career acceleration. With help from our leadership, associates, and our community, we aim to have equity be a key component of the SharkNinja DNA.

Learn more about us:
Life At SharkNinja
Outrageously Extraordinary

About WithCoverage:

WithCoverage replaces the traditional insurance brokerage with AI-supercharged risk management designed for the modern economy.

We partner with hundreds of high-growth, category-defining companies, including GoPuff, Eight Sleep, Bombas, Chomps, and Blank Street Coffee. Our clients span iconic consumer brands, hospitality leaders, GCs, advanced manufacturers, and next-generation defense contractors. They operate in complex risk environments and need a partner that can move at their speed.

Instead of a fragmented, manual brokerage stack, we have built a new category: elite risk advisors operating on top of proprietary technology. Our in-house Agency Management System gives our team and AI agents full visibility into policies, exposures, claims, billing, and commissions. This platform enables deep automation, better decisions, and a fundamentally higher standard of service.

WithCoverage was founded by JD Ross (co-founder of Opendoor) and Max Brenner (Bain, Compound). We have raised over $43M from leading investors including Sequoia, 8VC, Khosla Ventures and Crystal Venture Partners.

Our ambition is not to build a better brokerage. It is to redefine how risk is managed across the economy.

Why Join Us:

• Work That Matters – We protect the world’s most innovative brands: consumer icons, hospitality leaders, next-gen defense contractors, and US manufacturers.

• Redefine an Industry – Insurance is one of the largest, slowest-moving markets. We rewrite the playbook with proprietary technology, automation, and AI.

This role may also be eligible for additional variable compensation, including quota-based incentives where applicable. What We Offer:

• Pre-tax accounts (FSA, HSAs, dependent care FSAs, commuter savings)

• Human Interest: 401(k) provider

• Time Off: Flexible time off, sick leave, family and medical leave, major national holidays

• Collaborative, transparent, and fun culture

jobs.title: Database Administrator
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

DATABASE ADMINISTRATOR

SpaceX is looking for a Database Administrator with strong technical knowledge in Microsoft SQL/ PowerBI technologies as well as excellent interpersonal and communication skills. This employee will be a part of our IT Engineering organization and join a team of database administrators and engineers responsible for all database technologies used throughout SpaceX. The ideal candidate will be flexible, flourish in a fast-paced and challenging environment and have an insatiable desire to learn, solve complex problems and help others. They should be a self-starter, self-motivator, and possess ingenuity to excel at this position.  This individual will need to demonstrate strong knowledge in Windows, server/storage infrastructure, and troubleshooting skills.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Partner with internal customers to understand current challenges, plan/communicate improvements and anticipate future needs.

• Perform root cause analysis of production-related database issues.

• Collaborate with internal stakeholders to optimize schemas, queries, and database/server configurations.

• Perform data migration / data transformation from OLTP to OLAP systems.

• Develop code to automate routine tasks and provide end user self-service tools by leveraging PowerShell or a similar scripting language.

• Engineer, deploy and maintain all aspects of Microsoft SQL database monitoring.

• Quickly address critical support situations by providing effective solutions to database technical issues.

• Manage PowerBI licensing, utilization, permissions and provide best-practices guidance and query optimization assistance for users.

• Provide comprehensive and fully vetted backup and restore solutions.

• Engineer, implement and routinely test Disaster Recovery (DR) strategies.

• Develop and maintain strong documentation and support runbooks.

• Support and foster the professional growth of other database engineering and administration staff via cross-training, coaching and responsibility sharing.

• Participate in an on-call rotation.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or Engineering and 3+ years of IT database administration, or 5+ years of IT database administration in lieu of a degree.

• 1+ years experience in optimizing SQL queries and data replication & transformation.

• 3+ years experience in monitoring and tuning databases to provide highly available and performant services.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Proficient in SQL Server and at least one other database technology (Postgres, MySQL, Oracle).

• Proficient in resiliency and high availability methods for SQL Server, such as SQL Server log shipping, availability groups, database mirroring and replication.

• Expertise in scaling large critical databases with high expectations for uptime and performance.

• Ability to work effectively and provide technical leadership in high-stress situations such as production database outages.

• Knowledge of configuration management automation and limiting the amount of manual toil.

• Knowledge of data structure design and modeling.

• Strong understanding of hardware in relation to SQL server; SAN, Virtualization, and basic networking for troubleshooting.

• Good knowledge of development cycle to interface well with developers.

• Working knowledge of adjacent database technologies (Postgres, Oracle, MySQL).

• Strong attention to detail, high degree of accuracy, excellent oral and written communication skills, strong interpersonal skills, and the ability to meet deadlines.

• Open to learn new database technologies especially Column-oriented databases.

• Expertise in reporting options (SQL reports, PowerBI, etc.).

• Strong understanding of big data and data warehouse concepts and technologies.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Willingness to work extended hours and weekends as needed (to respond to network and server errors after hours).

• This role is an onsite position - remote work or hybrid work will not be considered.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:
Database Admin: $95,000.00 - $120,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.

jobs.title: BIM Manager
jobs.description:
About TensorWave

Our mission is simple: deliver seamless, secure, reliable, and resilient AI compute at scale. We've built a versatile cloud platform that eliminates infrastructure barriers, empowering builders to focus on innovation instead of fighting their stack. Because breakthrough AI should move at the speed of ideas, not infrastructure.

About the Role

We’re looking for a BIM Manager to join our team during an exciting phase of growth. In this role, you’ll be responsible for coordinating, governing, and maintaining Building Information Models (BIM) across the company's data center portfolio. This role supports greenfield development, facility expansions, renovations, and AI infrastructure deployments for a neocloud provider.

The position establishes and maintains company-wide BIM standards, ensures consistency across projects and design partners, and implements formal model review and approval gates throughout design and construction. The BIM Coordinator works closely with mechanical and electrical engineering teams, architects, consultants, contractors, equipment vendors, and commissioning personnel to ensure coordinated, accurate, and construction-ready deliverables.

The role supports scalable data center development, including high-density AI and HPC environments, direct-to-chip liquid cooling, and mission-critical power and cooling infrastructure.

What You’ll Do

Portfolio-Wide BIM Standards and Governance

 - Develop, implement, and maintain company-wide BIM standards, modeling guidelines, naming conventions, coordinate systems, and model deliverable requirements.

 - Establish standardized BIM execution plans and information exchange protocols for greenfield, expansion, retrofit, and capacity augmentation projects.

 - Maintain standardized data center model templates, equipment families, typical details, and reusable design components to support repeatable engineering and construction delivery.

 - Define model development, coordination, and information requirements for each project phase.

 - Establish minimum model quality, clash detection, issue resolution, and design coordination acceptance criteria.

 - Ensure engineering consultants, architects, contractors, and equipment vendors comply with company BIM standards and project-specific requirements.

 - Conduct periodic audits of project models to verify consistency, completeness, and compliance with established standards.

 - Coordinate lessons learned across projects and incorporate improvements into company-wide standards and reference models.

 - Support the engineering organization in developing a scalable digital delivery framework that improves consistency and accelerates deployment across the data center portfolio.

Multidisciplinary BIM Coordination

 - Coordinate mechanical, electrical, plumbing, structural, architectural, civil, and technology models.

 - Manage model federation, clash detection, issue tracking, and resolution workflows.

 - Maintain model integrity, version control, shared coordinates, and common data environment protocols.

 - Facilitate coordination meetings with internal engineering teams, consultants, contractors, and vendors.

 - Identify and resolve spatial conflicts affecting installation, operation, maintenance, and future expansion.

 - Ensure coordinated models align with approved engineering documentation, specifications, equipment submittals, and project requirements.

Formal Model Review and Approval Gates

 - Establish and administer formal BIM review gates at key project milestones, including design development, construction documentation, procurement, prefabrication, installation, and final handover, as applicable.

 - Define model readiness criteria and required approvals before models are released for design issue, fabrication, or construction use.

 - Coordinate documented model reviews with mechanical and electrical engineering leads to verify compliance with the approved basis of design, engineering criteria, and project standards.

 - Verify that critical clashes, design discrepancies, equipment access constraints, and system interface conflicts are resolved or formally dispositioned before milestone approval.

 - Maintain a model review register documenting review status, identified issues, responsible parties, corrective actions, approvals, and outstanding risks.

 - Coordinate resolution of conflicts between BIM models, engineering drawings, specifications, equipment submittals, and field conditions.

 - Escalate unresolved critical issues that may affect safety, reliability, maintainability, cost, schedule, or operational readiness.

 - Ensure model revisions are reviewed and revalidated when design changes materially affect previously coordinated systems.

 - Coordinate model release status with project management, procurement, construction, and commissioning teams to ensure the correct model version is used.

 - Maintain an auditable record of model approvals, deviations, exceptions, and final acceptance.

Data Center Mechanical and Electrical Systems

 - Coordinate mission-critical mechanical and electrical infrastructure, including cooling systems, pumps, piping, valves, heat exchangers, CDUs, electrical distribution, switchgear, transformers, UPS systems, busways, generators, cable trays, and associated utilities.

 - Coordinate direct-to-chip liquid cooling infrastructure where applicable.

 - Verify equipment footprints, access clearances, service zones, replacement paths, and maintenance requirements.

 - Coordinate high-density rack layouts and IT infrastructure interfaces with facility power and cooling systems.

 - Identify conflicts involving overhead congestion, utility routing, structural penetrations, and equipment installation requirements.

AI Infrastructure and Scalable Deployment

 - Coordinate facility layouts to support evolving AI and HPC rack densities, power requirements, and cooling architectures.

 - Develop reusable model components and reference layouts that support standardized deployment across multiple sites.

 - Coordinate phased construction and expansion strategies to accommodate future compute capacity.

 - Support integration of IT infrastructure requirements with mechanical, electrical, structural, and architectural systems.

 - Identify spatial and utility constraints that could affect deployment schedules or future capacity growth.

Construction and Commissioning Support

 - Provide coordinated model deliverables to support construction, installation sequencing, and field coordination.

 - Coordinate model updates resulting from approved design changes and field conditions.

 - Support prefabrication and modular construction planning.

 - Verify that construction teams and trade contractors use the appropriate approved model versions.

 - Coordinate model information with equipment submittals, installation requirements, testing plans, and commissioning activities.

 - Ensure final record models incorporate approved changes and meet owner handover requirements.

Digital Handover and Continuous Improvement

 - Establish model and asset information requirements for handover to data center operations and facilities management.

 - Coordinate equipment identifiers, asset schedules, and maintenance information where required.

 - Support integration with asset management, CMMS, and digital twin platforms where applicable.

 - Monitor model quality, clash resolution, review-gate compliance, and delivery milestones.

 - Identify recurring coordination issues and implement improvements to standards, templates, and review processes.

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

 - Five or more years of BIM coordination, VDC, or multidisciplinary design coordination experience.

 - Experience coordinating complex MEP systems in data centers or other mission-critical facilities.

 - Proficiency with Autodesk Revit, Navisworks Manage, and a common data environment or model coordination platform.

 - Experience developing or implementing BIM execution plans, modeling standards, clash detection processes, and issue tracking workflows.

 - Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications, equipment submittals, and construction documentation.

 - Strong understanding of mechanical and electrical infrastructure and constructability requirements.

 - Demonstrated ability to coordinate multidisciplinary teams, track issues, and enforce project deliverable requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

 - Experience supporting hyperscale data centers, neocloud providers, AI infrastructure, or HPC facilities.

 - Experience establishing BIM governance and standards across multiple projects or facilities.

 - Familiarity with direct-to-chip liquid cooling, CDUs, immersion cooling, and high-density electrical distribution.

 - Experience implementing formal model review gates and design release criteria.

 - Knowledge of prefabrication, modular construction, commissioning, and digital asset handover.

 - Familiarity with Autodesk Construction Cloud, BIM Collaborate Pro, or comparable platforms.

What We Offer

 - Stock Options

 - 100% paid Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance for Employees

 - Company Health Savings Account Contributions

 - 100% paid Short Term and Long Term Disability Insurance for Employees

 - Life and Voluntary Supplemental Insurance Options

 - Other Insurance Options, such as Pet & Legal Insurance

 - Various Supplementary Health Benefits, such as discounted Virtual Healthcare Appointments and Serious Illness Support

 - Flexible Spending Account

 - 401(k)

 - Employee Assistance Program

 - Flexible PTO

 - Paid Holidays

 - Parental Leave

 - Other In-Office Perks

Equal Employment Opportunity

TensorWave is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected status under applicable law.

Reasonable Accommodations

TensorWave provides reasonable accommodations in accordance with applicable laws. If you require accommodation during the hiring process, please contact accomodations@tensorwave.com.

Employment Eligibility

All offers of employment are contingent upon verification of identity and authorization to work in the United States, as required by law.

Background Checks

Where permitted by law, employment may be contingent upon the successful completion of a job-related background check.

Data Privacy Notice

By submitting an application, you acknowledge that TensorWave may collect, use, and retain your personal information for recruiting and employment-related purposes in accordance with applicable data privacy laws.

As a Manager in Utility Substations, you will lead engineers, designers, drafters, and technical professionals responsible for the accurate, timely, and quality completion of discipline specific engineering scopes. • Partner with Project Managers and technical leaders to coordinate multidisciplinary work and maintain appropriate coverage across project scopes.

• Support proposal development, marketing activities, client pursuits, and business development through technical input and resource-planning support.

• Support client relationships by helping resolve technical and delivery concerns and promoting consistent, responsive service.

• Strong workload-planning and resource-forecasting skills, including team assignments, project coverage, milestones, and estimate-to-complete information.

• Demonstrated experience leading and developing engineers, designers, drafters, technicians, or other technical professionals.

• Experience managing team workload, resource assignments, schedules, project coverage, and technical deliverables across multiple projects.

jobs.title: Manager, New Verticals - Pharmacy Strategy & Operations
jobs.location: New York, NY; San Francisco, CA
jobs.description:
About the Team

The New Verticals team is building the future of local commerce through expanding our product offerings on our marketplace platform. We launched in 2020 and have since then built world-class operations to delight our customers with access to Grocery, Convenience, Alcohol, Pharmacy and Retail delivery through our marketplace. We focus on building new businesses and scale them - this team is focused on building our Pharmacy business from the ground up.

About the Role

As a Manager on the Pharmacy Strategy & Operations team, you will own the growth and merchant engine for DoorDash's Pharma business. You will build and execute the go-to-market plan that brings pharmacy merchants onto DoorDash, grows their volume, and keeps them. You'll work closely with Product, Engineering, Partnerships, Marketing, Finance, Legal, and New Verticals platform teams to be successful.

You'll be responsible for turning the pharmacy opportunity into a repeatable motion: planning and launching GTM programs, pitching and negotiating with merchants, and shaping how we speak to returning customers about pharmacy on DoorDash. You are the owner for knowing how Pharma merchants are performing, where the funnel leaks, and where to place the next bet to drive growth. You turn targets into operating plans, and plans into measurable outcomes.

This role requires strong commercial instincts and comfort with data. You should move fluently between merchant-level detail and business-level economics, build frameworks for tradeoffs and prioritization, and familiarity with modeling different scenarios and outcomes. Experience using SQL and data visualization tools is a plus.

You will report into the GM of Pharmacy S&O and be an individual contributor, with the opportunity to build a team in the future.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

• Strategize. From first principles, you’ll develop the optimal strategy for best serving all sides of the marketplace - dashers, merchants and consumers.

• Operate. Own tracking dashboards and manage week over week metrics to drive high quality operations.

• Analyze. Build models using Excel and SQL to evaluate the economic, operational and strategic costs and benefits of various programs and experiments — and increasingly, use AI to accelerate and deepen that analysis.

• Experiment. You’ll transform strategies into operational experiments, product features and net-new tooling that create measurable outcomes.

• Build with AI. You'll use AI tools to automate manual processes, build new prototypes and develop product visions. You'll be expected to push the boundaries of what's possible with AI in your day-to-day work, and share what you learn with the team.

• Lead, collaborate and Influence. You’ll partner with and influence cross-functional teams including growth, quality, finance, product and engineering to launch initiatives to the finish line.

We’re excited about you because…

• You have 6-8+ years of experience. You've succeeded in similar cultures that are highly analytical and cross-functional (whether in tech, e-commerce, operations, strategy, consulting, banking, or a related experience). Merchant-facing or healthcare/pharmacy experience is a plus.

• You are an owner. You're always looking for opportunities to better your work product and own the outcome – both the good and the bad.

• You're entrepreneurial. You have a bias for action and are able to build things from the ground up.

• You're analytical. You let data win arguments, and you're comfortable pulling your own data in SQL, building models, and building the tools you need to create 10x outcomes.

• You are AI Native. You root cause problems with a systems first approach and can identify how to automate repeatable tasks using AI tools like Claude, Cursor, Gemini or Copilot.

• You're equally comfortable operating at 10,000 feet and 1 foot. You don't hesitate to get in the weeds and operate at the lowest level of detail, but you're just as comfortable thinking long-term and inspiring a team.

• You're a persuasive communicator. You can pitch and negotiate with senior merchant stakeholders and align internal partners around a plan.

• You're unafraid of ambiguity. Rapid change and learning is exciting to you, and you thrive in an ambiguous, startup environment.

• You have a completed Bachelor's Degree. MBA is a plus!

Compensation

The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the pay range listed below and is determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Base salary is localized according to an employee’s work location. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future.

In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information.

DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package to all regular employees, which includes a 401(k) plan with employer matching, 16 weeks of paid parental leave, wellness benefits, commuter benefits match, paid time off and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable laws (e.g. Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act). DoorDash also offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, disability and basic life insurance, family-forming assistance, and a mental health program, among others.

To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here.

See below for paid time off details:

• For salaried roles: flexible paid time off/vacation, plus 80 hours of paid sick time per year.

• For hourly roles: vacation accrued at about 1 hour for every 25.97 hours worked (e.g. about 6.7 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 3.4 hours/month if working 20 hours/week), and paid sick time accrued at 1 hour for every 30 hours worked (e.g. about 5.8 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 2.9 hours/month if working 20 hours/week).

The national base pay range for this position within the United States, including Illinois and Colorado.

$136,000—$200,000 USD

About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Whether blatant or hidden, barriers to success have no place at DoorDash. We value a diverse workforce – people who identify as women, non-binary or gender non-conforming, LGBTQIA+, American Indian or Native Alaskan, Black or African American, Hispanic or Latinx, Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander, differently-abled, caretakers and parents, and veterans are strongly encouraged to apply. jobs.title: Recruiting Coordinator (Fixed Term)
jobs.description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.



Please note that this role will require you to be comfortable with working in-person at our NYC office 3 days/week. We will sponsor you for relocation if you need to move for this role. 




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Drive the scheduling process and communicate logistics to all candidates and hiring teams 

 - Build a world-class team by providing a high-touch “white glove” experience at every step of the interview process

 - Act as the primary contact during virtual and in-person interviews 

 - Develop collaborative relationships with Talent team members,  hiring managers, and interviewers

 - Spot and flag what isn't working such as interviewer load imbalances, bottlenecked stages, slow feedback and bring fixes

 - Manage workflows within GSuite, Ramp’s ATS (Ashby), and scheduling tools for automation




WHAT YOU’LL NEED

 - 1-2+ years of coordination / admin experience, ideally in start-up or high-growth environments

 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to quickly build trust and rapport

 - Organizational and time-management skills with superb attention to detail

 - Comfort working at high volume and re-prioritizing mid-day when plans change, interviews get moved, interviewers cancel, and you'll need to solve it without dropping anything else

 - A bias toward urgency: you respond quickly and follow through without being chased




NICE TO HAVES

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager (Threat Intel)
jobs.description:
SpyCloud is on a mission to make the internet a safer place by disrupting the criminal underground. SpyCloud’s solutions thwart cyberattacks and protect more than 4 billion accounts worldwide. Cybersecurity is an exciting, evolving space, and being at the forefront of the fight to disrupt cybercrime makes SpyCloud a special place to work. If you’re driven to align your career with a fantastic mission, look no further!

Identity Threat Intelligence is one of the most interesting corners of a crowded market. Every vendor has data. Few can explain why theirs changes what a security team does on Monday morning. As our Product Marketing Manager for the solution area, that explanation is yours to build: why companies should care about SpyCloud, and how we are different.

This is a high-growth solution area, and 2027 will bring continued innovation, including more AI-powered investigations. We want someone who knows this world well enough to help define what great looks like, and who can bring our sellers, customers, and partners along on the path to disrupting cybercrime.

You do not need to have been a product marketer. If you have spent your career as a threat researcher, CTI analyst, investigator, sales engineer, product manager, or engineer in this space, and you write & present well, we want to talk to you.

You will report to our Senior Director of Product Marketing, and partner with Sales, Demand Gen, Content, Customer Success, and Product as regular collaborators. You will be especially close to the Investigations product team, since the people who use Investigations (security teams, fraud analysts, investigators, and threat intelligence professionals) overlap heavily with the audiences you will market to. It is a role with real ownership and plenty of variety.

What You'll Do:

Read the market

• Research how buyers choose and use threat intelligence.

• Turn customer feedback from calls, advisory programs, and win/loss reviews into messaging and priorities.

• Identify where SpyCloud is different and state it in terms the field can defend.

Know the competition

• Run the competitive intelligence program for your solution area: competitor moves, win/loss patterns, market shifts.

• Build battlecards, talk points, and objection handling for live deals.

• Brief Sales, Product, and leadership as the landscape changes.

Sharpen the story

• Define why companies should care about SpyCloud and how we are different, for security operations, threat intel, fraud, and identity audiences.

• Shape AI-powered investigations messaging for users and organizations at different levels of maturity, acceptance, and skepticism.

• Explain technical capabilities clearly to practitioners and executives.

• Keep messaging consistent across Identity Threat Intelligence and Investigations, from the UI to the API and MCP.

Launch well

• Lead cross-functional GTM for new capabilities, data sets, APIs, and integrations, aligning Product, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success from planning through adoption.

• Treat every launch as a cycle, not a date: prepare, launch, measure adoption, gather feedback, adjust, repeat.

• Support packaging and pricing messaging and xsell/upsell motions.

Equip the field

• Own the core content set (our bill of materials): positioning, one-pagers, decks, web copy, blogs, documentation, and demos.

• Write talk tracks, demo scripts, and discovery guides.

• Train Sales, Sales Engineering, and Customer Success, and keep materials current.

Fill the pipeline

• Work with Demand Gen and Content on campaigns, webinars, and programs that build pipeline.

• Work with research and threat intel experts on thought leadership that shows what our data can do.

Win buyers, keep Defenders

• Shape how SpyCloud engages prospects, from first conversation through evaluation, so they choose to partner with us.

• Define how we engage existing customers, our Defenders, so they keep getting value and keep partnering with us to disrupt cybercrime.

Scale your expertise with AI

• Use AI to scale programs: research, first drafts, content, and messaging tests.

• Run launches efficiently end to end, using AI where it saves time or raises quality.

• Track how AI is changing threat intelligence and investigations, and how buyers want to use it.

• Check AI output for accuracy with internal experts and SMEs before it ships.

Prove what works

• Own go-to-market results for the solution area: launch execution, pipeline impact, and growth.

• Set metrics for each launch and program (pipeline, win rates, adoption, usage, expansion) and report results.

• Work with Customer Success to find use cases that drive adoption.

Requirements:

• 5+ years of experience in cybersecurity, with deep working knowledge of threat intelligence or a closely adjacent space, such as digital risk protection, fraud intelligence, identity security, incident response, SOC operations, or digital investigations.

• Hands-on time in the work: threat researcher, CTI analyst, investigator, SOC or incident response analyst, sales engineer, product manager, engineer, or product marketer. Product marketing experience is welcome, not required.

• Familiarity with the threat intelligence landscape: the tools, the tech stacks, and how intelligence flows into SIEM, SOAR, TIP, and investigation workflows.

• Stellar writing and storytelling, and the ability to explain complex topics so a CISO, an analyst, and a seller all get it.

• Experience enabling others, through training, demos, technical content, or sales support, and a knack for making it stick.

• Knowledge of how AI is changing threat intelligence, or at least a clear view of how our target buyers use AI and where they want to apply it. You are AI-savvy without being AI-dependent.

• Familiarity with MCP, APIs, and data platforms, and comfort talking them through with product managers and engineers.

• Market and competitive curiosity: you can read competitors, win/loss patterns, and market shifts, and explain what they mean for how we sell.

• Results you can point to, such as growth in adoption, usage, pipeline, or revenue.

• A feel for how buyers and customers experience SpyCloud, and ideas for making them want to stay close.

• The self-direction to do your best work in a remote-first, highly collaborative environment, and willingness to travel occasionally for customer meetings, industry events, and internal planning sessions.

Nice to Have:

• Federal or global government experience.

• Experience marketing threat intelligence or fraud platform tools.

• Experience marketing data-driven or API-based products, including product-led growth motions.

• Customer marketing and advocacy program experience.

• Analyst relations experience.

Base Salary Range: $115,000 – $150,000

The salary range reflects the expected base compensation for a fully qualified candidate at this level based on experience, qualifications, and market data at the time of posting.

U.S.-Based Benefits + Perks (for Full Time Employees):

At SpyCloud, we are committed to working alongside individuals who are equally passionate about preventing cybercrime, regardless of their department or role. Guided by our core values in all business decisions, we prioritize unity in our mission and ensure all SpyCloud employees have the support and benefits they need to stay focused on our goals. In addition to our engaging workspace in South Austin, flexible and remote-friendly work options, and competitive salary package, we offer our employees a comprehensive benefits package that includes:

• 401(k) with Employer Contribution

• Health, Vision, and Dental Insurance Health Savings Account (HSA) available with Employer Contribution

• Employer Paid Life, Short-term, and Long-term Disability Insurance

• Generous PTO Plan and 16 paid holidays per year

U.K.-Based Benefits + Perks (for Full Time Employees):

• Retirement Savings Plan with Employer Contribution

• Employer Provided Private Health Insurance and Healthcare Cashplan

• Employer Paid Life Insurance, Income Replacement, and Critical Illness Protection

• Employee Assistance Program

• 25 days annual accrued holiday plus 8 paid bank holidays and a paid company shutdown during winter holidays

About SpyCloud:

SpyCloud transforms recaptured darknet data to disrupt cybercrime. Its automated identity threat protection solutions use advanced analytics and AI to accelerate investigations and  protect workforce, consumer, and supplier identities from the threats that matter most: authentication bypass, session hijacking, malicious insiders, account takeover, ransomware, and fraud. Its data from malware-infected devices, successful phishes, combolists, and third-party breaches also powers many popular dark web monitoring and identity theft protection offerings. Customers include 7 of the Fortune 10, along with hundreds of global enterprises, mid-sized companies, and government agencies worldwide. Headquartered in Austin, TX, SpyCloud is home to more than 250 cybersecurity experts whose mission is to protect businesses and consumers from the stolen identity data criminals are using to target them now.

To learn more and see insights on your company's exposed data, visit spycloud.com.

Our Mission:

Our mission is to make the internet a safer place by disrupting the criminal underground. Together with our customers and partners, we aim to end criminals’ ability to profit from stolen information.

Who We Are:

SpyCloud is a place for innovative, collaborative, and problem-solvers to thrive. Individually, we’re amazing, but together, we’re unstoppable. We celebrate diversity and various perspectives and aim to create an inclusive and supportive environment for all. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer of choice. All aspects of employment decisions will be based on merit, performance, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of any status protected under federal, state, or local law. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. Women, minorities, individuals with disabilities, and protected veterans are encouraged to apply. SpyCloud complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

SpyCloud expressly prohibits any form of workplace harassment. Improper interference with the ability of SpyCloud's employees to perform their job duties may result in discipline up to and including discharge. SpyCloud shares the right to work and participates in the E-Verify program in all locations.

If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us.

Our Culture:

Our culture is something really special. We’re all driven to disrupt the cybercriminal economy as we keep customer accounts safe from compromise. We support a truly worthy and serious mission, but we have fun doing it together. If you are driven, inventive, and collaborative, you’ll fit right in.

SpyCloud’s Recruitment Policy:

We will never ask an applicant for sensitive or personal financial information during the recruitment process. We advise all applicants seeking employment with SpyCloud to review available information on recruitment fraud. Anyone who suspects that they have been contacted by someone falsely representing SpyCloud should email careers@spycloud.com.

Compensation Transparency Policy:

At SpyCloud, we believe in transparency and fairness in compensation. We strive to ensure that all employees are fairly compensated for their contributions, and we openly discuss our compensation philosophy and structure. We are committed to providing competitive salaries and benefits packages to attract and retain top talent, and we encourage open dialogue and feedback regarding compensation matters.

Learn more and apply: SpyCloud Careers

SpyCloud is not sponsoring visas at this time.

For applicants residing in California, please click here to read SpyCloud's CCPA Notice.

For applicants residing in the UK, please click here to read SpyCloud's Employee Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Account Manager, Customer Engagement
jobs.description:
Role Purpose

LevelTen Energy's mission is to accelerate the energy transition by facilitating frictionless transactions. As the leading provider of renewable transaction infrastructure, we deliver the cloud based software, centralized supply, automated analytics, and transaction expertise required to power the renewable energy economy. The LevelTen Platform is the world's largest online hub for renewable energy buyers, sellers, advisors, asset owners and financiers, and delivers the online tools and expertise they need to buy, sell and finance assets quickly.

The Account Manager owns a portfolio of roughly 40 of LevelTen's existing North American client accounts — primarily renewable project developers, plus a set of energy buyers. Reporting to a Director of Account Management, the Account Manager manages day-to-day relationships for their accounts, keeps clients engaged with the LevelTen Platform, and supports the team's RFPs and bilateral engagements, market updates and renewals. The Account Manager ensures buyers and sellers are successful on the LevelTen Platform by guiding them and providing value through market insights. The role is focused on growing and retaining current accounts rather than new-logo prospecting.

This is a learning-and-growth role for someone early/mid in their renewable energy career. Over time, the Account Manager will take on direct ownership of more accounts and more complex engagements. As a fast-growing company in a quickly evolving industry, we are always learning and improving how we support our customers, and this role will help shape how the team delivers for both sides of the LevelTen Marketplace.

Duties and Responsibilities

Duties and responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

Account Management

• Nurture and expand relationships with a portfolio of renewable energy developers and energy buyers

• Act as a day-to-day point of contact for client questions, routing requests to Transactions, Product and Client Services as needed

• Run regular check-ins, market update calls and project pipeline discussions with clients

• Collaborate with buyers to scope and launch demand signals (RFPs and bilaterals) across product types, including PPAs, VPPAs, BESS contracts and capacity supply agreements

• Lead proactive outreach when market or policy changes affect clients' projects (e.g., tariff impacts on project timelines and contract milestones)

• Drive platform adoption by onboarding new users, explaining LevelTen's offline products and services, and tracking usage

• Demonstrate the value of LevelTen's services to buyers, developers and asset owners to drive robust participation in LevelTen products and marketplaces

• Foster engagement by presenting transaction opportunities, leading educational demos and webinars, and attending (and occasionally speaking at) industry conferences

• Represent buyer and seller perspectives in LevelTen's software and product design

• Support client engagement KPIs and other leading and lagging indicators of how buyers and sellers use the Platform

• Support and land renewals by preparing account reviews, usage summaries and renewal materials

Transaction Support

• Support PPA transactions (RFPs, auctions and bilaterals), including notifying clients, providing updates, and sharing won/lost and report feedback

• Encourage developer participation in appropriate RFP and bilateral opportunities

• Guide buyers and sellers through deal execution alongside LevelTen's transaction teams

• Help coordinate client analyses with the team's leads

• Keep the team's RFP and market activity trackers current

Business Development

• Spot and lead upsell and cross-sell opportunities across LevelTen's product portfolio

• Sell value-based subscriptions for buyer- and seller-focused products and services, including PPA solutions and market intelligence

• Help clients get full value from LevelTen's market intelligence products (e.g., PPA MarketPulse and market reports) and identify opportunities to expand their subscriptions

• Work with Marketing and Business Development to keep clients engaged with campaigns, events and market insights

• Contribute to LevelTen's industry thought leadership, including newsletters, white papers, webinars, social media and events

Operations & Team Support

• Maintain accurate account, contact and opportunity data in Salesforce

• Prepare client-facing materials, decks and meeting notes

• Support team initiatives as roles and responsibilities evolve

Qualifications

The ideal candidate is a self-starter with an innate desire to uncover the ever-changing needs of the industry and flow those insights into the LevelTen Platform. They will also have the following.

Must have

• 3+ years of relevant work experience in the renewable energy industry, energy consulting, or B2B account management/customer success

• Experience managing a book of multiple client accounts with overlapping deadlines

• Clear writing, presentation and verbal communication skills, with attention to detail

• Experience partnering with other internal teams, such as sales, product or operations

• Interest and aptitude in building relationships with clients and internal stakeholders

• Ability to think quickly on your feet, make decisions and work independently with limited supervision

• Comfort with PowerPoint/Google Slides and Excel

• Ability to travel domestically up to 20%

Nice to have

• Familiarity with North American wholesale electricity markets, PPA origination and/or utility-scale renewable project development

• Experience with Salesforce, Asana or similar tools

• Business development or enterprise sales experience

• Project management experience

• Experience with AI tools such as Claude

Additional Details

• The estimated compensation for this position is $110,000 – $140,000 per year, (OTE $150,000 - $180,000) based on experience and qualifications.

• Seattle or Denver-based candidates preferred. Remote candidates will be considered.

Benefits / Perks

• Full medical, vision and dental coverage

• Wellness credit

• Flexible vacation policy

• 11 paid company holidays

• 401(k) plan

About LevelTen Energy

LevelTen Energy is the leading provider of transaction infrastructure for the renewable energy economy. Our platform delivers buyers, sellers, advisors, and financiers the automation software, data management, and standardized contracts needed to facilitate faster, safer renewable energy transactions. LevelTen's marketplace of renewable energy power purchase agreements is the world's largest, with more than 4,000 Transaction-Ready Pricing™ offers spanning 21 countries in North America and Europe. LevelTen's CFO-Ready Analytics™ automatically calculate more than a billion data points every day, providing our partners with leading-edge, real-time risk and value insights at modern market scale. Together, LevelTen and our partners share #OneGoal to accelerate the clean energy transition. Visit us at LevelTenEnergy.com to learn more.

Equal Opportunity Employer

LevelTen Energy is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, marital status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other legally protected status.

Accessibility

If you are an individual with a disability and need assistance completing the online application or during the interview process, please call 1-800-995-2152. Please leave a message and a member of our People team will return your call within three business days. Alternatively, an email may be sent to hr@leveltenenergy.com. “Applicant Accommodation” should be included in the subject line of the email. Please note that this phone number and email are only for those individuals who would like to request an accommodation to apply for a job.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Registered Nurse (RN) - Full-Time Nights

Reports To: Director of Nursing

Location: Loveland, CO

Facility: Northpoint Colorado  (Adult inpatient)

Schedule: 3x12's 6pm-6:30am MST with alternating holidays and weekends

Compensation: $33-52/hour + Shift Differential

Northpoint Recovery Holdings, LLC began 2009 as Ashwood Outpatient and officially launched the Northpoint platform in 2015. Now celebrating 10 years of growth in 2025, Northpoint is a leading behavioral healthcare provider offering evidence-based treatment for adults with substance use and co-occurring disorders through the Northpoint Recovery brand, and mental health treatment for adolescents through Imagine by Northpoint. Operating under an in-network, commercial insurance model, Northpoint has grown exclusively through de novo expansion—from two facilities to seventeen across the Western U.S.—with more planned in both existing and new markets. We’re guided by core values of humility, heart, inspiration, and conviction. Our mission is simple: saving lives and restoring relationships by helping people get their lives back, and treating every individual with empathy and respect.

POSITION SUMMARY: As a key member of the Northpoint team, the Registered Nurse (RN) will provide and oversee the medical services provided to a caseload of patients. This licensed nursing professional will act as the medical treatment plan coordinator for the multi-disciplinary team in the development and implementation of the master treatment plan and the discharge plan for each patient. This person will actively communicate with support staff, treatment teams, providers, and outside agencies on treatment and safety issues pertaining to patients and their family members. The Registered Nurse (RN) will work under the supervision of a Registered Nurse or provider, and will perform duties according to established patient care protocols, standards, and procedures. This position is expected to complete all documentation associated with these duties in a professional and timely manner.

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES:

• Interact routinely with patients, observe behaviors and communicate significant observations to multidisciplinary team as necessary

• Administer medications to patients, and engage in education process

• Utilize de-escalation skills when exposed to volatile patients to maintain personal safety for the patient and other individuals in our care

• Provide admission, orientation, education and discharge plans to patients, families and others to aid in the treatment process

• Consult with the multidisciplinary treatment team in the development of treatment plans and discharge planning to strive for excellent patient care

• Participate in the maintenance of a clean, orderly and safe environment, and report needs for repairs and maintenance to appropriate staff

• Admissions and discharges of patients

• Obtain vital signs, monitor symptoms and document in the patient record

• Comply with all laws, regulations, and scope of licensure

• Monitor patients on an ongoing basis to continually assess needs and facilitate medical treatment and interventions

• Document medical assessment, diagnosis, progress notes, roundings, and other treatment planning items in a timely manner to assure comprehensive and quality patient care

• Actively participate as a member of the multidisciplinary treatment team and maintain effective working relationships with employees and peers

• Maintain professional boundaries with patients at all times

• Oversee and participate in the quality assurance and compliance activities of the facility

• Provide medical updates to utilization review and representatives of managed care to best coordinate reimbursement of treatment services

• Adhere to all company policies and procedures

• Maintain confidentiality in accordance with established policies and procedures and standards of care

• Other clinically appropriate services and special projects as assigned

QUALIFICATIONS/REQUIREMENTS:

• Current, unencumbered, active license to practice as a Registered Nurse in the state where services are rendered

• Must be at least twenty-one (21) years of age

• Current and nationally accredited CPR/First Aid/AED certification

• Knowledge of computer and electronic medical records systems (KIPU preferred)

• Enthusiasm, passion for working with people, and an internal drive to improve the lives of individuals in our care

• Must maintain applicable state licensure requirements throughout duration of employment

• Ability to work with a diverse population along with interpersonal skills and knowledge required for treating patients in area of assigned specialty

• Demonstrated ability to hold strong personal boundaries and ability to build rapport with patients

• Must understand and adhere to the ethical standards of the respective licensure governing board

PREFERRED KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS:

• Excellent organizational abilities

• Excellent written and oral communication skills

• Attention to detail and accuracy

• Patient service oriented (both internal and external)

• Creative and persistent problem solver

• Able to handle confidential material in a reliable manner

• Ability to interact and communicate with individuals at all levels of organization

• Strong interpersonal skills to handle sensitive situations and confidential information

• Ability to multi-task and prioritize workload in a fast-paced environment

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite

FULL-TIME BENEFITS INCLUDE:

• Subsidized Health Insurance Coverage for Employee, Spouse, & Dependent(s)

• 100% Employer Paid Basic Life Insurance equal to 1x annual salary, up to $100,000

• 100% Employer Paid Employee Assistance Program

• Voluntary Dental, Vision, Short-Term Disability, Supplemental Life & AD&D, Critical Illness, Accident, and Hospital Indemnity Insurance.

• Pre-tax Savings Accounts for all IRS-allowable medical and dependent care expenses

• Generous Paid Time Off plan

jobs.title: Staff, Advanced Analytics
jobs.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

Airbnb, a leader in travel and hospitality, is on a mission to create a world where anyone can belong anywhere. We offer unique accommodations and experiences, crafted and curated by locals. As we expand into new marketplaces for in-person experiences and services, we are on the lookout for driven and innovative individuals to help shape our growth trajectory.

The Difference You Will Make:

Airbnb is seeking a Staff, Advanced Analytics, to support our Host Incentives team. This individual will play a pivotal role in supporting strategic business and product initiatives through detailed data analysis, experimentation, statistical modeling, and the development of reporting tools and metrics. The individual will be instrumental in building and scaling an efficient, effective incentive program for our hosts.

A Typical Day:

• Own the measurement strategy for host incentives end to end, and drive the roadmap with limited direction.

• Set the analytical standard for how host incentive programs are evaluated and act as the senior thought partner to Operations, Data Science, Finance, and Product leadership.

• Work with large and complex data sets to solve a wide array of challenging problems using different analytical and statistical approaches.

• Apply technical expertise with quantitative analysis, experimentation, data mining, forecasting and the presentation of data to identify trends and patterns that can inform decision-making.

• Collaborate closely with Operations, Data Science, Finance, Product and other cross-functional teams to provide actionable insights.

• Design, execute, and analyze experiments to measure impact and guide incentive iterations. Leverage causal methods when traditional randomized trials aren’t available.

• Design and build metrics / dimensions to monitor product and business performance.

• Build sophisticated reporting and analytical tools that empower stakeholders to make data-driven decisions.

• Present findings and recommendations to stakeholders, including senior leadership, in a clear and concise manner.

• Stay up-to-date with the latest industry trends and advancements in quantitative and qualitative data analysis techniques.

• Leverage AI to automate repetitive tasks and empower stakeholders.

Your Expertise:

• 10+ years of industry experience with a degree (Masters or PhD is a plus) in a quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science, Operations Research).

• Prior experience in an advanced analytics or data science role.

• Experience measuring incentive, promotion, pricing or marketing-spend programs, including incrementality and ROI, strongly preferred.

• Exceptional business acumen, strategic thinking skills, and the ability to conduct rigorous analysis and make informed judgments.

• Excellent communication skills, capable of engaging with a variety of stakeholders and conveying complex concepts in an accessible manner.

• Proven stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate and influence across functions.

• Experience partnering with Operations and Finance teams to drive action and provide expertise and direction on analytics, experimental design, and measurement.

• Experience in analysis of A|B experiments and statistical data analysis.

• Experience designing and building metrics, from conception to building prototypes with data pipelines.

• Strong expertise in at least one programming language (Python or R) and SQL.

• An agile, growth-minded approach, demonstrated through a history of driving projects from ideation to impact.

• Experience with AI-assisted analytics (Claude, ChatGPT, etc).

Your Location:

This position is US - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. While the position is Remote Eligible, you must live in a state where Airbnb, Inc. has a registered entity. Click here for the up-to-date list of excluded states. This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list  If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from.

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com. Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process.

We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application.

Equal Employment Opportunity:

Airbnb values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Airbnb are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, gender, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic.

How We'll Take Care of You:

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

Pay Range

$180,000—$221,000 USD

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing.  We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

Skills & Abilities
