jobs.title: Product Marketing Director
jobs.description:
We're Scan.com http://Scan.com.  We're building America's national imaging network: the infrastructure that connects patients, providers, and payers to faster, better-value diagnostic imaging.  Thousands of patients move through our platform every day, and each is a real person waiting for an answer to a healthcare concern. We exist to get them that answer faster.



We manage the medical imaging pathway end-to-end.  Providers order through a single point of entry, and from there, we run the entire medical diagnostic pathway.  Managing the full pathway, rather than brokering pieces of it, is what lets us deliver imaging faster, at higher quality, and at a lower cost than the fragmented status quo.



We're looking for a Product Marketing Director, Self-Funded Employers & Health Plans at an exciting time. We've raised over $200m in funding to date, reached profitability, and are growing 100% year on year.



Millions of people wait too long for a diagnosis. Come help us fix that.




WHAT YOU WILL ACHIEVE IN THIS ROLE:

You'll own product marketing for Scan.com http://Scan.com's self-funded employer and health plan business lines. You'll report to the VP, Marketing and work closely with multiple teams across the business, including Sales, Product, RevOps and Finance.

Your job is to help Sales win. That means clear positioning, credible evidence and materials that move buying decisions forward. You'll create the messaging, positioning, pricing and content for everyone in the buying process, including CFOs, benefits leaders, consultants, brokers and TPAs.

This is a chance to build product marketing from the ground up for a high-growth vertical in a fast-scaling company. You'll start as a team of one, with AI being part of how you work from day one. Over time, you'll build the workflows and agents that let this function scale without matching headcount.



As a scale-up business, you can expect your role to develop over time. Here are some of the types of things you could be getting involved in:

 - Build deep buyer insight. Understand how self-funded employers, health plans, and their advisers evaluate, buy, and implement imaging benefits. Map the buying committee, decision criteria, and barriers to adoption through interviews with buyers, consultants, industry experts, and executives.

 - Define positioning and messaging. Own the employer value proposition and adapt it for each stakeholder and buying route. Give Sales a clear story on why Scan.com http://Scan.com, why now, and how implementation works.

 - Turn analysis into commercial proof. Partner with Finance and Analytics to turn validated analysis into a persuasive savings story. Own how we explain the findings, assumptions, and limitations to buyers. Build a repeatable proof package for Sales to use.

 - Set pricing and packaging. Own market pricing across customer segments and verticals, including competitive benchmarking, pricing models, and packaging.

 - Sharpen the message in the field. Join Sales on live calls and at events. Deliver new messaging alongside reps, hear the pushback firsthand and refine based on what wins. Maintain practical battlecards, run win/loss reviews, and bring field evidence to Product and Engineering to shape what we build next.

 - Equip Sales and partners. Build decks, one-pagers, ROI tools, talk tracks, and consultant briefings. Work with leadership on channel and strategic partner deals, developing partner value propositions, proposals, pitch materials, and pricing inputs. Support partner onboarding and enablement.

 - Lead product and partnership launches. Lead marketing readiness for new employer and health plan products, features, and partnerships. Turn it into a repeatable playbook with agreed positioning, commercial materials, Sales training, and measures of success.

 - Direct targeted campaigns. Agree a small number of employer and consultant campaigns with Sales. Define the audience, message and content, then brief the team on execution. Use targeted outreach, selected events, hosted dinners and data-led content where they support a clear commercial objective.

 - Prove marketing's commercial impact. Work with RevOps to track pipeline origin and marketing's contribution to opportunity progression in HubSpot. Report monthly on partner-originated and marketing-originated pipeline. Use the findings to decide which campaigns and materials we invest in.

 - Build an AI-native function. Use AI daily across research, competitive and win/loss analysis, RFP responses, and content. You’ll move from using AI to building with it: designing the workflows and agents that run core product marketing work. Decide where AI does the work and where people add the most value, and shape the hiring plan from there.
   
   


WHAT YOU MIGHT BRING TO THE TABLE:

You don't need to tick all the boxes to apply for this role. Whether it's your first role or your fifth role, we believe everyone can add value, learn, and grow. However, these might be some of the ways you are currently adding value:

 - Experience marketing a complex healthcare or benefits offering to self-funded employers or health plans, and the advisers and partners who influence their decisions.

 - Comfort in the field. You present to prospects, consultants and brokers, and you know how differently each one thinks and operates.

 - Strong positioning and writing skills, with examples of materials you personally built that Sales used in live opportunities. You can brief campaigns and creative to others.

 - The ability to turn claims, pricing and outcomes analysis into credible commercial arguments, working closely with analytical specialists.

 - Experience planning product or partnership launches and targeted campaigns with Sales, with clear objectives and measurable results.
   
   


AI REQUIREMENTS

At Scan.com http://Scan.com, AI isn't a side project; it's how we work. We expect everyone to use AI to think faster, remove drudgery, and multiply their output. What we care about is judgment: knowing when AI makes you sharper, when it doesn't, and how to use it responsibly around patient data. You don't need to be an engineer. You need to reach for the best tool and get more done as a result.

For this role, you're expected to be AI-Amplified. AI is part of your daily workflow for drafting, analysis, and research, and you know how to check its output and use it responsibly with sensitive data.

Where this role is heading: Over your first year, you'll move from using AI daily to building with it directly. That means designing, shipping and running the workflows and agents behind research, competitive analysis, RFP responses and content production. If you've already built your own workflows or agents, that's a strong plus.

One assessment principle across all tiers: we're testing judgment and adaptability, not whether you've memorized today's tools. Tools change quarterly; the ability to learn and apply them is what compounds.




A VIEW ON OUR CULTURE

We're building something that matters. Every scan we speed up is a real person waiting on an answer, and that urgency runs through everything we do. We move fast, we own outcomes, and take pride in our output. If you like ambiguity, working with ambitious people, and want your work to visibly move the needle, you'll feel at home here.



HOW WE WILL INTERVIEW YOU

We keep our interview process short and sweet. Here are the stages you can expect, but we might switch up the order depending on team availability:

 1. 30-minute introductory phone call with a member of our Talent Team.

 2. If it feels like there is an initial fit for all, we will invite you to a 45-minute video call with the hiring manager. This is a more structured interview that will deep-dive into the role and technical needs.

 3. 'Scan Standard' interview, where our panel screens for values alignment and the success factors that matter at Scan.com http://Scan.com. You will also be assessed on your AI fluency at the stage and depth relevant to your role (see AI Requirements above).

 4. Meet the founders and/or other team members. Again, the length varies depending on how many people are involved and whether in person or via video call.

 5. Offer!
    


WHAT WE OFFER

We go beyond the basics with our benefits package. We believe great work starts with supporting our people. Here's what you can expect from us:

 - Salary range of $175,000 - $220,000

 - Equity

 - Bonus

 - Flexible remote or hybrid work options

 - Dedicated personal development budget




DIVERSITY AT SCAN.COM http://Scan.com

Scan.com http://Scan.com is committed to eliminating discrimination and encouraging diversity within our team. We strive to provide equality and fairness for all job applicants and employees and never discriminate on the basis of gender, marital status, age, race, ethnicity, religion, or physical differences.

We are opposed to all forms of unlawful treatment and discrimination.

Our ambition is for our team to be representative of society's diversity, and for every employee to feel respected and able to bring their best selves to work.

If you need an accommodation to apply or interview, contact us at people@scan.com.

We look forward to receiving your application!

jobs.title: Senior Art Director - Campaigns
jobs.description:
We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. We’re looking for a Senior Art Director to join the creative team at Plaid and shape how we execute brand awareness campaigns. For more information about the design team, visit https://designedbyplaid.com/.



This role is ideal for someone who thrives in concepting and executing across multiple mediums—from campaign development to social to video storyboards—and knows how to bring a big idea to life with consistency, creativity, and impeccable design execution. You’re a design generalist that can flex across any medium and thrives in the world of brand campaigns.

Qualifications:

 - 8+ years of experience in design/art direction, with a portfolio that showcases 360 brand campaigns spanning video, social, and digital (print and OOH a plus)     

 - Proficiency in Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, and AI tools  

 - Advanced understanding of photography and videography. On-set experience a mandatory

jobs.description:

Whether you are turning an apartment to create the perfect move-in experience for new residents or resolving service requests to ensure that our current residents feel at home, every day is filled with new challenges.

You will work at The Huntington Gateway Apartments, our 440+-unit community, just minutes from Old Town Alexandria in Alexandria, VA.

Check it out here: Huntington Gateway

What We Offer

jobs.title: Spring 2027: Quality Engineering Co-op, Shark (January through June)
jobs.description:
About Us

SharkNinja is a global product design and technology company, with a diversified portfolio of 5-star rated lifestyle solutions that positively impact people’s lives in homes around the world. Powered by two trusted, global brands, Shark and Ninja, the company has a proven track record of bringing disruptive innovation to market and developing one consumer product after another has allowed SharkNinja to enter multiple product categories, driving significant growth and market share gains. Headquartered in Needham, Massachusetts with more than 4,100 associates, the company’s products are sold at key retailers, online and offline, and through distributors around the world.

AI at SharkNinja

At SharkNinja, we’re building an AI-native culture. We’re not waiting for the future; we’re creating it. Our people are expected to experiment boldly, adopt new tools, and continuously raise what’s possible to create meaningful impact for our consumers. If you believe the best way to do your job hasn’t been invented yet, you’ll fit right in.

Job Name: Spring 2027: Quality Engineering Co-op, Shark January through June

Location: Needham, MA

Work Period: January to June

Location & Schedule: This is a full-time, 40-hour-per-week position with a minimum of 5 Days per week onsite in Needham, MA. There is no relocation or housing assistance for this position.

Compensation Range: Ranges from $30/hr - $36/hr. Specific compensation is set according to a standardized scale aligned with your educational level at the time of hire.

Join the SharkNinja Early Edge Experience: Built for early talent. Geared toward impact. Driven by speed. Whether you're in a co-op or internship, our early talent program is designed to provide valuable exposure to the industry and a fast-paced professional environment. You’ll dive into meaningful projects and tasks that sharpen your skills and deepen your knowledge. Along the way, you’ll benefit from professional development opportunities, community events, and connections that make your experience well-rounded and enriching. Your time with us will culminate in an opportunity to showcase your contributions and learnings to SharkNinja leaders because this is a program for those ready to shape what’s next — fast.

This role: Quality Engineering Co-op, Shark

We are looking for a passionate Quality Engineering Co-op, Shark. The Product Development organization within SharkNinja drives our global product roadmap from concept to shelf through the constant lens of the consumer. We are the “product CEOs” and partner cross-functionally with almost every other team within the company to drive high satisfaction for our end user and to drive business results. We are comprised of individuals from a variety of professional and educational backgrounds, from product marketing managers to consumer-focused engineers – but we all have one thing in common: we’re consistently striving to deliver a 5-star experience for every customer on every product we bring to market.

This unique role is part of our team dedicated to positively impacting consumers' lives worldwide. You'll contribute to enhancing and optimizing our existing product lines while playing a critical role in insights-driven new product development across the organization.

Here are some of the EXCITING things you’ll get to do:

• Tear down consumer-returned units and perform failure analysis on mechanical and electrical failures. This is the majority of the role.

• Analyze consumer complaints from call center data and web reviews using Power BI. You will find patterns, size issues, and track trends.

• Recreate consumer-reported failures in the lab by running products for extended periods, with the goal of reproducing failures reliably.

• Use what you learn from reproduced failures to help improve test methods for future programs.

• Document findings and root cause in Jira tickets, using structured problem-solving tools such as 5 Why, 8D, and fishbone diagrams.

• Present findings clearly to PI, engineering, PD, and process quality partners and leaders.

ATTRIBUTES & SKILLS:

• Currently pursuing a degree in mechanical, electrical, mechatronics, or a related engineering field, second year or beyond.

• Hands-on mechanical or electrical aptitude (disassembly, use of hand tools, basic multimeter or measurement skills). Prior project, lab, or maker experience counts.

• Working knowledge of data analysis (Excel required). Power BI or similar tools are a plus, and a willingness to learn is essential.

• Comfort with, and patience for, repetitive lab work. Reproducing a failure often takes many hours of running a product.

• Curiosity and structured thinking. Experience with 5 Why, 8D, fishbone, or other root-cause tools is a plus, but we will teach these.

• Clear written communication, with careful and consistent documentation.

• A “100% on” consumer-first perspective when it comes to introducing new products/processes or improving current products

Please note that, due to the high volume of applications for early talent roles, response times may vary depending on the specific role and timeline. Our team appreciates your patience!

Salary and Other Compensation: The hourly salary range for this position is displayed below. Factors which may affect starting pay within this range may include geography/market, skills, education, experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate.

The Company offers the following benefits for this position, subject to applicable eligibility requirements: medical insurance, health savings account (HSA) with company contribution, sick time, company holidays, employee product discount, product testing opportunities, referral bonuses, and more.

Hourly Pay Range

$27—$36 USD

Our Culture

At SharkNinja, we don’t just raise the bar—we push past it every single day.  Our Outrageously Extraordinary mindset drives us to tackle the impossible, push boundaries, and deliver results that others only dream of. If you thrive on breaking out of your swim lane, you’ll be right at home.

What We Offer

We offer competitive health insurance, retirement plans, paid time off, employee stock purchase options, wellness programs, SharkNinja product discounts, and more. We empower your personal and professional growth with high impact Learning Programs featuring bold voices redefining what’s possible. When you join, you’re not just part of a company—you’re part of an outrageously extraordinary community. Together, we won’t just launch products—we’ll disrupt entire markets.

At SharkNinja, Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion are vital to our global success. Valuing each unique voice and blending all of our diverse skills strengthens SharkNinja’s innovation every day. We support ALL associates in bringing their authentic selves to work, making an impact, and having the opportunity for career acceleration. With help from our leadership, associates, and our community, we aim to have equity be a key component of the SharkNinja DNA.

Learn more about us:
Life At SharkNinja
Outrageously Extraordinary

jobs.title: Sr. Full Stack Engineer, Launch Software
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SR. FULL STACK ENGINEER, LAUNCH SOFTWARE

The application software team is the central nervous system of SpaceX – we create mission critical applications that are used throughout SpaceX to accelerate launch vehicle production and flight as well as systems that allow Starlink to grow into a worldwide fast, reliable Internet service. We are looking for engineers who treat fellow teammates with fairness, respect, and support.

Our team is currently creating and evolving systems to enable rapid build and reuse of Starship as well as designing the next generation manufacturing software that will be used in high throughput factories for Starlink. Other applications range from platforms that support concurrent streams of data from many always-on assets to manage the world’s largest satellite constellation to public facing systems where customers can join our Starlink network globally. We work closely with engineers throughout the company to create and update our systems with respect to crewed launches, Starship flights, changes to the Starlink network and much more.

Aerospace experience is not required to be successful here - rather we look for smart, motivated, respectful, collaborative engineers who love solving problems and want to make an impact on a super inspiring mission. You will have full ownership of challenging problems, working with a team of enthusiastic engineers with diverse perspectives to design and produce solutions that enable SpaceX to move towards our goals at a rapid pace. The success of the missions at SpaceX depends on the software that you and your team produce.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Develop highly reliable software solutions that are used across SpaceX

• Create new applications that improve how SpaceX operates

• Build prototypes to prove out key design concepts and quantify technical constraints

• Own all aspects of software engineering and product development

• Deep dive into your users’ problems to find and create efficient solutions

• Bring your voice to the table in team collaborations on architecture, design, and code reviews

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, math, or scientific discipline and 5+ years of professional experience in software development; OR 7+ years of professional experience building software in lieu of a degree

• 3+ years of professional experience in full stack development

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Programming experience in Python, C#.NET, Go, Scala, Java, or similar object-oriented language

• 1+ years of rigorous experience building single page web applications

• Experience with version control, continuous integration, and continuous delivery concepts

• Expertise in designing software systems

• Deep understanding of testing, continuous integration, build, deployment & monitoring

• Expertise in profiling and improving application performance

• Experience with build systems (Make, Bazel/Pants/Buck, Gradle) and package management tools (pip, npm)

• Experience with UNIX-like operating systems and tools like Terraform, Ansible, Puppet for managing them

• Experience working with in-stream data processing using Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, ActiveMQ, or similar technologies

• Production experience with Docker and Kubernetes

• Front-end experience in Angular, React, or similar JavaScript framework

• Database experience with PostgreSQL, SQL Server, or similar database technologies

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• You may be asked to work extended hours/weekends dependent on launch cadence

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:
Sr. Software Engineer: $165,000.00 - $230,000.00/per year

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock, stock options, or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.

jobs.title: Master Scheduler [Contract]
jobs.description:
Spacecraft represent the most pressing unmet need across the entire aerospace industry. As more launch vehicles come online and the cost to orbit decreases, more companies launching payloads to space continue to emerge.

For the first time in history, this influx of payload companies combined with reduced launch costs has resulted in a massive increase in need for commercial spacecraft platforms, known as satellite buses. These buses hold the payloads of our customers and are flown on launch vehicles.

Apex manufactures these satellite buses at scale using a combination of software, vertical integration, and hardware that is designed for manufacturing. Our spacecraft enable the future of society: ranging from earth observation to communications and more.

We’d love for you to join us on our mission of providing humankind access to the galaxy beyond our planet. 




ABOUT THE ROLE

Apex is looking for a Master Scheduler [Temp to Hire] to own the company's overall schedule. This role builds and maintains the integrated master schedule that ties together product design, development, and program execution, and keeps leadership and every department tracking to plan. You will work across engineering, supply chain, production, program management, and leadership to build accurate schedules, surface risks early, and show clearly where the company is on plan and where it is not.

This is a senior, cross-company role. It fits someone who can hold the big picture across many programs while staying close enough to the work to build a credible, bottoms-up schedule.



**This is a temporary contract role that has eligibility to move to full time



Responsibilities

 - Own the integrated master schedule by building and maintaining the company-wide schedule that connects product design, development, and program execution across all programs.

 - Work with engineering to build design and development schedules, including major milestones, dependencies, and gates.

 - Create and manage detailed program execution schedules that drive on-time delivery and good use of resources.

 - Monitor progress across the company and its departments against the master schedule and show clearly where teams are on plan and where they are falling behind.

 - Learn the engineering development and production processes used to build Apex products and break down schedule tasks to reflect that technical scope.

 - Work with engineering, supply chain, production, and program management to keep schedules aligned and realistic.

 - Establish and maintain consistent scheduling processes, cadence, and standards so updates stay timely and schedules stay trustworthy across the company.

 - Identify risks to the schedule, work with teams on mitigation and contingency plans, and flag critical path issues early.

 - Address competing priorities and resource conflicts across programs to keep work moving.

 - Communicate schedule changes to the right stakeholders and make sure adjustments carry through the organization.

 - Provide regular updates to leadership on schedule health, progress, and major issues, including a clear read on whether the company is tracking to plan.



Requirements

 - U.S. Person status, as this role requires access to export-controlled data.

 - Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Manufacturing, or related field, or equivalent experience. 

 - 7+ years in scheduling or program planning, preferably in manufacturing or aerospace.

 - Track record building and owning complex, integrated schedules with many interdependent tasks across multiple programs or teams.

 - Strong understanding of engineering development and production processes.

 - Proficiency in scheduling software such as Microsoft Project and Smartsheet.

 - Experience building critical path and milestone schedules.

 - Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.

 - Strong communication and interpersonal skills, including working directly with leadership.

 - Comfort in a fast-moving environment with shifting priorities.
   
   

Preferred

 - Experience owning a company-level or integrated master schedule (IMS).

 - Experience delivering IMSs on a U.S. Government Contract Data Requirements List (CDRL).

 - Experience in satellite manufacturing or related industries (aerospace, defense, or high-tech).

 - Certification in project management or scheduling (PMP, CPIM, PMI-SP, or Six Sigma).

 - Experience scheduling both product development and production, not just one.



#LI-RC1


WHY JOIN APEX?

Apex believes in creating a work environment that you look forward to embracing every day. Our employees love working at Apex, and we want you to love it too. We're a fast-growing startup that has raised more than $500M in funding, and we invest heavily in our people from day one.




WHAT WE OFFER FOR FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES:

 - Shared upside: Receive equity in Apex, letting you benefit from the work you create

 - Best-in-class healthcare: 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision for you and your dependents, plus $100k life insurance at no cost

 - Comprehensive PTO package:  Starting at 15 days vacation, growing to 20+ days annually, plus 10 paid holidays

jobs.title: Creative Technology Lead
jobs.description:
Creative Technology Lead

In a nutshell:

IDEO Chicago is looking for a Creative Technology Lead who is passionate about using technology to imagine and create products, services, and experiences that people love.

You’ll sit at the intersection of design and technology, using software, AI, hardware, and emerging tools as a creative material for exploration, invention, and making. This is a hands-on role for someone who lets the challenge at hand guide the technology they use: a curious maker who learns quickly, experiments fearlessly, and is as interested in what a technology means as in how it works.

You might prototype an AI-powered product experience one week, build an interactive physical prototype the next, and explore an entirely new tool or medium after that. Through it all, you’ll stay focused on the humans involved — using technology in service of people’s needs rather than as an end in itself.

Once you are here, you will…

• Bring a technologist’s perspective to help clients and interdisciplinary teams navigate the intersection of what is desirable and newly possible. You may be leading a team and project or joining a team as a contributing member.

• Rapidly prototype products, services, and experiences using software, AI, hardware, physical computing, and whatever other tools the problem demands, or that you dream up!

• Explore emerging technologies and translate their capabilities, limitations, and implications into meaningful opportunities for people and organizations

• Inspire teams through making — introducing new tools, unconventional approaches, and experiments that expand how we design and what solutions are possible

• Contribute to the evolution of IDEO’s design practice, exploring how new technologies are changing the relationships between design, prototyping, development, and delivery

• Participate in IDEO’s broader emerging technology community alongside other designers, engineers, data scientists, and more.

We're looking for someone with:

• A strong track record of experimenting, prototyping, and building with a broad range of technologies, including products or experiences where AI plays a meaningful role

• Experience shipping real products and an understanding of what it takes to get technology-enabled ideas to market.

• Fluency in software and digital prototyping, with the ability to move from sketches and prototypes to proofs of concept and functioning experiences

• A demonstrated curiosity to acquire new skills, learn new tools, and explore emerging technologies

• The ability to hold rigor and imagination at the same time: enough technical understanding to recognize real constraints, and enough creative curiosity to explore things that have not been built before

It's a bonus if you:

• Work across both software and hardware, including electronics, sensors, physical computing, fabrication, robotics, or connected products

• Have experience in consulting, innovation, R&D, creative technology, or other environments where the problems and tools change frequently

• Have thoughtful perspectives about how AI is changing software design, based on hands-on experience

• Have a habit of building things simply because you are curious to find out whether they can be built

Some IDEO projects to check out:

• Duck, Duck, Duck

• American Express Pay it Plan it

• Moooi Piro

• Kooth Soluna

• Ethiqly

Why is this role important for IDEO's work?

The technology landscape is changing quickly. AI is a powerful force, but it is far from the only one changing what is possible, easy, and commercially viable. At the same time, the boundaries between design, prototyping, development, and delivery are shifting.

We believe Creative Technologists have an important role to play in that change: staying curious about what is becoming possible, making those possibilities tangible, and helping teams imagine better things to build.

What does IDEO offer you?

IDEO is a place where you can solve diverse, complex challenges for our clients and their organizations, alongside thoughtful, intelligent individuals who lead with curiosity, empathy, and humility. We intentionally craft moments that allow our community to pause, create, and connect. We encourage our community to bring their whole selves to work, respect the need for work-life balance, and allow for autonomy in the design process and your career.

As a Creative Technology Lead in Chicago, we provide the opportunity for you to:

• Work on breakthrough products, services and experiences across industries like health, financial services, and mobility.

• Collaborate with a studio of creative, curious, and deeply thoughtful people who challenge and inspire one another

• Shape end-to-end innovation, from early insight to market activation

• Strengthen and explore your craft within deeply multidisciplinary teams while growing as a human-centered creative leader

Application Instructions:

To apply, please submit your resume, cover letter, and your portfolio. In particular, we would like to see your approach and process of your projects in addition to the final outputs.

Payscale & Benefits

IDEO is committed to paying its employees, contractors & vendors equitably, regardless of gender identity or race/ethnicity/cultural identity.

The salary range for this role is $120,000-140,000 USD. Final offers may vary based on candidate experience, location, and other factors. As a full-time position, this role is eligible for employee benefits.

In addition to base compensation, IDEO offers a rich benefits package including the following:

Hybrid Model: Team members based in Chicago are expected to work in the studio on Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays, with flexibility based on client travel, project needs, and deliverables.

Health Benefits: Vision, Dental, Medical/Healthcare

Financial Benefits: 401K with Employer Contribution

Family & Caregiving: Parental Leave, Adoption Assistance, Fertility Assistance, Transgender Medical Assistance, Breastmilk shipment, Back-up/Dependent Care, Pet Insurance

Other Benefits: Flexible Work, Flexible Time Off, Paid Holidays, Annual Education Stipend, Home Office Stipend, Commuter Reimbursement, and Phone & Internet Reimbursement

What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.

Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.

Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating our wins – big and small.

Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!

We believe in hard work, having fun, and bringing excellence to everything we do. Our product is arguably the most sophisticated in its class, but our product alone does not make heroes of our customers. Our Professional Services team does. A position on our team gives you the opportunity to take the “service” in “software-as-a-service” to a whole new level, and enjoy rapid career growth while you’re at it.

We’re looking for a SOLUTION ARCHITECT focused on our Sales Performance Management platform who delights in the most meticulous and exciting puzzles. Do you enjoy diving into issues and crafting complex solutions? If you have a passion for data, multi-dimensional modeling, and data integration then this is a fantastic opportunity for a high-achiever able to interpret complex business challenges and design solutions for Anaplan customers.

Your Impact:

As a Solution Architect, you are primarily responsible for the successful delivery of Anaplan planning solutions in strategic accounts. You will:

• Translate existing solutions, spreadsheets, and business problems into sophisticated Anaplan multi-dimensional models

• Modify existing models as part of a connected solution, optimization, or to incorporate new functionality

• Serve as the architectural SME for large-scale connected planning solutions

• Exemplify The Anaplan Way

• Provide important feedback and progress updates in a timely manner to the Business Partner and team

• Develop model documentation

• Participate in data integration and migration solutions

• Participate and/or lead UAT testing and deployment

Your Qualifications:

• A 4-year degree in Finance, Accounting, or MIS

• 4+ years’ experience implementing Enterprise Performance Management solutions for use cases: Supply Chain, FP&A, WFP, or Sales Performance solutions.

• Advanced Microsoft Excel / financial modeling skills

• Demonstrated knowledge of a formal system implementation methodology – requirements gathering, design, build/test, and deploy (Agile methodology preferable)

• Superb written and oral communication skills

• Consistent track record to lead and implement responsibilities simultaneously

• Penchant for service excellence and a collaborative style

• Subject matter expertise in planning and modeling in Finance, Work Force Planning or Sales is strongly preferred

• Strong understanding of data integration (inbound and outbound)

• Passion for business analytics, modeling, and planning

• Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills

• Results-oriented, motivated, self-starter

• Coaching mentality

• Collegial, open, and grounded in integrity

• Desire to work with a truly dynamic and exciting team, with a “roll-up your sleeves” approach

• Strong desire to excel and be committed to gaining exposure to multiple industries while further developing your career

Base Salary Range:

$106,000—$152,000 USD

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)

We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer

It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.

Anaplan does not:

• Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.

• Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.

All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

Privacy & AI Notice

Candidate data processed during our recruitment activities is handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Notice. This may include the use of artificial intelligence or automated tools to assist our team in evaluating qualifications.

jobs.title: Sales Engineer
jobs.location: Denver, CO - Hybrid; New York, NY - Hybrid; San Francisco, CA - Hybrid; Scottsdale, AZ - Hybrid
jobs.description:
About Gusto

At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.

All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy.

AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

About the Role

This is a highly customer-facing role at the intersection of engineering, solution architecture, agentic AI, and customer delivery. You will work directly with stakeholders and own the technical discovery for our ongoing opportunities end to end. Once a deal is qualified, you scope, build, embed with the client, and build it yourself, code that holds up against real tax and jurisdiction data, not a prototype you clean up later. What you ship only counts once the client is paying for it, it's live, and it's measurably cutting the manual work they used to do by hand, hours saved, tickets deflected, risk reduced. You should be comfortable speaking with both technical and executive stakeholders, moving quickly from problem discovery to prototype, and turning complex workflows into production-ready agents and multi-agent systems.

Here's what you'll do day-to-day

• Scope & Qualify: Give Sales a technical feasibility read early on ambiguous Enterprise opportunities, then own scoping the compliance challenge once the deal is sales-qualified.

• Define the Problem: Own requirements gathering on complex, ambiguous opportunities, scoping the problem clearly enough for Sales, Product, and Engineering to align on it.

• Prove It First: Build a working proof-of-concept of the proposed agent when a deal needs to see feasibility before committing to the full build, tailored from a hands-on integration engineer to a VP of Payroll Tax.

• Make the Business Case: Translate every deployment into the business case that justifies the subscription: hours saved, risk reduced, compliance simplified.

• Own the Build: Embed with clients and write the code yourself, work that runs their compliance decisions instead of just connecting to them. There's no fixed method yet, you figure out what each engagement needs and build it.

• Clear the Blockers: Diagnose and fix the data issues, jurisdiction mapping, tax ID reconciliation, that stand between a client and production.

• Bridge the Gap: Keep technical teams and business stakeholders aligned as requirements evolve mid-engagement, so scope changes don't blindside either side.

• Own the Handoff: Deliver the build and a runbook Client Success runs solo without the need to loop back the FDE.

• Close the Loop: Feed structured signal from both the sales motion and the build motion back into product and go-to-market strategy, including infrastructure gaps.

• Create Implementation Playbooks: solution patterns, demo flows, and deployment documentation that make future deployments faster.

Here's what we're looking for

• Demonstrated 5+ years of hands-on experience in a customer-facing technical role such as Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Engineer, AI Engineer, Implementation Engineer, Solutions Architect, Technical Consultant, or similar.

• Proven track record of shipping production systems in ambiguous, client-facing environments, with demonstrable evidence of:

• REST APIs, webhooks, event-driven systems, auth patterns, data modeling, idempotency, and failure modes, not just happy-path builds

• Building production systems in highly regulated categories, payroll, tax, or compliance fluency deep enough to run a conversation with a client's compliance team without a translator

• Agentic workflows beyond prototypes: MCP or function-calling patterns, evaluation and reliability practices

• Deep technical discovery skills with the ability to navigate a high degree of ambiguity

• Ability to scope a technical solution from an ambiguous opportunity, build the business case that justifies a subscription, and ship a pattern the next engagement can reuse

• Proven ability to present to and influence a range of audiences, from individual engineers to executive sponsors

• Entrepreneurial, passionate about our mission, and deep empathy for the clients whose compliance work you're automating

• Bonus points for experience with a specific HR/payroll platform's integration surface, enterprise procurement or security review processes, or MEDDPICC-style deal frameworks

Who Thrives Here

Builders who can sit with a customer, understand the real problem, quickly build an agentic solution, and present it clearly enough that the customer immediately sees the value.

You’ll thrive here if you are technical, customer-facing, fast-moving, and independent. You prototype and debug rather than only coordinate. You take responsibility for the customer outcome, communicate proactively, flag risks early, and follow through. You are comfortable being the technical adult in the room, whether you’re speaking with a customer’s architect, operations lead, engineering team, or VP of Payroll.

We’re looking for someone low-ego, collaborative, sharp, and highly accountable - someone who can build trust with customers while also building real technical solutions.

Our total cash compensation amount for this role is targeted at $88,000-140,000 in Scottsdale, $95,000-150,000 in Denver, and $115,000-181,000 in New York & San Francisco Bay Area. Stock equity is additional. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience and expertise and may vary from the amounts listed above.

At Gusto, we don't use titles the traditional way, as a signal of rank or hierarchy. Instead, our titles describe two things at once — your craft (what you do, e.g. Engineering, Design) and your scope of ownership (what you're accountable for) — which is why you'll see something like "Head of X" instead of a rank word like "Director" that tells you neither. Because of this, the title on this posting may look different from what you'd expect based on the scope and seniority of the role, and from how similar roles are typically titled elsewhere. If you have questions about how this role compares to your current title or level, your recruiter can help translate.

Gusto has physical office spaces in Denver, San Francisco, and New York City. Employees who are based in those locations will be expected to work from the office on designated days approximately 2-3 days per week (or more depending on role). The same office expectations apply to all Symmetry roles, Gusto's subsidiary, whose physical office is in Scottsdale.

Note: The San Francisco office expectations encompass both the San Francisco and San Jose metro areas.

When approved to work from a location other than a Gusto office, a secure, reliable, and consistent internet connection is required. This includes non-office days for hybrid employees.

Reliable, consistent presence: We expect regular and predictable attendance, whether you're working in-office, hybrid, or fully remote, so that you stay closely connected to your team, customers, and stakeholders in real time and ensure colleagues and customers receive the timely support and responsiveness they deserve.

Our customers come from all walks of life and so do we. We hire great people from a wide variety of backgrounds, not just because it's the right thing to do, but because it makes our company stronger. If you share our values and our enthusiasm for small businesses, you will find a home at Gusto.

Gusto is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Gusto considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Gusto is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. We want to see our candidates perform to the best of their ability. If you require a medical or religious accommodation at any time throughout your candidate journey, please fill out this form and a member of our team will get in touch with you.

Gusto takes security and protection of your personal information very seriously. Please review our Fraudulent Activity Disclaimer.

Personal information collected and processed as part of your Gusto application will be subject to Gusto's Applicant Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Software Engineer | Infrastructure
jobs.description:
WHAT WE DO 

Gecko Robotics is helping the world’s most important organizations ensure the availability, reliability, and sustainability of critical infrastructure. Gecko's complete and connected solutions combine wall-climbing robots, industry-leading sensors, and an AI-powered data platform to provide customers with a unique window into the current and future health of their physical assets. This enables real-time decision making to increase the efficiency and safety of operations, promote mission readiness, and protect the environment and civilization from the effects of infrastructure failure.




ROLE AT A GLANCE

The Software Platform team’s purpose is to empower software engineers, reduce unnecessary blockers, and increase our velocity to create exceptional products. They do this by making software effortless to build, deploy, and manage. Using automation, shared libraries, and DevOps tools, they solve the common software problems so other engineers can focus on Gecko’s unique challenges.

This role will specifically focus on leveling up our cloud architecture and automation, empowering engineers to manage and own their own deployments without needing extensive cloud expertise. We are looking for someone to become the primary owner of Gecko’s Cloud, supported by the rest of the team.







WHAT YOU WILL DO

Primary owner of Gecko’s Cloud, discovering and designing solutions for a well-architected cloud

 - Operational excellence (i.e. observability)

 - Security, privacy, and compliance

 - Reliability

 - Cost optimization

 - Performance optimization

 - Contribute significantly to the Software Platform team’s other work

 - Smooth, intuitive, automated CI/CD

 - Customer authentication

 - Permission management

 - DevOps Tool management and optimization

 - Optimizing the local development experience

 - Effective onboarding and internal training

 - Enable new business for Gecko by architecting solutions to achieve necessary certifications (e.g. DoD IL4/5)




TECHNOLOGIES WE USE

We use a variety of technologies, but we primarily operate using Python, React, and Typescript with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) as our primary cloud provider. Our cloud architecture is primarily serverless, stateless, and event-driven. This is a non-exhaustive list and we are tech agnostic in our interview process, so we encourage you to apply regardless of your background.




ABOUT YOU


REQUIRED SKILLS

 - Previous experience in a DevOps role

 - Strong automation/scripting skills

 - Previous experience with one or more cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, Azure, etc.)

 - Previous experience with Terraform

 - Previous experience with cloud automation, CI/CD, and Docker

 - Proficiency with Linux and command line tools

 - Experience in developing and maintaining technical documentation and procedures

 - Strong communication skills, both verbal and written

 - Ability to work both independently and with cross-functional teams







PREFERRED SKILLS

 - Python

 - Experience working with the US Government (DoD specifically)

 - GCP specific experience




WHO WE ARE

At Gecko, our people are our greatest investment. In addition to competitive compensation packages, we offer company equity, 401(k) matching, gender-neutral parental leave, full medical, dental, and vision insurance, mental health, ongoing professional development, family planning assistance, and flexible paid time off.

Our expertise lies in simplifying the complex and establishing long-standing relationships with our partners. We have a national presence but a local approach—every customer benefits from our capabilities and our care.

jobs.description:
Lead Risk Advisor

Location: New York, NY, or Philadelphia, PA

About WithCoverage:

WithCoverage replaces the traditional insurance brokerage with AI-supercharged risk management designed for the modern economy.

We partner with hundreds of high-growth, category-defining companies, including GoPuff, Eight Sleep, Bombas, Chomps, and Blank Street Coffee. Our clients span iconic consumer brands, hospitality leaders, GCs, advanced manufacturers, and next-generation defense contractors. They operate in complex risk environments and need a partner that can move at their speed.

Instead of a fragmented, manual brokerage stack, we have built a new category: elite risk advisors operating on top of proprietary technology. Our in-house Agency Management System gives our team and AI agents full visibility into policies, exposures, claims, billing, and commissions. This platform enables deep automation, better decisions, and a fundamentally higher standard of service.

WithCoverage was founded by JD Ross (co-founder of Opendoor) and Max Brenner (Bain, Compound). We have raised over $43M from leading investors including Sequoia, 8VC, Khosla Ventures and Crystal Venture Partners.

Our ambition is not to build a better brokerage. It is to redefine how risk is managed across the economy.

Why Join Us:

• Grow Faster – We’re scaling quickly, giving you significant opportunities to learn, lead, and shape your career and the company's future.

• Work That Matters – We protect the world’s most innovative brands: consumer icons, hospitality leaders, next-gen defense contractors, and US manufacturers.

• Redefine an Industry – Insurance is one of the largest, slowest-moving markets. We rewrite the playbook with proprietary technology, automation, and AI.

• Financial Rewards – We hire the best and invest in you. That means competitive comp, meaningful equity, and excellent benefits. We believe strongly in internal promotion and lay out a plan for everyone's career growth.

About The Role:

We’re looking for a Lead Risk Advisor to own client relationships end-to-end and help scale a risk vertical. You’ll work directly with business leaders to assess exposures, lead Risk Analyses, and deliver tailored solutions that drive measurable impact.

What You’ll Do:

• Own and manage a portfolio of client accounts end-to-end, driving strong relationships and delivering exceptional service.

• Lead client-facing Risk Analyses with senior executives, diagnosing coverage gaps and presenting tailored insurance solutions.

• Build and refine playbooks for your vertical to create repeatable, scalable best practices for future advisors.

• Collaborate closely with the Growth, Product, and Ops teams to ensure seamless execution and a differentiated client experience.

• Translate client needs into actionable insights for underwriting, operations, and product improvements.

• Track and report key client metrics to identify opportunities for expansion, efficiency, and impact.

• Contribute to the culture of excellence, curiosity, and accountability that defines our team.

Who You Are:

• 4–7 years into your career, ideally with experience in commercial insurance, risk management, or client advisory roles.

• Confident leading high-stakes client conversations and comfortable presenting analyses or proposals.

• Deeply curious about how businesses operate and motivated to become a trusted advisor to their leaders.

• Strong communicator who thrives in fast-moving, collaborative environments.

• Highly detail-oriented and accountable — you own outcomes, not just tasks.

• Coachable and eager to learn; open to feedback and committed to growth.

• Drawn to environments where performance is rewarded with real upside and autonomy.

• Hardworking, kind, and humble — the type of teammate others want to work with.

For candidates based in the United States, the expected OTE pay range for this position at the start of employment is $140,000 – $190,000/year. Actual compensation will vary based on individual factors, including market location, relevant experience, and role scope. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for variable compensation tied to performance or quota attainment, where applicable. WithCoverage’s Total Rewards package for full-time employees also includes equity participation and comprehensive benefits.

What We Offer:

• Comprehensive benefit plans for medical, dental, vision, life, and disability

• Pre-tax accounts (FSA, HSAs, dependent care FSAs, commuter savings)

• Human Interest: 401(k) provider

jobs.title: Group Business Director
jobs.description:
Who We Are

We are an award-winning independent creative solutions company that aspires to be the most culturally-influential company in the world. We help ambitious brands harness the power of culture to solve their biggest challenges. As a unique mix of experts in culture, technology, and storytelling, we are united by a passion to grow brands in ways that advertising alone can never do.

We are an entrepreneurial business, not a traditional “ad agency.” That means we value resourcefulness and tenacity just as much as we value creativity and intelligence. We’re unapologetically ambitious!

We are looking for a Group Business Director to help lead our growing Eli Lilly partnership, shaping culturally relevant creative work for brands that impact people’s health.

Position Summary

As a Group Business Director, you will own the health, growth, and performance of a portfolio of Eli Lilly brands and workstreams. You will serve as a senior strategic partner to VP- and SVP-level marketing stakeholders, connecting brand priorities, patient needs, and cultural opportunities into a clear vision for the business.

You will make portfolio-level decisions with minimal executive oversight, lead and develop Business Directors and Business Supervisors, and co-own financial performance with Program Management. You will balance creative ambition with the rigor of a regulated category, bringing clear judgment to complex decisions and engaging executive leadership when significant risks or investments require alignment.

What You Will Do

Lead Portfolio Strategy and Growth

• Partner with the Executive Director to drive portfolio performance and strengthen client relationships, setting priorities across assigned brands and workstreams and proactively addressing risks to the partnership.

• Develop and drive growth plans that connect unmet client needs with Translation’s capabilities, expanding relationships and agency impact.

• Build a deep understanding of Lilly’s business, patient audiences, and competitive dynamics; identify opportunities across brands and connect them into a broader business vision.

Build Senior Client Partnerships

• Build trusted relationships with senior marketing leaders, shaping client agendas and influencing decisions through clear, proactive counsel.

• Navigate complex stakeholder needs, constructively challenge assumptions, and lead sensitive conversations about priorities, investment, and the work.

• Maintain a consistent pulse on client satisfaction, risks, and opportunities, aligning Lilly’s brand teams, internal creative team, and agency partners.

Champion Strategic and Creative Excellence

• Ensure work solves meaningful business problems and meets Translation’s standards for strategic rigor, creative and cultural excellence, and client readiness.

• Guide Strategy, Context, Creative, and Analytics toward ambitious ideas grounded in audience insight, business objectives, and clear measures of success.

• Champion empathetic, accessible health communications that reflect real patient experiences, with alignment to client-provided medical, legal, and regulatory guidance.

Own Commercial Performance

• Co-own portfolio financial performance with Program Management, including resource allocation, profitability, forecasting, and long-term growth.

• Lead senior client conversations on scopes, fees, changing needs, and investment; ensure commercial implications are addressed before commitments are made.

• Coach Business Directors on commercial judgment and make investment recommendations across the portfolio, balancing immediate needs with long-term opportunity.

Develop Teams and Align Delivery

• Lead, mentor, and develop Business Directors and Business Supervisors through regular coaching, semi-annual performance reviews, and meaningful development opportunities.

• Establish clear roles, accountability, and development pathways, building teams that exercise sound judgment and collaborate effectively.

• Partner with Program Management, which leads operational planning and delivery, to align staffing, scope, schedules, and review requirements with business goals.

• Ensure seamless integration across Strategy, Context, Creative, and Production; confirm feasibility before major commitments and resolve competing portfolio priorities.

Strengthen the Agency

• Partner with department leaders to shape Business Leadership standards, improve ways of working, and strengthen agency capabilities.

• Support new business pitches and represent Translation through relevant partnerships and industry participation.

• Help recruit and develop a strong pipeline of future Business Leadership talent.

Knowledge Skills and Abilities

• Strong business judgment and strategic fluency, with the ability to turn complex client needs into clear priorities across multiple brands.

• Executive presence and exceptional communication skills, with the confidence to influence senior stakeholders and navigate difficult conversations.

• Commercial acumen across scopes, staffing, profitability, and forecasting, paired with a collaborative approach to Program Management.

• Ability to champion integrated creative work while respecting accuracy and medical, legal, and regulatory review requirements.

• A decisive, curious leadership style that develops other leaders and builds a culture of accountability and collaboration.

Minimum Qualifications

• 12+ years of experience in an agency or communications-related industry, with a well-rounded understanding of marketing, media, creative, production, and agency finance.

• Proven success leading a portfolio of businesses or a complex multi-brand client relationship, with responsibility for financial performance and organic growth. Experience at a scale comparable to $6M–$10M+ in annual agency revenue.

• Demonstrated ability to advise VP- and SVP-level marketing clients and make consequential business decisions with limited executive oversight.

• Experience managing and developing senior account or Business Leadership talent and leading integrated, multi-channel campaigns and large-scale production.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with pharmaceutical, healthcare, or other regulated brands and medical, legal, and regulatory review. Direct pharma experience is a plus, not a requirement; curiosity about the category and an eagerness to learn are valued.

• Experience with consumer health communications, patient storytelling, brand launches, or culturally relevant campaigns, including talent partnerships, social content, or experiential work.

• Experience partnering with in-house creative teams and working within a multi-agency environment.

• Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, or a related field.

About UnitedMasters, Inc.

UnitedMasters Inc. represents the creative solutions company, Translation, and the leading software and services platform for independent creators, UnitedMasters. UnitedMasters enables ownership, exposure, and new paths for financial return for independent creators, while Translation helps brands leverage the power of contemporary culture to achieve transformational growth. Combined, UnitedMasters, Inc. is the world’s leading marketplace for cultural capital, connecting independent artists and brands to realize a future in which all creators own their future. Backed by Alphabet, Andreessen Horowitz, and Apple, UnitedMasters, Inc. is reimagining how brands and artists come together to tell their stories, build profitable growth, and push culture forward.

Salary Hiring Range: $175,000 - $210,000

Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of many compensation, benefits and other reward opportunities we provide (e.g. bonus, stock options, 401(k) match, etc.)

Individual pay rate decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company.  We expect the majority of the candidates who are offered roles at our company to fall healthily throughout the range based on these factors.

The range above is for the expectations as laid out in the job description, however we are often open to a wide variety of profiles, and recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this job description as posted.  If that ends up being the case, the updated salary range will be communicated with you as a candidate.

The salary range above is for the NY/CA.  As a company, we have a location based strategy, which means the salary range could be lower or higher than this if the role is hired in another location.

#Translation

jobs.title: Account Executive - Enterprise - Telecommunications
jobs.description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for an experienced, motivated Enterprise Account Executive to drive ElevenLabs’ growth across the telecommunications industry - including wireless carriers, broadband providers, cable companies, and other communications service providers.

Telecommunications companies support millions of customer interactions every day across service, sales, billing, technical support, retention, and field operations. Voice is already central to how these businesses engage with customers, creating a significant opportunity for conversational AI to improve customer experience, increase efficiency, and unlock new revenue.

Our ideal candidate is passionate about the transformative potential of AI voice technology and eager to act as a strategic partner, helping leading telecommunications companies reimagine how they serve, support, and communicate with their customers.




IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

 - Build and manage a growing portfolio of enterprise telecommunications accounts to help ElevenLabs achieve its revenue goals

 - Identify opportunities where conversational AI can drive growth, automation, or cost efficiency across customer-facing and internal workflows - including customer care, technical support, sales, retention, billing, collections, field service, employee enablement, and multilingual communications

 - Develop and maintain a deep understanding of the telecommunications and conversational AI landscapes, including customer priorities, competitive solutions, emerging technologies, and evolving customer expectations

 - Demonstrate expertise around how ElevenLabs’ voice technology can create value across contact centers, virtual agents, in-app assistants, outbound communications, branded voice experiences, and creative content

 - Develop and execute account strategies across the full buying group - including Customer Experience, Care and Operations, Digital and Product, IT and Engineering, Marketing, and Procurement - landing with one high-impact use case and expanding across business units, customer journeys, and markets

 - Navigate complex telecommunications environments and identify opportunities to integrate ElevenLabs with existing contact center, CCaaS, CRM, and operational technology ecosystems

 - Partner closely with Forward Deployed Engineers to design high-impact solutions, manage successful Proofs of Value with customers, and establish a path to scaled production deployment

 - Serve as a trusted advisor by educating customers on generative AI and voice while helping shape ElevenLabs’ telecommunications playbook, including our ICP, messaging, use cases, and customer references
   
   


REQUIREMENTS

 - 7+ years of quota-carrying enterprise sales experience in SaaS or technology, ideally with exposure to AI, generative AI, LLM-based products, or API-driven platforms

 - Experience selling to telecommunications companies - including wireless carriers, broadband providers, cable companies, or other communications service providers

 - An established network and strong relationships across the telecommunications industry

 - Proven success closing seven figure deals and managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles

 - Experience selling to both technical buyers - such as Product, Engineering, IT, and Architecture, and business buyers across Customer Experience, Care, Operations, Digital, and Marketing

 - Ability to understand a customer’s business, operational environment, and requirements for success, then translate ElevenLabs’ capabilities into solutions that deliver measurable value

 - Proficiency navigating enterprise procurement, security, legal, and technical validation processes, with the ability to operate autonomously and partner effectively across functions

 - Strong executive presence, the ability to build relationships at the C-suite and senior leadership level, and a willingness to travel frequently for onsite customer meetings and industry events

 - Comfort operating in an early-stage, high-growth environment where ambiguity is the norm and priorities evolve quickly

 - Passion for voice and audio AI and its potential to transform customer experience across the telecommunications industry




LOCATION

This role is remote-first and can be based anywhere in the United States; however, the ability to operate across EST, CST, or PST time zones is required. We have a preference for candidates based in New York or San Francisco, with the option to work from one of our offices.

#LI-remote
