jobs.title: Team Lead, Client Success
jobs.description:
EnergyHub empowers utilities and their customers to create a clean, distributed energy future. Our customers are real utilities managing the real electrical grid supporting the normal lives of millions of real people. Our mission is to keep the grid running reliably while enabling more renewable energy and reducing reliance on fossil fuel.

Team Lead - Client Success

EnergyHub’s Client Success team launches and operates best-in-class programs for utilities, helping them address grid challenges by engaging customers with connected devices. As a Team Lead - Client Success, helping our clients and your team achieve their goals is your mandate. You will own the client relationship end-to-end, including supporting the launch of our programs, building and maintaining strong client relationships, and serving as a trusted partner to your clients and our sales, product, engineering and marketing teams to maintain account health.

This is a highly visible, client facing role, ideal for someone who has a passion for working with clients and software products, enjoys solving complex challenges, and is curious about the energy distribution systems that power our daily lives. The successful candidate is a quick learner and self-starter, has the ability to communicate a variety of data driven messages to varying audiences, can build relationships effortlessly, is client-focused, and consistently achieves results. This position requires a player-coach leadership style with direct contributions balanced by tactical leadership of a team.

What you’ll do

• Own success for your region. Take responsibility for the Northeast regions’ P&L by driving revenue, managing ARR to meet or exceed company targets, developing and implementing strategies to grow accounts for long-term value and client satisfaction, and serving as the first escalation point for client issues to ensure timely and effective resolution.

• Drive results and strategy. Collaborate with internal stakeholders to develop and execute strategic initiatives that drive growth and efficiency within the Northeast, lead cross-functional projects and initiatives to ensure alignment with overall company goals and objectives, manage and develop team members while fostering a culture of continuous improvement, learning, and knowledge sharing, and promote excellent people management and leadership through weekly one-to-one meetings, holistic performance management, and creating an environment where high performers can thrive and grow in their careers.

• Model leadership in the business. Oversee a team of Client Success Managers, helping the team manage launches and multi-faceted programs with device partners, clients, and internal teams. Ensure program operations are seamless and client goals and success metrics are top of mind for the organization. Work with Sales to design new program structures to meet client requirements and identify new (and improve existing) tools, processes and best practices. Track and drive renewals and upsell efforts. Develop and report on key metrics of utility programs with internal teams. Foster a collaborative, proactive, problem-solving, high-performance culture within the Client Success team.

• Be a trusted advisor who ensures we meet your clients and your team’s goals. Help the team manage internal expectations as well as those of our clients. Spend time to understand client objectives and help the team guide clients through key decisions to design programs that support these targets. Help set the direction for new programs, including shaping program designs for new BYOD programs and informing required resources for delivery of contracts. Be an escalation point when difficult situations arise and help the team resolve operational challenges. Support Product and Marketing in capturing the voice of the customer and market feedback. Develop and execute strategies to meet or exceed financial targets by managing the ARR for your region.

• Be an effective communicator. Work with your team to present key results, facilitate meetings, and deliver nuanced messages to clients. Maintain consistent communication with an array of stakeholders to ensure efficient program implementation across the portfolio, review ongoing needs, and provide timely solutions and recommendations to help achieve program success. Foster effective decision-making and operational excellence by building relationships and helping internal teams understand priorities and business context.

• Be a product and service expert. Develop a comprehensive knowledge of demand management, the drivers of program success, and a deep understanding of the product to effectively communicate capabilities to clients and shape program design. Actively contribute to the refinement and development of new product features and service offerings. Support contract negotiations between EnergyHub and utility clients, SOW negotiations with partners and development for end-use customers.

• Other duties as assigned.

The ideal candidate will have:

• Experience working in or with renewable energy, utilities, grid services or adjacent industries ( cleantech / greentech) required

• Excellent communication skills and the ability to describe complex and technical topics in an engaging and succinct manner

• Demonstrated success working directly with a portfolio clients and programs

• Project management experience with the ability to multitask, hit deadlines, and think through risk and dependencies

• An analytical, yet creative and curious mind, with a confident approach to numbers and spreadsheets

• The ability to build trust and outstanding client and partner relationships

• Good judgment in a business context

• Experience working with a team in a cross-functional environment

• Experience managing multiple high-priority projects and the ability to make multi-tasking look effortless

• A BS or BA degree

• At least 7-10 years of professional experience in technology services or customer success with a strong preference for experience within a SaaS or enterprise software-related field

• Willingness to travel (~25%)

Nice to have:

• Familiarity with EVs, batteries, connected devices, IOT, or building automation

• Familiarity with VIrtual Power Plan (VPP) programs and initiatives

• Certifications in energy management, project management, program management

Please note that sponsorship of new applicants for employment authorization, or any other immigration-related support, is not available for this position at this time.

Why work for EnergyHub?

• Collaborate with outstanding people: Our employees work hard, do great work, and enjoy collaborating and learning from each other.

• Make an immediate impact: New employees can expect to be given real responsibility for bringing new technologies to the marketplace. You are empowered to perform as soon as you join the team!

• Gain well rounded experience: EnergyHub offers a diverse and dynamic environment where you will get the chance to work directly with executives and develop expertise across multiple areas of the business.

• Work with the latest technologies: You'll gain exposure to a broad spectrum of IoT, SaaS and machine learning obstacles, including distributed fault-tolerance, device control optimization, and process modeling to support scalable interaction with disparate downstream APIs.

• Be part of something important: Help create the future of how energy is produced and consumed. Make a positive impact on our climate.

About EnergyHub

EnergyHub empowers utilities and their customers to create a clean, distributed energy future. We help consumers turn their smart thermostats, EVs, batteries, and other products into virtual power plants that keep the grid stable and enable higher penetration of solar and wind power.

To learn more, visit energyhub.com.

Company Benefits

EnergyHub offers a generous benefits package including 100% paid medical for employees and a 401(k) with employer match. We offer a casual environment, the flexibility to set your own schedule, a fully stocked fridge and pantry, free Citi Bike membership, secure bike rack, gym subsidy, paid parental leave, and an education assistance program.

jobs.title: IQC Inspector 1
jobs.description:
Primary Function of Position:

The IQC Inspector I is an entry-level quality role primarily responsible for incoming documentation review, material certification verification, ERP transaction processing, and release of incoming material for manufacturing use. This position ensures that incoming material packages meet quality system requirements and maintain accurate records to support traceability and compliance. The position may perform basic visual inspections and limited dimensional verification while developing inspection knowledge and skills.

Essential Job Duties

• Review Certificates of Conformance, test reports, inspection reports, and supplier documentation to verify compliance with purchase order, drawing, and specification requirements.
• Verify completeness and accuracy of incoming material documentation packages.
• Perform material release transactions within SAP or applicable ERP systems.
• Create and maintain inspection history records and electronic quality documentation.
• Ensure traceability information is complete and accurate.
• Process nonconforming material documentation and create quality notifications when required.
• Communicate documentation discrepancies to Quality Engineers, Supplier Quality Engineers, and supervisors.
• Support inventory accuracy and material disposition processes.
• Perform visual inspection of incoming materials and assemblies.
• Conduct basic dimensional verification using standard measuring tools when required.
• Learn blueprint reading and GD&T fundamentals.
• Support quality projects and continuous improvement activitie

Required Skills and Experience

• Strong attention to detail and ability to identify documentation discrepancies.
• Ability to review technical documents, certifications, and manufacturing records.
• Strong computer proficiency including Microsoft Office applications.
• Ability to learn SAP, ERP, and electronic quality systems.
• Effective written and verbal communication skills.
• Strong organizational and prioritization abilities in a high-volume environment.

Required Education and Training

• High school diploma, A.S. Engineering Degree would be a bonus.
• Related experience or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Working Conditions

• Must be able to remain in a stationary sitting/standing position for extended periods while performing documentation review, material verification, and inspection activities.
• Requires frequent walking between IQC workstations, receiving areas, warehouse locations, and material storage areas.
• Must be able to occasionally lift and move materials weighing up to 45 pounds.

jobs.description:

Headquartered in Needham, Massachusetts with more than 4,100 associates, the company’s products are sold at key retailers, online and offline, and through distributors around the world.

AI at SharkNinja

At SharkNinja, we’re building an AI-native culture. We’re not waiting for the future; we’re creating it. Our people are expected to experiment boldly, adopt new tools, and continuously raise what’s possible to create meaningful impact for our consumers. If you believe the best way to do your job hasn’t been invented yet, you’ll fit right in.

Location: Needham, Massachusetts, USA

Work Period: January through June

Location & Schedule: This is a full-time, 40-hour-per-week position with 5 DAYS per week onsite in Needham, MA.  There is no relocation or housing assistance for this position.

Compensation Range: Ranges from $28/hr - $34/hr. Specific compensation is set according to a standardized scale aligned with your educational level at the time of hire.

Join the SharkNinja Early Edge Experience: Built for early talent. Geared toward impact. Driven by speed. Whether you're in a co-op or internship, our early talent program is designed to provide valuable exposure to the industry and a fast-paced professional environment. Along the way, you’ll benefit from professional development opportunities, community events, and connections that make your experience well-rounded and enriching. This role: Design & Engineering Co-op

Are you passionate about designing the future of consumer tech? Do you thrive at the intersection of imagination and engineering? Are you excited by the challenge of building real prototypes that push boundaries and bring innovation to life? If so, we invite you to explore the Design & Engineering Co-op at SharkNinja.

As a key member of our Advanced Development team, you’ll play a hands-on role in designing and testing early-stage prototypes for the next generation of Shark and Ninja products. You’ll collaborate with engineers, designers, and cross-functional partners to bring forward-thinking concepts into functional reality. From building circuits to experimenting with form factors, your contributions will directly shape what’s next in performance-driven innovation. If you’re technically curious, solution-oriented, and ready to create products that truly make a positive impact in people’s everyday lives, we want to hear from you!

Here are some of the EXCITING things you’ll get to do:

ATTRIBUTES & SKILLS:

• Exposure to one or more of the following: motor control, sensor integration, embedded microcontrollers (e.g., Arduino), battery management, signal amplification, and switching power supplies

• Familiarity with general prototyping tools and processes; experience building quick-turn physical models is a bonus

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

• Comfortable supporting software/firmware testing and development—experience is a plus

• Strong understanding of core physical and electrical engineering principles

• Ability to communicate technical ideas clearly and translate abstract concepts into tangible outcomes

• Naturally curious, creatively driven, and excited to apply both innovation and technical depth to real-world challenges

Our Culture

At SharkNinja, we don’t just raise the bar—we push past it every single day.  Our Outrageously Extraordinary mindset drives us to tackle the impossible, push boundaries, and deliver results that others only dream of. If you thrive on breaking out of your swim lane, you’ll be right at home.

jobs.title: Mission Operations Engineer, USMC (Active Clearance)
jobs.location: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Connected Warfare division builds systems to support global command and control missions. We create joint, time sensitive, multi domain, ubiquitous, connected mesh ecosystems. Our ecosystem enables connected warfare with disproportional impact by connecting every robot, human, and sensor in every domain, bringing together hundreds of thousands of end points across the globe. We are the substrate that provides the source of truth for time sensitive decisions, effectively transforming the way that militaries close kills chains and enable mission autonomy.

The Mission Operations (MOPs) team is responsible for managing the execution, growth, and success of our customer accounts. Working across product, engineering, sales, and logistics teams, our Mission Operations Engineers own the customer relationships and develop, plan, and deploy Anduril products in support of their missions. They work side-by-side with customers to understand their specific problem sets and then shape Anduril’s offerings alongside our engineering teams to fit the mission needs. Because the problems we solve are uniquely challenging, our Mission Operations Engineers naturally gravitate toward finding solutions and are adept at navigating organizational hurdles. They are ultimately responsible for customer and mission success and therefore play a critical role in the shaping and future of Anduril Industries.

ABOUT THE JOB

Orchestrate the deployment of Anduril products. Lead the planning and deployment of Anduril’s flagship hardware and software products in support of customer missions. Through collaboration with our engineering, logistics, and technical operations teams, Mission Operators are in charge of deploying our products to the field, training end users, and ensuring the high performance of our products. We are obsessed about engagement and keeping our finger on the pulse of how customers interact with our products. This helps us improve the user experience and evolve their operational tactics and techniques. And if something isn’t quite right, we work with product teams to quickly address the issue on behalf of our customer.

Grow your business through customer success. In addition to the operational and executive relationships you own, you will be responsible for meeting commercial targets that drive top line growth. This requires establishing committed and trust-based partnerships with our customers to not only help them solve their immediate problems, but also to foresee future opportunities where Anduril’s technology can make them more effective. Understanding Anduril’s value proposition and articulating how we can have an impact on a customer’s problem set, from the executive level to the end user, is critical to positioning Anduril for the future.

Shape our products to meet mission needs. Work side-by-side with our customers to understand their specific mission challenges and represent the customer as you work with Anduril engineers to shape products that solve critical national and international security challenges. Anduril engineers rely on Mission Operators to understand the lay of the land and bring a perspective that informs the product development process.

Collaborate across nearly every Anduril team. Successfully deploying our complex hardware and software products requires collaborating with nearly every internal Anduril team - business development, engineering, product, logistics, finance, legal, contracting, technical operations, and many more. You’ll be responsible for ensuring each party is engaged and informed, and will therefore become well-versed in what it takes to really bring the best of Anduril to our customers.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Mission First Mindset. We put the needs of the mission and our customers first and understand that the US and its allies have no preordained right to victory in any future conflict. We actively seek out opportunities to better understand our customers’ mission needs, with a goal to build the best possible products for the warfighter and radically evolve our national and international defense capabilities. We push ourselves and the limits of our capabilities in the pursuit of this goal.

Ownership Mentality. We’re looking for owners; those who have a natural bias to assume responsibility, a healthy dose of skepticism, and contribute to a culture of performance. We empower our Mission Operators to quickly assume high levels of responsibility and entrust them to actively own their account and shape its success. Our Mission Operators are just as comfortable helping to shape a proposal or pitch a new customer as they are working with engineers on new features or deploying products in the field.

Technical Aptitude and Intellectual Curiosity. We are first and foremost a technology company, working at the leading edge of capabilities like machine learning, autonomy, distributed networking, and multi-modal sensor fusion. Do you have a natural desire to see beyond simple cause and effect relationships to really understand how complex systems operate? Do you actively seek out opportunities to educate yourself? These capabilities form the foundation of our product offerings, so we are looking for those who are comfortable communicating technical concepts and can articulate them in the context of the customer’s mission.

Structured Thinker and Problem Solver. Leading technical programs requires clear communication and well thought-out plans. We are looking for assertive communicators who bring a thoughtful perspective and honest dialogue. A solution-driven approach, the ability to distill complexity into its essential, digestible components, and the ability to supervise execution are critical to ensure mission success.

High Value Team Member. Do you enjoy working as part of a team? At Anduril, the path to success weaves through the organization - account teams, engineering, logistics, technical operations, and more. It requires humility, an eagerness to learn, and empathy toward your fellow team member. We assume best intentions and empathize with customers just as we do with our colleagues. Can you develop rapport at both the user and executive levels? Do you enjoy sharing successes? We are a low ego group that promotes teamwork and collaboration to bring about success.

360 Degree Leader. We are a flat, non-hierarchical organization with a matrix structure that is dynamic and evolving. We expect you to be self-aware enough to recognize your position of unstated leadership within the company. You should have a demonstrated ability to lead and influence people through both formal and informal constructs and in situations where there is lack of clarity across teams. Finally, we need people who identify gaps and breakdowns and solve them immediately, rather than point them out and step back. You should also seek 360 feedback to help inform your growth trajectory as a leader.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

• Serve in a customer-facing Account Manager capacity, working directly with the United States Marine Corps to develop and deploy Anduril integrated hardware-software C2 products to meet customer and operational needs

• Own the delivery of contract deliverables to include the developing, and implementing, measures of performance and effectiveness, writing technical reports and creating user engagement roadmaps

• Design & implement user feedback loops to gather, triage, and prioritize requirements, feedback, issues, and challenges found through the employment of Anduril C2 products during training, exercises, and normal use within unit schedules

• Provide input to program and engineering teams to drive the development of product features and configurations that enhance or greatly improve efficiency of user workflows and employment of Anduril C2 products

• Support engagement with other service components, Geographic Combatant Commands, and other Government organizations as required to integrate Anduril products laterally across United States Armed Forces customers for increased adoption

• Develop and contribute to a streamlined user feedback and engagement system, which include issue tracking, training sessions, refreshers, and focused preparation for large scale exercises and events

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

• Experience in program management and product deployment roles

• Exceptional interpersonal and stakeholder management skills

• Understanding of U.S. and allied military operations, doctrines, and multi-domain environments

• Experience translating and decomposing highly technical concepts into operational requirements and performance specifications

• Strong aptitude for problem solving in unstructured situations at the interface of hardware, software, and networking. Ability to drive challenging and vague technical problems to clarity and resolution

• Willing to travel as necessary (25-50%)

• Secret Clearance or above required

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

• Experience in Defense Technology Product/Program Management, Solutions Architect, or Customer Success type roles

• Experience and familiarity with USMC intelligence, operational planning, targeting, and fires systems and workflows

• Familiarity with doctrinal, functional, and technical command and control concepts, processes, and principles

US Salary Range

$132,000—$209,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Lead Quality Engineer
jobs.description:
The Lead Quality Engineer serves as the primary technical leader for the Quality Engineering team, providing coaching, guidance, and quality oversight across product development, manufacturing, supplier quality, and corrective action processes. The role leads company-wide problem-solving initiatives, drives continuous improvement, supports new product introductions, and helps ensure consistent application of quality standards and best practices throughout the organization.

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Provide technical leadership, guidance, and mentorship to Quality Engineers across electronic, mechanical, supplier, and calibration quality disciplines.

• Support onboarding, training, and development of Quality Engineering personnel.

• Assist with prioritization and coordination of Quality Engineering activities to support business objectives.

• Lead company-wide problem-solving initiatives using structured quality methodologies and root cause analysis tools.

• Lead and facilitate the Corrective Action Request (CAR) process, ensuring timely and effective resolution of quality issues.

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on product quality, process performance, and customer satisfaction.

• Monitor product quality performance and support quality improvement efforts throughout the product lifecycle.

• Partner with Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, and Supply Chain teams to resolve quality-related challenges and implement sustainable solutions.

• Support manufacturing operations through investigation and resolution of product and process quality issues.

• Monitor, analyze, and communicate quality metrics, trends, and key performance indicators (KPIs).

• Support supplier quality activities, including issue resolution, corrective actions, and supplier performance improvement initiatives.

• Provide oversight and support for incoming, in-process, and final inspection activities.

• Support New Product Introduction (NPI) and project onboarding activities to ensure quality requirements are effectively implemented.

• Participate in risk assessments, PFMEAs, control plan reviews, validation activities, and product launch readiness efforts.

• Ensure compliance with applicable quality management system requirements, customer specifications, and regulatory standards.

• Perform other related duties and special projects as assigned.

REQUIREMENTS

• Bachelor's Degree from a 4 year College or University

• AND 5 years of related experience in Quality Engineering within a manufacturing environment.

• OR equivalent combination of education and experience.

• 2-3 years experience working within ISO9001 Quality Management System or equivalent.

• Experience collaborating with global teams or working within an international manufacturing environment preferred.

• Strong technical leadership skills with the ability to guide, coach, and mentor Quality Engineers across multiple quality disciplines.

• Demonstrated expertise in Root Cause and Corrective Action (RCCA) methodologies, including 8D, 5-Why, and Fishbone.

• Ability to lead cross-functional problem-solving activities and drive effective resolution of complex quality issues.

• Strong analytical and data interpretation skills with the ability to identify trends, measure performance, and recommend improvements.

• Ability to read, interpret, and apply engineering drawings, specifications, standards, and technical documentation.

• Excellent verbal, written, and presentation communication skills with the ability to effectively influence cross-functional teams.

• Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to prioritize multiple initiatives and drive actions to closure.

• Experience supporting manufacturing operations, supplier quality activities, and new product introduction processes.

jobs.description:
The QA Compliance Lead is responsible for providing technical leadership and oversight for Quality Management System (QMS) compliance activities, ensuring alignment with ISO 9001, ISO 14001, IEC 80079 requirements, corporate standards, and applicable regulatory obligations. This position supports the effectiveness of document control, auditing, certifications, approvals, competence management, and risk governance processes by partnering with designated compliance resources and cross-functional teams. Monitor quality system performance, promote continuous improvement, and help ensure the organization maintains audit readiness and compliance with customer, regulatory, and corporate requirements.

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Provide technical leadership and guidance for Quality Management System (QMS) compliance activities.

• Maintain oversight of VEGA Americas' ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 Management Systems, ensuring ongoing compliance, effectiveness, audit readiness, and continuous improvement.

• Support regulatory conformity, product approvals, and hazardous location certification activities while coordinating with VEGA subject matter experts in IECEx, ATEX, and IEC 80079 requirements.

• Support the development, implementation, and maintenance of quality policies, procedures, and management system processes.

• Provide oversight and support for the document control process to ensure accuracy, consistency, and compliance of controlled documentation.

• Support and coordinate internal, external, customer, and certification audits in partnership with designated audit personnel.

• Monitor audit findings, corrective actions, and compliance initiatives to ensure effective and timely closure.

• Provide oversight of product certifications, approvals, and regulatory compliance activities in partnership with designated subject matter experts.

• Support compliance efforts related to hazardous locations (HazLoc), explosive atmosphere requirements, and other applicable product certifications.

• Monitor changes to quality, regulatory, and certification requirements and assess organizational impact.

• Facilitate management review activities and support quality system performance reporting.

• Lead risk-based thinking initiatives and support organizational risk assessment and mitigation activities.

• Support competence management processes, including quality-related training, awareness, and qualification requirements.

• Monitor compliance metrics and identify opportunities to improve process effectiveness and system performance.

• Collaborate with Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Product Management teams to maintain compliance and drive continuous improvement.

• Support customer, regulatory, and third-party inquiries related to quality system compliance and certifications.

• Serve as a resource for quality system interpretation, compliance guidance, and best practices.

REQUIREMENTS

• Bachelor's Degree from a four-year college or university, preferably in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, or a related technical field.

• Minimum of five (5) years of experience in Quality Assurance, Quality Systems, Compliance, or a related quality discipline.

• Minimum of three (3) years of experience working within an ISO 9001 Quality Management System. Or equivalent combination of education and experience.

• Strong knowledge of ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems and quality system governance principles.

• Experience supporting internal, external, customer, and certification audits as well as quality management system compliance activities.

• Experience working with regulatory, certification, approval, or conformity assessment requirements preferred.

• Experience supporting risk management, document control, or training/competence management systems preferred.

• Experience collaborating with global teams and/or working within an international manufacturing environment preferred.

• Ability to interpret quality standards, regulations, certification requirements, and compliance obligations.

• Working knowledge of auditing principles, corrective action processes, and risk-based thinking methodologies.

jobs.title: Senior Commercial Collections Specialist, Fintech
jobs.description:
This is Adyen

Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition.

For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster.

About the team

Credit Risk Operations owns Adyen's global arrears and collections flow for our financial products. When a merchant falls behind on repayment, we work to recover what is owed while keeping the relationship intact and staying fully compliant.

We sit at the intersection of Credit Risk, Product, Finance, Legal and our second-line Risk and Compliance teams. The team is growing quickly, so the processes, tooling and playbooks you help build now will shape how Adyen collects at scale.

What you'll do

As a Senior Commercial Collections Specialist, Fintech in Chicago, you will own a portfolio of US merchants in arrears across Adyen's financial products: cash advances, capital loans, charge cards, overdrafts and hardware financing. You will resolve each case end to end, from first outreach to repayment plan, recovery or escalation. Alongside your caseload, you will help turn a fast-growing operation into a scalable, compliant and increasingly automated one.

You will run your own portfolio independently, within agreed playbooks and approval limits. You will escalate exceptions such as settlements, write-offs and legal action to senior colleagues, and take on more complex accounts as you grow.

Responsibilities

• Own a portfolio of merchant accounts in arrears and drive each case to resolution by email

• Explain contractual obligations clearly, negotiate realistic repayment plans and follow through until they are met

• Spot breaches of agreement, such as licensing issues or unauthorized business activity, and agree next steps with Legal and Credit Risk

• Escalate at the right moment and coordinate recoveries with Risk, Finance, Legal and Product so merchants get one consistent answer

• Monitor portfolio health, including delinquency rates, roll rates, promise-to-pay and cure rates, and flag emerging risks early

• Keep accurate, audit-ready records of every merchant interaction and case decision

• Make sure every recovery action complies with US federal and state collections, servicing and lending rules

• Help design and improve collections tooling, automation and workflows so the operation scales without adding headcount at the same rate

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements below. If you do, we encourage you to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• Experienced in collections, account recovery or credit operations at a lender, bank, fintech or payments company

• Hands-on experience managing a portfolio of overdue business or consumer credit accounts

• Working knowledge of US collections and servicing regulations, and how to apply them day to day

• Confidence in difficult conversations: you balance empathy with firmness and keep the relationship intact

• Clear written and spoken English, including explaining terms like breach of contract or default in plain language

• Strong organization: you track many accounts, deadlines and follow-ups without dropping detail

• Comfort with collections platforms or CRM tools, and with Excel or Google Sheets for basic reporting

• A low-ego, high-accountability approach to working with Risk, Legal, Finance and Product

• Ability to leverage AI tools and automation to increase operational efficiency

Preferred qualifications

• Experience collecting on commercial credit products: merchant cash advances, working capital loans, charge cards, overdrafts or equipment financing

• Familiarity with FDCPA, UDAAP, state collection licensing rules and fair-lending expectations as they apply to business credit

• Experience handling legal escalations, settlements, charge-offs or third-party agency placements

• Comfort with data: SQL, Looker or similar tools to analyze delinquency trends and build reports

• A track record of improving a collections process, building a playbook or helping automate a workflow

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Adyen

We actively seek different perspectives to sharpen our ideas. Our unique culture is a product of our diverse backgrounds and experiences. No matter who you are or where you’re from, you’re welcome to be your true self at Adyen.

If you need accommodations or support during the recruitment process to perform at your best, you’ll have the opportunity to let our team know in your application. We encourage people from all backgrounds and abilities to apply.

What’s next?

Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Learn more about our hiring process here. Don’t be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility.

Adyen is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status or any legally protected status.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Please note that this role is a hybrid, 3 times per week, position in Chicago.

The annual base salary range for this role is $100,000-$130,000; to learn more about our compensation philosophy, please click here.

jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Design Specialist
jobs.description:
About Pacific Fusion

Pacific Fusion was founded in 2023 with the mission to power the world with abundant, affordable, clean energy.

We are rapidly designing and building a pulser-driven inertial fusion system to achieve net facility gain (more fusion energy output than stored energy input). In parallel, we are developing the key components required to build affordable fusion systems.

Our plans are ambitious. We have raised over $900M so far from incredible investors, resourcing us to deliver on these plans. We are bringing together the best scientists, engineers, and operators from the fusion community, hard tech industry, and other sectors. We are united by a shared sense of urgency to provide clean power for the world, particularly managing climate change while meeting growing global energy demand. You can read more about us in this letter from our founders.

Why This Role Matters

Pacific Fusion is seeking a Senior Mechanical Design Specialist to support the development of advanced mechanical systems for next-generation fusion energy technology. This role is ideal for creative, hands-on mechanical designers with strong CAD expertise who can work independently while collaborating closely with scientists, engineers, and cross-functional technical teams.

Successful candidates will develop and analyze complex mechanical systems, conduct research to resolve challenging engineering problems, and translate concepts into fully detailed, production-ready designs. Depending on experience and qualifications, candidates may also provide technical leadership, including planning and leading multiple complex projects

What You'll Do

• Independently analyze complex design problems and develop robust mechanical design solutions that satisfy all requirements and constraints.

• Translate design solutions into detailed layouts and assemblies using Creo Parametric

• Develop supporting documentation for design solutions, including analysis, schedules, cost estimates, and procedures.

• Capture design intent using Creo Parametric, including model-based definition practices where applicable.

• Maintain accurate design documentation and configuration control within Windchill or equivalent PLM/ELM systems.

• Estimate schedules and costs to determine effective approaches for design, materials selection, and fabrication to meet project deliverables.

• Prepare and present technical material for design reviews, procedures, and related documentation.

• Provide technical mentorship to fellow designers and contribute to workforce planning, task prioritization, and work assignments.

• Participate in formal design reviews and engineering change processes.

• Author, review, and approve engineering reports, manuals, and other technical documentation.

• Present designs and technical analyses to engineering leadership and project stakeholders

What You Bring

• Associate's degree in Mechanical Design, Mechanical Design Technology, or a related technical field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

• Significant applied experience with Creo Parametric and Windchill (or equivalent CAD/PLM systems).

• Advanced knowledge of CAD/PLM systems and configuration management best practices.

• Strong working knowledge of drafting standards, including ASME Y14.5 Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T).

• Demonstrated ability to analyze and interpret complex design requirements and develop original, practical engineering solutions.

• Experience with hardware design, fabrication, assembly techniques, material selection, testing processes, and manufacturing methods.

• Ability to read, interpret, and follow complex engineering drawings, specifications, sketches, and procedures.

• Proven ability to manage multiple tasks with attention to detail, accuracy, and independent follow-through.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present technical information clearly.

Bonus Points For

• Demonstrated technical or project leadership experience.

• Experience developing staffing plans, safety notes, mentoring engineers or designers, and contributing to performance development.

• Familiarity with project management methods and tools.

• Experience using CAD-supported Finite Element Analysis (FEA) to support conceptual and detailed design decisions.

jobs.title: Lead Governance, Risk and Compliance Manager
jobs.description:
Opportunity Overview

We’re looking for an experienced Lead Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) Manager to lead and mature our enterprise security governance, risk management, regulatory compliance, and customer assurance programs. In this role, you will drive operational excellence across compliance frameworks, security risk management, third-party assurance, and customer-facing security initiatives while strengthening the processes and technology that support our growing business.

This is a hands-on leadership role suited for an experienced GRC professional who can independently manage complex initiatives, influence cross-functional stakeholders, and build scalable, repeatable operations. You’ll work closely with Security, Engineering, IT, Legal, Sales, Customer Success, and executive leadership to advance our security posture, accelerate customer trust, and enable business growth.

What you’ll do:

• Lead and mature Cohere’s GRC program, establishing scalable governance processes, operating procedures, risk management practices, and measurable performance indicators aligned with business objectives.

• Own the deployment, configuration, and optimization of enterprise GRC platforms, including control mapping, evidence automation, risk registers, continuous monitoring, and compliance reporting.

• Direct compliance and certification initiatives across HITRUST, HIPAA, ISO 27001, and applicable regulatory requirements, ensuring ongoing audit readiness and effective control execution.

• Lead customer security assurance activities, including security questionnaires, due diligence requests, customer audits, executive briefings, and security discussions with prospective and existing clients.

• Partner with Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing to develop security-focused go-to-market materials, establish and maintain a customer-facing Trust Center, and strengthen security as a competitive differentiator.

• Review and negotiate security-related contractual requirements in partnership with Legal, including Data Protection Agreements (DPAs), Business Associate Agreements (BAAs), security exhibits, and customer security obligations.

• Oversee enterprise risk management activities, including risk assessments, remediation tracking, exception management, and the enforcement and reporting of vulnerability remediation SLAs across Engineering, Platform, DevOps, and Data teams.

• Govern identity and access compliance, including periodic access reviews, privileged access certifications, segregation of duties, and remediation of access control deficiencies.

• Establish and maintain cross-functional GRC engagement with business units to align security policies, controls, risk ownership, and compliance obligations with operational priorities.

• Develop and deliver executive-level presentations, dashboards, and reporting that communicate compliance posture, risk exposure, remediation performance, customer assurance metrics, and program maturity.

• Build and scale a high-performing GRC function, establishing repeatable processes, developing team capabilities, managing external assessors and partners, and driving continuous improvement with minimal day-to-day oversight.

What you’ll need:

• 8+ years of progressive experience in information security, governance, risk management, compliance, or IT audit, including 2+ years leading GRC initiatives, programs, and/or teams.

• Professional certifications such as CISM, CISSP, CRISC, CISA, CGRC, or HITRUST CCSFP.

• Deep working knowledge of HITRUST, ISO 27001, and HIPAA including direct experience managing assessments, implementing controls, coordinating audits, and maintaining certification readiness.

• Demonstrated experience deploying and administering enterprise GRC platforms, including implementation, workflow design, control mapping, evidence collection, reporting, and process automation.

• Familiarity with the NIST Cybersecurity Framework, NIST AI Risk Management Framework, ISO 27017, ISO 27018, ISO 42001, and privacy-related security requirements.

• Deep understanding of enterprise risk management, including risk registers, control assessments, risk treatment plans, vulnerability remediation SLAs, and formal exception management.

• Demonstrated project and program management capabilities, including managing concurrent initiatives, developing operational roadmaps, establishing KPIs, and delivering results independently.

• Proven experience leading customer assurance programs, including security questionnaires, customer-facing security meetings, due diligence reviews, and responding to enterprise customer requirements.

• Experience with GRC platforms such as Vanta, Anecdotes, ZenGRC, Drata, ServiceNow GRC, or similar enterprise solutions.

• Demonstrated success developing GRC program maturity models, executive scorecards, and risk-based reporting frameworks.

• Excellent written and verbal communication, executive presentation, and analytical reporting skills, with the ability to translate complex security and compliance requirements into actionable business insights.

• Working knowledge of contractual security requirements, including reviewing and redlining security exhibits, DPAs, BAAs, and customer agreements in collaboration with Legal.

• Demonstrated ability to partner with Sales, Customer Success, and business stakeholders to develop customer assurance materials, security documentation, and go-to-market enablement resources.

• Experience designing, launching, or administering a customer-facing Security Trust Center and associated assurance workflows.

• Background in healthcare technology, SaaS, AI/ML-driven organizations, or other highly regulated environments.

Pay & Perks:

💻 Fully remote opportunity with about 5% travel

🩺 Medical, dental, vision, life, disability insurance, and Employee Assistance Program

📈 401K retirement plan with company match; flexible spending and health savings account

🏝️ Flex Time Off + company holidays

👶 Up to 14 weeks of paid parental leave

🐶 Pet insurance

The salary range for this position is $133,000 to $145,000 annually; as part of a total benefits package which includes health insurance, 401k and bonus. Individual pay decisions are ultimately based on a number of factors, including but not limited to qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, and internal alignment.

• Meet your Hiring Manager!

About Cohere Health:

Cohere Health’s clinical intelligence platform and agentic AI-powered solutions connect health plans’ strategic goals and providers’ needs, optimizing the speed, cost, and quality of care. With an enterprise approach that streamlines payer-provider decision-making across the care continuum–including policy, prior authorization, payment accuracy, and more–the company improves collaboration and reduces burden, resulting in up to 8x ROI and 94% provider satisfaction.

With the acquisition of ZignaAI, we’ve further enhanced our platform by launching our Payment Integrity Suite, anchored by Cohere Validate™, an AI-driven clinical and coding validation solution that operates in near real-time. By unifying pre-service authorization data with post-service claims validation, we’re creating a transparent healthcare ecosystem that reduces waste, improves payer-provider collaboration and patient outcomes, and ensures providers are paid promptly and accurately.

Cohere Health’s innovations continue to receive industry wide recognition. Backed by leading investors such as Deerfield Management, Define Ventures, Flare Capital Partners, Longitude Capital, and Polaris Partners.

jobs.title: Staff Design Engineer, IC Layout
jobs.description:
Impinj delivers the Physical Intelligence that connects the physical world to the AI-powered digital world, fueling automated workflows and improving consumer experiences. From retail merchandise and groceries to packages and shipping pallets, Impinj products and solutions identify and track tens of billions of everyday items, providing real-time operational insights about every item enterprises make, move and sell. We are, quite literally, the eyes and ears of smart enterprise systems. Come help us build technology and solutions that enable businesses to visualize everything, waste nothing and act instantly.

Team Overview:

The Layout Design Engineering group is an integral part of the Silicon Engineering department, working closely with the analog RFID end-point IC development team and the Reader IC team, internationally. The team is responsible for delivering tape-outs for RFID products, test chips, reader ICs, and DOEs (design of experiments) work that sits at the center of how Impinj brings new silicon to market.

Layout decisions made by this team directly influence the power efficiency, cost, and time-to-market of every piece of silicon we ship, making the group's work foundational to Impinj's mission. The team operates with a continuous-improvement mindset, adapting quickly and challenging each other to remain best-in-class in both quality and speed, with meticulous attention to detail to ensure designs have long-term reliability and zero defects, at production volumes in the many billions and eventually trillions of tags per year.

What You Will Do:

• Perform detailed transistor-level layout of RF, mixed-signal, and analog circuit blocks for both high-performance RF as well as ultra-low power and compact RFID

• Work closely with the analog and digital design teams on floor planning, pin placement, power supply strategy and signal distribution between blocks

• Conduct layout reviews for power/ground routing, electromigration, matching, and signal coupling

• Participate in schedule meetings coordinating layout and floorplan activities

What You Will Bring:

• Bachelor’s degree in computer or electrical engineering and 8+ years of experience

• Experience in custom analog, RF, and mixed-signal layout

• Ability to collaborate with other layout engineers on the top-level IC floorplan, partnering with circuit designers to resolve complex problems

• Understanding of semiconductor manufacturing processes and foundry technologies across advanced process nodes down to 16nm for ultra-low-power and high-fidelity applications

• Knowledge of analog layout challenges and layout-dependent effects in advanced processes — noise coupling, matching, parasitics, LOD, WPE, PSE, and coloring — along with proficiency in mitigation techniques such as guard rings, DNW, PN junctions, parasitic management, signal integrity, reliability (EMIR), and ESD

• Proficiency with the use of Cadence Virtuoso layout editor and Cadence/Siemens layout verification tools (including PVS and Siemens Calibre DRC/LVS). Ability to interpret and correct ERC, DRC and LVS error reports

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills

• Strong technical project management skills

jobs.title: Senior CDD Risk Analyst, Direct Customer Onboarding
jobs.description:
This is Adyen

Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition.

For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster.

CDD Direct Customer Onboarding Team

Our Direct Customer Onboarding (CDD) team is seeking an experienced Senior CDD Risk Analyst with a strong compliance background and deep CDD expertise. In this role, your core focus centers on two key pillars: leading quality improvements (and quality control processes sign-offs) and directly managing high-complexity enterprise onboarding cases. Additionally, you will serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) and mentor, actively helping to upskill the team while collaborating cross-functionally with Quality Assurance, Compliance, and Commercial teams to streamline our onboarding process while safeguarding Adyen through strict regulatory compliance.

What You’ll Do

• Complex Merchant Onboarding & Collaborative Problem-Solving: Autonomously lead the onboarding process for Adyen’s most strategic and complex enterprise merchants. Conduct multi-jurisdictional due diligence, dissecting opaque corporate structures, and mitigating risks associated with PEPs, sanctions, adverse media, and high-risk industries.

• Regulatory Interpretation & Policy Alignment: . Translate complex second-line compliance policies into actionable first-line operational procedures and lead calibration sessions to ensure consistent application across the team.

• Uphold Quality & Consistency: Maintain "First-Time-Right" accuracy, perform regular quality control checks for the team, upskill team members on quality standards, ensure accurate risk reasoning, follow SOPs strictly, and maintain high-quality decision-making across all casework.

• Process Optimization & Tooling Innovation: Proactively identify operational bottlenecks, redundancies, and friction points across the end-to-end merchant lifecycle. Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Compliance, and Operations to optimize workflows, improve tooling capabilities, and automate manual controls, streamlining the onboarding experience while maintaining robust regulatory safeguards.

• Merchant & Commercial Partnership: Partner with Commercial, Sales, and Account Management teams during high-stakes negotiations and merchant escalations. Rather than managing processes solely via tickets, actively participate in merchant and commercial calls to understand their business setups firsthand, clearly explain compliance requirements, and design practical, compliant pathways to successful onboarding while balancing regulatory integrity with business growth.

• Team Mentorship: Mentor a cohort of CDD analysts, acting as a go-to expert for complex case guidance and fostering a culture of proactive risk ownership. Develop and lead training sessions to upskill the team on emerging risk typologies and regulatory changes.

Who You Are

• Experience: 6+ years experience in CDD, KYC/EDD operations or Second Line Risk or Compliance role within a FinTech, Payment Service provider, or Financial Institution. Prior experience as a Quality Checker or QA auditor in 1st/2nd Line functions is preferred.

• Complex Risk & Regulatory Depth: Proven mastery in evaluating complex risk scenarios beyond standard checklists. You bring deep experience navigating challenges such as layered corporate structures, offshore/nominee entities, UBO transparency, high-risk business models, scheme rules, and multi-jurisdictional AML/CFT standards (e.g. DNB, FCA, FinCEN, MAS, RBI, AUSTRAC).

• Commercial Maturity & Pragmatism: Proven track record of navigating complex commercial dynamics and high-pressure go-live targets without compromising risk controls. Skilled at negotiating and implementing concrete risk-mitigation solutions that enable safe business growth while satisfying strict regulatory mandates.

• Merchant-Facing & Direct Customer Engagement: Experienced in direct customer interactions and merchant-facing roles, effectively bridging complex compliance requirements with commercial discussions and operational needs.

• Data Rigor & Continuous Improvement: Analytical mindset proficient in leveraging data and analytics to identify root causes of onboarding friction, contributing directly to automation and tooling enhancements.

• Autonomous & Strong Team Mentality: High autonomy, resilience, and clear written and verbal communication skills. Eager to share knowledge, coach colleagues, and collaborate seamlessly across operational, second line and commercial teams.

• Nice to Have: Financial Product & Issuing Background: Experience with and understanding of financial products and/or issuing, such as business bank accounts, card issuing, and capital. You can assess how a merchant’s business model, funds flows, and product structure translate into risk, and apply that knowledge to onboarding decisions and risk mitigation.

Total rewards & compensation

The annual base salary range for this role in Chicago is $100,000 - $130,000.

jobs.title: Customer Success Analyst
jobs.location: Rohnert Park, California; San Francisco, California
jobs.description:
Heartflow is a medical technology company advancing the diagnosis and management of coronary artery disease, the #1 cause of death worldwide, using cutting-edge technology. The flagship product—an AI-driven, non-invasive cardiac test supported by the ACC/AHA Chest Pain Guidelines called the Heartflow FFRCT Analysis—provides a color-coded, 3D model of a patient’s coronary arteries indicating the impact blockages have on blood flow to the heart. Heartflow is the first AI-driven non-invasive integrated heart care solution across the CCTA pathway that helps clinicians identify stenoses in the coronary arteries (RoadMap™Analysis), assess coronary blood flow (FFRCT Analysis), and characterize and quantify coronary atherosclerosis (Plaque Analysis). Our pipeline of products is growing and so is our team; join us in helping to revolutionize precision heartcare.

Heartflow is a publicly traded company (HTFL) that has received international recognition for exceptional strides in healthcare innovation, is supported by medical societies around the world, cleared for use in the US, UK, Europe, Japan and Canada, and has been used for more than 750,000 patients worldwide.

Heartflow is transforming how coronary artery disease is diagnosed and managed. The Heartflow platform, including the Heartflow FFRCT Analysis and Plaque Analysis, is used by hospitals, imaging centers, and physician practices across the country, and keeping those customers successful at scale is central to our growth. We are looking for a Customer Success Analyst to join the Strategic Analytics team and serve as the analytical engine behind our Customer Success and Support organizations.

In this role, you will own the data, models, and insights that help Customer Success leaders decide how to staff, where to focus, and what to fix. You will build headcount and capacity models, turn support ticket data into clear themes and root causes, track customer health and adoption across our site base, and deliver dashboards and analyses that leadership relies on. You will work closely with Customer Success, Support, Sales Operations, Finance, and Product, translating operational questions into rigorous analysis and practical recommendations.

We are an AI-forward analytics team. The ideal candidate is someone who already uses AI tools as a core part of how they work, from accelerating SQL and Python development to classifying and summarizing unstructured ticket data, and who is excited to help build the automated, AI-assisted workflows that will define how Customer Success operates at Heartflow.

Job Responsibilities:

• Capacity & Headcount Planning: Build and maintain capacity models for Customer Success and Support teams, linking case volume, site growth, ticket demand, and handle time to staffing needs; support annual planning and in-year headcount decisions.

• Support Ticket Insights: Analyze Salesforce case data to identify volume drivers, recurring issues, root causes, and trends by site, product, and issue type; translate findings into actionable recommendations for Support, Product, and Operations.

• Support Operations Metrics: Define and track core operational KPIs such as ticket volume, first response time, time to resolution, backlog, SLA attainment, escalation rates, and workload distribution.

• Customer Health & Retention: Develop and refine customer health scoring, adoption and utilization tracking, and early-warning indicators of churn or declining engagement; partner with CS leaders to prioritize proactive outreach.

• Onboarding & Time-to-Value: Measure onboarding performance and ramp of newly launched sites, identifying where customers stall and what drives faster adoption.

• Dashboards & Executive Reporting: Build and maintain Tableau dashboards and recurring reports for CS and executive audiences, with clear narratives on what changed, why, and what to do about it.

• Salesforce Data & Process: Partner with Sales Operations and Salesforce administrators to improve case and account data structures, ticket categorization taxonomy, and data quality so the data supports reliable analysis.

• AI-Enabled Analytics & Automation: Apply LLMs and AI tools to classify, cluster, and summarize ticket text and customer feedback; automate recurring reporting and data pipelines; and evaluate AI outputs for accuracy and consistency.

• Ad Hoc Analysis: Lead deep-dive analyses on cross-functional questions, framing the problem, choosing the right method, and presenting findings to stakeholders at all levels.

• Data Stewardship: Follow Heartflow data handling policies, including appropriate safeguards for any customer or patient-related information encountered in support data.

Skills Needed:

• CS Operations Expertise: Hands-on experience in Customer Success or Support Operations, including capacity and workforce planning and deriving insights from support ticket data.

• SQL: Advanced SQL skills and comfort working in a cloud data warehouse (Amazon Redshift or similar), including complex joins, window functions, and deduplication logic.

• BI & Visualization: Strong experience building dashboards in Tableau or a comparable BI tool, with an eye for clear, decision-oriented design.

• Salesforce Fluency: Deep working knowledge of Salesforce (Service Cloud and Sales Cloud), including the case and account data model, reports and dashboards, and extracting data for analysis; SOQL experience is a plus.

• AI Fluency: Demonstrated, regular use of AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) to accelerate analysis, write code, and process unstructured text; familiarity with prompt design, semantic models, LLM-based classification, and validating AI-generated outputs.

• Python: Working proficiency in Python (pandas or similar) for data wrangling, automation, and analysis; experience with text analytics or NLP techniques is a plus.

• Modeling & Forecasting: Strong Excel and modeling skills, including scenario-based capacity and demand forecasting.

• Communication: Ability to turn complex analysis into concise, compelling stories for both operational teams and senior leadership.

• Ownership & Judgment: Self-directed, detail-oriented, and comfortable with ambiguity; able to define metrics carefully and push back when data does not support a conclusion.

jobs.title: Meteorologist I
jobs.description:
We are seeking a meteorologist with strong forecasting and communication skills to join the AccuWeather Forecasting Team at our Global Headquarters in State College, Pennsylvania, beginning January or February 2027. We are looking for someone who is collaborative, curious, and passionate about helping people and businesses make the best weather-informed decisions. Our mission is to save lives, protect property, and help people plan with confidence. If you want to grow your career on a team that is committed to Superior Accuracy™, this opening is for you!

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

As a Meteorologist I, you will prepare and communicate impact-driven forecasts that power AccuWeather’s app, website, and business solutions used by millions worldwide. These include:

· Prepare specialized weather forecasts and products for media outlets, business clients, and digital platforms.

· Collaborate with colleagues to evaluate data, discuss differing analyses, and reach consensus on predicted weather outcomes.

· Communicate complex weather scenarios clearly through verbal briefings, written products, and digital forecasts.

· Monitor new weather data, determine whether forecast adjustments are needed, and communicate updates to customers.

· Contribute to special projects such as quality assurance, process improvement, customer support, or research and development.

· Stay current on emerging forecasting tools, models, and techniques, and learn to use AI and machine learning to improve forecasting efficiency, and streamline product creation and dissemination.

· Perform other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS

· Bachelor’s degree in Meteorology or Atmospheric Sciences, or equivalent education and experience.

· Eligibility for membership in the American Meteorological Society or National Weather Association.

· Proven forecasting skills across multiple regions or weather types.

· Ability to translate complex meteorological data into clear, accurate forecasts.

· Excellent analytical, verbal, and written communication skills.

· Strong collaboration and leadership abilities in a team-based environment.

· Availability to work evenings, overnights, weekends, and holidays.

· All levels of forecasting experience are encouraged to apply.

ABOUT ACCUWEATHER

AccuWeather, recognized and documented as the most accurate and most used source of weather forecasts and warnings in the world, has saved over 12,000 lives, prevented injury to over 100,000 people, and saved companies tens of billions of dollars through better planning and decision-making.

A billion people around the world rely on AccuWeather’s proven Superior Accuracy™ across our consumer digital platforms. AccuWeather For Business serves more than half of the Fortune 500 companies and thousands of other businesses and government agencies globally.

Dr. Joel Myers, Founder and Executive Chairman, established AccuWeather in 1962 and is considered the “father of modern commercial meteorology.” Myers is a visionary entrepreneur and has been called “the most accurate man in weather” by The New York Times. jobs.title: Applications Software Engineer - Industrial Automation
jobs.description:
Eurofins Food & Feed Testing is seeking an Applications Software Engineer - Industrial Automation to design, develop, and maintain software solutions for custom laboratory automation and industrial equipment.

This position is ideal for a talented software engineer who enjoys solving complex technical problems and building scalable software systems. The role will focus on developing modern web-based Human-Machine Interfaces (HMIs), backend services, machine communication layers, reusable software components, and standardized software frameworks that support automation platforms across the organization.

The engineer will work closely with Automation Engineers, Mechanical Engineers, and Electrical Engineers to develop reliable, maintainable, and scalable software solutions for advanced laboratory and manufacturing systems.

Previous PLC or industrial automation experience is preferred but not required. We are primarily seeking a strong software developer with a passion for learning new technologies and solving real-world engineering challenges.

Software Development & Architecture

• Design, develop, test, and maintain software applications for automation equipment.
• Develop modular, reusable, and scalable software components.
• Apply object-oriented programming principles and software design best practices.
• Develop and maintain common software libraries and frameworks for future automation projects.
• Participate in software architecture decisions, code reviews, and technical design discussions.
• Implement structured diagnostics, logging, error handling, and automated testing where appropriate.

HMI & Application Development

• Design and develop modern web-based Human-Machine Interfaces (HMIs).
• Develop frontend and backend applications for machine monitoring, configuration, and operator interaction.
• Develop APIs and communication interfaces between machine controllers and external systems.
• Support data acquisition, visualization, reporting, and diagnostics functionality.
• Improve user experience, system usability, and maintainability through software enhancements.

Industrial Automation & Systems Integration

• Support development and maintenance of machine control software.
• Integrate software solutions with PLCs, industrial PCs, robotics, motion systems, sensors, and instrumentation.
• Support implementation of machine state management, alarms, diagnostics, and sequential equipment operation.
• Assist with integration using industrial communication protocols.
• Collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams during machine development, testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting.

Software Quality & Standardization

• Establish and maintain software coding standards and documentation.
• Utilize Git-based version control and collaborative development practices.
• Participate in software validation, debugging, and root cause analysis.
• Contribute to the development of reusable software standards that reduce development time and improve reliability across future projects.
• Support continuous improvement initiatives focused on software quality and engineering efficiency.

Project Support

• Support new automation projects from concept through deployment.
• Participate in factory acceptance testing, commissioning, and startup activities.
• Troubleshoot software and system integration issues.
• Document software architecture, functionality, and support procedures.
• Perform other duties as assigned.

Required

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
• 5+ years of professional software development experience.
• Strong programming experience in C#, C++, Java, Python, or similar modern programming languages.
• Solid understanding of object-oriented programming, software architecture, and modular software design.
• Experience developing, debugging, and maintaining software applications.
• Familiarity with frontend technologies including JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
• Understanding of client-server applications, APIs, and communication protocols.
• Experience using Git or similar version control systems.
• Strong problem-solving, troubleshooting, and analytical skills.
• Ability to independently learn new technologies and technical concepts.
• Strong communication and collaboration skills.

Preferred

• Experience with Beckhoff TwinCAT 3.
• Knowledge of IEC 61131-3 programming, particularly Structured Text.
• Experience with industrial automation, PLCs, or PC-based control systems.
• Familiarity with EtherCAT, EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, Modbus TCP, or OPC UA.
• Experience with robotics, motion control systems, or servo technology.
• Experience developing industrial HMIs or SCADA applications.
• Familiarity with finite state machine architectures and sequential machine control.
• Knowledge of industrial machine safety concepts.
• Experience working in laboratory, manufacturing, pharmaceutical, or regulated environments.
• Experience with automated software testing and CI/CD workflows.
• Experience with database development and management (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, or similar).
• Experience designing applications for industrial data collection, storage, reporting, and analytics.
• Familiarity with Industry 4.0, Smart Manufacturing, and Digital Transformation initiatives.
• Experience with Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) technologies and connected equipment architectures.
• Knowledge of MQTT , OPC UA, REST APIs, and cloud-based industrial data platforms.
• Experience integrating automation systems with MES, LIMS, ERP, cloud services, or enterprise applications.

Candidates currently living within a commutable distance of Houston, TX are encouraged to apply.

What Success Looks Like

• Development of reusable software components used across multiple automation platforms.
• Successful deployment of modern HMI and backend software applications.
• Contributions to a standardized software architecture that improves maintainability and scalability.
• Improved system diagnostics, troubleshooting capabilities, and software reliability.

This role offers a unique opportunity to combine modern software engineering practices with cutting-edge industrial and laboratory automation technologies.
