jobs.title: Director, Acquisition, Provider Growth
jobs.description:
Our Mission

You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you’re blocked.

We’re here to give power to the patient.

For nearly 20 years, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace - helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we’re going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc’s marketplace to power access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.

Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from seeking to getting. We don’t want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.

Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.

Your Impact on Our Mission

We think the way businesses approach customer growth needs to be reinvented.

For years, acquisition marketing has been built around channels, campaigns, media plans, and predefined funnels. But providers do not discover, evaluate, and choose products along the paths we create for them. They search, compare, ask peers, respond to changing business needs, and increasingly find answers through new platforms and AI-powered experiences.

We believe the future of acquisition is understanding what providers are trying to accomplish, recognizing where Zocdoc can help, and finding intelligent, creative ways to show up with something useful. That means building an acquisition system that is relevant to the provider, responsive to intent, and accountable to real business outcomes.

As Director, Provider Growth Acquisition, you will have the opportunity to build that system at Zocdoc. You will define how we find the providers we are best positioned to serve, how we earn their attention, how we turn interest into action, and how we learn what creates durable growth. You will also own the performance of that system: balancing ROAS and efficiency with incremental new active providers, MQL quality, and the long-term value of the providers we acquire.

You will report to the VP, Provider Growth and help define what acquisition-led growth can look like at Zocdoc.

Your day-to-day...

• Build the strategy, roadmap, and operating model for Provider Acquisition, translating them into shipped programs and measurable business outcomes.

• Own acquisition performance and investment decisions: deliver MQL volume and quality, improve conversion to active providers, grow incremental new active providers, and meet ROAS or payback expectations while building long-term provider value.

• Establish the performance framework, data, instrumentation, attribution, and reporting that connect investment to MQLs, sign-ups, conversion, incremental lift, provider LTV, and revenue by segment, specialty, geography, account, and program. Use channel reporting and incrementality testing to distinguish true impact from credited activity.

• Define the audiences and markets where Zocdoc is best positioned to win, prioritize provider segments and account tiers, and match investment to opportunity, from scalable reach to 1:1, 1:few, and 1:many ABM.

• Reimagine acquisition as a connected growth system, bringing ABM, paid and organic search, web experiences, CRO, and field events together around shared audiences, messaging, and provider needs.

• Run a fast learning loop through bold experiments across audiences, channels, creative, offers, landing pages, journeys, events, partnerships, and emerging tools; scale what works and stop what does not.

• Partner with Sales, Product Marketing, Events, Marketing Operations, Data Science, and other growth leaders to align on audience definitions, handoffs, priorities, and decisions.

• Recruit, lead, coach, and develop the team; hire for the capabilities the function needs next, set a high bar, and create clarity across a growing portfolio of work.

• Lead the team’s priorities, planning, and operating cadence while staying close to the work, shaping strategy, reviewing creative and experiences, interrogating performance, and resolving obstacles as the function takes shape.

You’ll Enjoy This Role If You...

• Want a real builder challenge. We’ve experimented across ABM, paid and organic search, web, CRO, and events, but haven’t yet turned them into a connected, repeatable acquisition engine. You’ll help decide what to build, where to focus, and what to stop.

• Are motivated by ownership with visible business stakes. Your decisions will affect MQL quality, incremental active providers, ROAS or payback, conversion, and provider LTV.

• Are comfortable starting without a playbook. You can work with incomplete data and uneven foundations, form a point of view, get a test into market, learn quickly, and adjust.

• Like working at both altitudes: setting strategy and then getting into the details of audiences, campaigns, creative, landing pages, and performance data to unblock progress.

• Are excited to build the team as well as the function. There are teammates to partner with, but you’ll need to identify capability gaps, hire thoughtfully, and create clarity and momentum as the team grows.

• See paid, organic, web, ABM, and events as different ways to solve the same problem: helping the right providers discover, understand, and act on value.

• Are curious about new ways to find providers and earn their attention, including new channels, partnerships, content formats, data sources, and AI-enabled approaches and willing to test ideas that may not work before discovering the ones that do.

• Are energized by creating structure where today there is mostly ad hoc work and turning early lessons into repeatable capabilities.

You’ll Be Successful in This Role If You...

• Bring 10+ years leading acquisition, growth, demand generation, digital, performance, or integrated marketing, including 5+ years hiring and managing teams.

• Have built acquisition capabilities from strategy through activation, conversion, measurement, and scale.

• Bring deep expertise in performance marketing and strong working fluency across ABM, paid and organic search, SEO/AEO, website strategy, CRO, and field marketing.

• Have owned budgets and outcomes against a rigorous scorecard including ROAS or payback, incremental acquisition, MQL quality, funnel conversion, and provider or customer LTV.

• Are analytically rigorous: design experiments, assess incrementality, understand attribution limits, and translate results into investment decisions.

• Connect channel performance to qualified pipeline, active providers, revenue, and durable provider value and make clear trade-offs between near-term efficiency and long-term growth.

• Build strong cross-functional partnerships and create focus, momentum, and accountability in ambiguous environments.

• Communicate with clarity and influence, from aligning senior stakeholders to giving a growing team focus, confidence, and momentum.

Benefits

• Flexible, hybrid work environment at our convenient Soho location

• Unlimited vacation

• 100% paid employee health benefit options, including medical, dental, and vision

• Commuter benefits

• 401(k) with employer-funded match

• Corporate wellness program with Wellhub

• Sabbatical leave for employees with 5+ years of service

• Competitive paid parental leave and fertility/family planning reimbursement

• Cell phone reimbursement

• Catered lunch every day, along with beverages and snacks

• Employee Resource Groups and ZocClubs to promote shared community and belonging

Zocdoc is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. Salary ranges are determined through alignment with market data. Base salary offered is determined by a number of factors including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and skills. Certain positions are also eligible for variable pay and/or equity; your recruiter will discuss the full compensation package details.

NYC Base Salary Range

$190,000—$240,000 USD

About us
Zocdoc is the country’s leading digital health marketplace that helps patients easily find and book the care they need. Each month, millions of patients use our free service to find nearby, in-network providers, compare choices based on verified patient reviews, and instantly book in-person or video visits online. Providers participate in Zocdoc’s Marketplace to reach new patients to grow their practice, fill their last-minute openings, and deliver a better healthcare experience. Founded in 2007 with a mission to give power to the patient, our work each day in pursuit of that mission is guided by our six core values. Zocdoc is a private company backed by some of the world’s leading investors, and we believe we’re still only scratching the surface of what we plan to accomplish.

Zocdoc is a mission-driven organization dedicated to building teams as diverse as the patients and providers we aim to serve. In the spirit of one of our core values - Together, Not Alone, we are a company that prides itself on being highly collaborative, and we believe that diverse perspectives, experiences and contributors make our community and our platform better.  We’re an equal opportunity employer committed to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. Applicants are considered for employment regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, national origin, gender, sex, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or parental status, disability, veteran status, or any other class protected by applicable laws.

Registered Nurse-Medical-Surgical-Oncology Full-Time Nights

The Staff Nurse Inpatient-Kishwaukee reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

• The Registered Nurse performs established procedures in accordance with hospital and the department of patient care services philosophy, policies, and standards. Care is provided with consideration to developmental needs and abilities. The RN uses the nursing process to ensure the delivery of high-quality evidence-based nursing care to the patient and family

Responsibilities:

Description

• According to hospital and unit specific guidelines and standards of practice, completes an assessment for each assigned patient reflecting age specific physical, psychological, emotional, spiritual, cultural, and environmental variables affecting the patient. Recognizes signs of abuse/neglect.
• Assesses patient/family educational needs, abilities, learning preferences, and readiness to learn
• Anticipates potential problems including those related to the patient’s disease entity, adjustment to disease, physical complications, knowledge deficit, discharge needs, and family support
• Develops and updates nursing plan of care based on patient assessment and nursing diagnosis with input from interdisciplinary team members and patient/family/significant others; patient/family education and discharge planning needs are assessed and included in the plan of care
• Initiates and coordinates effective communication with physicians and/or other healthcare providers by reporting and recording pertinent observations and reactions regarding patient/family/significant others
• Assesses patient response to treatment regime, recognizes and analyzes the cause of patient’s symptoms and changing condition and initiates appropriate nursing interventions
• Prioritizes the care needs for assigned patients by demonstrating ability to readjust priorities with changing patient status or unit activity
• Actively participates in discharge planning from time of admission as evidenced by documenting patient teaching, patient/family understanding of plan, and timely referrals, etc.
• Applies Standards of Care in the provision of safe patient care, with consideration given to normal characteristics of growth and development throughout the life span, consulting with team and clinical development coordinator, as needed (see Standards of Care). Follows OSHA standards according to guidelines and policies/procedures
• Appropriate age-specific interventions are identified, implemented, and documented in a safe and timely manner; documentation and practice reflects patient’s response to interventions
• Includes the patient/family/significant other as active participants in the development of the plan of care, the care given, and in teaching
• Administers prescribed medications and performs treatments in a safe manner utilizing knowledge of standards of care in administration of medications. Utilizes medication administration time as opportunity to educate patient/family about medications
• Provides pain management for patient as well as comfort and support to patient/family/significant other
• Follows hospital policy in reporting potential abuse/neglect.
• Anticipates patient needs and coordinates patient care activities with other hospital departments, healthcare providers, and agencies in the community
• Performs re-assessment of patient according to patient condition, standards of practice, and hospital policy
• Consistently evaluates patient diagnostic data in a timely manner and intervenes appropriately
• Comprehensively and accurately documents treatments, assessments, and patient’s response to nursing actions and interventions/medical regime
• Communicates patient’s status changes to shift charge nurse, physician, and/or other healthcare team members as appropriate
• Evaluates patient’s and family’s response to teaching plan including level of understanding, acceptance, and compliance
• In consultation with members of the interdisciplinary team, initiates patient care conferences and revises plan of care based on patient response to interventions.
• Evaluates the quality of care provided including nursing assessments and plan of care

• American Heart Association Basic Life Support (BLS)

• Ability to collaborate with others

Jumia is a leading pan-African e-commerce platform. Its mission is to improve the quality of everyday life in Africa by leveraging technology to deliver innovative, convenient and affordable online services to customers, while helping businesses grow as they use Jumia's platform to better reach and serve customers.

Over two years, you’ll combine on-the-job learning and mentoring . By the end, you’ll understand Jumia’s operations well and be ready for a range of career paths in the company.

Start your career as the voice and champion of millions of consumers and top partner brands like Samsung, Tecno, Infinix, Delron, Bruhm, Hikers, Nivea, Unilever, Oraimo, and Nasco. About Point

✨ Real Impact, Real People: Our mission at Point is to make homeownership more valuable and accessible. Your work directly helps homeowners access their wealth, achieve financial flexibility, and realize life changing goals.

✨ Funding: With over $175M raised from top investors like Andreessen Horowitz, WestCap, Greylock, and Prudential, we’re scaling fast! You have the opportunity to join us at a pivotal stage.

✨ Game-changing Product: We're building a category defining company in home equity. We’ve earned a 4.7 Trustpilot rating and an A+ from the BBB, a testament to the value we provide to our 20,000+ customers.

✨ Great Place to Work: Our employees love working here! We are a Certified Great Place to Work and a Fortune Best Workplaces in the Bay Area.

✨ Remote First Culture, Genuine Connection: Work from anywhere in the U.S. while staying closely connected through virtual collaboration, team gatherings, and a people-first culture. Select roles may require onsite work at our Palo Alto office one day per week.

Local or 100% Remote

About the role

Point for Brokers is the channel through which mortgage brokers and loan officers offer Point's home equity investment to their clients. The program is live, partners are onboarded, and Point is forming a dedicated product team for it. The Senior Product Manager owns the broker product experience. That covers the broker portal where loan officers submit and track files and the tools that help them qualify clients. It also covers the integrations that place Point inside the systems brokers already use. This person takes over work already in flight, runs it end to end, and finds the next integrations and paths that grow the channel. They work with a dedicated engineering and design team and partner with Sales, Broker Operations and Compliance to grow the channel.

Your responsibilities

• Own delivery across multiple broker workstreams at once, from discovery and requirements through launch and adoption.

• Drive the broker roadmap, and tie each project to channel goals such as loan officer activation, submission quality and funded volume.

• Write clear specifications for major features and manage all jira tickets through our SDLC process.

• Make scope, design and technical trade-offs with engineering and design, and know which decisions to escalate.

• Talk with loan officers, processors and brokerage owners every week. Combine what they say with support cases, session recordings and funnel data, and turn it into product recommendations.

• Define instrumentation and success metrics before launch. Analyze results after launch and recommend the next step.

• Scope and evaluate integrations with mortgage industry systems, such as pricing engines and loan origination systems, so brokers can work with Point from the tools they already use.

• Partner with Broker Operations and Compliance so features hold up in practice, including task routing, document handling and state-by-state rules.

• QA releases that span interrelated features, triage bugs, and decide what blocks a launch.

• Report status, results and risks to Product leadership and channel stakeholders before they ask.

About you

• 5+ years of product management experience.

• Shipped major features in a B2B, B2B2C or partner-facing product, where the person using the product is not the end customer.

• Took over an in-flight product or program and improved its results.

• Writes SQL and uses analytics tools like Sigma or PostHog, along with AI, to form hypotheses and measure outcomes.

• Sketches wireframes and gives specific, usable feedback on design work.

• Builds alignment with Sales, Operations and Compliance partners without direct authority, and escalates when alignment fails.

Nice to have

• Experience with mortgage brokers, loan officers or third-party origination (TPO) channels.

• Experience with partner portals or Salesforce Experience Cloud.

• Experience scoping API integrations with third-party platforms.

• Experience in mortgage, lending, fintech or real estate.

Compensation at Point will be determined by skills, experience, and geographic location. Point has identified the expected annual base salary for this role at this level based on the market by tiers (Region | Location | Market Salary):

• Tier 1 | San Francisco Bay Area, New York, and Seattle | $180,500 - $199,500

• Tier 2 | Austin, Boston, Chicago, Denver, Los Angeles, Miami, Philadelphia, Portland, Sacramento, San Diego, Santa Barbara & Washington DC | $158,650 - $175,350

• Tier 3 | All other US metro areas | $146,300 - $161,700

This does not include any other potential components of the compensation package, including equity, benefits, and perks outlined above. At the launch of each position, we benchmark compensation to the appropriate role and level utilizing competitive compensation data from various data sources as references. At the offer stage, we use the signal we received from our interviews, coupled with your experience, location, and other job-related factors, to determine final compensation.

Location Requirement: This is a remote position. However, candidates must reside in one of Point’s states of operation: AL, AR, AZ, CA, CO, CT, DC, FL, GA, IL, KS, KY, MA, MD, ME, MI, MN, MO, NC, NH, NJ, NV, NY, OH, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA, WI.

Our benefits

• Generous health benefits: We provide comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans with options for flexible spending accounts (Health Care FSA) and health savings accounts (HSA).

• Unlimited paid time off: Recharge with unlimited paid time off and 10 company holidays.

• Flexible remote and onsite work: Our teams work from many different locations and time zones. We support fully remote work and also have an amazing in-person environment in our downtown Palo Alto, CA HQ.

• Fully paid parental leave: Point will supplement state Paid Family Leave (PFL) so employees receive 100% of their regular base pay, plus two additional weeks of fully paid leave after state PFL ends. In states without PFL, Point offers up to 8 weeks of paid parental leave. In addition, employees also receive 4 weeks of fully paid transition time, during which you may work 2–3 days per week while receiving full base pay.

• Equity: We offer meaningful equity because we believe in sharing the value you help create. Your contributions directly impact our growth, and your equity gives you a stake in our future success.

• Financial wellness: We provide 401K retirement plans for employees as well as guaranteed life insurance and short- and long-term disability coverage.

• Extra work/life benefits: We provide monthly stipends for internet, mobile plans, wellness perks, a one-time home office reimbursement, and company provided equipment including a MacBook and monitor.

We provide employment opportunities regardless of age, race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other protected class. Each individual at Point brings their own perspectives, work experiences, lifestyles, and cultures with them, and we believe that a more diverse team creates more innovative products, provides better services to customers, and helps us all grow and learn.

jobs.title: Staff, Mapping Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About Lucid

At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience.

We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility.

About the Role

The GeoAI team is building the next generation of fleet-powered mapping infrastructure that
continuously learns from vehicle observations and automatically generates, validates, and updates
map content at scale.

We are seeking a Staff Mapping Engineer to lead the development of large-scale mapping systems
that leverage data collected from engineering fleets, FOT programs, and customer vehicles to create
and maintain production-quality map assets. You will define the architecture and algorithms that
transform millions of vehicle miles into continuously improving lane-level maps, road graphs,
localization maps, map change detections, and spatial intelligence products for Navigation, ADAS,
and Autonomous Driving.

This role requires deep expertise in mapping, large-scale optimization, SLAM, sensor fusion, and
cloud-scale data processing

What You'll Do

Fleet-Scale Mapping & Map Fusion

• Develop large-scale HD mapping systems using camera, LiDAR, GNSS/IMU, and vehicle telemetry data.

• Build scalable pipelines that fuse observations from millions of fleet-driven miles into unified, continuously improving maps.

• Design multi-route and multi-vehicle map alignment, optimization, and crowdsourced mapping solutions.

HD Map Generation & Maintenance

• Create automated pipelines to extract lane geometry, road boundaries, traffic controls, crosswalks, speed limits, and localization landmarks.

• Develop confidence, validation, and quality-control frameworks that promote verified observations into production maps.

• Build automated map change detection and update systems for evolving road networks.

AI-Powered Mapping

• Apply machine learning, Spatial AI, and foundation models to automate map creation, semantic understanding, anomaly detection, and map quality evaluation.

• Drive innovation in self-supervised learning and fleet-scale mapping technologies.

Production-Scale Mapping Systems

• Design and operate cloud-based mapping platforms capable of processing petabyte-scale fleet data.

• Optimize distributed infrastructure for performance, scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency.

• Establish engineering standards, validation frameworks, and operational monitoring for production mapping systems.

• Mentor engineers and collaborate across teams to deliver end-to-end mapping solutions.

Required Qualifications

• MS or PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, Geospatial Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related field.

• 8+ years of industry experience developing large-scale mapping, localization, SLAM, robotics, or autonomous driving systems.

• Expert-level software development skills in C++ and Python.

• Deep knowledge of: SLAM Multi-view geometry Bundle adjustment Pose graph optimization Sensor fusion State estimation Geospatial systems

• Experience processing large-scale camera, LiDAR, GNSS, IMU, and vehicle telemetry datasets.

• Experience building production cloud services and distributed processing pipelines.

• Proven ability to lead complex technical initiatives across organizations

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with fleet-scale mapping systems at companies such as Tesla, Waymo, Cruise,
Zoox, Rivian, Mobileye, HERE, TomTom, or Google.
• Experience building crowdsourced mapping platforms using customer vehicle data.
• Experience with HD map generation, lane graph construction, localization maps, and map
lifecycle management.
• Experience with map compilation, map distribution, and incremental map updates.
• Experience with Spark, Ray, Kubernetes, AWS, Azure, or similar large-scale compute
platforms.
• Publications or patents related to mapping, localization, SLAM, or autonomous driving.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Patient Marketing
jobs.description:
Company introduction:

Compass Pathways plc (Nasdaq: CMPS) is a biotechnology company dedicated to unlocking urgently needed new treatment options in mental health care.

The Company is headquartered in London, UK, with a U.S. office in New Jersey. We believe mental health patients deserve the possibility of a better future. Our initial focus is developing COMP360 psilocybin, a proprietary, investigational, synthetic psilocybin treatment under evaluation for treatment-resistant depression (TRD) and post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD). COMP360 is a potentially first-in-class treatment and has Breakthrough Therapy designation from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA), as well as Innovative Licensing and Access Pathway (ILAP) designation in the UK for TRD.

We are leading the world’s largest classic psychedelic clinical program in TRD, and building upon that robust foundation, we are executing a late-stage trial evaluating COMP360 for PTSD, another condition with high unmet need. Our goal is to advance treatments that move the field of psychiatry towards treatment options that offer rapid onset and sustained durability with infrequent dosing. - Compass Pathways

Cover letter required for consideration. Please highlight your relevant and transferable skills that make you a strong fit for this role.

About Carvana
At Carvana, we’re changing the way people buy and sell cars. With an ambitious vision and a fundamentally different approach designed to be fun, fast, and fair, Carvana became the fastest-growing automotive retailer in history. We expanded nationally, went public on the New York Stock Exchange, sold our 1 millionth car, and reached the Fortune 500, all in just eight years.

Today, with 4 million retail customers and counting, Carvana is both the fastest-growing and the most profitable public automotive retailer, and we’re just getting started. We continue to raise the bar for our customers as we tackle the enormous opportunity still ahead in the largest consumer vertical.

Working here means being part of a team that embraces change, celebrates creative problem solving, and always strives to be better. At Carvana, you’ll have the opportunity to take on meaningful challenges, learn quickly, and help shape the future of automotive retail. If you’re driven to grow and make an impact as part of a collaborative team, you’ll fit right in. Learn more about what it’s like to work here from the people that already do.

This is a fully on-site position, Monday through Friday, at our corporate HQ in Tempe, Arizona.

What You’ll Do
Legal Support & Lease Administration

• Draft, review, and obtain approval for standard legal notices, landlord–tenant communications, and ancillary legal documents, under the supervision of a Manager.

• Conduct thorough lease reviews and abstracts on commercial leases; interpret lease provisions and identify key obligations, rights, and risks to support real estate, portfolio management, facilities, and legal teams.

• Lead or support lease administration workflow including estoppels, SNDAs, access requests, and other routine commercial real estate matters that do not require continuous attorney involvement.

• Support drafting efforts, review, and negotiation efforts in connection with commercial real estate leases, specifically related to lease terms, renewals, terminations, extensions, etc..

• Support lease commencement efforts, serving as a key point of contact internally and externally to coordinate lease commencement and site readiness efforts.

• Recommend and coordinate legal action as necessary; partner closely with Manager and Real Estate Legal for collaboration, or sign-off as needed.

• Work closely with Manager, Legal Operations and the broader team to identify legal workflow that can be more efficiently handled at this level, enabling attorney resources to remain focused on higher-complexity matters.

What You’ll Need

• Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution required. In lieu of a degree, a combination of relevant experience and education will be considered. A paralegal certificate or similar credential is a meaningful plus.

• 8+ years of directly relevant experience in commercial real estate — lease administration, transactional commercial real estate, or a corporate in-house/legal environment with substantial commercial property exposure (office, retail, or industrial). Multifamily or residential property management experience alone does not meet the bar.

• Demonstrated ability to independently review, interpret, and issue-spot commercial leases, notices, amendments and related contracts or real property documents, with sound judgment on when a matter requires escalation to a team lead or attorney.

• Comfortable navigating sensitive, complex landlord/tenant and counterparty communications with professionalism and discretion.

• Ability to work cross-functionally with real estate, portfolio management, facilities, market operations, expansion and launch and legal teams, and to influence outcomes and drive projects forward without formal authority over those teams.

• Proficiency in lease interpretation, contract review, and legal notice drafting; comfort with risk analysis and identifying when matters require escalation to an attorney.

• In-depth knowledge of Microsoft Office products (Word, Excel, Outlook); proficiency with Adobe Acrobat, DocuSign, Wrike (and similar project management) and other technology platforms and tools.

• Core proficiency utilizing AI tools with proven ability to create tested and reliable work product, leveraging AI resources responsibly to simplify legal and operational processes and tasks.

• Extensive organizational skills, advanced attention to detail, and strong initiative to independently complete tasks that drive greater team efficiencies.

• Enthusiasm and energy to thrive in a rapidly growing, fast-paced environment where roles continually adapt as the company evolves.

What we’ll offer in return

• Full-Time salary position with a competitive salary.

• Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits.

• 401K with company match.

• A multitude of perks including student loan payments, discounts on vehicles, benefits for your pets, and much more.

• A great wellness program to keep you healthy and happy both physically and mentally.

• Access to opportunities to expand your skill set and share your knowledge with others across the organization.

• A company culture focused on high performance and bar-raising, with vast opportunity to learn and grow.

Other requirements

• Must be able to read, write, speak, and understand English.

Of course, we’ll make any reasonable accommodations for those with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their jobs.

jobs.title: Head of Revenue Operations
jobs.description:
THE OPPORTUNITY

Casechek is on a mission to innovate the implant supply chain and bring greater transparency to the cost of patient care. From procurement to payment, Casechek automates workflows for vendor supported surgical procedures. Our Bill Only Solution provides a comprehensive system of record for Hospitals and Health Systems to manage the complexity of surgical cases with implantable medical devices, expose hidden expenses and surface revenue opportunities.

The Head of Revenue Operations owns the systems, data and processes behind Casechek's commercial organization: Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Customer Operations. You'll build the infrastructure that makes our pipeline predictable, our forecasts accurate and our customer lifecycle measurable. This covers how we land health systems through multi-stakeholder enterprise cycles, how we onboard facilities and suppliers, and how we expand across a health system's footprint. You'll report to the President & Chief Growth Officer and work closely with Operations, Finance, and Product.

Casechek is a highly collaborative environment, but our team is also self-motivated and works independently. We strongly believe that great ideas are not created in isolation! Our team interacts with our healthcare customers to understand their needs and ultimately deliver the best user experience as possible.

About Us

• Casechek is based out of Chicago’s Fulton Market, but we’re a hybrid, remote and in-person team.

• We are highly motivated and passionate about solving healthcare’s messiest problems with new technologies.

• We value diversity, curiosity, and a passion for learning. The team has a lot of advanced degrees and even a few professional musicians.

• Innovating the implant supply chain is a marathon and not a sprint – we support each other in long-term growth and value developing transferrable skills.

About You

• Hands-on and results-driven, with a builder’s mindset: comfortable rolling up your sleeves as an individual contributor while shaping the long-term direction of the function.

• Scrappy, organized, and resourceful; thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where much of the infrastructure is still being built.

• Deep Salesforce expertise, with a strong grasp of how systems, data, and integrations fit together, and a practical approach to using AI and automation to work smarter.

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills; able to partner across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Product, Finance, and Legal to build processes people actually adopt.

• Experience supporting complex enterprise sales motions with long cycles, multiple stakeholders, and procurement-heavy buyers. Healthcare or hospital-facing experience is a plus.

• Strong business and financial acumen, including fluency in forecasting, SaaS metrics, and quota, territory, and comp design.

• Data-driven and insight-oriented; able to turn complex data into clear recommendations that leadership can act on.

• Service-minded toward the commercial team: seeks to understand what creates friction for sellers and customer-facing teams, and builds systems that make their work easier.

Responsibilities

• Revenue strategy across the lifecycle – Build and run a RevOps strategy covering acquisition, implementation and go-live, facility-by-facility expansion within IDNs, supplier enrollment and monetization, renewal and retention.

• Commercial tech stack – Own and evolve the GTM stack (Salesforce, Pardot/Marketing Cloud Account Engagement and Gong) and their integrations with the Casechek platform, Google Workspace and Slack. Prioritize automation, a single source of truth and adoption by the team.

• Product to revenue data – Partner with Product and Engineering to bring platform usage into the CRM (cases processed, Bill Only volume, supplier adoption, savings delivered), making expansion, renewal risk and ROI visible to Sales and CS.

• Supplier-side revenue – Build the operating model, data and reporting for the supplier side of the platform, including enrollment, adoption and revenue opportunities with medical device manufacturers and distributors.

• Deal desk and contracting – Build a deal desk with Sales, Finance and Legal that streamlines pricing, quoting, approvals and contracting, including health-system procurement requirements, GPO/IDN contracting nuances, BAAs, and security and vendor-credentialing reviews.

• Forecasting and planning – Partner with the President and Finance on bookings and ARR forecasting, territory and account planning, building and tracking quota plans, capacity modeling and comp plan design that fit 6–18 month enterprise sales cycles.

• KPIs and insight – Define and report the metrics that run the business: pipeline coverage and velocity, win rates by segment, time-to-go-live, net revenue retention, facility penetration per health system, and supplier adoption.

• Win/loss analysis – Partner with Product Marketing to build a win/loss process and make sure loss reasons are recorded consistently in Salesforce.

• Cross-functional alignment – Align Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Implementation and Product on shared definitions, handoffs and lifecycle stages, especially the sales-to-implementation handoff, where most value is won or lost.

• Build the team over time – Start as a hands-on individual contributor running RevOps directly, then design the RevOps function across systems, analytics and deal operations.

Requirements

• 10+ years in revenue, sales or business operations, with 5+ years leading a team, and comfort working hands-on as an individual contributor while building a team over time

• Experience scaling RevOps at a growth-stage B2B SaaS company; healthcare, health-tech or hospital-facing enterprise SaaS strongly preferred

• Experience supporting complex enterprise sales motions with long cycles, multiple stakeholders and procurement-heavy buyers

• Deep Salesforce expertise, with hands-on experience in Pardot and Gong (conversation intelligence, deal and forecast insights, marketing-to-sales attribution), plus a strong grasp of integrations, automation, data architecture and practical AI use in GTM workflows

• Fluent in forecasting, SaaS metrics (ARR, NRR, CAC, LTV) and comp/territory design

• Working knowledge of regulated-data environments (HIPAA, BAAs, SOC 2) and comfort partnering with Security and Legal

Why You'll Love Working Here

• Competitive Salary & Annual Bonus – The base salary range for this role is $160,000-$190,000

• Opportunity for Long-Term Incentives (LTI) – Be part of our success with equity or long-term incentive plans that grow with the company.

• 401(k) Match – Invest in your future with our generous matching program to help you build long-term financial security.

• Work-from-Home Flexibility – Enjoy the freedom to work where you're most productive with a supportive hybrid (Chicago) or remote setup (National).

• Flexible Time Off (Unlimited PTO) – Recharge and focus on what matters most with unlimited paid time off tailored to your needs.

• Parental Leave – Take time to bond and care for your growing family with fully paid parental leave options.

• Comprehensive Medical and Dental Benefits – Prioritize your health and well-being with premium plans for you and your family.

• Brand-New Pro-Level Laptop – Equipped with top-tier tools and technology to set you up for success from day one.

• Annual Education Budget – Expand your skills and knowledge with dedicated funding for courses, certifications, and learning resources.

jobs.title: Developer Marketer
jobs.description:
ABOUT BLACKSMITH

 - We started by building infrastructure to run CI workloads really fast. Our first product helps companies run GitHub Actions substantially faster and cheaper by owning and operating our own global fleet of bare-metal machines rather than renting generic cloud VMs.

 - Today, we orchestrate tens of millions of Firecracker VMs each week, running CI for 10,000+ companies and tens of millions in ARR. We’ve grown 20x so far in 2026.

 - We operate thousands of bare-metal machines across multiple regions, regularly schedule 300k+ vCPUs concurrently, and run a petabyte-scale Ceph cluster that we manage ourselves.

 - We’ve raised $125M from Seed to Series C, led by Sequoia, Google Ventures (GV) & Peak XV Partners, and we’re intentionally building a small, but exceptional team.

 - Blacksmith was founded by a team with deep systems and scaling experience, including building search/ads infrastructure at Faire, and operating large distributed systems at Cockroach Labs. Our GTM is led by Jon Boyer, formerly Head of Sales at Zapier.

 - We're now extending the same CI infrastructure into a broader platform: running agent sandboxes at scale and building our own background coding agent on top of it.




OUR DEVELOPER MARKETER

At Blacksmith, we ship a lot: new products, new features, and a steady stream of engineering work worth showing off. But the more we build and the faster we move, the wider the gap between what Blacksmith can do and what developers know it can do. Closing that gap is the job.

We're looking for a Developer Marketer who is equally at home in a codebase and a content calendar to own how developers find, understand, and adopt Blacksmith. You'll be embedded with our engineering team, with a front-row seat to what we’re building and why it matters. You’ll also work closely with the founders and growth team to shape how we launch and how developers discover us.




WHAT YOU'LL OWN


Documentation as a product

For many developers, our docs https://docs.blacksmith.sh/ are their first real impression of our products.

 - Keep them accurate and informative as our products evolve, and cut anything that doesn't earn its place.

 - Redefine how they look and read.

 - Make them as useful to coding agents as to the people using them.

Launch machinery

We have an exciting roadmap of products and features shipping rapidly, and each one deserves to land.

 - Plan and run launches of every size, from new products to new features, moving fast without cutting corners.

 - Build a repeatable playbook for each launch day and beyond: the announcement, media kit, social posts, email blasts, customer communications, and follow-up content in the weeks thereafter (e.g., real metrics and customer quotes).

 - Help enable our sales team to speak to what's new as soon as it ships.

 - Track engagement and adoption metrics after a launch to keep refining the strategy over time.

Social media presence

 - Publish a regular and engaging stream of content on X, LinkedIn, etc.

 - Identify the most interesting work our engineers are doing and turn it into something worth sharing.

 - Create high-quality and engaging short videos and graphics.

 - Join the conversation: engage with the developer ecosystem on our socials, building brand awareness and bringing back product feedback to our team.

Technical writing and customer stories

 - Help our engineers convey what they’re building in written form and edit until the message lands.

 - Collaborate with Growth to identify and fill gaps in topics where developers and AI search can't find us yet.

 - Surface insights from real customer experiences https://www.blacksmith.sh/customers and results to feed back into our messaging, content, and proof for what we’re building.

What this role isn't

 - A sales-materials job (i.e., not primarily pitch decks and sales enablement).

 - Paid, brand or demand-gen marketing.

 - Community management or events.

 - Writing a strategy doc and relying on others to build and ship it.




YOU'RE A GOOD FIT IF YOU

 - Are technical. You've built software and can read a PR or design doc and explain why it matters. Some of the best people for this role are developers seeking a more creative outlet or marketers who code.

 - Can deeply understand our product and roadmap well enough to demo it from memory.

 - Have shipped things that resonate with developers: docs, launches, videos, threads, posts.

 - Write engaging and convincing copy with a point of view (and like a developer speaking to developers).

 - Are “chronically” online and know what's trending on developer X and Hacker News.

 - Have a high motor. You spot problems and fix them without being asked.

 - Enjoy working in person 5 days a week in SF or NYC.




BONUS

 - You've run launches at a developer tools or infrastructure company.

 - You make videos and graphics yourself, or are eager to learn with agentic tools.

 - You've built and maintained an audience of your own.

 - You have experience testing and measuring what works (from social media engagement to customer success metrics).
   
   


HOW WE HIRE

 - An intro call, then 1-2 conversations with a founder or member of the team.

 - On-site: we give you an example product / feature in the morning, you plan and build its launch (assets, launch-day posts, week-one and week-two plan), and we review it together at the end of the day




COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

 - Medical, Vision, and Dental insurance.

 - Competitive base + equity.

 - 401k match.

 - Unlimited PTO.

 - Annual offsite.

 - Early-exercise stock options

 - 12 weeks fully paid parental leave (US)

jobs.title: Manager - Transmission Engineering
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Atwell, LLC is a bold leader in the consulting, engineering, and construction services industry, delivering a broad range of creative solutions to clients in the real estate & land development, and energy markets. We have a strong national presence and a diverse, award-winning project portfolio. Atwell is a privately owned company, with 2,000+ passionate team members across 75+ locations and growing!

Atwell, LLC is a proud recipient of the following 2025 awards:

• Recognized in Crain's “Fast 50” as one of the fastest-growing companies (#14)

• Recognized as the 2025 ENR Design Firm of the year for the Southeastern US

About the Position

The Manager - Transmission leads teams of engineers, designers, drafters, technicians, and other technical professionals responsible for the accurate, timely, and quality completion of overhead transmission and related transmission line engineering scopes. This role combines people leadership, technical oversight, workload and resource planning, operational management, and project-delivery support to ensure appropriate project coverage and consistent achievement of scope, schedule, budget, quality, safety, and client objectives. In this role, an employee will be expected to demonstrate proficiency in regard to the essential functions of the job below.

Essential Responsibilities

• Lead, manage, mentor, and develop engineers, designers, drafters, technicians, and other technical professionals supporting transmission projects.

• Maintain accountability for the accurate, timely, and quality completion of transmission engineering and design scopes assigned to the team.

• Establish clear expectations and support employee development through coaching, feedback, training, performance management, individualized development planning, and succession planning.

• Assess team strengths, development needs, and technical capabilities and coordinate appropriate training, mentoring, and work assignments.

• Foster a collaborative, accountable, inclusive, and high-performing team environment focused on quality, safety, professional growth, and continuous improvement.

• Lead workload forecasting, resource planning, staffing decisions, team scheduling, and project-performance monitoring to maintain appropriate project coverage.

• Maintain visibility into active projects, milestone dates, resource assignments, estimate-to-complete information, and workload constraints.

• Coordinate project assignments and team priorities with Project Managers, technical leaders, operations, and organizational leadership.

• Monitor team level project budgets, estimate-to-complete information, and financial performance in coordination with Project Managers and organizational leadership.

• Identify and address workload, resource, schedule, quality, safety, and project delivery risks before they affect project continuity or client commitments.

• Drive improvements in standards, workflows, tools, and team practices that enhance quality, consistency, efficiency, predictability, and project performance.

• Oversee the planning, coordination, and detailed engineering and design of overhead transmission and related distribution-line projects from small to large scale.

• Oversee development and review of design packages, including plan and profile drawings, pole-assembly details, pole grounding and guying details, steel framing details, structure loading diagrams, structure design and fabrication details, foundation design, construction details, and supporting calculation packages.

• Provide or coordinate technical and QA/QC reviews of engineering calculations, models, drawings, specifications, reports, and construction deliverables to support quality, accuracy, constructability, and compliance.

• Ensure work reflects applicable utility and client requirements, engineering standards, structural-design principles, material requirements, and construction practices.

• Provide technical guidance and training to engineers and technical staff and coordinate work across engineering, design, field, project-management, client, and contractor stakeholders.

• Identify, address, and escalate technical, constructability, quality, coordination, and project-delivery concerns to support timely resolution and project continuity.

• Support project planning and execution to help ensure assigned work is delivered within established scope, schedule, budget, technical, safety, and quality requirements.

• Prepare or support technical documents and reports, including cost estimates, budget reports, proposals, studies, schedules, assumptions, and project-change documentation.

• Partner with Project Managers and technical leaders to coordinate multidisciplinary work and maintain appropriate coverage across project scopes.

• Support proposal development, marketing activities, client pursuits, and business development through technical input and resource-planning support.

• Support client relationships and communications by helping resolve technical and delivery concerns and promoting consistent, responsive service.

• Perform other job-related responsibilities as assigned.

Must-Have Qualifications

• Demonstrated ability to lead, coach, develop, and hold accountable multidisciplinary transmission engineering and design teams.

• Advanced knowledge of overhead transmission and related distribution-line engineering, design, project delivery, applicable utility standards, and construction practices.

• Advanced knowledge of plan and profile design, structure spotting, pole assemblies, grounding and guying, structure loading, steel framing, foundations, structural analysis, and construction documentation.

• Ability to maintain accountability for team deliverable quality, schedule performance, work efficiency, and adherence to established processes.

• Strong workload-planning and resource-forecasting skills, including team assignments, project coverage, milestone dates, and estimate-to-complete information.

• Working knowledge of project budgets, financial performance, engineering estimates, project controls, and operational performance measures.

• Strong technical-review and QA/QC capabilities with the ability to identify engineering, constructability, compliance, coordination, quality, and execution concerns.

• Ability to investigate and resolve technical, workload, resource, safety, and project-delivery concerns and escalate issues appropriately.

• Ability to support technical scopes, estimates, schedules, assumptions, proposals, studies, and project-change documentation.

• Strong written, verbal, interpersonal, coaching, conflict-resolution, and stakeholder-communication skills.

• Ability to collaborate effectively with Project Managers, Technical Advisors, organizational leaders, clients, utilities, contractors, field personnel, and multidisciplinary teams.

• Advanced proficiency with PLS-CADD and proficiency with AutoCAD; knowledge of structure-spotting and transmission-line design applications applicable to assigned work.

• Proficiency with engineering, design-review, project-delivery, workload-planning, and business-productivity tools applicable to transmission engineering.

• Demonstrates commitment to Atwell quality and safety standards, employee development, ethical conduct, accountability, and continuous improvement.

• Bachelor degree in Civil Engineering, Civil Engineering Technology, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related engineering or technical discipline from an accredited institution.

• Professional Engineer (PE) license required.

• 6-10 years of experience in overhead transmission-line, distribution-line, structural, civil, mechanical, engineering, design, field, or related technical field.

• Experience managing team workload, resource assignments, schedules, project coverage, and technical deliverables across multiple projects.

• Experience producing or reviewing transmission-line design packages, structure-loading or foundation work, engineering calculations, and construction documentation.

• Experience supporting QA/QC, engineering estimates, project budgets, forecasting, risk management, proposals, client relationships, and operational improvement.

Additional Position Details

• Work is performed in a professional work environment, with work location and reporting expectations determined by business needs and position requirements. Some field work may be required.

• Must be able to remain in a stationary position for extended periods and operate a computer and other office productivity equipment.

• Frequently communicates and collaborates with clients, engineers, designers, contractors, vendors, and project stakeholders.

• Must be able to move around project sites and work in indoor or outdoor environments as required.

• Travel may be required based on client and project needs.

Cultural Fit

• Independent yet Collaborative

• Dependable

• Creative Problem Solver

• Natural Communicator

• Flexible

• Results Oriented

• Client Focused

• Enthusiastic

Fair Labor Standards Act

• Exempt | Overtime pay is not required.

Disclaimer

• Must be legally authorized to work in the USA.

• If current job responsibilities differ from assigned duties, please contact Human Resources.

Pay Range

Atwell Benefits: To attract and retain the best professionals in the industry, we aim to provide an excellent working environment and a progressive benefits program designed to support your personal and professional needs.

jobs.title: Warehouse Supervisor
jobs.description:
About Stitch Fix, Inc.

Stitch Fix (NASDAQ: SFIX) Stitch Fix is redefining retail by combining human creativity with advanced data science and Generative AI. As we build the future of personalized shopping, we’re equally committed to building yours.  We believe in investing in our team as much as our technology. Join us to be a trendsetter in the industry and help us redefine what’s possible for our clients, while we help you reach your full potential.

About the Role

Our Warehouse Supervisors at Stitch Fix are frontline leaders within our operations organization, responsible for leading large teams of hourly employees to achieve daily performance goals while fostering a positive and inclusive work environment. This role drives day-to-day execution within a core department while supporting broader site and company initiatives. You will partner with operations leadership and cross-functional teams to deliver strong business results, enhance team performance, and bring Stitch Fix’s culture and values to life.

Responsibilities

• Lead, coach, and develop a large team of hourly employees to achieve daily operational and throughput goals

• Deliver onboarding, training, and ongoing coaching to support employee growth and engagement
