jobs.title: Senior Assembly Integration and Test Technician
jobs.description:
ABOUT ROCKET LAB

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

SPACE SYSTEMS

Rocket Lab’s Space Systems division builds complete spacecraft, precision payloads to the components and subsystems that allow them to thrive in space including solar panels, flight software, star trackers, optical systems, separation systems, and radios.

The Space Systems division has enabled more than 1,700 missions, ranging from interplanetary exploration, in-space manufacturing to national security and defense initiatives. We have built spacecraft, payloads, and components for missions to the Moon and Mars, working with partners including NASA, the Space Development Agency, and the U.S. Space Force. Whether it’s a single high-performance spacecraft, constellation, or the vertically integrated components that help get to space — our Space Systems division is empowering the boldest and most ambitious space missions.

SENIOR ASSEMBLY, INTEGRATION & TEST TECHNICIAN

Rocket Lab Optical Systems solves mission-critical space domain and Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance challenges for Department of Defense and Intelligence Community customers. Our vision is to revolutionize the space-based payload market with innovative and novel designs for space, terrestrial, and airborne environments. Building on more than 20 years of electro-optical and infrared systems innovation from Geost, Rocket Lab Optical Systems delivers solutions to the warfighter for responsive, scalable sensing solutions across all orbital domains.

As a Senior Assembly, Integration and Test Technician for Rocket Lab Optical Systems in Tucson, AZ, you will have the opportunity to support Tranche 3 of the U.S. Space Development Agency's Proliferated Warfighter Space Architecture by integrating advanced electro-optical space payloads.

WHAT YOU’LL GET TO DO:

• Lead integration, alignment, calibration, and verification activities for advanced EO/IR optical payloads used in spaceborne sensor systems

• Execute hands-on optical integration tasks including optical bench setup, alignment, metrology, and environmental test readiness—we build beautiful things

• Develop and refine test procedures, optical characterization methods, and performance-validation processes

• Support environmental tests (TVAC, vibe, shock), monitor optical performance, and ensure compliance with mission requirements

• Drive resolution of integration issues, test anomalies, and optical performance deviations—we hustle and we do the impossible

• Work cross-functionally with Mechanical, Electrical, Systems, and AIT teams to ensure seamless optical-mechanical-electrical integration

• Support customer reviews, data packages, and technical briefings

• Identify opportunities to improve alignment methods, test tooling, and data-analysis workflows

YOU’LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS AS AN ASSEMBLY, INTEGRATION AND TEST TECHNICIAN:

• High school diploma and 4+ years of experience

• U.S. citizenship with ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance

• Experience in optical system integration, test, or verification

• Hands-on experience with optical alignment, metrology, interferometry, and imaging-system characterization

• Familiarity with optical benches, cleanroom practices, contamination control, and environmental testing

• Strong data analysis, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills

THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:

• Experience with EO/IR payloads, infrared focal planes, or space-based sensor systems

• Experience implementing alignment procedures, test scripts, and verification plans

• Experience with automated test equipment or optical STE

This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas.

WHAT TO EXPECT

We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other’s backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.

jobs.title: AI Architect
jobs.description:
About the Role

We are building AI capabilities that improve important human workflows across the company. As AI Architect, you will set the technical direction for how we design, evaluate, integrate, and operate AI systems. You will help teams choose the right approach for each problem—from conventional software and deterministic workflows to retrieval-augmented systems and agents—and ensure those systems meet clear standards for quality, reliability, safety, and value.

This is a strategic, hands-on role. You will establish reusable architecture and evaluation practices, guide cross-functional teams, and prototype or validate key patterns where needed. You will partner with product and engineering leaders to turn high-value opportunities into systems that can be measured and operated in production.

What You'll Do

• Set AI architecture direction: define reference architectures and design principles for AI services, agents, model integrations, data and context flows, tools, and human review. Make trade-offs among quality, autonomy, reliability, latency, cost, and complexity.

• Build the evaluation discipline: help teams define expected behavior and success measures; design representative datasets and evaluation methods; write and maintain evals; establish regression checks and quality thresholds; and use results to prioritize improvements.

• Guide production readiness: shape shared practices for tracing and observability, versioning, monitoring, incident response, privacy, security, and lifecycle management of AI systems.

• Enable teams to ship: create reusable patterns, reference implementations, and practical guidance. Coach engineers through architecture reviews and help teams move valuable work from prototype to production.

• Connect architecture to outcomes: partner with product, operations, and domain teams to identify workflow needs and measure whether AI improves completion, quality, time, or other agreed outcomes.

• Stay close to implementation: prototype high-risk or foundational designs, review critical implementations, and use production evidence to refine architecture.

• Track the evolving ecosystem: evaluate models, agent runtimes, orchestration approaches, and evaluation tooling against our requirements, and recommend adoption based on evidence.

What We're Looking For

• At least 8 years of experience in backend software development.

• At least 3 years of experience in AI architecture with demonstrated organization-wide impact.

• Strong experience designing and delivering production software systems, with substantial work on AI/ML-powered products or services.

• A track record of setting technical direction across teams and influencing decisions through evidence and collaboration.

• Practical understanding of LLM applications, including retrieval and context construction, tool use, agent patterns, model selection, and failure handling.

• Experience defining quality expectations and building evaluations for AI behavior; able to connect offline evaluations to production outcomes.

• Sound judgment about where AI is appropriate and when a simpler deterministic approach is better.

• Experience with production concerns such as observability, privacy and security, reliability, cost, latency, and safe human escalation.

• Clear communication across engineering, product, and executive audiences, with a builder's mindset and comfort prototyping and reviewing implementation.

Helpful Experience:

• Establishing shared AI platforms, service patterns, or architecture standards across multiple teams.

• Creating evaluation datasets, test harnesses, regression suites, or quality dashboards for LLM or agent systems.

• Operating AI products with measurable user or business outcomes.

• Working with cloud AI platforms, model APIs, agent frameworks, tracing/evaluation tools, and data platforms. Adaptable judgment matters more than one vendor's tools.

jobs.title: Remote Bilingual Therapist (Haitian Creole) – Older Adults (LCSW, LMFT, LMHC)
jobs.description:
Do the work you trained for, without the parts that burn you out. Sailor Health is hiring bilingual English/Haitian Creole licensed mental health therapists to provide telehealth therapy to Haitian Creole-speaking older adults, fully from home. We fill your caseload, handle billing and admin, and give you real clinical support, so your time goes to patients. Don’t just take our word for it: read what our therapists say in our Indeed reviews.




🌊 ABOUT SAILOR HEALTH

Older adults are too often overlooked by mental healthcare, and those who speak Haitian Creole face even fewer options. Sailor Health exists to change that. Through Medicare-covered therapy, care navigation, and healthcare advocacy, we help older adults move through grief, loss, isolation, and life’s hardest transitions with more ease and peace of mind.

Our model is built around their needs and yours:

 - We handle everything outside the session. Care Navigators and Healthcare Advocates take on patients’ non-clinical needs, so your work stays clinical.

 - You’re part of a team. Clinical Quality Leads provide ongoing consultation, and our provider support team answers questions as they come up.

 - Language-concordant care by design. Haitian Creole-speaking patients are matched with Haitian Creole-speaking clinicians. You won’t be working through an interpreter or translating for the rest of the team.




⭐ THE POSITION

Location: Fully remote, anywhere in the U.S. | Schedule: You set it, 7 days a week available

We’re hiring independently licensed bilingual therapists for part-time or full-time roles, paid per session. Choose the setup that fits your life:

 - 1099 contractor: starting at 15 hours per week

 - W2 employee: starting at 25 hours per week, with full benefits




💙 WHAT WE OFFER

 - A full caseload, built for you. Share your availability and we’ll match you with Haitian Creole-speaking older adults who fit your approach. No marketing, no chasing referrals. Most clinicians have a full caseload within a few weeks.

 - Support that’s actually there. A dedicated clinical lead and live admin help. Our providers tell us it’s the most supported they’ve felt in telehealth.

 - Your schedule, your call. Work the days and hours that suit you. No on-call, no required evenings.

 - Less paperwork, more therapy. Our telehealth platform and AI documentation assistant handle the busywork.

 - Room to grow. Free CEUs, geriatric-focused training, and clinical consultation with experienced directors.

 - Pay that works for you. 1099 clinicians earn competitive per-session rates, paid as full cash compensation.

 - Full benefits for W2 clinicians (25+ hours/week). Health, dental, and vision coverage, plus a 401(k) with up to 3.5% employer match.




💻 YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Provide evidence-based psychotherapy to Haitian Creole-speaking older adults via telehealth

 - Conduct sessions fluently in Haitian Creole, meeting patients in their language and cultural context

 - Build individualized treatment plans around each patient’s goals and needs

 - Manage your own caseload and clinical decisions, with a supportive care team behind you

 - Complete documentation in our EMR, with AI-assisted notes

 - Join regular, paid case consultations with experienced clinical leaders




📋 QUALIFICATIONS

 - Must be located in the United States

 - Active, independent clinical license (LCSW, LMFT, LPC, LMHC, or equivalent) in the state where this role is posted

 - Fluent in English and Haitian Creole, able to conduct full therapy sessions in Haitian Creole

 - Master’s or doctoral degree in social work, counseling, psychology, or marriage and family therapy

 - Experience with older adult or geriatric populations preferred

 - Comfortable with telehealth platforms and electronic health records

 - Medicare billing experience a plus (we handle billing either way)




✅ WHO THRIVES AT SAILOR

 - You care about the mission. Supporting older adults through grief, loss, and the challenges of later life feels meaningful to you.

 - You know what language access means clinically. Meeting a patient in their native language is one of the most powerful things a therapist can offer, especially in later life.

 - You understand this population. Maybe you’ve spent years working with older adults, or you’re later in your own career and chose this work on purpose.

 - You do your best work on a team. You want colleagues, a clinical lead, and real support, not just a login and good wishes.

 - You like independence with backup. You trust your clinical judgment and want infrastructure behind you, not oversight on top of you.




🚀 APPLY TODAY

If you want a full caseload, a flexible schedule, and a team that has your back while you serve Haitian Creole-speaking older adults in their own language, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today, and our recruiting team will guide you through every step of the process.

Learn more: https://www.sailorhealth.com/careers/therapy

jobs.title: Sales Programs, Sales Enablement
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Our co-founders are Bret Taylor https://www.linkedin.com/in/brettaylor/ and Clay Bavor https://www.linkedin.com/in/claybavor/. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own the end-to-end lifecycle of sales plays: intake, design, build, launch, adoption, and retirement

 - Work with Product Marketing, Product, Sales Leadership, and Sales Engineering to decide which plays get built and in what order

 - Build play assets: messaging, discovery guides, demo flows, competitive battlecards, objection handling, and customer proof points

 - Train sellers and SEs on new plays through live sessions, async content, and practice

 - Define how each play's success is measured (usage, pipeline influence, win rate where attributable) and report on it

 - Retire or update plays that aren't working

 - Create the intake and prioritization process for play requests

 - Build plays so they can be adapted for regional teams, including our London office


WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - 4+ years in sales enablement, sales programs, product marketing, or a related field at a B2B software company

 - Experience building and launching sales plays or go-to-market programs for both sellers and technical teams

 - Ability to say no and prioritize across competing requests from senior stakeholders

 - Strong writing and facilitation skills

 - Comfort with data, and honesty about what can and can't be attributed to enablement


EVEN BETTER…

 - Experience in AI or enterprise software sales environments

 - Experience with enablement and conversation-intelligence tools (e.g., [Highspot, Seismic, Gong])

 - Prior experience as a seller or SE


OUR VALUES

 - Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.

 - Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it.

 - Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. We are proud of the products we produce. We continuously self-reflect to continuously self-improve.

 - Intensity: We know we don’t have the luxury of patience. We play to win. We care about our product being the best, and when it isn’t, we fix it. When we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

 - Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements.


WHAT WE OFFER

We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:

 - Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

 - Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

 - Life insurance and disability benefits

 - Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

 - Parental leave

 - Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot

 - Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized 

 - Discretionary benefit stipend giving people the ability to spend where it matters most

 - Free alphorn lessons

These benefits are further detailed in Sierra's policies, may vary by region, and are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefits plans. Eligible full-time employees can participate in Sierra's equity plans subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies.


BE YOU, WITH US

We're working to bring the transformative power of AI to every organization in the world. To do so, it is important to us that the diversity of our employees represents the diversity of our customers. We believe that our work and culture are better when we encourage, support, and respect different skills and experiences represented within our team. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. We strive to evaluate all applicants consistently without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other legally protected class.

jobs.title: Context Director
jobs.description:
Who We Are

UnitedMasters, Inc. is a first-of-its-kind company that lives at the intersection of culture, tech and storytelling. Through our creative solutions company, Translation, we build ideas that transcend traditional marketing to

drive business results through cultural impact. Through our music tech platform, UnitedMasters, we power the careers of independent artists through music distribution services and partnership opportunities with the world’s biggest brands. As one-company, we are building a world where cultural capital is equitably exchanged at scale by serving as the go-to source for shared gains between artists and brands.

If this description makes you feel like running through a brick wall, you’re in the right place.

The Role

Context Planning is the connective tissue between what we make and who we’re making it for. This is a team that only exists at Translation and we built it to help brands diffuse their ideas through culture by focusing on where, when and who they live through.

This role is for a leader who can translate raw insight into real influence, help brands find their voice inside the communities they are looking to engage with, and build systems that make great ideas scale. At your core, you're not just a comms planner. You’re a front row student of culture, a campaign conductor, and an idea amplifier. The Context Director is a leadership position that demands creative foresight, cultural nuance, business acumen, cross-functional collaboration, and a deep connection to what’s moving the world today.

What You’ll Do

Functional Skills

• Cultural Research: Lead and assign cultural deep dives that inform strategy and creative development.

• Comms Planning: Own authorship of holistic GTM plans that connect the dots creatively while translating business objectives into actionable rollouts over time and space/channels.

• Casting & Talent Strategy: Lead authorship of casting filters that help identify talent who personify our campaign message while ensuring brand safety and creative alignment.

• Creative World-Building: Analyze hero deliverables (e.g., film scripts) and provide cultural nuance that infuses insider fan perspective in the form Easter eggs, and additional engagement tactics that will resonate with core audience members.

• Convergence & Collaboration: Facilitate onboarding for new hires to ensure alignment on Context’s function and value. Partner across PR, Media, and Social teams to preserve creative integrity and contextual fluency from pitch to publish.

• Leadership & Mentorship: Serve as a core member of the business leadership team, aligning day-to-day execution with our broader One Company Vision. Mentor DRs across IC1–IC3 levels and informally coach team members outside your direct reporting line.

Who You Are

• A systems thinker who can orchestrate brand storytelling through people, platforms, and moments.

• A culture junkie with strong intuition and analytical rigor—you know what’s next, and why it matters.

• A collaborator who’s equally fluent in creative, strategy, talent, and media environments.

• A researcher at heart, with a passion for ethnography, behavioral analysis, and emerging platforms.

• A mentor and motivator who uplifts junior talent and brings out the best in cross-functional teams.

Qualifications

• 7–9 years experience in cultural strategy, brand planning, or creative strategy roles.

• Proven experience leading multi-channel campaigns from insight through execution.

• Strong writing and storytelling skills—must be comfortable presenting work to senior leaders and clients.

• Proficiency in Keynote, Google Suite, and qualitative research tools.

• Deep understanding of subcultures, niche internet communities, and artist ecosystems.

• Bonus: Background or minor in a creative craft, artistic discipline, or subcultural space.

About UnitedMasters, Inc.

UnitedMasters Inc. represents the creative solutions company, Translation, and the leading software and services platform for independent creators, UnitedMasters. UnitedMasters enables ownership, exposure, and new paths for financial return for independent creators, while Translation helps brands leverage the power of contemporary culture to achieve transformational growth. Combined, UnitedMasters, Inc. is the world’s leading marketplace for cultural capital, connecting independent artists and brands to realize a future in which all creators own their future. Backed by Alphabet, Andreessen Horowitz, and Apple, UnitedMasters, Inc. is reimagining how brands and artists come together to tell their stories, build profitable growth, and push culture forward.

Salary Hiring Range: $120,000 - $140,000

Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of many compensation, benefits and other reward opportunities we provide (e.g. bonus, stock options, 401(k) match, etc.)

Individual pay rate decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company.  We expect the majority of the candidates who are offered roles at our company to fall healthily throughout the range based on these factors.

The range above is for the expectations as laid out in the job description, however we are often open to a wide variety of profiles, and recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this job description as posted.  If that ends up being the case, the updated salary range will be communicated with you as a candidate.

The salary range above is for the NY/CA.  As a company, we have a location based strategy, which means the salary range could be lower or higher than this if the role is hired in another location.

jobs.title: Lead Childcare Teacher
jobs.description:
Shape a child’s very first learning experiences. At Guidepost Montessori, our Lead Infant and Toddler Teachers create calm, nurturing environments where children are respected as capable individuals from the very beginning.

If you’re passionate about early childhood development and want to lead a thoughtfully designed classroom that supports independence, movement, and discovery, we’d love to meet you.

As a Lead Infant or Toddler Teacher (Guide), you’ll lead a mixed-age classroom (ages 0–3) in a Montessori environment intentionally designed to support each child’s natural development.

In Montessori, the environment and the guide work together to nurture independence, curiosity, and confidence. You’ll thoughtfully prepare the classroom, observe each child closely, and provide individualized care that honors their unique rhythms and needs.

Most importantly, you’ll help infants develop trust in themselves and the world around them laying the foundation for lifelong learning.

What You’ll Do

• Observe each child to understand and support their physical, emotional, and cognitive development

• Respect and follow each child’s natural rhythms for sleeping, eating, and toileting

• Prepare and maintain a beautiful, orderly environment that fosters trust, movement, and exploration

• Support independence by encouraging children to participate in care activities

• Build warm, meaningful relationships with children and families

• Partner closely with parents to support each child’s growth and development

• Lead and collaborate with classroom team members to create a strong, respectful community

The Montessori Prepared Environment

Every Guidepost infant and toddler classroom is fully equipped with high-quality Montessori materials and thoughtfully designed to support movement, exploration, and independence.

Our infant environments include:

• Open floor space for movement and exploration

• Child-sized furniture and materials

• Curriculum that supports independence in feeding, dressing, and toileting

• Scientifically designed materials for fine and gross motor development

• Natural elements like real plants, cozy rugs, and abundant natural light

• Beautiful, breakable materials made from wood and metal rather than plastic

• Opportunities for climbing, crawling, and discovery without restrictive devices

What We’re Looking For

• Interest in pursuing fully sponsored Montessori certification through our Prepared Montessorian Institute, or prior Montessori diploma

• Experience working with children ages 0–3 in a daycare, preschool, or early childcare setting

• Alignment with child-led educational philosophies (Montessori, Reggio Emilia, or similar)

• Required ECE or Child Development credits

• Bachelor’s degree (Child related field)

What We Offer

• Sponsored Montessori diploma training and ongoing professional development

• Competitive salary: $40,000 - $50,000 depending on experience and education

• Health, dental, and vision insurance

• Paid time off and paid holidays

• 75% tuition discount for up to two children at any Guidepost school

• A collaborative community of peers and mentors

• Clear pathways for career growth and leadership advancement

About Guidepost Montessori

Guidepost Montessori is a growing network of over 100 schools across the U.S. and Asia, serving children from 3 months to 6 years old in our Nido, Toddler, and Children’s House programs.

We believe children are capable and we design environments that empower them to explore, grow, and flourish. Our mission is to transform education by nurturing independence, joy, and lifelong learning.

If you’re passionate about early childhood, excited to partner with families, and ready to lead with purpose, we’d love to welcome you to our community.

Apply today and help shape the earliest years of learning.

• Serve as a security engineering SME for containerized environments, service mesh technologies, and microservices.

• Design, implement, and manage security controls for containerized workload solutions, including image scanning, firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, endpoint protection, encryption mechanisms, runtime protection, role-based access control (RBAC), and network segmentation to ensure the organization’s networks and systems remain secure.

• Integrate security into CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps workflows, ensuring compliance with RMF, NIST SP 800-53, ICD 503, and FedRAMP requirements.

• Configure and optimize security monitoring and logging solutions and work with container security tools such as Prisma Cloud or similar.

• Monitor network traffic, system logs, and security alerts to detect and respond to potential security incidents; analyze and investigate anomalies and security breaches and take appropriate actions to mitigate risks; and develop and implement incident response plans to address security breaches, incidents, and other security concerns.

• Monitor and assess threat intelligence feeds, conduct threat analysis, and perform risk assessments to proactively identify emerging threats and vulnerabilities.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams—including platform engineers, ISSOs, developers, IT, software development, and compliance—to establish, embed, and enforce security policies, standards, and procedures throughout the system lifecycle, integrate security into all phases of the development lifecycle, and ensure a comprehensive approach to cybersecurity.

• Conduct regular security assessments of container orchestration platforms, microservices, and APIs to identify vulnerabilities and weaknesses in systems, networks, and applications and recommend mitigations.

• Maintain thorough and accurate documentation of security architecture processes, control implementation procedures, configurations, and continuous monitoring strategies, and prepare detailed reports on security findings, incidents, and actions taken.

What you’ll need to succeed:

• Active TS/SCI

• CISSP or equivalent certification to support DoD 8140 requirements.

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field.

• 7+ years of experience as a cybersecurity engineer specializing in designing and building implementations of required security controls and implementing continuous monitoring and auditing of solutions for compliance with security controls, with strong experience in these areas (e.g., NIST SP 800-53, RMF, ICD 503, FISMA, FedRAMP).

• Strong skills in specifying and implementing log collection into tools (Splunk) and querying and analyzing aggregated logs to identify security-relevant anomalies or risks.

• Experience with security tools such as Fortify, Acunetix, and Prisma Cloud.

• Proficiency in incident response, security incident handling, and forensic analysis techniques.

• Hands-on experience implementing and validating security controls within a containerized/Kubernetes/DevSecOps IL5/IL6+ environment.

• Experience performing periodic security checks to support continuous monitoring aligned with the NIST Risk Management Framework.

• Strong understanding of network protocols, operating systems, and infrastructure components.

• Effective communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

SALARY RANGE: $190,000 - $280,000

The salary range for this position is determined based on qualifications, skills, and relevant experience. The final salary offered will be determined based on several factors including:

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Product Design
jobs.description:
LIFE AT UIPATH

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?



About the team

Vertical Solutions is where UiPath brings agentic AI into some of the world's most complex and demanding industries: healthcare and life sciences, financial services, and the office of the CFO.

An AI decision here can shape how a claim is reviewed, how a patient's care progresses, or how a financial close is completed. The stakes are high, and so is the bar. Regulated does not mean complicated. We believe enterprise software should feel as clear, intuitive, and thoughtfully designed as the best consumer applications.

Our designers are builders. We design in code with AI tools like Claude and Codex, co-create with customers, and ship directly to production alongside our engineering partners. AI isn't just what we design for; it's fundamentally changing how we work.

We're looking for a Senior Manager, Product Design who can lead this next chapter: someone who thinks beyond individual products, connects experiences across industries, and builds the systems, strategies, and teams that make exceptional design scalable.

About the role

As Senior Manager, Product Design, you'll lead a team of senior and principal-level product designers responsible for user experiences across UiPath's Vertical Solutions portfolio.

This is not a traditional design management role focused on assigning work, managing deliverables, or overseeing design reviews. Your team already knows how to execute. Your opportunity is to help them see further, think bigger, and create more cohesive experiences across products and industries.

You'll set the design strategy for the Vertical Solutions portfolio, turn workflows that recur across industries (reviews, approvals, exception handling, human oversight of agents) into shared patterns, and build design systems that accelerate delivery without compromising quality.

You'll also shape how AI transforms the design discipline itself. AI is collapsing the distance between an idea and working software, and that changes what design craft, collaboration, and quality look like. You'll lead this shift from the front, setting the workflows, standards, and quality bar that make AI-forward design work at scale.

What you'll do

 - Set the design strategy. Define and communicate a cohesive, forward-looking experience vision across multiple products, industries, and business workflows. Connect near-term execution to longer-term product and design priorities.

 - Lead and empower an exceptional team. Manage and develop the team, providing strategic direction, thoughtful feedback, and the autonomy they need to do their best work.

 - Connect the dots across products. Identify the user needs and interaction patterns shared across healthcare, financial services, and finance operations, and turn individual solutions into reusable components and patterns that improve consistency, quality, and speed across the portfolio.

 - Lead AI-native design and delivery. Set how the team designs and builds with AI tools like Claude Code and Codex. Make working code and shipping to production, not static handoffs, the default way design gets delivered.

 - Partner deeply with product and engineering. Operate as an integrated member of cross-functional teams that plan, build, and ship together, influencing priorities, navigating tradeoffs, and ensuring design considerations shape product decisions from the beginning.

 - Stay connected to customers. Champion user research, direct customer engagement, and a deep understanding of how people work across different industries. Ensure product decisions reflect real user needs rather than assumptions.

 - Influence and advocate. Communicate design strategy and build alignment with senior product, engineering, and business leaders.

 - Stay hands-on. Build and ship yourself when it matters, critique work, and dig into complex design challenges with the team.

What we're looking for

 - Proven experience leading product design teams, including at least two years managing a team of five or more designers, ideally including senior or principal-level individual contributors.

 - A strong background in product design, with experience shaping modern enterprise SaaS applications, business-user-facing products, or consumer digital experiences.

 - Demonstrated ability to establish design strategy across multiple products, teams, or business domains, not simply manage execution against an existing roadmap.

 - Deep systems thinking, including direct experience developing, scaling, or meaningfully evolving design systems and reusable experience patterns.

 - Hands-on experience designing with an AI-forward process. You use tools such as Claude Code and Codex in your day-to-day work to prototype, build, and ship, and can show examples of work produced this way.

 - A builder mindset. You understand how modern frontend applications come together and have shipped production code alongside engineering partners, or led designers who do.

 - Strong cross-functional leadership, with a track record of influencing product managers, engineers, and other stakeholders within a larger organization.

 - Strong customer empathy and experience using research, customer engagement, and real-world workflows to inform design decisions.

 - The ability to communicate complex ideas clearly and build alignment around a compelling design vision.

 - Comfort operating in ambiguity, navigating competing priorities, and making thoughtful decisions in a rapidly evolving technology environment.

Nice to have

 - Experience designing AI-powered, agentic, or automation-driven products, particularly those involving human oversight, trust, or complex business workflows.

 - Experience spanning multiple industries, such as healthcare, financial services, enterprise software, or consumer technology.

 - Familiarity with GitHub and modern frontend development workflows.

 - Experience leading distributed teams or collaborating across North American and European time zones.

 - Experience evolving traditional design organizations toward AI-native, code-first ways of working.

How we work

We believe the future of product design is more integrated, more technical, and more collaborative.

Our designers don't hand off static files to engineering. They prototype, build, and ship directly to production alongside their cross-functional peers. We use AI to reduce repetitive work, accelerate iteration, and create reusable systems that make the entire organization more effective.

We also believe great design leadership is about creating clarity, not bureaucracy. Our designers are experienced, independent thinkers who thrive when given meaningful problems, strong strategic direction, and room to explore.

You'll lead a team that spans multiple business domains and collaborates with colleagues across the United States and Europe.

If you're energized by building exceptional teams, connecting complex problems, and redefining how AI-powered enterprise experiences are designed and delivered, we'd love to meet you.

#LI-MH1

Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes—and passion can’t be learned.

Many of our roles allow for flexibility in when and where work gets done. Depending on the needs of the business and the role, the number of hybrid, office-based, and remote workers will vary from team to team. Applications are assessed on a rolling basis and there is no fixed deadline for this requisition. The application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or may close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected.

We value a range of diverse backgrounds, experiences and ideas. We pride ourselves on our diversity and inclusive workplace that provides equal opportunities to all persons regardless of age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, and expression, national origin, disability, neurodiversity, military and/or veteran status, or any other protected classes. Additionally, UiPath provides reasonable accommodations for candidates on request and respects applicants' privacy rights. To review these and other legal disclosures, visit our privacy policy https://www.uipath.com/legal/trust-and-security/privacy-policy.

jobs.title: Chief Financial Officer
jobs.description:
Join the Rapidly Growing Team at Attivo Partners!

Are you dedicated to excellence and eager to advance your career? Passionate about technology and startups? Excited to work with some of the most innovative early-stage companies in the world? If so, Attivo Partners is the place for you!

Why Attivo?

Attivo Partners is a fast-growing full-service finance and accounting consulting firm headquartered in San Francisco, with a presence in major startup hubs across the US. Our remote teams specialize in providing fractional CFO and accounting services to venture-backed emerging growth clients, supporting their journey from inception to over $50M in revenue.

What We Offer:

• Collaborative Environment: Work alongside a talented team with extensive experience in venture-backed companies. At Attivo, we believe in teamwork and value the unique insights and creativity each member brings.

• Culture of Growth: We thrive on the challenges presented by diverse and exciting clients, offering unparalleled learning and professional development opportunities.

• Mentorship and Training: We are committed to nurturing talent and providing ongoing mentoring and training to help you grow personally and professionally.

• Flexibility: We understand the importance of balance and are dedicated to maintaining a culture that supports your career and personal life.

Our Values:

• Lasting Relationships: We build solid and enduring connections with our clients and team members.

• Data-Driven Insights: We leverage data to drive intelligent decisions and impactful results.

• Growth-Focused Mindset: We embrace opportunities for continuous improvement and innovation.

• Collaboration-First: We prioritize teamwork and believe the best solutions come from working together.

• Culture-Conscious: We foster a supportive and inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

Join us at Attivo Partners and be part of a team that's shaping the future of finance and accounting for startups. Let's grow together!

Role Overview

Attivo Partners is seeking entrepreneurial, AI transformational, forward-thinking Chief Financial Officers to join Attivo. This is a senior, client-facing role for a strategic finance leader who wants to be a trusted advisory to the leading companies in SaaS, AI, Robotics, American Dynamism and FinTech: someone who sees around corners, brings new ideas to the table, incorporates AI transformation into their solutions and helps founders and executive teams build durable, well-funded companies.

As an Attivo CFO, you will serve as the strategic finance partner to a portfolio of venture-backed and emerging growth clients across industries and stages. You will own the overall health of each client relationship, from the quality of the work and the economics of the engagement to the growth of the partnership over time. You will also help Attivo grow, by expanding what we deliver for existing clients and by bringing new clients to the firm.

Finance is changing quickly. AI and automation are reshaping how the CFO leads Finance and Accounting, how forecasts get built, how analyses are prepared, and how leaders make decisions. We are looking for CFOs who understand that shift, are energized by it, and can guide clients through it with sound judgment. The right person brings a growth mindset, real grit, and a habit of going above and beyond for clients and teammates.

Responsibilities

Strategic CFO Leadership

• Serve as a trusted fractional CFO and strategic advisor to CEOs, founders, executive teams, boards of directors, and investors across a portfolio of client companies

• Lead financial planning, forecasting, and budgeting, including 3-statement models, scenario analysis, and runway planning that turn strategy into numbers leadership can act on

• Oversee the preparation of financial statements, management reporting, KPI dashboards, and board materials in compliance with GAAP

• Lead AI transformation, essentially architecting and building the client’s operating system by evaluating and implementing core systems across ERP, billing/revenue, spending, and financial planning

• Manage cash flow, treasury, and capital deployment, applying current cash management practices that balance principal protection with return on investment

• Guide clients through equity and debt financings, including SAFEs, convertible notes, priced venture rounds, and venture debt; prepare data rooms and support investor due diligence

• Advise on M&A, strategic transactions, and exit readiness; support due diligence and integration planning

• Bring forward opportunities clients may not yet see, such as pricing and unit economics, revenue recognition (ASC 606) and contract structure, non-dilutive funding, entity and tax strategy, and operational efficiency

• Oversee audits, reviews, and tax compliance, and maintain strong relationships with external auditors, tax advisors, bankers, and legal counsel

• Identify and manage risks to each client’s financial and business health; maintain internal controls appropriate to each client’s stage and complexity

Client Relationship Ownership

• Serve as the client’s primary senior point of contact, with executive-level presence and the ability to earn the trust of the CEO, board, and investors

• Lead periodic client business reviews (monthly or quarterly) that connect the finance function’s work to the client’s strategic goals

• Set clear expectations on scope, staffing, timing, and pricing at engagement kickoff, and revisit them as client needs change

• Address client delivery issues or concerns immediately, translate client feedback into action, and respond to all client survey feedback

• Hold regular check-ins to build trust and surface emerging issues before they become problems

• Help clients recognize the strategic value of the accounting and finance function, and advocate for the Attivo team on process improvements and working norms

Engagement Economics & Quality

• Monitor team hours and costs against client estimates and budgets on a weekly to bi-weekly basis, in partnership with the Engagement Lead

• Review and approve client invoices; review engagement profitability and realization quarterly

Client Growth & Business Development

• Represent Attivo through thought leadership, events, and community involvement, and position Attivo to earn testimonials and referrals

Finance Innovation & AI

• Bring a point of view on how AI and automation are changing finance, and help clients adopt tools that improve speed, accuracy, and insight

• Recommend and coordinate implementation of systems that support fast growth across core processes, including AP, billings, AR and revenue, cash and treasury, and FP&A

• Identify where AI-assisted forecasting, automated reporting, intelligent document processing, and workflow automation can reduce manual work and improve decision quality

• Keep human judgment, controls, and data integrity at the center of every new tool or workflow you introduce

• Share what works with Attivo colleagues so best practices scale across the firm

• Build the client operating system

Requirements

• Strategic thinker who connects financial data to business decisions and can tell a clear, compelling story to founders, boards, and investors

• Growth mindset: curious, coachable, quick to learn, and motivated by new industries, business models, and tools

• Grit and ownership: you follow through when things get hard, stay steady in ambiguity, and do what it takes to deliver for clients

• A habit of going above and beyond, anticipating needs and bringing ideas before you are asked

• Demonstrated ability to manage multiple client relationships at once in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment

• Excellent executive communication and interpersonal skills, including board and investor presentations, with the ability to explain complex finance to audiences at every level of financial knowledge

• Commercial instinct and comfort leading conversations about scope, pricing, and new opportunities

• Act like an owner of the firm in terms of quality, expansion, and profitability

• High integrity, sound business judgment, and the confidence to deliver difficult news while shaping what happens next

• Working knowledge of AI and automation tools applicable to finance and operations, and enthusiasm for applying them responsibly

• Entrepreneurial spirit and a passion for startups and emerging growth companies

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field required; MBA and/or CPA strongly preferred

• Minimum of 10 years of senior financial leadership experience, with at least 5 years as a CFO or VP of Finance

• Minimum of 5 years of experience with venture-backed, emerging growth companies

• Experience in a fractional CFO, professional services, or multi-client advisory environment strongly preferred

• Proven experience leading equity and/or debt financings and supporting board and investor relations

• Strong technical accounting foundation, including GAAP reporting and ASC 606 revenue recognition, sufficient to review and sign off on deliverable quality

• Track record of growing client relationships and/or sourcing new business

• Advanced financial modeling skills in Excel and/or Google Sheets; experience with modern finance systems such as NetSuite, QuickBooks Online, Ramp, Bill.com, and FP&A platforms

• Demonstrated experience designing the finance function’s “operating system” (data, workflows, AI agents and controls), not just managing it. Comfortable personally using AI-native tools to build and improve processes, and able to apply clear frameworks for what to automate, what to build, what to buy, and the ROI of each.

• Proven ability to build, train and resource a small, high-leverage team where AI fluency is a baseline skill. Moves finance toward real-time operations (continuous forecasting, a faster close) while keeping a clear audit trail from every number back to its source, including any work done by AI.

Location: New York City or San Francisco Bay Area (preferred)

jobs.title: Senior Vehicle Integration and Test Technician
jobs.description:
ABOUT ROCKET LAB

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

NEUTRON

Neutron is a medium lift launch vehicle capable of delivering the mega constellations of tomorrow, high assurance payloads, and human spaceflight. As a highly reusable launch platform, Neutron will deliver a highly cost-effective and reliable launch solution leveraging Rocket Lab’s proven execution history with the Electron program. If you’re interested in joining a high performing team, pushing the boundaries with a clean sheet development of re-usable liquid launch vehicle, this is your opportunity!

SENIOR VEHICLE INTEGTRATION AND TEST TECHNICIAN

The role of Senior Vehicle Integration and Test Technician is key to enabling the build of the Neutron launch vehicle. This role will work closely with system Responsible Engineers and a tight nit team of talented technicians that will lead the build, integration and test of the Neutron launch vehicles mechanical, fluids, and avionics systems. This role requires a multi-discipline problem solver who has a broad understanding of Launch Vehicle systems and an extreme eye for detail.

WHAT YOU’LL GET TO DO:

• Play a crucial role in the creation and implementation of Neutrons assembly and test procedures

• Work closely with various system owners to develop and document procedures

• Provide hands-on leadership and guidance to a team of technicians in the implementation of assembly and test procedures

• Lead and train technicians in industry standards and best practice for the installation and testing of aerospace flight components

• Troubleshoot and work solutions to unforeseen issues and drive workflow best practices and efficiency improvements

• Provide support on other operations as needed to enable the rapid processing of Neutron

• Help drive the specification and setup of technician workstations and tooling requirements for Neutrons Integration

• Work alongside the Neutron production team at the Rocket Lab Space Structures Complex in Baltimore MD learning and helping develop various integration procedures

• Work with greater Rocket Lab manufacturing and integration teams in Auckland, New Zealand; Long Beach, CA; and Stennis Space Center, MS.

YOU’LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS AS A SENIOR VEHICLE INTEGRATION AND TEST TECHNICIAN:

• 8+ years of assembly and/or test experience in a highly regulated manufacturing environment.

• High School diploma or GED.

THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:

• Experience in the assembly and testing of launch vehicle fluid systems including: - Pneumatic, Cryogenic, electrical, and others.

• Maintenance skills including: troubleshooting, precision cleaning, components disassembly/assembly, system testing, and others.

• Experience and comfortability with necessary equipment to perform job duties including: forklift, telehandler, boom lift, scissor lift, power tools, torque wrenches and others

• Experience with cleanroom work and a sound understanding of ISO cleanliness standards

• Fabrication skills including: Tube bending, tube flaring, and mechanical assembly

• Avionics installation and harness routing experience

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Stand and walk for entire shift (8+ hours) on various work surfaces

• Climb ladders and work at elevated height small spaces, awkward positions, and tight areas as needed

• Perform repetitive motions including bending, twisting, reaching, grasping, pushing, pulling, and stooping

• Use hands with precision to handle, control, and operate tools, instruments, and equipment

• Lift, carry, push, and pull materials and equipment up to 25 lbs.

• Work in varied environments including production floors, equipment areas, and field locations with exposure to noise, temperature variations, and moving machinery

• Flexibility to work extended hours, weekends, and varied shifts as operational needs require

The expected salary range for the position is displayed in accordance with the state of Virginia’s pay transparency requirements. Final agreed upon compensation is based upon individual qualifications and experience.

Base salary is only one part of Rocket Lab’s compensation package for this role. You may be eligible for company stock, or cash incentives, and can purchase discounted stock through Rocket Lab’s Employee Stock Purchase Program. Employee benefits also include medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage; 401(k) retirement plan options; paid vacation, holidays, and sick leave; paid parental leave; and other discounts and perks.

Base Pay Range (VA Only)

$30—$40 USD

WHAT TO EXPECT

We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other’s backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.

Important information:

FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN US OFFICES ONLY:

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), Rocket Lab Employees must be a U.S. citizen, lawful U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State and/or the U.S. Department of Commerce, as applicable. Only messages left for this purpose will be considered. A response to your request may take up to two business days.

FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN NEW ZEALAND OFFICES ONLY:

For security reasons, background checks will be undertaken prior to any employment offers being made to an applicant.  These checks will include nationality checks as it is a requirement of this position that you be eligible to access equipment and data regulated by the United States' International Traffic in Arms Regulations.

jobs.title: Senior Portfolio Accountant, Reporting & Compliance
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Operator I
jobs.description:
Position Purpose:

The Operator I operates, monitors, and maintains water treatment, dewatering, sludge-processing, disposal, and testing equipment in a refinery or industrial facility. This position ensures that water treatment processes are completed safely and efficiently and that treated water meets customer and regulatory specifications.

The Operator I monitors plant operations, conducts quality testing, maintains process controls, and adjusts chemical levels as needed to support optimal treatment performance. This position works 12-hour day shifts, including rotating weekends.

Primary Duties/Responsibilities:

• Perform routine grounds and facility maintenance, including mowing, weed trimming, and operating various tools and equipment.
• Monitor water treatment plant processes and maintain effective process control by adjusting chemical levels as needed.
• Collect water and process samples in accordance with established procedures.
• Operate and monitor the SCADA system to track plant performance and identify operational issues.
• Conduct laboratory testing and accurately record and report results.
• Maintain a clean, safe, and orderly work area and follow all applicable safety procedures and regulatory requirements.
• Must consistently demonstrate the ability to learn and independently operate assigned machines and equipment meeting or exceeding processing and quality targets.
• Must demonstrate ability to learn and independently operate equipment such as pumps, engines, centrifuge, generators, valves, gates, mixers, conveyors, blowers, dryers, chemical feed, odor control, disinfection equipment, sludge processing filters, belt presses and measuring/control devices, testing equipment and material handling equipment.
• Must demonstrate ability to work in a team environment and willingness to assume additional or new responsibilities readily.

Education/Experience/Background:

• High School Diploma/GED is required.
• Some experience in a related position and environmental services preferred.
• Previous experience in a related position or industrial, refinery, or water treatment environment preferred.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

• Must demonstrate a working ability to use computer programs for process control.
• Must have the ability to read, write and comprehend English (operational, process, safety and quality instructions).
• Must have the ability to perform basic mathematical calculations.
• Must demonstrate ability to work in a team environment and willingness to assume additional or new responsibilities readily.
• Must be able to serve rotational 24 hour emergency on-call if required by site.

Required Certification/Licenses/Training:

• Must possess a valid driver's license and a safe driving record.
• Must be able to pass a drug test and a criminal background check.
• NC Grade C. Surface Water Treatment Certification - Preferred.

Physical Requirements:

• While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear.
• The employee is frequently required to stand; walk; climb stairs or ladders; sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl and taste or smell.
• The employee may occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds and move rolling sludge hoppers up to 200 pounds.

jobs.title: Assistant Spanish Teacher
jobs.description:
Do work that matters! Every single day. We are hiring an Assistant Teacher for our Spanish Immersion classroom at our Guidepost Montessori Downtown Naperville location!

Part-time and full-time positions are available. If hired as part-time, there may be an opportunity to increase hours based on the need of the school.

At Guidepost Montessori, our Assistant Teachers play a meaningful role in helping children ages 0–6 develop independence, confidence, and a lifelong love of learning.

If you’re passionate about working with young children and want to grow in a supportive, purpose-driven environment, we’d love to meet you.

Your Impact

As an Assistant Teacher, you’ll support a mixed-age Spanish Immersion Montessori classroom (Infant, Toddler, and Children’s House ages 3–6), helping create a calm, engaging environment where children are empowered to explore, learn, and grow at their own pace.

In a Montessori classroom, the environment and the guide work together to support each child’s development. You’ll assist in preparing beautiful, intentional learning spaces and support children through individualized and small-group activities—always with respect, patience, and care.

Most importantly, you’ll help children build confidence in themselves and discover what they’re capable of achieving.

What You’ll Do

• Observe children closely to understand and support their individual needs

• Help prepare and maintain a beautiful, orderly classroom environment

• Support individual and small-group learning activities

• Build warm, respectful relationships with children and families

• Collaborate with Lead Guides and fellow team members to create a strong classroom community

What We’re Looking For

• Experience working with children ages 3–6 in a school or childcare setting

• A positive, adaptable, and collaborative mindset

• A genuine love for working with young children

• Interest in learning and growing within the Montessori approach (prior Montessori experience is welcome but not required)

What We Offer

• Fully sponsored Montessori diploma training through the Prepared Montessorian Institute

• Ongoing professional development and mentorship

• 75% tuition discount for up to two children at any Guidepost school

• Competitive pay

• Health, dental, and vision insurance

• Paid time off and paid holidays

• Abundant opportunities for growth and career advancement

• A supportive network of peers who value collaboration and shared best practices

About Guidepost Montessori

Guidepost Montessori is a growing network of over 100 schools across the U.S. and Asia, serving children from 3 months to 6 years old.

We believe children are capable and we design an education that nurtures independence, curiosity, and joy. Our mission is to transform education by helping every child reach their highest potential academically, socially, and emotionally.

If you love working with children and are looking for a role where you can grow, make an impact, and be part of something meaningful, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and join our school community!

jobs.title: Senior Security Architect
jobs.description:
About LogicGate
LogicGate is the leading AI GRC platform for the Enterprise, helping governance, risk, and compliance teams limit surprises, strengthen resilience, augment program performance, and confidently quantify impact and business value. Built to provide a centralized view of risk and compliance, with AI intelligence woven into the platform's core, LogicGate delivers real-time insights and actionable data to help drive current business decisions, with the flexibility to scale alongside evolving business needs. Recognized as a Leader in the GRC Market, LogicGate continues to further solidify its position as a best-in-class platform.

The GRC Market
Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) is a rapidly expanding sector, with a global market size projected to reach $104.5 billion by 2031. LogicGate is at the forefront of this industry transformation, empowering enterprise professionals to navigate complex regulatory environments, manage critical uncertainty, and operate with integrity at scale.

Senior Security Architect

Location: Chicago, IL (Hybrid) or Bellevue, WA (Hybrid)

About the Role

As LogicGate continues to transform the GRC market, we are seeking a Senior Security Architect to lead the charge in securing our AI-driven solutions and tech stack. Reporting into the IST organization, you will solve critical business challenges by architecting defenses against emerging AI-specific threats and bridging any gaps in LogicGate’s security. You will serve as both a hands-on engineer and a strategic advisor, partnering closely with Engineering, Marketing, and GTM teams to ensure security is a business enabler. By shaping our security architecture, you'll empower LogicGate to innovate rapidly and securely, quantifying impact and building trust across the enterprise.

What You’ll Do

• AI Security Leadership: Serve as the subject matter expert on securing our AI stack - including agents, LLMs, and infrastructure - mitigating risks from attacks to support rapid, secure innovation.

• Cross-Functional Enablement: Partner directly with Engineering, Marketing, and GTM teams to assess new SaaS risks and guide teams in executing secure architectural patterns.

• Application Security Execution: Lead application security initiatives by integrating tools like GitLab Ultimate (SAST, DAST) to proactively identify and remediate vulnerabilities in the release lifecycle.

• Infrastructure Defense Strategy: Architect and secure AWS cloud environments utilizing Network Firewalls and Egress-Only VPCs to ensure robust protection of enterprise data.

• Operational Automation: Drive continuous security monitoring and SOC2/ISO evidence automation using tools like Wiz and Datadog to maintain our high standards of compliance with lean resources.

• Risk Communication: Articulate security trade-offs and document architectural decisions (via SBARs and ADRs) to help leadership balance risk mitigation with business agility.

• Incident Response Management: Triage security events (e.g., vendor incidents, IAM/SCIM access reviews) to quickly resolve vulnerabilities and maintain operational resilience.

What You Bring

Required:

• Information Security & AppSec Architecture: 7–10 years of progressive experience in security architecture or engineering, with demonstrated full-stack technical depth and a proven track record of establishing application security (AppSec) standards across modern SaaS environments.

• AI & Cloud Threat Modeling: Hands-on experience architecting and securing cloud environments (AWS preferred) and applying structured threat modeling methodologies to AI/ML stacks (agents, LLMs, MCP servers) to proactively mitigate adversarial risks.

• Security Tooling & Compliance Automation: Proven proficiency with modern cloud security, observability, and CI/CD policy tooling (such as Wiz, Datadog, and GitLab Ultimate SAST/DAST), including automating SOC 2 and ISO compliance evidence collection and driving SLA-governed vulnerability remediation.

• Cross-Functional Influence & Governance: Track record of partnering effectively across Engineering, Product, and GTM teams, articulating risk trade-offs with clarity and codifying architectural decisions using structured frameworks (such as Architecture Decision Records [ADRs] and SBARs).

• AI Literacy & Upskilling: Demonstrated curiosity and experience leveraging modern AI tools, LLMs, or automated workflows to enhance problem-solving and operational efficiency.

• Flexibility for On-Site Engagement: Willingness and ability to travel as needed for customer on-sites, team planning workshops, and company gatherings.

Nice to Have:

• Cloud & Security Certifications: Industry-recognized credentials such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect (Professional), AWS Certified Security – Specialty, AWS Certified Advanced Networking – Specialty, or CISSP.

• AI Security Frameworks & Community Contribution: Practical familiarity with emerging AI security standards (e.g., OWASP Top 10 for LLM/GenAI, MITRE ATLAS) or contributions to the security community through research, open-source tooling, or industry presentations.

• Program Building in Growth SaaS: Experience establishing or scaling a security architecture function from the ground up within a fast-paced, high-growth SaaS organization operating with lean resources.

The anticipated base salary range for the role is $165,000 - $180,000 per year + bonus + equity + benefits. Actual salaries may vary and will be based on factors, such as the candidate's qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. Internal candidates who have current pay within or above the hiring range are still encouraged to apply if interested.

Office Location

This role is classified as Hybrid, based out of our Chicago HQ or Bellevue office. You are expected to be available to work from the office as needed to support in-person collaboration with your team which may include recurring in-office days.

How We Work
At LogicGate, we empower organizations to transform risk into a strategic advantage. As we continue to scale, we are looking for driven, high-performing individuals who are ready to take ownership, raise the bar, and do the best work of their careers.

Our culture is built on execution, collaboration, and a shared commitment to excellence. We believe the strongest, most innovative teams are forged by diverse perspectives. We are dedicated to fostering an inclusive environment where differences are celebrated and supported.

Global Total Rewards
We invest in our people with a comprehensive and competitive rewards package designed to support our team members across the US and the UK:

• Compensation & Equity: Competitive base salaries, variable compensation plans, and equity options.

• Health & Wellbeing: Comprehensive health, wellness, and lifestyle benefits tailored to your region.

• Time Away: Generous paid time off and annual company holidays so you can recharge and return at your best.

• Growth & Development: Continuous career advancement through structured mentorship, leadership training, and premium learning platforms.

Recognized as a top workplace by Built In, Crain’s Chicago Business, and the Chicago Tribune.

LogicGate is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a high-performing, diverse workforce. We make all employment decisions based on merit, business needs, and professional qualifications. We strictly prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, marital or civil partnership status, pregnancy or maternity, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic governed by federal, state, and local laws in the United States, the Equality Act 2010 in the United Kingdom, or applicable regulations in any jurisdiction where we operate.

jobs.description:
