jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Marketing Manager, Performance
jobs.location: Denver, CO; New York City, NY; San Francisco, CA
jobs.description:
Fastly helps people stay better connected with the things they love. Fastly’s edge cloud platform enables customers to create great digital experiences quickly, securely, and reliably by processing, serving, and securing our customers’ applications as close to their end-users as possible — at the edge of the Internet. The platform is designed to take advantage of the modern internet, to be programmable, and to support agile software development. Fastly’s customers include many of the world’s most prominent companies, including GitHub, Yelp, Paramount, and JetBlue.

We're building a more trustworthy Internet. Come join us.

Posting Open Date: 11/4/26

Anticipated Posting Close Date*:  12/4/26

*Job posting may close early due to the volume of applicants.

Senior Technical Product Marketing Manager – Performance

We're looking for a Senior Technical Product Marketing Manager to drive go-to-market strategy, and positioning for Fastly's application and API performance solutions. In this role you will articulate the technical details of how Fastly talks about performance and why it’s needed in a world where a growing share of traffic hitting applications and APIs is no longer human. Performance has always been core to Fastly's story. What's changing is who and what that performance now has to serve.

In partnership with Product Management, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing, you will translate deep technical understanding of modern traffic patterns into launches, solution sets, and enablement that help internal team members, customers, and prospects see Fastly as the platform built for how the internet actually behaves today.

What You'll Do

• GTM Launch Execution: Design, enable, execute, and measure product launches and go-to-market plans in alignment with Product Marketing and other cross functional teams

• Positioning: Own positioning for how Fastly's platform delivers performance for both human and non-human traffic — including AI crawlers, fetchers, and autonomous agents — developing narratives that resonate with technical buyers.

• Report on emerging Traffic Patterns: Stay ahead of how AI-driven and automated traffic is reshaping application and API performance requirements, and translate that understanding into empirical product positioning and content.

• Competitive Differentiation: Position Fastly's performance capabilities against both legacy CDN vendors and newer entrants addressing AI-era traffic.

• Cross-Sell Narrative: Build narratives that help existing customers understand the value of Fastly's expanding performance capabilities as their traffic mix evolves.

• Sales Enablement: Partner with sales and enablement teams to create trainings, slide decks, and other assets they can use in their sales cycles.

• Market Positioning: Apply competitive intelligence and market context from Portfolio Intelligence to optimally position Fastly's performance-oriented products and features.

• Cross-Functional Alignment: Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure product strategy, messaging, and packaging are aligned and effective.

• Content & Campaign Support: Support technical assets with the Growth Marketing and Campaign teams for use across the buyer journey.

• Product Evangelism: Deliver presentations to the public on Fastly's unique and differentiated performance story.

What We're Looking For

• 7+ years of professional experience, with at least 3+ years of product marketing or related experience.

• Technical background in content delivery, edge computing, or a closely adjacent field — you understand how modern applications and APIs are built, served, and optimized at scale.

• Working knowledge of (or strong interest in) how non-human traffic — AI crawlers, fetchers, bots, and agents — is changing performance, cost, and reliability requirements for applications and APIs.

• Strong storytelling skills, including excellent written and spoken communication, with the ability to translate technical nuance into clear customer-facing narratives.

• Exceptional critical thinking and problem-solving skills.

• Proven organizational skills with the ability to prioritize and multitask.

• Self-starter with strong initiative and drive.

We'll Be Impressed If You Have:

• Previous experience as a sales engineer

• Hands-on experience with content delivery networks, gateways, and adjacent technologies .

• Direct exposure to how AI agents, LLM crawlers, or automated fetchers interact with web and API infrastructure.

• A track record of launching or marketing performance-related products in a technical, developer-adjacent market.

Work Hours: This position will require you to be available during core business hours.

Work Location(s) & Travel Requirements:

This position is open to Hybrid Work Locations.

The preferred locations for this position are:

• San Francisco, CA

• Denver, CO

• New York, NY

Fastly currently embraces a largely hybrid model for most roles which allows employees flexibility to split their time between the office and home.

There is a preference for Hybrid near a local office. However, we are willing to consider remote candidates within the US.

This position may require travel as requested by your manager.

Salary:

The estimated salary range for this position is $132,060 to $186,444.

Starting salary may vary based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as experience, skills, qualifications, and location.This role may be eligible to participate in Fastly’s equity and discretionary bonus programs.

Benefits:

We care about you. Fastly works hard to create a positive environment for our employees, and we think your life outside of work is important too. We support our teams with great benefits that start on the first day of your employment with Fastly. Curious about our offerings?

We offer a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance. Family planning, mental health support along with Employee Assistance Program, Insurance (Life, Disability, and Accident), a Flexible Vacation policy and up to 18 days of accrued paid sick leave are there to help support our employees. We also offer 401(k) (including company match) and an Employee Stock Purchase Program. For 2025, we offer 11 paid local holidays, 11 paid company wellness days.

AI Statement

To ensure a fair and equitable interview process for everyone, the use of AI technologies—including real-time transcription tools, automated scripts, AI copilots, or external assistants—is strictly prohibited during the interview process unless explicitly authorized by the company in advance. Unauthorized use of AI tools may result in disqualification.

Why Fastly?

• We have a huge impact. Fastly is a small company with a big reach. Not only do our customers have a tremendous user base, but we also support a growing number of open source projects and initiatives. Outside of code, employees are encouraged to share causes close to their heart with others so we can help lend a supportive hand.

• We value diversity. Growing and maintaining our inclusive and diverse team matters to us. We are committed to being a company where our employees feel comfortable bringing their authentic selves to work and have the ability to be successful -- every day.

• We are passionate. Fastly is chock full of passionate people and we’re not ‘one size fits all’. Fastly employs authors, pilots, skiers, parents (of humans and animals), makeup geeks, coffee connoisseurs, and more. We love employees for who they are and what they are passionate about.

We’re always looking for humble, sharp, and creative folks to join the Fastly team. If you think you might be a fit please apply! A fully completed application and resume or CV are required when applying.

All job applications must be submitted through our official careers site at www.fastly.com/about/careers. We will never request sensitive information, such as your Social Security number, bank account or credit card information during the application process. All official communication will come from an @fastly.com or @recruiting.fastly.com email address.

Our employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications. jobs.title: Maintenance Technician II, Sterile Facilities
jobs.description:
Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve. 



Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about http://hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works http://hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals http://www.hims.com/careers-professionals.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

 This role reports to the Sr. Facilities Manager.  The Maintenance Technician II, Sterile Facilities provides mid-level support to the Operations Engineering & Maintenance Department by applying predictive and preventive maintenance procedures for all Lab & facility equipment.  This position analyzes, troubleshoots, and communicates maintenance problems/concerns in the following areas: electrical, mechanical, plumbing, air compression, and HVAC.  The Maintenance Technician II, Sterile Facilities works with general supervision and will interact with a supervisor several times per week, perhaps daily, to receive guidance and feedback. Some non-routine activities may require a supervisor’s advance approval.




YOU WILL:

 - Provide predictive/preventive maintenance on all Lab Equipment: Blenders, Hoods, Air compressors, electrical controls, etc.

 - Document maintenance technical and other data on predictive/preventive maintenance charts, as required.

 - Conduct repair/troubleshoot duties throughout the pharmacy as required.

 - Diagnose and repair all equipment in the labs outside labs like refrigerator , incubators etc including electrical, mechanical, plumbing, air compressors and HVAC repairs.

 - Identify facilities issues and develop an ongoing strategy to chart trends and take appropriate remedial action from a predictive maintenance approach.

 - Communicate to management all issues that could result in safety risks or those that might cause loss to the company or its associates.

 - Work as directed in all areas of the outsourcing facility to maintain safety and health standards for the facility.

 - Support calibration and testing procedures on equipment to ensure accurate operation and compliance with quality standards.

 - Conduct regular checks and measurements to verify equipment performance, including temperature, pressure, speed, and other relevant parameters.

 - Support the maintenance of calibration records and documentation in compliance with regulatory requirements.

 - Ensure that all equipment meets regulatory and quality standards and take corrective actions to address any non-compliance issues.

 - Collaborate with quality assurance and regulatory affairs teams to implement and maintain proper documentation, including equipment logs, maintenance records, and validation reports.

 - Respond promptly to equipment breakdowns, emergencies, and production interruptions to minimize downtime.

 - Work closely with production personnel to coordinate repairs and minimize disruptions to the manufacturing process.

jobs.title: Analyst, Revenue Cycle Management & Managed Care
jobs.description:
Compass Surgical Partners is a leading, independent, full-service ambulatory surgery center (ASC) development and management partner. An exclusive partner for premier health systems, Compass has built a nationwide portfolio of ASC joint ventures with health systems and physicians. Compass’ experienced leadership team has developed more than 250 ASCs over the past three decades, making it the partner of choice for high-performance ASCs. Differentiated by a proven track record of success and an agile, aligned operating model, Compass Surgical Partners aims to create strong partnerships that improve the lives of patients and providers. Learn more at www.compass-sp.com http://www.compass-sp.com.





ROLE OVERVIEW

Compass Surgical Partners is seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Analyst, Revenue Cycle Management & Managed Care to support financial and operational performance across our growing portfolio of ambulatory surgery centers. This role works closely with Revenue Cycle Management, Managed Care, Finance, and Corporate Development teams to evaluate reimbursement performance, identify revenue opportunities, monitor payer trends, and translate complex healthcare data into actionable business insights.

The ideal candidate combines a strong understanding of healthcare revenue cycle operations with advanced analytical skills, an innovation-focused mindset, and experience using technology, automation, and AI-enabled tools to translate complex data into actionable business insights.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

Revenue Cycle Performance & Reporting

 - Develop and maintain accurate reporting on revenue cycle performance, including accounts receivable, collections, denials, aging, and reimbursement trends

 - Identify performance gaps and emerging risks, providing actionable recommendations to improve financial outcomes

 - Analyze denial patterns, payment variances, and collection trends to identify root causes and opportunities for improvement

 - Monitor key revenue cycle metrics and provide timely insights to operational leadership

Managed Care & Reimbursement Analysis

 - Analyze payer contracts, reimbursement rates, fee schedules, and payment methodologies to evaluate financial performance

 - Identify and quantify reimbursement discrepancies, including underpayments and incorrect contract rate applications

 - Develop financial models supporting payer contract negotiations, renewals, and reimbursement changes

 - Evaluate payer mix, service line performance, and reimbursement scenarios to inform strategic decisions

Financial & Strategic Analytics

 - Partner with Finance and Corporate Development to support budgeting, forecasting, and growth initiatives

 - Analyze claims, reimbursement, procedure-level, and specialty data to develop financial projections and identify potential risks

 - Translate complex datasets into clear recommendations for business and operational leaders

 - Support ad hoc analytical requests related to portfolio performance and strategic initiatives

Data Integrity, Automation & Process Improvement

 - Maintain accurate payer, contract, and reimbursement data used in financial analysis and reporting

 - Validate data quality and ensure consistency across recurring reports and analytical models

 - Identify opportunities to streamline reporting processes, reduce manual work, and improve analytical efficiency

 - Maintain confidentiality and comply with applicable HIPAA requirements and data governance standards

 - Leverage AI-enabled tools, automation, and advanced analytics to accelerate data analysis, identify patterns, and improve reporting efficiency

 - Evaluate manual workflows and develop practical solutions that improve accuracy, consistency, and scalability

 - Validate automated and AI-generated outputs before incorporating findings into financial analysis or business recommendations

 - Apply appropriate safeguards when using sensitive financial, payer, or protected healthcare information


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Healthcare Administration, Business Analytics, Economics, Information Systems, or a related field

 - Experience in healthcare revenue cycle management, managed care, reimbursement analysis, healthcare finance, or a closely related analytical function

 - Working knowledge of healthcare revenue cycle processes, including claims, payment posting, denials, collections, and accounts receivable

 - Understanding of payer reimbursement methodologies, contract rates, and reimbursement variance analysis

 - Experience analyzing financial or operational data and translating findings into actionable recommendations

 - Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including formulas, lookups, pivot tables, data reconciliation, and analysis of large datasets

 - Strong analytical judgment, attention to detail, and ability to communicate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders

 - Understanding of healthcare data confidentiality and HIPAA requirements

 - Experience using AI, automation, business intelligence, or workflow tools to improve analysis and reporting

 - Ability to evaluate new technologies and apply them thoughtfully to practical business challenges

 - Sound judgment when validating AI-generated outputs and handling sensitive healthcare information

Preferred Qualifications

 - Experience supporting ambulatory surgery centers, hospital outpatient departments, physician practices, or multisite healthcare organizations

 - Experience with payer contract modeling, fee schedule analysis, reimbursement methodologies, or contract performance evaluation

 - Experience analyzing accounts receivable, denials, collections, payment variances, or other revenue cycle performance indicators

 - Familiarity with healthcare financial reporting, forecasting, and dashboard development




WHY COMPASS SURGICAL PARTNERS

Compass Surgical Partners develops and manages ambulatory surgery centers (ASCs) in partnership with physicians and health systems. We’re builders and operators committed to patient value, physician partnership, and scalable excellence. You’ll join a team that works with clear outcomes, moves fast, and supports each other through our STAR values—Service, Teamwork, Accountability, and Respect (respect through directness, kindness, and ownership).




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Compass Surgical Partners is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

jobs.title: Director, CMC External Manufacturing
jobs.description:
Location:  This position may be performed remotely, but requires the flexibility and willingness to travel as needed.

The Opportunity

The Director, External Manufacturing (CMC) will lead and manage outsourced manufacturing operations supporting Praxis’s clinical and future commercial programs. This role will oversee Contract Development and Manufacturing Organizations (CDMOs) responsible for drug substance (API) and drug product manufacturing, ensuring high-quality, compliant, and timely supply of clinical materials. The ideal candidate is a strategic, hands-on CMC leader experienced in managing external partnerships and driving operational excellence in a dynamic biotech environment.

Primary Responsibilities

External Manufacturing Oversight

• Lead the strategy, selection, and management of CDMOs for both drug substance and drug product manufacturing.

• Serve as the primary operational interface between Praxis and external manufacturing partners.

• Oversee technology transfer, process scale-up, validation, and clinical supply readiness.

• Establish and maintain robust Quality and Technical Agreements with manufacturing partners.

• Manage and optimize the end-to-end supply chain process, including raw materials procurement, production planning, logistics, inventory management, and distribution.

• Lead supplier qualification, monitoring, and performance evaluations, addressing risks and identifying opportunities for improvement.

• Negotiate contracts and pricing agreements with suppliers and CMOs to achieve cost-effective outcomes while maintaining supply security.

CMC Operations and Program Support

• Collaborate closely with Process Chemistry, Formulation, Analytical, Quality, and Regulatory teams to ensure seamless execution of CMC deliverables.

• Support CMC development strategies aligned with clinical timelines, regulatory expectations, and company objectives.

• Manage manufacturing planning, scheduling, and inventory to ensure uninterrupted clinical supply.

Governance, Compliance, and Continuous Improvement

• Ensure all outsourced manufacturing is performed under appropriate GMP and regulatory standards.

• Implement key performance indicators (KPIs) and governance mechanisms to monitor and improve CDMO performance.

• Proactively identify and mitigate technical and operational risks across the external supply network.

• Drive operational excellence and process improvements to enhance efficiency and compliance.

Qualifications and Key Success Factors

• Advanced degree preferred in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or related field; bachelor’s degree with extensive relevant experience considered.

• 15+ years of progressive CMC or manufacturing experience within the biopharmaceutical industry, including ≥8 years managing external manufacturing relationships.

• Proven experience in managing global CMC supply chains for commercial products in a regulated environment. Includes strong understanding of GMP, GDP, and ICH guidelines and their application in a commercial setting.

Placement within the range will be based on job-related factors, including experience, qualifications, scope of responsibilities, and demonstrated track record of delivering results in similar roles.

$210,000—$235,000 USD

Compensation & Benefits

At Praxis, we believe that taking care of our people (and their people) is important, so we provide a world class benefits package to help you thrive.  This includes 99% of the premium paid for medical, dental and vision plans.  We also provide company-paid life insurance, AD&D, disability benefits, and voluntary plans to personalize your coverage. Thinking about the future?  We match dollar-for-dollar up to 6% on eligible 401(k) contributions and sweeten the deal with long-term stock incentives and ESPP.  We provide a discretionary quarterly bonus, an extremely flexible wellness benefit, generous PTO, paid holidays and company-wide shutdowns.  Not to mention, you'll also be joining a phenomenal crew of colleagues who are smart, engaged and inspiring.  We aim high, collaborate hard, and produce results.  Let’s achieve the impossible together!

Praxis Precision Medicines is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company translating genetic insights into the development of therapies for central nervous system disorders characterized by neuronal imbalance.  At Praxis we share a common vision of reshaping the human condition into a more freeing and fulfilled existence by developing high impact medicines for patients and families affected by and living with complex brain disorders.  Our core Values of Trust, Ownership, Curiosity and Results are foundational to every aspect of our business and are exemplified by each and every one of our team members.

jobs.title: Third-Party Logistics (3PL) Partner Manager - Jumia (Full Time)
jobs.description:
About Jumia:

Jumia is a leading pan-African e-commerce platform. Its mission is to improve the quality of everyday life in Africa by leveraging technology to deliver innovative, convenient and affordable online services to customers, while helping businesses grow as they use Jumia's platform to better reach and serve customers.

Jumia is built around a marketplace and supported by a proprietary logistics business [Jumia Logistics] and a digital payment and fintech platform [Jumia Pay]. With over 3,000 employees, Jumia is led by top talented leaders offering a great mix of local and international talents and is backed by very high-profile shareholders. Jumia is committed to creating a sustainable impact in Africa.

In April 2019, Jumia was the first Tech company in Africa to be listed on the New York Stock Exchange.

As our 3PL Manager, you will lead and optimize end-to-end partner operations across Jumia’s third-party logistics network, ensuring high-velocity inbound fulfillment and cost-efficient distribution. In this role, you will act as the key strategic bridge between Jumia and our logistics partners—driving operational excellence, strict SLA compliance, lean process improvements, and transparent financial governance to support our fast-scaling e-commerce ecosystem.

What you will be doing:

• Operations & Partner Governance: Oversee daily operations across our third-party logistics network, leading monthly and quarterly business reviews (MBRs/QBRs) to drive partner accountability and high service standards.

• Performance & KPI Management: Track and optimize core fulfillment metrics - including on-time fulfillment, inventory accuracy, labor productivity per unit/hour, and safety compliance.

• Financial & Billing Oversight: Manage annual operational budgets, audit 3PL invoices for accuracy, and investigate chargebacks to maintain tight cost controls.

• Continuous Improvement & Lean Practices: Spearhead lean initiatives and workflow improvements across 3PL facilities to reduce operational bottlenecks and eliminate process waste.

• Cross-Functional & Vendor Leadership: Partner with internal supply chain, transport, and commercial stakeholders while directly driving performance evaluation, training, and operational alignment for 3PL partner teams.

• Compliance & Business Continuity: Ensure all partner facilities comply with regulatory and corporate safety policies while executing robust business continuity and sustainability plans.

What we are looking for:

• Educational Background: Bachelor’s or advanced degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Operations, or equivalent practical experience.

• Domain Expertise: Proven track record in logistics or warehousing operations (Distribution Center/WMS planning, inbound freight, inventory flow, or supply chain analytics).

• Execution & Productivity: Experience managing cross-functional projects, with a strong grasp of structured productivity frameworks (such as Work Breakdown Structures/WBS).

• Leadership & Influence: Strong vendor management capability with the gravitas to lead, coach, and influence external operational teams.

• Communication & Stakeholder Management: Exceptional written and presentation skills, comfortable facilitating group reviews and communicating data-driven insights to senior leadership.

• Tool Proficiency: Advanced working knowledge of MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint) and Google Workspace (Sheets, Docs, Drive).

#LI-Onsite

• A unique opportunity of having strong impact in building the African e-commerce sector

• The opportunity to become part of a highly professional and dynamic team

• An unparalleled personal and professional growth as our longer-term objective is to train the next generation of leaders

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, Researcher/Economist
jobs.description:
Profound is the fastest-growing AI marketing platform, used by 15% of the Fortune 500 including Comcast, Estée Lauder, and Walmart, and innovators like Ramp, MongoDB, and Figma. It is where marketing teams do the work: research, briefs, content, campaigns, reporting, all in one place, alongside agents that carry the load with them.  

Built on 2B+ real user prompts and growing, Profound’s data shows you what people ask AI and what the models say back. Profound's AI Marketer joins that data with deep context about our customers to find the opportunities worth acting on, and then puts agents to work: automating reporting, drafting content, auditing pages for readability, running competitive research. It measures what works and gets better every day.

Profound is on a mission to help companies understand and control their AI presence. As an Economist and Researcher, you will build trusted industry insights and measurement standards that explain how people use AI for search, shopping, and decision making. You will take real user conversations and AI model behavior and turn them into public-facing research that shapes the narrative of where AI is going and how brands must adapt.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Create accurate and rigorous research that becomes a trusted source of truth for AI usage trends and answer engine behavior

 - Engage with media, academia, and industry leaders to educate the market using evidence-grounded analysis

 - Identify emerging inflection points in AI search and AI shopping and quantify their impact on consumers and businesses

 - Publish research papers, reports, and insights that inform the product roadmap and guide strategic decisions

 - Uphold high standards of correctness, reproducibility, and transparency in all published outputs




WHO YOU ARE

 - Experience solving complex research problems in academia or industry, with 5 or more years of experience

 - Strong ability to validate assumptions, pressure test results, and ensure research can withstand scrutiny

 - Fluency in SQL and proficiency in R or Python for empirical analysis

 - Excellent communication skills and comfort presenting research externally

 - Ownership mindset, intellectual curiosity, and passion for answering questions that matter

 - Record of published research or public-facing insights that influenced decision making

 - Interested in publishing research cited by media, industry analysts, and academic partners

jobs.title: Production Coordinator, Silicon Assembly (Starlink)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

PRODUCTION COORDINATOR, SILICON ASSEMBLY (STARLINK)

As a Production Coordinator, you will keep silicon package production moving — coordinating workflows, tracking metrics, and clearing blockers so the team hits aggressive delivery schedules without compromising quality. You will work closely with engineering, supply chain, operations, and the production floor in a fast-paced manufacturing environment, supporting the build of packages used in Starlink products from early builds through high-volume output. The ideal candidate is motivated by Starlink’s mission to deliver high-speed, low-latency global connectivity.

Key Responsibilities

• Coordinate daily production for the silicon packaging line, including scheduling, material flow, and resource allocation to meet delivery commitments

• Track and report production status, yields, cycle times, and bottlenecks using manufacturing execution systems (MES) and other tools

• Liaise with engineering, quality, supply chain, and operations to resolve issues quickly and keep production on track

• Maintain accurate production records and inventory of critical materials (wafers, substrates, die, encapsulants, and related items)

• Support continuous improvement, 5S, and lean initiatives on the packaging floor to reduce waste and improve throughput

• Assist with new product introduction (NPI) and ramp-up of new packaging processes and equipment

• Ensure compliance with quality standards, ESD protocols, and cleanroom or controlled-environment procedures

Basic Qualifications

• High school diploma or GED

• 2+ years of experience in a production, manufacturing, or operations coordinator role

Preferred Skills & Experience

• Experience in semiconductor packaging, die attach, wire bonding, encapsulation, or similar processes

• Familiarity with MES systems

jobs.title: Remote Bilingual Therapist (Spanish) – Older Adults (LCSW, LMFT, LPC)
jobs.description:
Do the work you trained for, without the parts that burn you out. Sailor Health is hiring bilingual English/Spanish licensed mental health therapists to provide telehealth therapy to Spanish-speaking older adults, fully from home. We fill your caseload, handle billing and admin, and give you real clinical support, so your time goes to patients. Don’t just take our word for it: read what our therapists say in our Indeed reviews.




🌊 ABOUT SAILOR HEALTH

Older adults are too often overlooked by mental healthcare, and those who speak Spanish face even fewer options. Sailor Health exists to change that. Through Medicare-covered therapy, care navigation, and healthcare advocacy, we help older adults move through grief, loss, isolation, and life’s hardest transitions with more ease and peace of mind.

Our model is built around their needs and yours:

 - We handle everything outside the session. Care Navigators and Healthcare Advocates take on patients’ non-clinical needs, so your work stays clinical.

 - You’re part of a team. Clinical Quality Leads provide ongoing consultation, and our provider support team answers questions as they come up.

 - Language-concordant care by design. Spanish-speaking patients are matched with Spanish-speaking clinicians. You won’t be working through an interpreter or translating for the rest of the team.




⭐ THE POSITION

Location: Fully remote, anywhere in the U.S. | Schedule: You set it, 7 days a week available

We’re hiring independently licensed bilingual therapists for part-time or full-time roles, paid per session. Choose the setup that fits your life:

 - 1099 contractor: starting at 15 hours per week

 - W2 employee: starting at 25 hours per week, with full benefits




💙 WHAT WE OFFER

 - A full caseload, built for you. Share your availability and we’ll match you with Spanish-speaking older adults who fit your approach. No marketing, no chasing referrals. Most clinicians have a full caseload within a few weeks.

 - Support that’s actually there. A dedicated clinical lead and live admin help. Our providers tell us it’s the most supported they’ve felt in telehealth.

 - Your schedule, your call. Work the days and hours that suit you. No on-call, no required evenings.

 - Less paperwork, more therapy. Our telehealth platform and AI documentation assistant handle the busywork.

 - Room to grow. Free CEUs, geriatric-focused training, and clinical consultation with experienced directors.

 - Pay that works for you. 1099 clinicians earn competitive per-session rates, paid as full cash compensation.

 - Full benefits for W2 clinicians (25+ hours/week). Health, dental, and vision coverage, plus a 401(k) with up to 3.5% employer match.




💻 YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Provide evidence-based psychotherapy to Spanish-speaking older adults via telehealth

 - Conduct sessions fluently in Spanish, meeting patients in their language and cultural context

 - Build individualized treatment plans around each patient’s goals and needs

 - Manage your own caseload and clinical decisions, with a supportive care team behind you

 - Complete documentation in our EMR, with AI-assisted notes

 - Join regular, paid case consultations with experienced clinical leaders




📋 QUALIFICATIONS

 - Must be located in the United States

 - Active, independent clinical license (LCSW, LMFT, LPC, LMHC, or equivalent) in the state where this role is posted

 - Fluent in English and Spanish, able to conduct full therapy sessions in Spanish

 - Master’s or doctoral degree in social work, counseling, psychology, or marriage and family therapy

 - Experience with older adult or geriatric populations preferred

 - Comfortable with telehealth platforms and electronic health records

 - Medicare billing experience a plus (we handle billing either way)




✅ WHO THRIVES AT SAILOR

 - You care about the mission. Supporting older adults through grief, loss, and the challenges of later life feels meaningful to you.

 - You know what language access means clinically. Meeting a patient in their native language is one of the most powerful things a therapist can offer, especially in later life.

 - You understand this population. Maybe you’ve spent years working with older adults, or you’re later in your own career and chose this work on purpose.

 - You do your best work on a team. You want colleagues, a clinical lead, and real support, not just a login and good wishes.

 - You like independence with backup. You trust your clinical judgment and want infrastructure behind you, not oversight on top of you.




🚀 APPLY TODAY

If you want a full caseload, a flexible schedule, and a team that has your back while you serve Spanish-speaking older adults in their own language, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today, and our recruiting team will guide you through every step of the process.

Learn more: https://www.sailorhealth.com/careers/therapy

jobs.title: Vice President & Deputy General Counsel, Corporate

jobs.title: Technical Onboarding Manager
jobs.description:
As IMC continues to grow its client liquidity business, the technical onboarding of new clients has become central to how reliably and quickly those clients can access our liquidity. We are looking for a Technical Onboarding Manager to take dedicated ownership of the end-to-end onboarding and certification process from the first connectivity test through to a fully certified, production-ready client.

In this role you will sit at the intersection of our execution development teams, infrastructure, compliance, business development, and our clients. You will own the technical integration so that our developers can stay focused on building, and so that every client interacts correctly with IMC liquidity from day one. No two onboardings are identical, and the person in this role will make a considerable impact as the firm scales its client business.

Your Core Responsibilities:

• Own client certification across test and production environments.

• Validate client connectivity and routing setup.

• Coordinate the process across legal, compliance, clearing, infrastructure, development, and business teams.

• Ensure internal readiness across data, pricing, strategy configuration, and client setup.

• Monitor client connectivity, message quality, and trading behavior post-launch.

• Track dependencies, blockers, readiness, and certification through go-live.

• Ensure regulatory and post-trade readiness, including TRF and CAT reporting, AGU agreements, and trade reconciliation, in coordination with Mid Office and Compliance.

• Act as first line of response for onboarding-related issues and trigger re-certification where required.

Your Skills and Experience:

• Approximately 4+ years of relevant experience in client onboarding, connectivity, or client-integration engineering within an electronic trading environment; experience leading a regional onboarding or connectivity desk is an advantage.

• Strong FIX and electronic trading knowledge: a solid grasp of the order lifecycle (fills, rejects, cancels, IOC, short flags, sequence numbers, resets, drop copy), FIX version differences, and client-specific implementations.

• Hands-on technical ability: comfortable reading code, running SQL queries, setting up accounts, and debugging client integration and session issues using logs, FIX messages, and configuration files.

• Highly organized, with a track record of managing complex onboarding processes end to end across multiple stakeholders and dependencies.

• A strong communicator who can bridge Development, Infrastructure, Compliance, Business Development, and clients, and who can clearly articulate risks and open issues.

• Operationally disciplined, with an understanding of certification, monitoring, recertification, and repeatable onboarding processes.

• Familiarity with US equities regulatory reporting (TRF, CAT) and post-trade processes is an advantage.

• Experience with JIRA and CRM tooling is an advantage. Equities product knowledge is preferred.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, and a team player. At IMC, we’re all in it together.

The Base Salary range for the role is included below. Base salary is only one component of total compensation; all full-time, permanent positions are eligible for a discretionary bonus and benefits, including paid leave and insurance. Please visit Benefits - US | IMC Trading for more comprehensive information.

Salary Range

$175,000—$200,000 USD

About Us

IMC is a research-driven trading firm where quantitative modeling, machine learning, and engineering shape how modern markets are traded. A stabilizing force in markets since 1989, we provide liquidity across trading venues, delivering the best outcome in value and risk management to investors. Using our own technology and capital, we build proprietary systems and algorithms that operate across global markets. Our researchers, traders, and engineers work as a collective, combining rapid experimentation, advanced infrastructure, and real-time feedback to turn insight into execution and execution into advantage.

jobs.description:
About the Role

Abnormal AI stops the attacks other tools miss by understanding the behavior of every identity inside an organization. We protect more than 5,000 customers, including 30% of the Fortune 500, and we are growing from one product to a five-product AI Security suite. This role makes sure Finance keeps up.

The Chief of Staff to the CFO runs the CFO's most important strategic programs and makes sure they finish. You will sit in the room where priorities are set, then own the follow-through across Finance, GTM, R&D, Legal, and People. It is a high-autonomy, high-trust role, and nobody has written the playbook. You will see the full operating picture of a fast-growing company and shape how it matures.

AI is part of the job, not a side project. You will run Finance's AI adoption, build tools the team actually uses, and show others what is possible.

What you'll own

• Strategic programs. Run cross-functional programs for the CFO and strategy team: scope, milestones, owners, a weekly cadence, and a one-page status for the executive team. Escalate blockers early.

• Scale and controls. Own a program across 8 functional areas, from Accounting and controls to IT, cyber, and People, tracked against quarterly targets. Manage workstreams with external auditors and legal counsel.

• Finance operating rhythm. Run goal-setting, check-ins, and progress reporting, and track commitments across the CFO's direct reports so open items close on time.

• AI in Finance. Run recurring enablement and build practical tools for real workflows, such as performance review drafting, talent review intake, and action-item tracking. Report impact in hours saved and adoption.

• Talent, international expansion, and ESG. Run Finance talent reviews, the pulse survey, and team learning. Own the framework for deciding where Abnormal can sell, transact, and hire. Run the ESG engagement.

What 12 months looks like

• The executive team gets a one-page status every week, and no program surprises them.

• Finance commitments close on their date, and slips are visible before they happen.

• AI adoption in Finance rises every quarter, measured in hours saved and active users.

What you bring

• 12+ years in a Chief of Staff, program management, strategy and operations, or consulting role, ideally with Finance exposure or time at a late-stage, high-growth SaaS company.

• A record of running multi-stakeholder programs with hard deadlines, such as an audit, a systems implementation, or a compliance effort.

• You turn ambiguity into owners and dates, and you have started programs from a blank page.

• Strong writing and executive presence. You will represent the CFO in leadership settings.

• You push for dates and hold senior people to their commitments without making it personal.

• You use AI to change how work gets done, and you can show us something you built.

Nice to Have

jobs.title: Intern, Non-Clinical Safety

Location:  This position may be performed remotely but requires the flexibility and willingness to travel as needed.

The Opportunity

Praxis is seeking an undergraduate intern to join our Non-Clinical Safety team, working part-time during the academic year and full-time during summer break(s). This role provides hands-on experience supporting the non-clinical development of medicines for CNS disorders, with exposure to drug metabolism and pharmacokinetics (DMPK), toxicology, and the broader drug development process.

You’ll apply what you’re learning in the classroom to meaningful work—organizing and improving how study information is managed, building tools that help the team track progress, and contributing to continuous improvement projects. This is an opportunity to build practical industry experience while taking real ownership of work that supports the Non-Clinical team.

Primary Responsibilities

• Review, organize, and assign metadata to reports from in vitro Drug Metabolism and Pharmacokinetics (DMPK) studies.

• Build and maintain a dashboard or tracking tool that provides clear visibility into the status of in vitro DMPK studies.

• Take ownership of assigned projects, manage work against agreed timelines, and provide clear, regular updates on progress and roadblocks.

• Support continuous improvement projects across Non-Clinical Development, including Toxicology, Drug Metabolism, and Pharmacokinetics.

• Work with colleagues across the Non-Clinical team to understand how scientific data and studies contribute to the broader drug development process.

• Identify opportunities to improve the organization, accessibility, and usefulness of Non-Clinical information and tools.

Qualifications and Key Success Factors

• Currently enrolled as a junior or senior in a bachelor’s degree program in life sciences or a related field.

• Strong written communication skills and attention to detail, particularly when organizing and documenting scientific information.

• Comfortable working with databases and/or spreadsheets; proficiency with Microsoft Office is required, and experience with Smartsheet is preferred.

• Able to organize and prioritize work, stay focused, and independently move assigned projects forward while knowing when to ask for help.

• Curious and motivated to learn about non-clinical development and the pharmaceutical industry.

• Able to collaborate effectively with colleagues across different scientific and functional areas.

• Laboratory experience is preferred, particularly exposure to in vitro Drug Metabolism and Pharmacokinetics work.

• Key success in this role will come from ownership, curiosity, reliability, and a willingness to learn. We’re looking for someone who doesn’t just complete assigned tasks, but asks good questions, communicates clearly, and looks for ways to make the work better.

The physical and mental requirements of our roles include but are not limited to regular use of a computer, devices or other office equipment, clear communication, and occasional movement.  You'll need comfort with screen work, basic hand coordination, and focus.  Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions.

Compensation & Benefits

At Praxis, we believe that taking care of our people (and their people) is important, so we provide a world class benefits package to help you thrive.  This includes 99% of the premium paid for medical, dental and vision plans.  We also provide company-paid life insurance, AD&D, disability benefits, and voluntary plans to personalize your coverage. Thinking about the future?  We match dollar-for-dollar up to 6% on eligible 401(k) contributions and sweeten the deal with long-term stock incentives and ESPP.  We provide a discretionary quarterly bonus, an extremely flexible wellness benefit, generous PTO, paid holidays and company-wide shutdowns.  Not to mention, you'll also be joining a phenomenal crew of colleagues who are smart, engaged and inspiring.  We aim high, collaborate hard, and produce results.  Let’s achieve the impossible together!

Company Overview

Praxis Precision Medicines is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company translating genetic insights into the development of therapies for central nervous system disorders characterized by neuronal imbalance.  At Praxis we share a common vision of reshaping the human condition into a more freeing and fulfilled existence by developing high impact medicines for patients and families affected by and living with complex brain disorders.  Our core Values of Trust, Ownership, Curiosity and Results are foundational to every aspect of our business and are exemplified by each and every one of our team members.

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion
Guided by our core values, at Praxis Precision Medicines, Inc. we continue to DARE FOR MORE® to advance, promote, and champion diversity, equity, and inclusion by encouraging individuals to bring their authentic selves and perspectives to work each day. We are an equal opportunity employer and committed to providing opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, religious creed, color, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, genetics, military service and veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

These postings seek financial information in connection with fraudulent opportunities for employment. jobs.title: Market Research Analyst
jobs.description:
About Us

At VISASQ/COLEMAN, we connect businesses with hard-to-find expertise through our extensive global network of subject matter experts. VISASQ/COLEMAN is a partnership formed by VisasQ Inc., Asia's leading expert network and the only publicly traded company in our field. Through VisasQ’s merger with Coleman Research, a trusted expert service provider with over 20 years of experience, VISASQ/COLEMAN offers tailored consulting solutions for consulting firms, asset management funds, and corporations seeking primary research insights.

Our mission is to eliminate barriers to knowledge by facilitating direct exchanges of critical insights across industries. We take pride in utilizing our comprehensive internal database of qualified experts, along with our ability to custom recruit specialists for each project, ensuring our clients receive timely and relevant information to inform their decision-making processes.

With offices in Phoenix, Raleigh, New York, United Kingdom, Hong Kong, Bogotá and Japan, we empower our clients to navigate complex markets and gain a competitive edge. Join us in revolutionizing informed decision-making by transforming how businesses access expert insights.

For more information, visit our website.

Opportunity:

As a Market Research Analyst, you will support survey projects from start to finish. This includes reviewing questionnaires, testing links, managing data quality, and assisting with client communications. The role is ideal for someone who enjoys detail-oriented work and is ready to grow their skills in project management and client engagement within a fast-paced, supportive team.

You will work closely with colleagues across the U.S., EMEA, and APAC contributing to a truly global research team. To support collaboration and client coverage, we are looking for someone based on the U.S. East Coast, with a strong preference for Raleigh, NC.

Key Responsibilities:

• Manage responsibilities for assigned survey projects, including:

Reviewing questionnaires and providing constructive feedback

Testing survey links and compiling feedback from stakeholders

Conducting data quality reviews and final checks

Compiling and preparing final raw data files for client delivery

• Assist in assessing survey feasibility and developing quotes and proposals

• Participate in client intake and project management calls

• Coordinate day-to-day communication with clients under guidance from Associate or Market Research Managers

• Monitor survey fieldwork using Qualtrics or similar platforms; support basic programming tasks when needed

• Use ERM tools at a basic level to manage records, search projects, and track progress

• Support vendor communication and develop vendor management skills on assigned and collaborative projects

• Maintain accurate records in CRM and use PowerBI to review client activity and performance data

• Escalate any project-related risks or issues to senior team members as needed

• Contribute to a collaborative team culture and support process improvement efforts

This position offers a unique opportunity to thrive in a dynamic environment and contribute meaningfully to our clients’ success while driving your own professional growth.

The above job description is not intended to be all-encompassing; rather, it provides a general description of the types of duties a Market Research Analyst can be expected to perform. The nature of the expert network industry allows for a variance in day-to-day tasks as Market Research Analyst respond to ever-changing client needs. The types of tasks performed, and the amount of time spent on certain tasks will vary according to client type, client need, and the macro environment of the industries in which our clients operate.

Ideal Candidates Will Have:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent

• 3+ years of experience in quantitative market research, preferably in B2B

• Familiarity with both online and CATI survey methodologies

• Working knowledge of Qualtrics (or similar platforms); comfortable supporting survey setup and send-outs

• Basic proficiency with ERM systems, CRM platforms, and PowerBI

• Strong attention to detail and excellent organizational skills

• Confident communicator with experience in client-facing roles

• Ability to manage multiple deadlines and shifting priorities

• Skilled in Excel and the Microsoft Office suite

• Proactive, collaborative, and motivated to grow in a fast-paced environment

• Agile research experience and global collaboration interest a plus

Note: Must be authorized to work in the United States.

Why Join Us?

At VISASQ/COLEMAN, we are committed to your professional growth and success. Our employees are our most valuable assets, which is why we offer:

At VISASQ/COLEMAN, we are committed to your professional growth and success. Our employees are our most valuable assets, which is why we offer:

• Competitive Salary & Bonuses: Benefit from a rewarding compensation package that includes performance-based bonuses, which may be awarded on a quarterly or annual basis, depending on your role.

• Excellent Health Benefits: We cover high percentages of insurance premiums, and if you opt for a qualifying HDHP, we offer employer HSA contributions.

• 401K Contributions: Planning for your future? We’ve got you covered!

• Flexible Working Environment: Depending on location, this role may be fully remote or follow a hybrid work model, requiring only 10 in-office days per month.

• Generous Time Off: Enjoy Responsible Paid Time Off, 7 sick days, and observe 12 holidays off.

• Parental Leave: Take time off to support and bond with your growing family, ensuring new parents can adjust to their new roles.

• Ongoing Learning and Development: Our training aligns with our core values, ensuring you have the resources and skills to excel throughout your career.

• Team Engagement: Participate in regular team outings and social events and receive tenure gifts to celebrate your journey with us.

• Employer Provided Technology: All necessary technology will be provided to facilitate your work.

• Corporate Social Responsibility Days: Take the opportunity to give back to your community during paid service days.

As a Market Research Analyst, you will have the opportunity to launch your career in the rapidly growing market research industry, where your success is our primary focus. At VISASQ/COLEMAN, we are committed to seeing you thrive, supporting your professional development with mentorship programs and continuous learning opportunities. Our open and collaborative environment ensures every voice is heard as we work together to make insightful connections possible.

Become a part of our dynamic team and build a better future—one insightful connection at a time!

A Market Research Analyst salary compensates them for all hours worked, which may vary from week to week. Market Research Analyst carry an FLSA-exempt status and are not eligible for overtime pay.

jobs.title: Client Success Manager
jobs.description:
Lyra Technology Group is a private equity-backed holding company that invests in and operates industry leading technology service businesses. Our companies are operated independently by exceptional management teams. Companies that join our group retain the employees, name, and culture that have made them successful. As a platform of Evergreen Services Group, we never divest from businesses we partner with and approach every decision with the goal of driving sustainable and healthy growth over the long term.

Lyra Technology Group is seeking a Client Success Manager for one of our operating companies, Strategic Micro Systems.  The Client Success Manager is the post-sale owner of client relationships, retention, and account growth: the person clients turn to when they want a trusted partner in their technology decisions, not just a point of contact. This role blends relationship management with a working knowledge of the client's business and IT environment, running a disciplined cadence of business reviews and roadmap conversations that keep clients engaged, informed, and getting full value from the partnership. The Client Success Manager owns retention and expansion targets for an assigned book of business and works cross-functionally with service delivery, technical support, and sales to make sure client needs are met and expansion opportunities are identified early.

About Strategic Micro Systems…

Founded in 1998, Strategic Micro Systems is a highly ranked MSP in New Jersey. As a Microsoft Certified partner and Tier 1 Microsoft Cloud Solution Provider, Strategic delivers unlimited network support alongside a full portfolio of cloud IT solutions for businesses across the country and around the world. Our best-in-class business continuity and data protection services keep clients’ systems running and secure against cyber threats.  Our clients rely on our expertise to build agile, growth-ready technology infrastructure that boosts productivity and profitability. In today’s global marketplace, staying agile and competitive is no longer optional, and we make sure our clients’ technology delivers real value to their organizations. Our team combines deep technical knowledge with business experience to solve even the most complex challenges.  Above all, we are committed to our clients’ success, and we bring a customer-centric approach to everything we do. We believe that when our clients succeed, we succeed.

You will own…

Client Relationship Management

• Serve as the primary relationship owner for an assigned portfolio of managed services clients.

• Develop trusted relationships with executive stakeholders, business owners, and key decision-makers.

• Act as the primary point of contact for non-technical client communications and account-related matters.

• Advocate for clients internally while ensuring alignment with company objectives and service delivery standards.

Strategic Account Management

• Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) focused on business objectives, technology strategy, service performance, and future planning.

• Develop strategic account plans designed to increase client engagement, retention, and long-term value.

• Proactively identify opportunities to expand client relationships through additional managed services, cybersecurity, Microsoft 365, cloud solutions, licensing, and professional services.

• Prepare proposals and coordinate solution recommendations in partnership with engineering and leadership teams.

• Manage contract renewals and renewal planning to maximize retention and minimize contract risk.

Client Success & Growth

• Monitor client satisfaction, account health, and service adoption.

• Address client concerns proactively and coordinate internal resources to resolve issues before they escalate.

• Partner closely with technical and operational teams to ensure successful delivery of services and projects.

• Maintain accurate account documentation, opportunity tracking, and client activity within HubSpot and ConnectWise.

Revenue Development

• Drive organic revenue growth through account expansion, cross-selling, and upselling initiatives.

• Maintain awareness of each client's business objectives and identify opportunities where technology solutions can deliver measurable value.

• Collaborate with leadership to develop and execute account growth strategies.

Our ideal Client Success Manager has the following qualifications:

• 3+ years of experience in Account Management, Client Success, Customer Success, Business Development, or a similar client-facing role.

• Experience within the Managed IT Services (MSP), IT Services, SaaS, or technology industry is strongly preferred.

• Demonstrated ability to build and maintain executive-level client relationships.

• Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.

• Excellent organizational, planning, and time management abilities.

• Ability to successfully manage multiple client relationships simultaneously.

• Experience using CRM platforms such as HubSpot.

• Experience with ConnectWise Manage and ConnectWise CPQ is preferred.

• Comfortable initiating commercial conversations and identifying opportunities within existing client accounts.

• Previous consultative sales or account growth experience is considered a strong asset.

The targeted base compensation for this role is $80,000, with total on-target earnings of $100,000. This position is fully on-site in Parsippany, NJ.

If you are a post-sale relationship-builder who builds trust face to face, knows how to turn client relationships into long-term partnerships, and wants to build something, not just manage it, we would like to talk.

jobs.title: Senior Financial Analyst
jobs.description:
About Moloco:

Moloco is an AI-native performance advertising company, bringing the power of AI advertising to the open internet. Founded in 2013 by machine learning engineers who had built AI advertising systems inside the world's largest technology companies, Moloco began from a shared mission: to build that same engine for the open internet.

Today, Moloco is one company with two businesses, built on the same compound AI system. Moloco Ads is our AI-native performance advertising platform, helping mobile app marketers acquire, retain, and re-engage high-value users across the open internet. Moloco Commerce Media is our AI-native retail media platform, enabling retailers and marketplaces to turn their platforms into thriving ad businesses. Both are powered by CARA (Compound Ad Recommendation Architecture), the AI system behind every Moloco product.

At Moloco, we bring together those who've already solved hard problems and those with the drive to. Here, we work on some of the complex problems in AI advertising, at a scale and level of sophistication very few companies can offer. Come build what's next.

The Impact You'll Be Contributing to Moloco:

Moloco is currently looking for a Senior Financial Analyst to join our collaborative FP&A team. This position reports to a Corporate FP&A lead and will have an active role in the executive / internal & external reporting, budgeting, and forecasting processes. The ideal candidate is a highly motivated self-starter with the ability to manage multiple priorities. The ideal candidate thrives in dynamic environments across all levels of management, functions, and geographies.

The Opportunity:

• Maintain and improve detailed financial models that track and analyze key metrics and their impact on the company's overall performance

• Drive scenario and sensitivity analyses for medium to long range modelling

• Actively collaborate with select business leaders to assess needs and proactively identify and share short- and long-term opportunities for improved financial performance and strategic decision making

• Work closely with the accounting team to ensure timely and accurate financial closes

• Analyze actual financial results versus budget and prepare flux analysis to select business leaders and leadership

• Assist in annual planning and forecasting process (including P&L, Balance Sheet and Cash Flow)

• Build presentations for internal leadership and external stakeholders

• Actively identify opportunities for process improvement and challenge the status quo

What You'll Bring:

• BA/BS degree in a quantitative discipline

jobs.title: Lead Analog/Mixed-Signal ASIC Design Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

Born at X, Google's Moonshot Factory, Taara is on a mission to connect billions of people who lack abundant and affordable internet by pioneering high-throughput, long-range free-space optical communication (FSOC). Our links use eye-safe lasers propagating between two terminals to transmit high-speed data wirelessly. Lead the charge in bringing our groundbreaking wireless optical communication to the world. Join us to light the way toward bridging the digital divide and illuminating the future.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Taara is seeking a Lead Analog/Mixed-Signal ASIC Design Engineer to work on the next generation of co-integrated electronic and photonic modules. You will be part of an R&D team developing cutting-edge wireless optical communication systems based on integrated optical phased arrays.

The successful candidate will lead ASIC tape-out efforts, own the ASIC top-level architecture, and drive the delivery and validation of ASIC dies. This includes making hands-on contributions to Analog/Mixed-Signal (AMS) ASIC designs and coordinating a small team of ASIC design and layout engineers. The role requires extensive experience in ASIC design and layout—including top-level ownership of ASIC tape-outs at leading commercial foundries—and deep expertise in either or both of these two categories: high-precision AMS circuits and high-speed wireline/silicon photonics interface circuits.

We are looking for a highly motivated individual who thrives in ambiguity, enjoys working in a small, dynamic team environment, and has a passion for solving challenging problems that lead to high-impact technological advances.




HOW YOU WILL MAKE A 10X IMPACT

 - Own and deliver custom ASICs for co-integration with large-scale photonic integrated circuits to form record-breaking integrated modules.

 - Contribute to ASIC design and layout, system-level optimization, and product strategy.

 - Demonstrate a strong motivation to make the world a better place through technology and a desire to be part of the team making this happen.


WHAT YOU SHOULD HAVE

 - Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering or a related field.

 - 10 or more years of relevant industry experience with demonstrated achievements in analog/mixed-signal circuit design and implementation in modern CMOS technologies.

 - Demonstrated deep design expertise in one or both of the following categories:
   
   - High-precision designs: Analog-to-digital and digital-to-analog converters, bandgap references, voltage regulators, amplifiers, and other supporting circuitry. Integration and co-simulation of analog and digital circuits in the context of mixed-signal design and verification.
   
   - High-speed designs: Front-end circuits for optical communication, including modulator drivers and transimpedance amplifiers (TIAs) operating at tens of GHz, and broadband circuits for serial links including receivers, transmitters, and equalizers. Electromagnetic design of high-frequency transmission lines, inductors, and other passive elements.

 - Experience owning top-level ASIC architecture and coordinating engineering teams.

 - Hands-on experience leading multiple ASIC tape-outs at commercial foundries.

 - Hands-on experience with Design Rule Checks (DRC), Layout Versus Schematic (LVS), Power Integrity (PI), and Signal Integrity (SI) verification.


IT WOULD BE GREAT IF YOU ALSO HAD

 - Experience with planning and executing verification of large Systems-on-Chip (SoCs) incorporating complex digital logic and large numbers of custom-designed blocks.

 - Experience with hardware description languages, such as Register-Transfer Level (RTL) code, and RTL-to-GDS design flows using industry-standard EDA tools for synthesis, timing analysis, and place-and-route.

 - Experience with versioning tools such as SOS and Git.

 - Experience with commercial layout verification software (Calibre or equivalent).

 - Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to work effectively with senior external partners.

 - Hands-on experience advancing a product from the prototype phase to the final production stage.


LOCATION & COMPENSATION

A hybrid or onsite setup in Sunnyvale, CA, is preferred, though remote work can be considered. Relocation assistance can be provided.

The US salary range for this full-time position is $258,000 - $294,000 (inclusive of bonus at target) + equity + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your location during the hiring process.

jobs.title: Manager, Product Integrity — Connected Products
jobs.description:
Fortune Brands Innovations is hiring a Manager, Product Integrity to join our Connected Products team. Product Integrity is the team that confirms our connected products — Flo by Moen water devices, Yale and August smart locks, and Master Lock connected padlocks — do what their requirements say they do before they reach a customer. This role leads that team and owns the bridge between requirements and proof: taking what Product, Systems Architecture, and Compliance ask for and turning it into tests with a method, a sample size, and a pass/fail criterion.

The role also owns 100% end-of-line testing at the factory, including test fixture design and test software. Depending on test complexity, fixtures are built fully in-house or developed with a supplier.

We are looking for a leader who can spearhead the product quality and integrity function covering test definition, systems integration, test execution, and holding a high product integrity bar. This leader will lead a hardware testing team. The right person understands the whole product — electrical, mechanical, firmware, and how they interact — well enough to argue a requirement with Product, an interface with Architecture, and the statistics with Reliability, and then run the lab that proves it.

Position location: this position is eligible to work in a hybrid environment out of our North Olmsted, OH or San Francisco, CA locations. Remote days are Monday and Friday.

What you will own

• The Product Integrity team. Lead a team of test engineers covering production and 100% test, hardware test, reliability test, quality inspection, and overall confirmation of product requirements. You set the direction and the standard; the team executes.
• Requirements into tests. Turn every hardware requirement in the PRD — from Product, Systems Architecture, and Compliance — into a testable requirement with a method, a sample size, an acceptance criterion, and a gate. Product defines the design envelope; you define how we test to it.
• Gate evidence. Every stage gate (EVT, DVT, PVT) carries your evidence package: what was tested, against which requirement, with what result.
• Reliability. Define the reliability test plan for each program and own the statistics behind it: sample sizes, confidence levels, and acceleration factors for environmental testing.
• Production test. Develop fixtures and test software that meet approved cycle times, with test limits tied to expected field performance.
• Field performance. Review returns and field data, and feed what you learn back into requirements and test plans.

The team and the logistics

• Team: test engineers covering production test, hardware test, reliability test, and quality inspection. The lab is in North Olmsted.
• Location: North Olmsted, OH or San Francisco, CA. If based in San Francisco, expect occasional travel to North Olmsted.
• Travel: ~15%. Travel to factories in Nogales and Tecate, Mexico; Hanoi, Vietnam; and between North Olmsted and San Francisco.

Qualifications

• 10+ years on connected consumer hardware spanning electrical, mechanical, and firmware.

• Experience developing factory test fixtures at both board level and end of line.

• Experience writing requirements and V&V plans.

• Reliability engineering fluency: accelerated life testing, Weibull and AFR math, sample sizing at a stated confidence, HALT/HASS, thermal, drop, and cycle life. You can design a plan and read a failure.

• Production test experience: fixtures, test software, DFT, cycle time, and yield at a contract manufacturer.

• Has led a small technical team and is comfortable setting direction for test engineers who are more hands-on than you.

Nice to have

• Battery power model development.

• Sensor products with calibration and drift requirements.

• Sealed or outdoor enclosures.

• RF performance characterization.

• Certification literacy across safety (UL), RF (FCC), and interop (Matter/CSA); NSF/IAPMO for water products or BHMA for locks.
