jobs.title: Head of Marketing
jobs.description:
Role Summary

The Head of Marketing leads Enavate’s marketing strategy and is accountable for building our market presence, generating pipeline and supporting growth with existing clients. This person owns the marketing plan, budget, team priorities and results. They work closely with Sales and the business leaders to focus our efforts where they will have the greatest impact.

We need a leader who can think strategically and get things done. The Head of Marketing oversees demand generation, digital marketing, positioning and messaging, content and communications, marketing operations, partner marketing and the BDR function. They will develop the team, make decisions and step directly into important work when needed.

Key Responsibilities

• Build and manage the annual marketing strategy, plan and budget around Enavate’s growth goals.

• Define how Enavate stands out in the market. Turn our Microsoft expertise, services and industry knowledge into clear messages that resonate with buyers.

• Be accountable for Marketing’s contribution to pipeline and bookings, with clear goals and reliable reporting.

• Lead and develop the Marketing team. Set priorities, address performance issues and stay involved in the work that matters most.

• Oversee the BDR function, including inbound lead response, qualification, follow-up and conversion. Agree on funnel definitions and targets with Sales, and address gaps quickly.

• Set quarterly priorities across new business, existing client growth, Microsoft and partner programs, and brand awareness.

• Work with Sales leadership to improve lead quality, handoffs and follow up.

• Make the most of our Microsoft and technology partner relationships, including joint campaigns, co-selling support and available funding programs.

• Use campaign results, conversion data, customer feedback and market insight to decide where to invest.

• Run regular planning and performance reviews, and make adjustments based on results.

• Find practical ways to use AI and automation to improve research, content, campaign execution and team productivity. Keep Enavate visible as buyer search behavior changes, including SEO and AEO.

• Build strong working relationships with Sales, Delivery, Microsoft, partners and internal subject matter experts.

• Give the executive team a clear view of results, risks, priorities and decisions needed.

Leadership Scope

• Take ownership of Marketing’s direction and results. Bring recommendations, make decisions and challenge approaches that are not delivering.

• Coach team members, clarify responsibilities and resolve competing priorities. Know when to delegate and when to get directly involved.

• Ensure content, communications, thought leadership, PR and social media support Enavate’s business priorities. Organize the work around the strengths and capacity of the team.

• Work with Sales to agree on lead definitions, qualification standards, handoffs and follow-up responsibilities.

• Make sure Demand Generation, Marketing Operations and BDRs work together so leads are followed up, qualified and moved into Sales opportunities.

• Create a team culture where people take ownership, share what is working and improve what is not.

Ideal Experience and Capabilities

• 10+ years of B2B marketing experience in technology, cloud, software or technology services, including substantial experience leading a marketing function or team.

• A track record of marketing programs that have generated pipeline, supported bookings and helped grow client relationships.

• Experience managing BDRs or an inbound lead qualification team, including performance goals and Sales handoffs.

• Strong skills in demand generation, positioning and go-to-market planning, plus the ability to lead specialists in digital, content, communications, operations and partner marketing.

• Experience working closely with Sales leaders to improve lead quality and conversion.

• Ability to lead people with different skills, develop talent and hold the team accountable.

• Comfort with budgets, marketing performance data, attribution and campaign ROI.

• Good judgment about where to spend time and money, and the confidence to say no to lower-priority work.

• Clear communication with executives and the ability to turn data into recommendations.

• Experience in the Microsoft partner ecosystem is strongly preferred.

• Hands-on experience using AI and automation in marketing, with an understanding of SEO and AEO.

What Success Looks Like

• Marketing plans and spending support Enavate’s business goals.

• Marketing contributes measurable pipeline, bookings and growth with existing clients.

• Inbound leads are followed up promptly and measured against agreed conversion targets.

• Marketing and Sales agree on lead quality, handoffs and follow-up, and work together to improve results.

• Team members know what they own, deliver on priorities and raise issues early.

• Enavate tells a clear, consistent story across campaigns, digital channels, partner programs and Sales conversations.

• Marketing investment decisions are based on results, and programs that are not working are changed or stopped.

ABOUT ENAVATE

Transforming Businesses and the Lives They Touch

At Enavate, we are the Microsoft-focused business applications, Cloud services, and managed services company. We help businesses embrace the future by guiding them through ERP implementations, migrations to the cloud, and integrations that streamline their operations, allowing them to thrive in an ever-evolving business landscape.

Our work isn’t just about technology—it’s about transforming the way businesses operate, empowering them to grow, innovate, and succeed. By partnering with our clients, we provide peace of mind, enabling them to focus on what matters most while we handle the complexity of their systems and processes.

To learn more about what we do and how we make an impact, please check out our "What We Do?" 1-pager.

Our Culture

Whether you’re joining us in North America, Europe, or beyond, Enavate offers a dynamic and collaborative environment where you’ll have the opportunity to make a real impact.

At Enavate, we’re driven by our core values, and our people are at the heart of everything we do:

• Team Members: We take care of our own.

• Innovation: We explore, evolve, and seek excellence at every level.

• Results: We are achievers who set high goals and reach them.

• Integrity: We are trustworthy. Our word is our bond.

We believe that a diverse and inclusive team leads to better innovation and outcomes. We actively support diversity and inclusion through a variety of initiatives, creating a workplace where everyone is respected and valued.

To gain a deeper understanding of our values and the environment we foster at Enavate, take a look at our "Enavate Culture" Guide.

What We Offer

At Enavate, we’re committed to providing a supportive and rewarding environment that empowers you to thrive both professionally and personally. Here’s a glimpse of the benefits and perks you’ll enjoy as part of our team:

• Health and Wellness We offer competitive health insurance, wellness programs, and mental health resources to support your well-being, both physically and mentally.

• Flexible Work Arrangements We believe in work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible working hours and, where applicable, remote work options to help you manage both your professional responsibilities and personal needs.

• Team Member Recognition We appreciate and celebrate the hard work and achievements of our team. Our team member recognition programs are designed to acknowledge your contributions and ensure you feel valued at every step of your journey with us.

Work Structure & Collaboration

At Enavate, we embrace flexibility in how we work, but we also believe that collaboration is key to our success. Our office locations in Tampa, FL, Fargo, ND, and Kyiv, Ukraine are central to our culture and provide a hub for team interaction and innovation.

All North American new hires are onboarded in person at our Tampa office. Onboarding typically lasts 3 days, depending on the role, and provides a dedicated opportunity to connect with your leader, teammates, and our company culture.

Our Hiring Process

At Enavate, we take a thoughtful approach to hiring that ensures a great fit for both you and us. Our process includes:

• Interviews – A combination of technical and cultural interviews, focused on your expertise, problem-solving abilities, and alignment with our core values.

We aim to provide you with a clear understanding of your fit with Enavate, and we want to ensure you feel confident in your decision to join us.

Join Us in Our Mission!

At Enavate, we believe in transforming businesses and the lives they touch – because to us, it’s personal. If you're ready to make an impact, we invite you to be part of a team that listens, challenges, collaborates, and takes action. jobs.description:
What We Do:

Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact.

Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote-first team working to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. We work closely with security teams and service providers protecting complex environments, often without the time or headcount to handle it all. That’s why we build our technology in-house and back it with a 24/7 human-led Security Operations Center (SOC). As a result, our platform is never disconnected from the experts who manage it, ensuring our customers' protection.

Huntress now secures more than 6M endpoints and 17M identities worldwide. Those numbers keep growing because more businesses rely on us to help carry the load and operate with more confidence. Every day, you can see that commitment in how we stand with our customers and how we show up for each other.

Reports to: Sr. Director, Demand Integration

Location: Remote US

Compensation Range: $142,000 to $152,000 base plus bonus and equity

What You'll Do:

You own the lifecycle operating model for customer and partner growth, turning signals into plays that improve cross-sell performance, recover closed-lost opportunities, and identify where automation can change how the work gets done. On the Demand Integration team within Revenue Operations, you set priorities, make tradeoffs, and turn ambiguous opportunities into clear paths from marketing handoff through CAM execution. You shape the requirements, operating rhythms, and success measures that keep teams aligned, while the Customer Campaigns and Product Marketing teams own broader campaign strategy, content, and channel plans.

You are Give a $h*t in the way you identify gaps, take ownership of the operating model, and make the motion work instead of sending another one-off list to the field. You are Outcome-Obsessed about the measurable impact of lifecycle programs, from qualified expansion opportunities to recovered pipeline and efficient rep follow-up. Perfect Imperfection shows up in how you use data and feedback to make informed tradeoffs, improve the system, and raise the quality of each iteration. You lead through influence by building stakeholder buy-in, incorporating feedback from CAMs and partner teams, and keeping cross-functional decisions moving.

Responsibilities:

• Set and own the lifecycle operating model for customers and partners from marketing handoff through Account Management (CAM) execution, securing stakeholder buy-in, incorporating feedback from customer-facing teams, and aligning cross-functional priorities to improve expansion outcomes.

• Identify, prioritize, and lead high-value automation opportunities across lifecycle execution by diagnosing process gaps, defining requirements, aligning stakeholders, and implementing scalable workflows, routing, and handoffs across go-to-market platforms.

• Establish the measurement framework for lifecycle performance, including engagement, rep follow-through, conversion, recovered pipeline, and influenced pipeline, then use the findings to set priorities and improve the operating model.

• You have experience designing targeted lifecycle motions across marketing automation, email, CRM, and sales engagement platforms, including the audience segmentation required to support them.

• You are comfortable working with customer, opportunity, product, and engagement data to build accurate audiences and evaluate play performance.

jobs.title: Remote Bilingual Therapist (Spanish) – Older Adults (LCSW, LMFT, LPCC)
jobs.description:
Do the work you trained for, without the parts that burn you out. Sailor Health is hiring bilingual English/Spanish, California-licensed mental health therapists for W2 roles providing telehealth therapy to Spanish-speaking older adults, fully from home. We fill your caseload, handle billing and admin, and give you real clinical support, so your time goes to patients. Don’t just take our word for it: read what our therapists say in our Indeed reviews.




🌊 ABOUT SAILOR HEALTH

Older adults are too often overlooked by mental healthcare, and those who speak Spanish face even fewer options. Sailor Health exists to change that. Through Medicare-covered therapy, care navigation, and healthcare advocacy, we help older adults move through grief, loss, isolation, and life’s hardest transitions with more ease and peace of mind.

Our model is built around their needs and yours:

 - We handle everything outside the session. Care Navigators and Healthcare Advocates take on patients’ non-clinical needs, so your work stays clinical.

 - You’re part of a team. Clinical Quality Leads provide ongoing consultation, and our provider support team answers questions as they come up.

 - Language-concordant care by design. Spanish-speaking patients are matched with Spanish-speaking clinicians. You won’t be working through an interpreter or translating for the rest of the team.




⭐ THE POSITION

Location: Fully remote, anywhere in the U.S. | Schedule: You set it, 7 days a week available

We’re hiring independently licensed bilingual California therapists for full-time W2 roles, paid per session. Start at 25 hours per week and build from there, with full benefits.




💙 WHAT WE OFFER

 - A full caseload, built for you. Share your availability and we’ll match you with Spanish-speaking older adults who fit your approach. No marketing, no chasing referrals. Most clinicians have a full caseload within a few weeks.

 - Support that’s actually there. A dedicated clinical lead and live admin help. Our providers tell us it’s the most supported they’ve felt in telehealth.

 - Your schedule, your call. Work the days and hours that suit you. No on-call, no required evenings.

 - Less paperwork, more therapy. Our telehealth platform and AI documentation assistant handle the busywork.

 - Room to grow. Free CEUs, geriatric-focused training, and clinical consultation with experienced directors.

 - Competitive pay and full benefits. Competitive per-session rates, plus health, dental, and vision coverage and a 401(k) with up to 3.5% employer match.




💻 YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Provide evidence-based psychotherapy to Spanish-speaking older adults via telehealth

 - Conduct sessions fluently in Spanish, meeting patients in their language and cultural context

 - Build individualized treatment plans around each patient’s goals and needs

 - Manage your own caseload and clinical decisions, with a supportive care team behind you

 - Complete documentation in our EMR, with AI-assisted notes

 - Join regular, paid case consultations with experienced clinical leaders




📋 QUALIFICATIONS

 - Must be located in the United States

 - Active, independent California clinical license: LCSW, LMFT, or LPCC

 - Fluent in English and Spanish, able to conduct full therapy sessions in Spanish

 - Master’s or doctoral degree in social work, counseling, psychology, or marriage and family therapy

 - Experience with older adult or geriatric populations preferred

 - Comfortable with telehealth platforms and electronic health records

 - Medicare billing experience a plus (we handle billing either way)




✅ WHO THRIVES AT SAILOR

 - You care about the mission. Supporting older adults through grief, loss, and the challenges of later life feels meaningful to you.

 - You know what language access means clinically. Meeting a patient in their native language is one of the most powerful things a therapist can offer, especially in later life.

 - You understand this population. Maybe you’ve spent years working with older adults, or you’re later in your own career and chose this work on purpose.

 - You do your best work on a team. You want colleagues, a clinical lead, and real support, not just a login and good wishes.

 - You like independence with backup. You trust your clinical judgment and want infrastructure behind you, not oversight on top of you.




🚀 APPLY TODAY

If you want a full caseload, a flexible schedule, full benefits, and a team that has your back while you serve Spanish-speaking older adults in their own language, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today, and our recruiting team will guide you through every step of the process.

Learn more: https://www.sailorhealth.com/careers/therapy

jobs.title: Senior Motion Designer
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

About the role
We are looking for a Senior Motion Designer to help shape how SpaceXSI moves and shows up in the world. This role is built for someone who has built motion systems in fast-moving environments, cares deeply about craft, and brings an AI-first mindset to how creative work gets made. You'll join the Brand Studio, the team behind the brand across the entire SpaceXSI ecosystem (from Grok and Grok Bot to X), and help define both the motion language of the brand and how it comes to life in our campaigns and products.
This is a hands-on role. Much of the foundation is still being built, so you'll spend real time animating and making things yourself. It also comes with significant ownership: you'll lead projects from first concept through final delivery, and your work will help set the bar for how the brand moves.

What you'll do

 - Motion system: Define and extend the brand's motion language (timing, easing, transitions, logo animation, typography in motion, and graphic behaviors) and document it so other teams can apply it correctly.

 - Workflows & toolkits: Turn recurring motion work into repeatable, AI-assisted workflows: templates, tools, and generators that let marketing, product, and other teams produce on-brand motion without you in the room.

 - Campaigns: Concept and produce motion end to end, from storyboards through final delivery, across launch films, product videos, social, paid, web, and out-of-home.

 - Product motion: Partner with product designers and engineers to bring brand motion into product surfaces, from interactions and transitions to onboarding and launch moments.

 - Creative direction: Direct agencies, animators, and freelancers with clear briefs and candid feedback so the output meets the bar you'd set yourself.

 - Collaboration: Partner with marketing, product, engineering, and leadership; bring a motion point of view to new surfaces as they appear, and present your thinking clearly to senior stakeholders.

 - Range at speed: Move between projects quickly while holding a consistently high bar, and keep improving the process, not just the output.

What you bring

 - 6+ years of motion design experience, in-house or at an agency or studio.

 - Fluency in After Effects, Cinema 4D or Blender, Figma, and Adobe Creative Cloud.

 - Experience in AI coding tools, especially Cursor. You can build your own tools, scripts, prototypes, and simple web pages instead of waiting on engineering.

 - Hands-on experience with AI video and image generation tools as part of a real production workflow.

 - A reel and portfolio that show both motion system work and shipped campaigns. Bonus if they include tools or workflows you built.

 - Sharp instincts for timing, rhythm, typography in motion, and storytelling.

 - Experience in animation workflows from conceptualization, storyboard design, to execution

 - A systems mindset: you naturally turn one-off tasks into reusable processes and think about how creative work scales.

 - Conviction in your design decisions and the ability to explain why they matter, to designers, marketers, and leadership alike.

 - Self-directed, fast, and energized by variety and ambiguity.

Nice to have

 - Experience building or relaunching a brand's motion identity at a fast-growing tech company.

 - Experience with real-time or code-based motion, such as Rive, Lottie, or WebGL.

 - 3D modeling, lighting, and rendering skills.

 - Sound design sensibility, enough to work closely with audio partners.

 - Experience leading agencies on large, multi-channel campaigns.

jobs.title: Emerging Talent & Onboarding Program Manager
jobs.description:
Beginnings matter. Whether someone is starting their career or joining a new company, their early experiences shape how quickly they find their footing and how far they can go. A great beginning gives people the context, skills, and confidence to do their best work.

As our Emerging Talent & Onboarding Program Manager, you’ll own that moment for nearly everyone who joins Mercury, across new hire onboarding, internships, and a new apprenticeship program. You’ll think as deeply about the experience people have as the systems behind the scenes that make it all work, and you’ll be a visible face of Mercury when people need support most. You’ll build programs that feel distinctly Mercury, using AI and your creativity to rethink how they work from the ground up.

*Mercury is a financial technology company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

Here are some things you’ll do on the job:

• Run new hire onboarding. Own the program end to end: the learning arc, facilitator coordination, cohort communications, and feedback. Partner with People Operations on preboarding so the experience starts before day one and every new hire’s first weeks feel useful and welcoming.

• Launch our new apprenticeship program. Design and own program operations and the apprentice experience: cohort programming, exec exposure, check-ins at each rotation, and partnerships with host teams.

• Strengthen our internship program. Build on what teams already run with a shared company-wide experience for interns, including onboarding, community, regular check-ins, and a clear point of contact.

• Support managers and mentors. Give the people hosting new hires, interns, and apprentices clear expectations and the resources to do it well.

• Build the systems behind the programs. Use AI, automation, and tooling to reimagine what each program can do, keep quality high as hiring grows, and adapt as the technology evolves. Use feedback and data to see what’s working and improve it.

• Tell the story of emerging talent. Partner with Recruiting, People Operations, and leaders across Mercury to show how we invest in people early in their careers.

You should:

• Have 3–5 years of experience building and running programs, ideally in Learning & Development, People programs, early-career talent, or onboarding.

• Be an excellent program manager. You turn ideas into plans, keep many moving pieces organized, and follow through from launch to iteration.

• Be a skilled facilitator. You’ve led sessions or trainings and can turn what people need to know into something they learn.

• Be hands-on with AI. You experiment with new tools, know when they help, and use them to rethink what our programs can do.

• Think in systems. You spot themes across pain points, trace them back to how the program is designed, and solve them systematically.

• Be creative and comfortable with ambiguity. Some programs are established, some are new, and you’re energized by figuring out what fits Mercury.

• Be a clear, warm communicator. You can welcome someone on day one, run a room, and write a crisp message. You own the details, ask good questions, and stay open to changing your mind.

Experience with early-career, university, internship, apprenticeship, or employee onboarding programs is a strong plus.

At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. jobs.description:
Who We Are

Atwell, LLC is a bold leader in the consulting, engineering, and construction services industry, delivering a broad range of creative solutions to clients in the real estate & land development, and energy markets. We have a strong national presence and a diverse, award-winning project portfolio. Atwell is a privately owned company, with 2,000+ passionate team members across 75+ locations and growing!

Atwell, LLC is a proud recipient of the following 2025 awards:

• Recognized in Crain's “Fast 50” as one of the fastest-growing companies (#14)

About the Position

As a Project Management Advisor in Power, you will serve as a subject matter expert in project controls, project management best practices, and operational consistency. This role partners with Project Management leadership, Operations, Finance, and technical teams to strengthen the tools, processes, reporting, and quality standards that support predictable and profitable project delivery. The Project Management Advisor operates with a high level of autonomy, analyzes project and portfolio performance, mentors project management professionals, and recommends improvements that strengthen project management capability across Power. This role is primarily focused on improving how projects are managed across the organization rather than serving as the primary Project Manager for assigned client projects. In this role, an employee will be expected to demonstrate proficiency in the essential functions outlined below.

Essential Responsibilities

• Develops, standardizes, and continuously improves project controls processes, tools, reporting practices, and best practices across Power.

• Establishes and supports consistent quality control expectations for project setup, tracking, documentation, and reporting to promote completeness and consistency across projects.

• Develops and supports consistent project forecasting processes, including cash flow, budgets, revenue projections, and other project financial information, in partnership with Project Management, Finance, and Operations.

• Tracks and analyzes project and portfolio performance metrics, including cost, schedule, margin, resource utilization, forecasting, and other indicators of project performance.

• Develops and maintains project dashboards, scorecards, and reporting that improve project visibility and support timely decision-making by Project Managers and leadership.

Fair Labor Standards Act

jobs.title: Clinical Support Specialist - Southeast
jobs.description:
About Us

Hyperfine, Inc. (Nasdaq: HYPR) is the groundbreaking health technology company that has redefined brain imaging with the Swoop® system—the first FDA-cleared, portable, ultra-low-field, magnetic resonance brain imaging system capable of providing imaging at multiple points of care in a healthcare facility. Our mission is to revolutionize patient care globally through transformational, accessible, clinically relevant diagnostic imaging. Learn More

About The Role

Job Title: Clinical Support Specialist - Southeast

The Clinical Support Specialist is responsible for all aspects of the initial training and support for the customer team, including physicians, nurses, radiographers, MRI Technologists, and other relevant personnel in the use of Hyperfine’s Swoop Portable MRI System. This role will assist in optimizing customer experience by acting as a true consultant with regards to integrating the Swoop System within a customer’s workflow and procedures. The person in this role will partner effectively to relay customer feedback to internal Hyperfine teams and will function as the clinical specialist during the product sales cycle in close collaboration with the Sales, Marketing, Clinical Science, and R&D groups. They will also support clinical adoption, utilization, customer engagement, and related account activities for our customers.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Train hospital staff on the safe and effective use and operation of Hyperfine products within the clinical areas including amending workflow and optimize product value and utilization

• Provide customized training and support for new operators of the Swoop System and maintain strategic relationships and support post-installation

• Develop and maintain relationships in accounts with key personnel within the hospital and consult on best practices and use cases

• Provide R&D with clinical input and feedback for new projects

• Support the sales team by identifying customer needs and relaying potential opportunities within the existing installed base

• Support new product evaluation and clinical studies

• Support the centers in optimizing their standard procedures and workflows

• Support adoption and utilization activities and escalate retention or expansion opportunities

• Collaborate with the sales team by providing technical support in various sales cycles to win new business, including accompanying site visits as needed for demonstrations

• Work with the sales team to support Swoop utilization activities

• Support assigned opportunities to enhance client relationships and increase adoption within a facility or network.

• Partner with internal stakeholders (ex. sales, product, marketing, clinical sciences, clinical applications) to share feedback, identify trends, and make introductions that result in increased value for the customer and Hyperfine

• Identify potential attrition risks and product gaps and escalate them with recommended follow-up actions.

• Work closely with teammates and/or RN counterparts to provide customer success to install base customers and future potential customers

• Represent Hyperfine and demonstrate products at trade shows and society meetings

• Support MRI peer champion and Key Opinion Leader (KOL) development activities.

• MRI safety and screening knowledge and analyzing contraindications regarding portable low field vs. high field MR

• MRI sequence and protocol understanding workflow optimization

• Support scanner software and firmware upgrades for customers

• Perform scanner implementations at customer sites

• Perform virtual and on site training of scanners to customers

• Participate in image review with customer physicians and Hyperfine medical officers

• Backup / support for image demonstrations

• Case review with healthcare staff

• Trade show image support and case reviews

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILL:

• In-depth knowledge reading of the critical care setting to make consultative clinical recommendations to optimize procedures

• Experience working with a variety of stakeholders including physicians, business administration, clinical, etc.

• Ability to build effective relationships with customer stakeholders and support adoption of clinical workflows

• Strong problem solver with sound judgment

• Hands on, strong team player, and fully accountable for delivering agreed-upon tactical performance metrics

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

• Highly organized and able to multitask

• Articulate, analytical, technically savvy, and professional

• Strong computer skills

• Self-driven and self sufficient

• Positive attitude and team player-oriented individual

• Excellent time management, including managing daily schedule, travel plans, and expenses

EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:

• Associate’s degree in Radiology Sciences or related field

• Registered Technologist with the ARRT (American Registry of Radiologic Technologists) and current credentialing in MR (Magnetic Resonance) or equivalent

• 3+ years’ experience in clinical MR imaging or similar experience such as 3+ years X-ray + 2 years in MRI in a hospital setting

• 2+ years’ experience operating in clinical applications or clinical training experience

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

• Reside in assigned territory and ability to work from home-based office

• Able to travel up to 75% of the time within and outside of territory, including occasional weekend travel

• Ability to work long hours and execute under pressure with short turnaround times

• Live near a major airport

• Have an automobile for ground-based transportation

Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the United States. Hyperfine participates in E-Verify to confirm employment eligibility in accordance with federal law. We are unable to provide or assume employment visa sponsorship, now or in the future.

The annual base salary for this position is between $100,000 - $120,000. This position is also eligible for to participate in Hyperfine's corporate bonus and equity plans. Individual compensation packages are based on various factors unique to each candidate including skill set, relevant experience, qualifications, location, position level, and other job-related reasons.

Agency Resumes: We do not accept resumes from recruitment agencies without a prior agreement in place. Any unsolicited resumes submitted by agencies will be considered the property of Hyperfine and will not be subject to any fees or charges if the candidate is hired.

jobs.title: Director Sales
jobs.description:
We're building a sales team that wins, and we're looking for the leaders who'll make it happen.

As Director Sales at Lio, you're a true player-coach. You build, coach and lead a team of 6–8 Account Executives, and when a big deal is on the line, you're right there in the room helping close it. You don't chase a quota of your own. You own your team's number, and the goal is ambitious: hit the target together, then double it.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Lead your team to its number. You help your team hit its target and build the pipeline and habits that let it grow from there.

 - Be there when deals need you. You join calls, visit customers on site and help close seven-figure opportunities. When the usual playbook isn't enough, you get creative.

 - Know what's real in your forecast. You're curious about every deal and look into it yourself, so you and your team always know where you stand.

 - Take ownership. If a deal stalls, you reach out to the champion yourself. If it needs a workshop, you're happy to run it. You do what the deal needs.

 - Help your reps grow. You make coaching, training and deal reviews part of the team's week, and nothing motivates you more than seeing your AEs succeed.

 - Bring our way of selling to life. You know the product well and sell in an inquisitive, consultative and educative way, so your team learns it from you.



WHO YOU ARE

 - You've carried a quota, closed complex B2B or enterprise deals, and still enjoy selling.

 - You've led a sales team, had a first management experience, or feel ready to take that step. Many of our future managers start as AEs at Lio, get to know how we sell, and then grow into leadership.

 - You're entrepreneurial and find creative ways to reach a goal.

 - You like to check things for yourself and ask good questions, including of your own team.

 - You love learning and are excited to adapt to how we sell rather than bringing a ready-made playbook.

 - Building a team excites you more than your own quota.



THIS MIGHT NOT BE THE RIGHT FIT IF…

 - you'd prefer to focus purely on people management and step away from deals.

 - you'd rather stick to one proven playbook than adapt it.

 - you'd rather keep your own quota than build a team.

 - you prefer to rely on your team's forecast without digging into it.



WHY NOW

Our Go-To-Market team will grow significantly over the next year. You'd join early enough to shape how we lead sales, at a point where you can already see it working. Together with our sales leadership, you'll build your team and help define what great sales management looks like at Lio.

If you're hungry to build a team that outperforms every target, to turn good reps into great ones, and to win the biggest deals together, we want to hear from you.

jobs.description:

ArmorCode delivers the Agentic Control Plane for Unified Exposure Management. Enterprises including Visa, PayPal, Volvo Group, and Johnson Controls use ArmorCode to remediate at machine speed and reduce risk fast.

Processing over 400 billion+ findings a year across hundreds of native integrations, ArmorCode unifies, prioritizes, and drives remediation across applications, cloud, code, infrastructure, and AI. Powered by Anya, the industry's first agentic AI framework for enterprise security, ArmorCode is trusted by global enterprises to reduce exposure and adopt AI and modern software practices with confidence, without replacing existing tools or forcing vendor consolidation.

ArmorCoders believe in five core values: Hungry. Humble. Hardworking. Honest. jobs.title: Paid Media Growth Director
jobs.description:
Graphite is a technology-enabled growth agency that helps fast-growing companies like Masterclass, Notion, and BetterUp unlock sustainable revenue through content, SEO, AEO, and paid media.

We’re obsessed with impact: it’s foundational to who we are, why we’re successful, and how we approach delivering outcomes for clients and ultimately, everyone on the internet. We are a fully distributed company with team members located across North America, Latin America, and Europe.

We seek an experienced Growth Director (Paid Media) to lead paid growth strategies for high-growth tech companies. You will develop and execute full-funnel media, measurement, and creative strategies that drive business results for our partners, and build the paid team that delivers them. Success requires strong problem-solving skills, an AI-first way of working, and ownership of complex, large-scale programs.

This opportunity is full-time and fully remote, offering the flexibility to work from home.

Come join us and help us build the best paid growth engines, everywhere that matters!




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Lead paid growth strategies for tech companies, managing $1M+ a month in spend across clients.

 - Own full-funnel media plans across search, social, video and CTV, programmatic, and ChatGPT Ads, including channel expansion and investment scenario planning.

 - Design each client’s measurement plan: tracking, geo-holdout and in-platform lift tests, and MMM calibration. Decide what is incremental.

 - Set creative strategy and the testing roadmap, turning research and test results into concepts and briefs.

 - Run accounts AI-first: use AI workflows for audits, pacing, reporting, and optimization, and override them when they are wrong.

 - Present insights and outcomes to executives in weekly, monthly, and quarterly business reviews, linking paid results with SEO and AEO.

 - Support hiring and lead the paid team by building the team, designing playbooks, and coaching them on how to run highly effective paid programs.




WHAT EXPERTISE YOU’LL NEED

 - Paid Media: 7+ years of agency or in-house paid media experience, including $1M+ a month across multiple clients and channels.

 - Full-Funnel Buying: Hands-on with Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, and programmatic (DV360 or similar). Owns forecasting, pacing, and budget allocation against business goals.

 - Measurement: Has run lift tests end to end and acted on MMM readouts. Fluent in incrementality, attribution, KPI selection, and business economics.

 - Creative Strategy: Has led creative strategy and testing programs, not only briefed them.

 - AI Adoption: Uses LLMs daily and has built at least one AI workflow (audits, reporting, optimization, or creative) that saved the team real time.

 - Data Analysis: Exceptional data analysis skills; comfortable in Looker, Sheets and storytelling.

 - Leadership: Has managed and developed a team of paid marketers, with executive presence in front of VP and C-suite marketers.




HOW WE’LL HELP

Graphite’s mission is to create an environment where you build the best work of your career. In order to facilitate this, we provide:

 - Process As Needed - We view the process as a way to empower better work, not as a series of dogmatic rules. We develop the best internal processes as we do products - through iteration, measurement, and continuous improvement

 - Autonomy - We trust you to be excellent at what you do. We will provide as much support as needed when needed, but no more. You will have autonomy and agency to drive projects forward, and own decisions and outcomes

 - Flexible Work Environment - Everyone’s optimal work style is unique. We operate as a distributed team across the United States, Canada, Latin America, and Europe. jobs.title: Remote Mental Health Therapist – Older Adults (LCSW, LMFT, LPCC)
jobs.description:
Do the work you trained for, without the parts that burn you out. Sailor Health is hiring California-licensed mental health therapists for W2 roles providing telehealth therapy to older adults, fully from home. We fill your caseload, handle billing and admin, and give you real clinical support, so your time goes to patients. Don’t just take our word for it: read what our therapists say in our Indeed reviews.




🌊 ABOUT SAILOR HEALTH

Older adults are too often overlooked by mental healthcare. Sailor Health exists to change that. Through Medicare-covered therapy, care navigation, and healthcare advocacy, we help older adults move through grief, loss, isolation, and life’s hardest transitions with more ease and peace of mind.

Our model is built around their needs and yours:

 - We handle everything outside the session. Care Navigators and Healthcare Advocates take on patients’ non-clinical needs, so your work stays clinical.

 - You’re part of a team. Clinical Quality Leads provide ongoing consultation, and our provider support team answers questions as they come up.

 - Demand is steady. We serve patients in all 50 states, with a consistent flow of referrals.




⭐ THE POSITION

Location: Fully remote, anywhere in the U.S. | Schedule: You set it, 7 days a week available

We’re hiring independently licensed California therapists for full-time W2 roles, paid per session. Start at 25 hours per week and build from there, with full benefits from the start.




💙 WHAT WE OFFER

 - A full caseload, built for you. Share your availability and we’ll match you with patients who fit. No marketing, no chasing referrals. Most clinicians have a full caseload within a few weeks.

 - Support that’s actually there. A dedicated clinical lead and live admin help. Our providers tell us it’s the most supported they’ve felt in telehealth.

 - Your schedule, your call. Work the days and hours that suit you. No on-call, no required evenings.

 - Less paperwork, more therapy. Our telehealth platform and AI documentation assistant handle the busywork.

 - Room to grow. Free CEUs, geriatric-focused training, and clinical consultation with experienced directors.

 - Competitive pay and full benefits. Competitive per-session rates, plus health, dental, and vision coverage and a 401(k) with up to 3.5% employer match.




💻 YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Provide evidence-based psychotherapy to older adults via telehealth

 - Build individualized treatment plans around each patient’s goals and needs

 - Manage your own caseload and clinical decisions, with a supportive care team behind you

 - Complete documentation in our EMR, with AI-assisted notes

 - Join regular, paid case consultations with experienced clinical leaders




📋 QUALIFICATIONS

 - Must be located in the United States

 - Active, independent California clinical license: LCSW, LMFT, or LPCC

 - Master’s or doctoral degree in social work, counseling, psychology, or marriage and family therapy

 - Experience with older adult or geriatric populations preferred

 - Comfortable with telehealth platforms and electronic health records

 - Medicare billing experience a plus (we handle billing either way)




✅ WHO THRIVES AT SAILOR

 - You care about the mission. Supporting older adults through grief, loss, and the challenges of later life feels meaningful to you.

 - You understand this population. Maybe you’ve spent years working with older adults, or you’re later in your own career and chose this work on purpose.

 - You do your best work on a team. You want colleagues, a clinical lead, and real support, not just a login and good wishes.

 - You like independence with backup. You trust your clinical judgment and want infrastructure behind you, not oversight on top of you.




🚀 APPLY TODAY

If you want a full caseload, a flexible schedule, full benefits, and a team that has your back while you do meaningful work with older adults, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today, and our recruiting team will guide you through every step of the process.

Learn more: https://www.sailorhealth.com/careers/therapy

jobs.title: First Line Manager
jobs.description:
We're building a sales team that wins, and we're looking for the leaders who'll make it happen.

As a First Line Manager at Lio, you're a true player-coach. You build, coach and lead a team of 6–8 Account Executives, and when a big deal is on the line, you're right there in the room helping close it. You don't chase a quota of your own. You own your team's number, and the goal is ambitious: hit the target together, then double it.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Lead your team to its number. You help your team hit its target and build the pipeline and habits that let it grow from there.

 - Be there when deals need you. You join calls, visit customers on site and help close seven-figure opportunities. When the usual playbook isn't enough, you get creative.

 - Know what's real in your forecast. You're curious about every deal and look into it yourself, so you and your team always know where you stand.

 - Take ownership. If a deal stalls, you reach out to the champion yourself. If it needs a workshop, you're happy to run it. You do what the deal needs.

 - Help your reps grow. You make coaching, training and deal reviews part of the team's week, and nothing motivates you more than seeing your AEs succeed.

 - Bring our way of selling to life. You know the product well and sell in an inquisitive, consultative and educative way, so your team learns it from you.



WHO YOU ARE

 - You've carried a quota, closed complex B2B or enterprise deals, and still enjoy selling.

 - You've led a sales team, had a first management experience, or feel ready to take that step. Many of our future managers start as AEs at Lio, get to know how we sell, and then grow into leadership.

 - You're entrepreneurial and find creative ways to reach a goal.

 - You like to check things for yourself and ask good questions, including of your own team.

 - You love learning and are excited to adapt to how we sell rather than bringing a ready-made playbook.

 - Building a team excites you more than your own quota.



THIS MIGHT NOT BE THE RIGHT FIT IF…

 - you'd prefer to focus purely on people management and step away from deals.

 - you'd rather stick to one proven playbook than adapt it.

 - you'd rather keep your own quota than build a team.

 - you prefer to rely on your team's forecast without digging into it.



WHY NOW

Our Go-To-Market team will grow significantly over the next year. You'd join early enough to shape how we lead sales, at a point where you can already see it working. Together with our sales leadership, you'll build your team and help define what great sales management looks like at Lio.

If you're hungry to build a team that outperforms every target, to turn good reps into great ones, and to win the biggest deals together, we want to hear from you.

jobs.title: Senior Specialist, Store Development
jobs.description:
At Philz, every new store is an opportunity to bring our cups of love to more communities. As our Senior Specialist, Store Development, you’ll help bring new stores to life by coordinating contractors and vendors, managing project documentation and payments, and keeping construction projects on track. Your organization and follow-through will help ensure stores open on time, within budget, and ready to welcome customers.

This role is currently remote and must be based within the Greater Los Angeles area. Our teams will transition to an in-office environment in North Long Beach, CA, Monday through Thursday, beginning April 2027.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Construction & Project Management

• Independently manage assigned aspects of new store construction projects from kickoff through completion, evaluating priorities, anticipating challenges, and determining appropriate actions to keep projects on schedule and within budget.

• Evaluate contractor agreements, Notice to Proceed packages, change orders, and construction documentation for accuracy, completeness, and alignment with project requirements, identifying discrepancies and recommending resolutions.

• Oversee project closeout activities, assessing documentation, outstanding obligations, and potential risks to ensure construction requirements are satisfied.

• Assess permitting, utility, scheduling, and Certificate of Occupancy requirements, exercising judgment to identify potential delays, resolve issues, and escalate matters requiring leadership intervention.

• Partner with Real Estate to evaluate landlord requirements and Tenant Improvement Allowance documentation, identifying gaps and recommending solutions to support timely reimbursements.

Vendor Management & Financial Oversight

• Independently manage vendor-related financial activities across assigned projects, evaluating proposals, estimates, invoices, and payment requests for alignment with approved budgets, contractual obligations, and project priorities.

• Analyze construction progress billings, retention payments, deposits, and change orders, exercising judgment to identify discrepancies, assess financial exposure, and recommend corrective actions.

• Monitor project financial commitments and payment obligations, proactively identifying budget variances, outstanding liabilities, and opportunities to mitigate financial risk.

• Evaluate vendor onboarding requirements and documentation, resolving exceptions and ensuring vendors meet contractual and payment requirements.

• Assess equipment, fixtures, furnishings, and other project purchases, identifying delivery or payment risks and determining appropriate actions to minimize project disruption.

• Oversee preliminary notices and lien release requirements, identifying potential compliance or financial risks and coordinating appropriate resolutions.

Project Oversight & Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Establish and maintain effective project documentation and reporting practices, exercising discretion in determining how information is organized, monitored, and communicated to support project execution.

• Independently assess project status, competing priorities, and outstanding deliverables, identifying risks and recommending adjustments to improve project outcomes.

• Analyze project information and develop updates, recommendations, and actionable insights to support Development leadership in making informed decisions.

• Serve as a key point of contact for contractors, vendors, municipalities, and internal stakeholders, independently resolving routine project challenges and determining when issues require escalation.

• Identify opportunities to improve development processes, financial controls, and cross-functional workflows, recommending and implementing improvements that increase efficiency and reduce operational risk.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

• 3+ years of experience in a fast-paced, high growth environment overseeing key aspects of construction administration, project coordination, or a related role, preferably supporting multi-unit retail, restaurant, or commercial construction projects

• 2+ years overseeing construction-related financial processes, including vendor invoicing, accounts payable, progress billings, retention, and change orders

• Working knowledge of construction contracts, preliminary notices, lien releases, and related documentation requirements, particularly in California

• Strong organizational and project management skills, with high attention to detail

• Proficient in Excel, Google Workspace, and document management tools, construction and financial systems such as Kahua, Smartsheet, DocuSign, Tipalti, and Capturis a plus

• Strong communication and relationship-building skills

ESSENTIAL PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

• Visual acuity

• Expressing or exchanging ideas by means of the spoken word; those activities where detailed or important spoken instructions must be conveyed to others

• Repetitive motions: Making substantial movements (motions) of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers

• Extending hand(s) and arm(s) in any direction

• Bending, Reaching, Pulling, Pushing, Extending arms/hands occasionally during shift

• Sitting for extended periods of time

• Exerting up to 10-20 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 10 pounds of force frequently, and/or a negligible amount of force constantly to move objects

**Compensation & Benefits

A reasonable estimate of the starting annual base salary for this role is $75,000 to $85,000. Please note that the base salary will vary based on qualifications, previous experience, and work location.

When you join our team, we better your days through our benefits and support programs – we offer our team members medical, dental, and vision insurance, company-paid basic life insurance, optional family life insurance, 401(k) with company match, flexible spending accounts, commuter benefits, mental health support, holiday pay, Vacation & Sick Time, Team Member discounts, freebie drinks and discounted beans, fun Philz swag, opportunities for growth and advancement, and more!

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Portfolio Reporting & Compliance
jobs.description:
About Us
 
Solar Landscape is the nation’s leading distributed energy infrastructure company, transforming commercial real estate into a source of new power by deploying solar and storage at scale. Partnering with more than 170+ commercial real estate owners, the company develops, builds, owns, and operates distributed energy projects that deliver new capacity to the grid in as little as 12 months while generating long-term income for commercial and industrial property owners. 
Proven by our performance, backed by institutional capital, and trusted by the biggest names in commercial real estate, we’re building the future of energy, and it shows:
Recognized by the Financial Times as one of the fastest-growing companies in the U.S. in 2025
Named to the 2026 Inc. 5000 list of America’s fastest-growing private companies
Ranked the #1 commercial rooftop solar developer by Solar Power World in both 2025 and 2026 
That doesn’t happen without a team of smart, driven, and down-to-earth people who are serious about doing excellent work—and fun to work with. At Solar Landscape, you’ll be challenged, trusted with responsibility, and surrounded by people who thrive in our fast-paced environment. Career growth here isn’t limited by title or a rigid path: people who take ownership and deliver are given opportunities to stretch, lead, and make an impact. Along the way, you’ll be supported by great benefits, professional development, and a culture that values authenticity, collaboration, and accountability. 
Across our headquarters in Asbury Park, New Jersey and our offices in New York City, Chicago, and Baltimore, Solar Landscape employees are building something that matters, deploying critical energy infrastructure that creates long-term value for communities, property owners, and the grid. Come join us. 
About The Role


We are seeking a Senior Manager, Portfolio Reporting and Compliance, to lead portfolio reporting and financing compliance at Solar Landscape. This leader will own the reporting and compliance function end to end, build and manage a team of analysts and accountants, and serve as the primary accounting and compliance contact for our lenders, tax equity investors, and auditors.
You will lead three connected areas:
Portfolio reporting. Own the reporting framework that leadership, investors, and lenders rely on, and set the standard for its accuracy, timeliness, and insight.
Financing and capital contribution transactions. Lead the accounting workstream for new project financings and capital contributions, from term sheet review through funding and onboarding.

jobs.title: Customer Experience Coordinator (Relief) - Leesburg, VA
jobs.description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

THE JOB

As a Customer Experience Coordinator, your job is to define the customer’s experience through service, focus, and participation—so you are passionate about perfecting the experience before, during, and after their time at VEG. Outgoing and personable, with each customer, you conduct yourself professionally in both demeanor and presence. You find ways to say YES and put pets and customers experience above all else. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to grow where you want to go, building valuable experience and paving the way for your career to take unexpected and rewarding directions.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Greet every customer with warmth and urgency, whether in person, over the phone, or online

• Oversee all customer communications (calls, emails, texts), record details accurately, and route urgent medical calls to a doctor quickly

• Deliver personalized, memorable experiences—always looking for creative ways to say “yes” to customer needs

• Listen with empathy, resolve concerns quickly, and anticipate issues before they escalate

• Keep nursing team and doctors updated on customer needs for a seamless care experience

• Provide confidential, compassionate guidance on financial options and end-of-life decisions

• Process payments accurately while protecting personal and financial information

• Follow up with customers after visits to check on their pet’s care and strengthen relationships

• Celebrate and capture special moments (with permission), creating lasting connections between customers, their pets, and the hospital

WHAT YOU NEED

• 2+ years of experience in a customer service role

• Advanced proficiency in computer programs and practice management software

• Highly organized, with strong attention to detail

• Strong communication skills; able to interact positively with anyone and everyone

• The ability to multitask and thrive amid chaos

• High emotional intelligence, able to read a room and plan and act accordingly

• Adaptable and amenable in high stakes environments

• Problem solving skills and a focus on innovation

• Must be willing to work in a noisy environment with strong or unpleasant odors

• Availability to work nights, weekends, and holidays on a rotating or as needed basis based on hospital needs

• Work well in a fast-paced environment with people from all backgrounds and different personality types

WHO YOU ARE

• Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives

• Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s’ accomplishments

• Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results

• Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

• Competitive compensation

• Flexible work schedules to support your life outside of work

• Generous employee referral program, so our awesome people can bring in more awesome people

• And the little (big) things, like comfy scrubs, cool VEG swag, food in the fridge for when you’re hungry

DEI

At VEG, diversity is not just a word—it's a strength that fuels innovation and kindness. Our mission is “Helping people and their pets when they need it most.” And we do that better when our VEGgies (employees) feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. That's why we're devoted to creating an environment that reflects the diverse communities we serve—where different perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated.

We are focused on providing equitable opportunities for growth, promoting inclusive decision-making, and ensuring that everyone's perspective is considered. Saying yes to VEG means helping us build a culture where your unique experiences and background contribute to a shared vision: being the world’s veterinary emergency company.

While a strong relationship-management mindset is critical, successful candidates will also demonstrate the ability to develop new business opportunities through existing customer relationships, referrals, industry connections, prospecting, and strategic outreach. The ideal candidate brings experience supporting large, complex customer portfolios and understands how to build executive-level relationships that drive retention, expansion, and revenue growth.

This role requires the ability to quickly establish credibility with customers, uncover customer needs, coordinate internal resources, and create opportunities for additional service adoption across multiple locations. This position includes up to 50% travel to client locations and Fortis operating branches. When not traveling, this is an in-office role based at our Schaumburg, IL headquarters.

**In addition to the base salary range listed, this position is eligible for performance‑based incentive compensation, which may include commission or bonus components. Total compensation will include base salary plus incentives, depending on performance and final role alignment.**

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

• Manage and grow a portfolio of national and multi-site customer accounts, serving as the primary relationship owner and advocate for customer success.

• Develop and maintain relationships with key decision-makers, facilities leaders, property managers, and executive stakeholders across assigned accounts.

• Serve as the primary daily contact for assigned national and multi-location customers, fostering long-term partnerships and trust.

• Identify opportunities to expand Fortis services within existing customer locations and additional sites nationwide.

• Generate new business opportunities through referrals, industry relationships, customer introductions, prospecting, and strategic account expansion efforts.

• Secure meetings with decision-makers to support account growth, renewals, and new business development initiatives.

• Communicate regularly with clients regarding scheduling, service progress, inspection findings, and recommended next steps.

• Proactively address client concerns, service issues, and operational challenges to maintain high levels of customer satisfaction and retention.

• Coordinate inspections, deficiency walkthroughs, corrective work, and service activities with internal operations teams and customer contacts across multiple locations.

• Support multi-service account management, including alarm, sprinkler, suppression, monitoring, repairs, inspections, and project-related services.

• Review inspection results and deficiency reports, ensuring timely follow-up, remediation planning, scheduling, and closure.

• Partner with technicians, dispatch teams, service managers, branch leadership, and support teams to ensure consistent service delivery and execution.

• Identify and engage the appropriate decision-makers within customer organizations to support renewals, expansions, and enterprise-wide service adoption.

• Support cross-selling and upselling initiatives by aligning customer needs with Fortis capabilities and service offerings.

• Track account performance, customer engagement trends, risk factors, and growth opportunities using CRM and reporting tools.

• Assist with account reviews, business reviews, proposals, and strategic customer planning meetings.

• Support renewal strategies by preparing proposals, gathering requirements, presenting recommendations, and coordinating customer communications.

• Coordinate renewals, contract amendments, and service agreements in partnership with internal sales support, finance, and operations teams.

• Maintain accurate CRM documentation, including contacts, opportunities, service agreements, renewal schedules, location lists, and account activity.

• Stay informed on customer business initiatives, facility changes, expansion plans, and operational challenges that may create service opportunities.

Required Skills & Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Sales, Marketing, or a related field preferred; equivalent experience will be considered.

• 5+ years of experience in account management, strategic account management, national accounts, client relationship management, business development, or sales within fire protection, life safety, security, building systems, HVAC, low voltage systems, facility services, or other related commercial service industries.

• Experience managing enterprise, strategic, national, or multi-site customer accounts, including large and complex commercial client relationships.

• Demonstrated ability to build relationships with decision-makers and identify opportunities for account growth, retention, and new business development.

• Proven success managing customer relationships across multiple locations, regions, business units, or stakeholder groups.

• Experience developing revenue opportunities through account expansion, referrals, strategic outreach, networking, and relationship-based selling.

• Ability to identify, engage, and influence key decision-makers within customer organizations.

• Strong customer service and relationship-management skills with a commitment to delivering exceptional client experiences.

• Proficiency with CRM platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Q360, or similar systems.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook.

• Experience coordinating multi-site service programs, projects, or customer initiatives.

• Ability to thrive in a matrixed environment while collaborating across multiple branches, departments, and service lines.

• Strong operational coordination, problem-solving, and follow-through skills.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to clearly convey technical, operational, and service-related information.

• Highly organized with exceptional time-management skills and the ability to manage competing priorities effectively.

• Proven ability to work independently while building productive partnerships across operations, service, administrative, and leadership teams.

• Ability to analyze customer needs and recommend solutions that create value for both the customer and the organization.

• Ability to travel up to 50% to customer locations and Fortis operating branches.

• Ability to meet company driving eligibility requirements, including holding a valid driver's license and maintaining an acceptable motor vehicle record.

Preferred Qualification
