jobs.title: Manager, Solutions Architect
jobs.description:
ABOUT BASETEN

Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-our-series-f/, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products.



THE ROLE

As Manager (Player & Coach) of the Solution Architect team, you will lead and mentor a team of Solution Architects who will partner closely with Sales and customers to translate business needs into technical solutions, run technical discovery, and guide repeatable deployments and proofs of value for customers. Applying both hands-on technical ownership and managerial leadership, you will guide your team through the processes of owning discovery calls, demos,  technical scoping and driving POCs through to execution as well as designing, deploying, and managing high performance, low latency AI applications on Baseten’s platform.

You will also partner with product, infrastructure, and other customer engineering teams to ensure that large language models (LLMs) and other generative AI systems deliver best-in-class performance, reliability, and cost efficiency in production environments.

EXAMPLE INITIATIVES

Take a look at these blog posts written by members of our Forward Deployed Engineering team:

 - Forward Deployed Engineering on the frontier of AI https://www.baseten.co/blog/forward-deployed-engineering/

 - The fastest, most accurate Whisper transcription https://www.baseten.co/blog/the-fastest-most-accurate-and-cost-efficient-whisper-transcription/

 - Deploy production-ready model servers from Docker images https://www.baseten.co/blog/deploy-production-model-servers-from-docker-images/

 - Deploy custom ComfyUI workflows as APIs https://www.baseten.co/blog/deploying-custom-comfyui-workflows-as-apis/

RESPONSIBILITIES

Leadership

 - Lead, mentor, and grow a team of Solution Architects, providing guidance on technical direction, project execution, and professional development.

 - Set clear goals and ensure timely, high-quality delivery across multiple customer-facing projects involving LLM deployment and inference optimization.

 - Collaborate with leadership to align team priorities with company and customer goals, balancing short-term delivery, widely varying customer priorities, and long-term technical initiatives.

 - Player-coach – While much of this role will be leading the team, you will also be expected to be a key driver on strategic product initiatives and customer engagements. The best managers derive credibility from being able to be hands-on when needed.

Team Management - Lead a team of Solution Architects who will:

 - Partner with sales on customer discovery calls (most often second calls, occasionally first calls for large accounts).

 - Lead demos and technical scoping to align on success criteria, architecture, and deployment approach.

 - Own benchmarking and repeatable deployments, including handling standard deployment patterns and configurations across many modalities – LLMs, embeddings, image and video generation, VoiceAI, etc.

 - Advising on tradeoffs like H100s vs B200s and latency-optimized vs throughput-optimized setups.

 - Driving consistent “playbook” style deployments for common models and use cases.

 - Become a power user of different runtimes such as vLLM, SGLang, and TRT-LLM and all the common configurations and tradeoffs between them

jobs.title: Lead Doctor
jobs.location: Upper East Side, New York, United States
jobs.description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

THE JOB

As a Lead Emergency Veterinarian at VEG, beyond helping people and their pets, you’ll take ownership of supporting your team and ensuring that your hospital is a model of clinical excellence. Working alongside your hospital’s medical director, you’ll champion VEG’s medical processes and initiatives, developing your fellow doctors and coaching them to thrive. You’re well-versed in the VEG Spikes, our unique, customer-centered way of doing things—like ensuring people see a doctor right away and allowing families to stay with their pets—and you lead by example, ensuring your team practices the VEG way with every case. In this role, you’ll find ways to say yes to providing the guidance, resources, and encouragement your team needs to grow confidently in their careers. As a leader, you’ll have the opportunity to foster a culture of mentorship and learning, helping your doctors build fulfilling, unexpected career paths while creating a lasting impact on your hospital.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Work clinical shifts, with responsibilities consistent with emergency doctors at your VEG:

• Answer medical questions over the phone

• See patients right away as part of the VEG Triage and VEG Spikes, our unique, customer-centered way of doing things—like ensuring people see a doctor right away and allowing families to stay with their pets

• Complete a diagnosis of each pet's condition to create a diagnostic and therapeutic plan

• Communicate diagnosis and treatment options directly with customers

• Provide appropriate treatments to address each pet’s specific condition

• Create and review medical records to ensure accuracy

• Demonstrate the value of tests and treatments performed by speaking with the customer and addressing their concerns

• Coach fellow doctors on medical excellence, doctoring the VEG Way, and providing VEG’s customer-focused experience

• Support fellow doctors through their assigned growth and development plans

• Assist Medical Director (MD) when coverage is needed due to callouts or schedule changes

• Work as interim MD when the current MD is on leave or opening a new VEG hospital

• Lead monthly doctor meetings and M&M rounds with guidance from the MD

• Teaching hospitals only: If needed, own the New ER Doctor (NERD) training program and perform all NERD MD job duties.

• Create doctor schedules, including managing leave requests and posting schedules at least two months in advance

• Address customer complaints related to medical concerns.

WHAT YOU NEED

• A DVM, VMD, or equivalent degree

• 2+ years of ER experience and critical case management

• One year leadership experience is preferred, but not required

• Training in emergency surgery/endoscopy

• Flexible to work a combination of clinical and administrative shifts

• Ensure top-tier customer satisfaction and hospital revenue production

• Willingness to lead and support fellow doctors, as well as perform administrative tasks during off hours (i.e. doctor callouts, addressing customer complaints, scheduling)

• Must be willing to work in a noisy environment with strong or unpleasant odors

• Availability to work nights, weekends, and holidays on a rotating or as needed basis based on hospital needs

• Work well in a fast-paced environment with people from all backgrounds and different personality types

WHO YOU ARE

• Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives

• Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s’ accomplishments

• Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results

• Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

• Competitive compensation ($160,000 - 200,000 depending on experience), including base and 401K match

• Comprehensive health and wellness benefits that start on day one, including QPR training and access to free therapy or counseling

• Based on your role, you may be eligible for equity after one year of full time, active employment with VEG, so you can share in our growth and success

• A BIG focus on learning and growth, from VEG-created clinical and leadership programs to unlimited ER CE + travel stipend (no really!). Full-time credentialed VEGgies receive a $2,500/year travel stipend. Full-time uncredentialed VEGgies receive a $1,000/year travel stipend.

• Clinical student loan repayment so you don’t need to worry about your student debt

• Paid parental leave, up to 12 weeks at 100% of regular salary and inclusive fertility and family-building care for all types of families

• Flexible work schedules to support your life outside of work

• Generous employee referral program, so our awesome people can bring in more awesome people

• And the little (big) things, like comfy scrubs, cool VEG swag, and food in the fridge for when you’re hungry

DEI

At VEG, diversity is not just a word—it's a strength that fuels innovation and kindness. Our mission is “Helping people and their pets when they need it most.” And we do that better when our VEGgies (employees) feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. That's why we're devoted to creating an environment that reflects the diverse communities we serve—where different perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated.

We are focused on providing equitable opportunities for growth, promoting inclusive decision-making, and ensuring that everyone's perspective is considered. Saying yes to VEG means helping us build a culture where your unique experiences and background contribute to a shared vision: being the world’s veterinary emergency company.

jobs.title: Content Designer
jobs.description:
Perplexity is looking for a Content Designer to shape the words across our products. You'll design the language people see and hear across our family of Perplexity apps, from the first screen of onboarding to the way an agent explains what it's doing. Fundamentally, we are all writers. Our product is primarily spoken language and written product; but as we scale, we want someone who will continue to work on clarity, usefulness, and keep it unmistakably Perplexity.



You're a designer first? You're an engineer first? You're a writer first? Your shape is not conventional, and you wear many hats. You are fluent in AI tooling. You have strong UX fundamentals and good product instincts. You use language to solve product problems: flows, naming, information architecture, error states, permissions, and moments where people need to trust what the product is telling them. You command words. You command agents, and make decisions about words. You can write one perfect line, and you can build the system that keeps thousands of lines consistent.



You'll sit on the Design Systems team and work closely with product designers, engineers, PMs, research, brand, and marketing. (Again) You're fluent in AI-powered tools and use it every day. You understand how models behave, how prompts and system instructions shape what people see, and how to define and judge quality when the output isn't fully deterministic.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Design and write in-product language across web, mobile, desktop, and voice, including UI copy, flows, onboarding, notifications, empty states, errors, and in-product education

 - Partner with product designers from the start of a project, shaping flows, structure, and information architecture as well as the words in them

 - Name features and products, and own terminology, navigation labels, and taxonomies so the product stays easy to understand as it grows

 - Make complex AI and agent behavior understandable, including what the product is doing, why, what it can't do, and when it needs a person's input

 - Shape how AI-generated content reads by writing and refining prompts and system instructions, and help define voice and response style for our models in product

 - Define content quality standards and help build evaluation criteria, datasets, and reviewer guidance for AI-generated content

 - Build and maintain voice and tone guidelines, content patterns, and content guidance in our design system so every team can write well

 - Use research, data, and experiments to test language and improve comprehension, activation, and task completion

 - Partner with brand and marketing so product language and our external voice feel like one company

 - Work with internationalization partners so the product reads well in every language we support

 - Review copy in code and ship small language changes directly when it's the fastest path


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 5+ years of experience in content design, UX writing, or product design, shipping software at scale

 - An excellent portfolio that shows how your language shaped product decisions, with clear before and after examples and your role in each

 - Strong UX fundamentals, including interaction design, information architecture, usability, and accessibility

 - Good product sensibility and judgment about what to build, what to cut, and what matters most to people

 - Exceptional writing and editing skills, with range from precise interface copy to clear explanations and confident naming

 - Strong AI fluency, including hands-on experience writing prompts, working with LLMs, and judging the quality of AI-generated content

 - Systems thinking, with experience building content frameworks, style guides, or terminology that scale across teams

 - Clear communication, with the ability to explain content decisions and tradeoffs to designers, engineers, and leaders

 - You care about shipping great software more than anything else


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience designing content for AI products, assistants, agents, or conversational interfaces

 - Experience with prompt engineering, model evals, or working with research teams on model behavior

 - Experience across consumer and enterprise products, including admin, permissions, privacy, and billing flows

 - Comfort working in code, such as editing strings, reviewing PRs, or prototyping with AI tools

 - Experience with localization and writing for global audiences


NOTES FOR CANDIDATES

We want to see portfolio work where your words changed the product. Show us the problem, the options you explored, the language you shipped, and what happened after. We value end-to-end ownership, range, and impact, and we'd love to see examples of AI-related work, such as prompts, evaluations, or content you designed for model output.

jobs.title: ML Storyteller
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Most AI is frozen in place - it doesn't adapt to the world. We think that's backwards. Our mandate is to build efficient intelligence that evolves in real-time. Our vision is AI systems that are flexible, personalized, and accessible to everyone. We believe efficiency is what makes this possible - it's how we expand access and ensure innovation benefits the many, not the few. We believe in talent density: bringing together the best and most driven individuals to push the boundaries of continual adaptation. We're looking for builders and creative thinkers ready to shape the next era of intelligence.

 


THE ROLE

Our vision is AI systems that are flexible, adaptable, and accessible to everyone. We believe efficiency is what makes this possible. It’s how we expand access and ensure innovation benefits the many, not the few. But a mission only travels as far as the people who carry it. We’re looking for the person who will carry ours into the wider AI ecosystem, the voice researchers, developers and builders think of when they think of Adaption.

You’re a technologist who can’t help explaining things. You’ve worked with models yourself, and you have a rare knack for turning complex ideas into stories people want to share, whether that’s a thread that takes off, a video that makes a concept click, or a talk that leaves a room buzzing. You’re not here to run a community day to day. You’re here to grow one by giving people a reason to pay attention.

 


RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Become the public face of Adaption, building a recognizable presence on X, LinkedIn, YouTube, and wherever the AI conversation is happening

 - Define and own our voice: what we talk about, how we say it, and why it matters to builders who want more control over their AI

 - Create a steady stream of technical content (threads, short-form video, explainers, deep dives) that makes ideas like efficiency, adaptation and model customization feel tangible

 - Get hands-on with Adaption’s products and turn what you build into narratives: live experiments, side-by-side comparisons, and “here’s what happened when I tried…” stories

 - Represent Adaption on podcasts, panels and livestreams, and over time, on conference stages

 - Build relationships with creators, researchers and other voices across the ecosystem, collaborating on content and amplifying people doing interesting work with our tools

 - Bring the outside in by sharing what you hear in public conversations with product, research and marketing, so it shapes what we build and how we talk about it

 


QUALIFICATIONS

 - A technical foundation in ML: you’ve trained, fine-tuned or deployed models, or written serious code around them, and you can hold your own in a conversation with researchers

 - A track record of creating content that has earned attention in technical circles

 - Exceptional written and on-camera communication. You can make a complex idea feel simple without dumbing it down

 - Comfort being visible. You enjoy having opinions in public and standing behind them

 - Strong instincts for what’s interesting. You can spot a story in a benchmark result, a strange bug, or a user’s unexpected experiment

 - Self-directed and prolific. You publish consistently without needing a content calendar handed to you

 - Genuine conviction about changing the status quo of who gets to shape AI

 - Bonus: experience speaking at meetups, conferences or on podcasts

Above all, we're looking for great teammates who make work feel lighter and aren't afraid to go out on a limb with bold ideas. You don't need to be perfect, but you do need to be adaptable. We encourage you to apply, even if you don't check every box.

 


BENEFITS

 - Flexible work: In-person collaboration in the Bay Area, a distributed global-first team, and team offsites.

 - Adaption Passport: Annual travel stipend to explore a country you've never visited. We're building intelligence that evolves alongside you, so we encourage you to keep expanding your horizons.

 - Lunch Stipend: Weekly meal allowance for take-out or grocery delivery.

 - Well-Being: Comprehensive medical benefits and generous paid time off.

jobs.title: Sr. Strategic Account Director
jobs.description:
BUILD A SAFER WORLD.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

As a Snr. Strategic Account Director at TRM, you will own the relationship and the revenue for several of our largest global banking accounts, helping their teams detect and disrupt financial crime. You will set account strategy, navigate the bank from the inside, and grow what TRM does across the institution. TRM is distributed, not distant, and this role is built for someone who uses AI to move faster and sell smarter.

The impact you will have:

 - Grow several Tier-1 banking accounts from six to seven figure deals toward multi-million dollar annual relationships by tying TRM's intelligence to each business line's priorities, using AI to map buying committees, budget holders, and internal triggers before your first meeting.

 - Expand TRM's footprint inside your accounts beyond the team you start with, using AI-assisted account maps and your own network to find the right sponsor in each.

 - Own the full sales cycle from first conversation to signed contract, using AI-drafted account plans and call prep that you sharpen with your own judgment.

 - Build and maintain at least 3x qualified pipeline across your accounts, and use AI summaries of Gong calls to see what converts and fix what does not.

 - Partner with Sales Architects and Deployment Strategists on demos and proofs of value, turning discovery notes into tailored value narratives with AI.

 - Keep an accurate weekly forecast, with CRM and pipeline hygiene automated through AI workflows you build and share with the team.

 - Bring first-hand customer and competitive insight to Product and Research so the roadmap reflects what US customers need.

What we’re looking for:

 - 6+ years of experience in global banking or financial services, ideally at one or more tier-1 institutions

 - A background in areas such as innovation, asset management, payments, or compliance, with a record of owning or influencing large, multi-stakeholder purchasing decisions. Product and compliance knowledge can be learned; your network and your ability to navigate the institution are what we need.

 - Daily use of AI in your selling workflow, with concrete examples of time or revenue gained.

 - Experience running complex, multi-threaded deals with executive buyers at large banks, using AI to prepare and follow up with precision.

 - Rigorous qualification and forecast discipline, including MEDDPICC, supported by AI-assisted pipeline hygiene.

 - Credible, clear communication with senior executives, in person and virtually.

 - Based in the United States, with willingness to travel for customer meetings.

About the Team:

 - You will join a team of quota-carrying Account Directors who each focus on one or two of TRM's largest accounts.

 - The team is fast-paced, positive, and collaborative, with shared pipeline insight and open sharing of what works and which AI plays are landing.

 - The work is hard in a useful way: senior buyers, long cycles, and large, multi-stakeholder deals.

 - You will work with Sales Architects, Deployment Strategists, Product, Research, and RevOps, who move quickly to support your deals.

Team Operating Rhythms:

 - Distributed, not distant: the team works across US time zones with a shared core overlap.

 - Slack is the center of day-to-day communication. @mention colleagues for timely responses.

 - Weekly 1:1 with your manager, plus a weekly pipeline and forecast review. HM to confirm cadence.

 - Company-wide all-hands and founder Q&A sessions keep everyone connected to the mission.

Required online and collaboration hours:

 - Schedule: Core overlap of 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM in your US time zone, Monday to Friday. HM to confirm.

Travel Requirements:

 - Schedule: Customer meetings, industry events, and team gatherings.

 - Frequency: Up to 25%. HM to confirm.

Onsite Requirements:

 - Schedule: Remote and distributed, with in-person customer meetings as part of travel..

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

 - Within your first 30 days, you map the business lines, sponsors, and buying committees in each of your Diamond accounts and have an AI-assisted account plan for each, so pipeline builds before onboarding ends.

 - When a customer asks for an urgent executive briefing late on a Thursday, you prepare with AI-generated account research and deliver a tailored briefing within 24 hours.
   
   - When an RFP lands with only a few days to respond, you rally Sales Architects and Deal Desk to deliver a high-quality response on time.


APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.




INTERVIEWING WITH TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

 - Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

 - Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

 - First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

 - Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

 - References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

 - Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

 - Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.




AI FLUENCY AT TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

 - Accelerate repeatable workflows

 - Structure and solve problems

 - Improve output quality

 - Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.




LIFE AT TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

 - Priorities and targets to change quickly

 - Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

 - A high level of personal ownership and accountability

 - Close collaboration across teams and functions

 - Frequent, high-touch communication

 - Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

 - A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute. 




LEADERSHIP PRINCIPLES

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

 - Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

 - Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

 - Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.





JOIN OUR MISSION

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

jobs.title: Senior Instrumentation & Controls Engineer
jobs.description:
AECOM is seeking a highly motivated Senior Instrumentation and Controls (I&C) Engineer to join our Mining Project Delivery team in support of mining projects.

Job Summary/Responsibilities

• Provides project leadership in the areas of instrumentation & controls, engineering and design, investigations, analysis on multi-disciplinary mining projects.
• Serve as lead I&C engineer or discipline lead on mid-size to large projects.
• Coordinate and direct staff on designs, specifications, drawings, figures, reports and calculations on multi-discipline design efforts.
• Work with existing and potential clients to provide instrumentation & controls, engineering and design solutions on mining projects.
• Develop project proposals and work with mining business leader to support and grow the Mining practice.
• Provide direction and mentoring to technical staff in completing project tasks.
• Write technical scopes of work, specifications, design/check P&ID's (including instrumenting P&ID's, and adding control and interlock notes), data sheets, architecture drawings, functional descriptions, instrument index, loop sheets, interconnection diagrams, instrument location plans, I/O lists and cable schedules.
• Provide specialized technical input to studies and design for staff's specific area of expertise.
• Provide technical expertise for studies and design efforts.
• Present complex technical solutions to clients.
• Perform independent technical reviews of engineering documentation and sign off on work performed.
• Equipment bid package development, analysis, purchase order management and vendor drawing review
• Serve as primary point of contact with the client and develop client relationships
• Plan, schedule, conduct or coordinate detailed phases of the engineering project, focusing on the I&C designs of mine projects.
• Provides advice and consultation to clients on engineering matters, including compliance with government laws and regulations.

Minimum Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering + 8 years of relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.
• Valid U.S. Driver’s License

Preferred Qualifications

• PE in Colorado, New Mexico, Utah, Arizona, or ability to acquire a PE in those states.
• On-site field experience in commissioning and start-ups for facilities
• 10+ years or more of relevant experience
• MSHA Miner training
• Demonstrated experience in I&C engineering, design, and construction tasks including: HAZOP participation Human factors reviews SIL verification Valve, flow element and relief valve sizing Control system architecture development Control system Input/Output and instrument list development Instrument and control element specifications and data sheets Control system (DCS) and programmable logic controller (PLC) specifications Control system (DCS) and PLC wiring diagrams, panel layouts and network diagrams Control narrative, logic diagram, functional control diagram development Comprehension of electrical equipment designs and wiring (switchgear, panelboards, MCCs, VFDs, etc.) Interpretation and input to Piping and Instrumentation Drawings (P&IDs)
• Progressive project experience including task leadership and project management roles on design and design-build projects
• Lead designs, calculations, sketches, diagrams, schematic drawings, I&C specifications, and final working drawings
• Work with CAD designers to produce construction-level drawings
• Strong written and oral communication, quantitative and people skills
• Strong work ethic and professional demeanor
• Initiative-taking on assignments
• Ability to work independently with minimal supervision, and complete multiple technical tasks under tight deadlines
• Ability to estimate and define scope for I&C deliverables and tasks on projects
• Perform work in accordance with agreed upon scope, budget, and schedule
• Track and manage task budgets, schedules and projects.
• Author reports and prepare/or direct preparation of detailed calculation packages including proper documentation and references.

jobs.title: Director, Medical Quality
jobs.description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most by challenging norms and fixing the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7/365, and created an ER experience that focuses on what our pets and pet parents really need. We’ve done the same for our people (VEGgies), finding a way to say YES so they are empowered to achieve great things, grow in unexpected ways, and find a place where they truly belong.

We’re rethinking emergency care from every angle—from how we run our hospitals to how we support the people working inside them. That’s where our headquarters team comes in. Whether building technology to make our hospitals more efficient, recruiting and growing incredible VEGgies, or bringing our brand to life through marketing, our VQ (VEG Headquarters) team makes it all possible—ensuring our hospitals and people have everything they need to help pets and their families.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

THE JOB

The VEG Medical Quality mission is “Making it easy to deliver clinically excellent care the VEG way.” You will support that mission by collaborating with our medical leaders, medical educators, and frontline VEGgies, focusing on impactful medical quality solutions that are practical, frontline-focused, and enhance best practice medicine.

You will work 1-2 shifts per month in the hospital so you can stay connected to frontline needs and experience firsthand the impact of medical quality initiatives. Frontline VEGgies will see you as both an extension of VQ and as one of the team when you’re in the hospital. You will solicit and integrate feedback on how quality and patient safety improvements can make it easier for them to deliver clinically excellent care, particularly related to clinical resources and our electronic health record and treatment sheets. Frontline leaders and employees will look to you as an expert and partner for piloting and successfully implementing clinical and quality initiatives.

The world views VEG as a leader in veterinary emergency medical quality and knows our medical teams practice excellent medicine.  As a quality leader you help frontline teams understand that quality is a journey, not a destination. You help them continually develop their skills and knowledge as they strive to do it better every day!

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Create and manage medical quality projects from proposal to pilot implementation, data/feedback collection, and continuous improvement

• Ensure ongoing improvement and innovation of care delivery processes and systems

• Develop and implement pilots and clinical studies in collaboration with the medical field leadership and local medical leaders

• Work with field leaders (regional, market, and local) on skill building and engagement in medical quality and patient safety programs

• Provide assistance to medical leadership teams for patient safety events and case reviews, partnering with them to create solutions

• Identify frontline education and training opportunities, focusing on areas with practical and wide-spread impact

• Obtain frontline feedback about content, training, and medical quality needs

• Provide consistent feedback on frontline training and resource needs to Medical Education and Medical Operations teams

• Create and disseminate new and updated VEG Medical Quality content including clinical guidelines and one pagers with a focus on practical resources with a widespread impact

• Identify and create patient safety features such as default treatment instructions and safety alerts in the VEG electronic health record

• Remain up to date with current research and plan research projects

• Represent VEG at conferences and industry events, with particular emphasis on quality and patient safety

WHAT YOU NEED

• DVM, VMD, or equivalent

• DACVECC (or board-eligible) or equivalent preferred

• 5+ years of experience in emergency medicine

• 3+ years in academic emergency/specialty environment preferred

• 3+ years experience training, mentoring, and developing veterinary students, interns, and/or residents

• Multiple historical publications or equivalent experience that reflect skilled medical authorship required

• Experience lecturing at universities and/or conferences required

• State licensure that is in good standing OR eligibility for such licensure in at least 3 states with a VEG hospital

• Medical leadership experience preferred

• Project management experience preferred

• A commitment to mentorship and elevating the next generation of vets

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills

• Skilled at stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration

• Clear and direct written and verbal communication to inspire, motivate, guide, and influence local leaders

• Strong critical-thinking and creative problem-solving abilities, as this role is strategic in nature

• Strong financial and data literacy skills

• Genuine desire to improve one’s own skills and knowledge at all times and eager to both be a teacher and to learn from others

• Sets aside time to study up to date veterinary medical trends to ensure VEG hospitals maintain medical excellence

• Must be able travel up to 15%-25% of the time to various VEG hospitals when needed, occasionally including weekends and holidays. Additional travel to VQ on an as-needed basis for medical leadership meetings and project work.

WHO YOU ARE

• Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives

• Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s’ accomplishments

• Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results

• Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

• Competitive Compensation Including $180,000-$200,000 salary + bonus + benefits + equity.

• Comprehensive health and wellness benefits that start on day one, and access to free therapy or counseling

• Paid parental leave, up to 12 weeks at 100% of regular salary, and offering inclusive fertility and family-building care for all types of families

• Unlimited PTO to use for vacation or sick days—however you need it!

• Generous employee referral program, so our awesome people can bring in more awesome people.

• And the little (big) things, like casual office attire, ability to bring your fur baby to work, cool VEG swag, food in the fridge for when you’re hungry and free lunches twice a week!!

• Company laptop and a monthly cell phone reimbursement

BETTER TOGETHER: WHY IN-PERSON MATTERS AT VEG HQ

Our hospitals thrive on in-person collaboration, and VQ is no different. Time in the office sparks stronger connections, meaningful conversations, and better results—all bringing our core values to life. We prioritize being present because our values are best achieved side by side. Plus, we make getting here easy with free parking and a shuttle from the White Plains Metro-North station.

DEI

At VEG, diversity is not just a word—it's a strength that fuels innovation and kindness. Our mission is “Helping people and their pets when they need it most.” And we do that better when our VEGgies (employees) feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. That's why we're devoted to creating an environment that reflects the diverse communities we serve—where different perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated.

We are focused on providing equitable opportunities for growth, promoting inclusive decision-making, and ensuring that everyone's perspective is considered. Saying yes to VEG means helping us build a culture where your unique experiences and background contribute to a shared vision: being the world’s veterinary emergency company.

jobs.title: Drafter, Counter Intrusion
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

From detection to tracking, identification, deterrence, and defeat, our family of networked sensors and effectors enables our customers to rapidly detect and identify potential threats. close the kill chain against a broad range of Unmanned Aerial System (UAS) threats.

ABOUT THE JOB

The Sentry Engineering team builds hardware products and systems that leverage artificial intelligence to provide highly accurate, persistent autonomous awareness across land, sea and air. With an AI-enabled edge processing and a variety of radars and sensors with continuous 360 pan / tilt capability, Sentry can autonomously identify, detect, and track objects of interest to bring increased awareness to borders, military bases, oil and gas pipelines, airports and other critical infrastructure.

We are looking for a Drafter to join our rapidly growing team in Irvine, CA. This role will support rapidly developed, ruggedized product introduction in addition to providing critical support; scaling legacy design concepts to full-rate production. You will assist a team of approximately 20 Mechanical Engineers to define consistent drawing standards, take lead on drawing package creation, and work with sustainment and quality engineering to improve the quality and clarity of legacy drawings, CAD files, and other relevant documentation. The ideal candidate will work closely with the three Sentry Mechanical Engineering leads to define drawing standards, educate junior engineers, and ultimately increase the quality of engineering documentation across the team.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Own the quality of drawings and CAD files across the Sentry Mechanical Engineering team.

• Coordinate across Anduril internal departments to ensure CAD designs and released documentation meet both internal and government standards

• Mentor junior engineers on drawing and CAD process to ensure they meet the engineering standards and best practices.

• Work closely with Sustainment, Manufacturing Engineering, and Configuration Management to release and update both legacy and new product design files.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 3D CAD proficiency (any platform) and ability to understand and apply GD&T to create high quality engineering drawings.

• 5+ years of computer aided design experience in a professional setting for either defense or consumer product designs.

• Associates Degree in Computer Design, CAD, Graphics, or a related field.

• Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Extensive experience in NX/Teamcenter.

• Bachelors Degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field.

• Experience with manufacturing configuration management and revision control in complex production assemblies.

• Experience developing ruggedized electromechanical assemblies from concept to low-rate production for automotive, space, or military applications.

• Experience with production processes, including machining, sheet metal, injection molding, welding, wire harnessing and 3D printing to inform design for manufacturability.

US Salary Range

$132,000—$175,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

Location: Remote

About FamilyWell

FamilyWell's mission is to transform women's mental health across the reproductive journey, from fertility through menopause. We embed evidence-based, insurance-covered mental health care directly into women's health practices, making mental health support available where patients already receive care.

By integrating a virtual team of care managers, coaches, therapists, and psychiatric providers into clinical workflows, FamilyWell is expanding access to mental health support, improving outcomes for women and families, and reducing the administrative burden for our provider partners.

About the Role

FamilyWell is seeking a detail-oriented, organized, and proactive Practice Administrator to support the day-to-day administrative operations of our growing mental health care program.

In this role, you will help ensure that patient referrals, medical records, insurance information, and clinical documentation are processed accurately and efficiently. You'll work closely with our clinical, operations, and billing teams to support seamless coordination of care and maintain strong relationships with our partnering healthcare practices.

This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys creating order and efficiency, and takes pride in ensuring that important details are handled accurately and on time.

What You'll Do

Patient Referrals & Registration

• Process incoming patient referrals and ensure timely, accurate entry into patient management systems.

• Collect, verify, and maintain patient demographic, insurance, and referral information.

• Support patient registration and onboarding processes.

• Identify and resolve missing or incomplete information to help patients access care without unnecessary delays.

• Coordinate with internal teams and partner practices to address referral-related questions or issues.

Medical Records & Documentation

• Maintain accurate, complete, and up-to-date patient records across electronic health record (EHR) and practice management systems.

• Support the timely exchange of clinical documentation with referring providers and partner practices.

• Update patient information, appointment records, and other relevant documentation as needed.

• Identify and resolve discrepancies in patient records to ensure data accuracy and consistency.

• Ensure all documentation is handled in accordance with HIPAA and organizational policies.

Insurance & Billing Support

• Verify patient insurance eligibility and benefits to support timely access to care.

• Identify insurance coverage issues and coordinate with the appropriate team members to resolve them.

• Assist with routine billing-related administrative tasks, including processing applicable patient charges.

• Collaborate with billing and operations teams to address administrative issues that may affect reimbursement or the patient experience.

Practice Operations & Administrative Support

• Provide day-to-day administrative support to clinical and operations teams.

• Monitor and manage administrative workflows to ensure tasks are completed accurately and on time.

• Communicate with internal team members and external partners to facilitate smooth operations.

• Identify opportunities to streamline processes, improve efficiency, and reduce administrative burden.

• Assist with reporting, data management, and other operational projects as needed.

What You Bring

Required Qualifications

• At least 2 years of experience in healthcare administration, with a focus on insurance eligibility and benefits verification, revenue cycle management (RCM), or related medical practice operations.

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.

• Excellent organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.

• Comfort working with electronic health records, practice management systems, and other digital tools.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a remote, fast-paced environment.

• Understanding of patient confidentiality and HIPAA requirements.

• A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset and willingness to learn new processes and systems.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in behavioral health, women's health, or a related healthcare setting.

• Familiarity with insurance eligibility verification and medical billing processes.

• Experience working with multiple EHR or practice management platforms.

• Proficiency with spreadsheets, data entry, and basic reporting.

• Patient referrals and registration information are processed accurately and promptly.

• Medical records and clinical documentation are complete, organized, and up to date.

• Insurance and administrative issues are identified and resolved proactively.

• Clinical teams and partner practices receive timely, reliable administrative support.

Why Join FamilyWell?

At FamilyWell, we believe every woman deserves access to high-quality mental health care, regardless of where she is in her reproductive journey.

Your work behind the scenes will help ensure that patients receive timely support, clinicians can focus on delivering excellent care, and our partner practices have a seamless experience working with FamilyWell.

You'll join a mission-driven, collaborative, and growing team committed to improving women's mental health and transforming the healthcare experience.

Scale Value

• Codify Best Practices: Turn our solutions into scalable SaaS assets, reusable AI models, and use cases for the broader Value Engineering team.

• Mentor & Enable: Act as a senior resource for the team, helping junior engineers understand CPG terminology, seasonality nuances, and how to position AI capabilities to retail stakeholders.

• Product Feedback: Serve as a bridge between the customer and our Product teams, providing specific feedback on how to enhance our platform's machine learning and generative AI features for the CPG vertical (e.g., specific requirements for Trade Spend visibility or SKU Rationalization).

• Manage the Journey: Responsible for the end-to-end customer value journey: landing, expanding, driving adoption, and renewing—ultimately securing high Net Retention Rates (NRR).

• Build Roadmaps: Build a strategic expansion roadmap for customers embedding the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform as a scalable, cloud-native transformation engine in their organization.

• Drive Innovation: Provide feedback to our product development teams to enhance the Celonis platform and Apps based on new AI-driven use cases and SaaS market demands.

The qualifications you need:

• Deep Industry Experience: 8+ years of relevant experience in Supply Chain or Operations, ideally combining time at a CPG/FMCG company with Management Consulting, Sales Engineering, or driving digital/AI transformations.

• Domain Expertise: You possess granular knowledge of the CPG value chain, specifically in areas such as Demand & Supply Planning, Logistics, Trade Promotions, or Consumer/Retail Operations.

• Growth Mindset: Proven track record of managing the full customer lifecycle, with a demonstrated ability to land new accounts, expand footprint through strategic upselling, and drive long-term value to ensure high NRR, organic advocacy, and sustained SaaS growth.

• Value Realization Skills: You have a track record of identifying operational inefficiencies and driving them to resolution. You understand how to impact the P&L through process improvement, AI integration, and scalable technology deployment.

• Technical Fluency: Good knowledge of Business Software/SaaS applications (e.g., SAP S/4HANA, Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud, SAP IBP), and experience with data visualization, SQL, Python, or deploying LLMs/AI models is a strong plus.

• Stakeholder Management: Experience presenting to and working with senior stakeholders. You can navigate complex internal structures and clearly communicate SaaS value and complex AI concepts to non-technical audiences.

• Builder Mentality: You are comfortable working with ambiguity, adapting to a rapidly evolving AI landscape, and setting your own direction within an account team to achieve the best results.

jobs.title: Construction Laborer
jobs.description:
At RES, we’re looking for purpose-driven individuals who are passionate about restoration and sustainability, and who want their work to make a lasting environmental impact. Our team members go above and beyond, bringing initiative, integrity, and a strong work ethic to every project. Collaboration is key—we thrive on teamwork, open communication, and diverse perspectives. In a field that constantly changes, we value those who are resilient, adaptable, and resourceful in the face of challenges. If you're intellectually curious, eager to learn, and ready to help restore ecosystems and protect natural resources, you’ll find your place here.

We’re seeking a motivated and dependable Laborer to join our hardworking team! If you enjoy working outdoors, thrive in a hands-on role, and take pride in delivering high-quality results, this is the job for you. As a Construction Laborer, you’ll be an integral part of our projects, helping with a variety of tasks including site preparation, landscaping, and general labor, on active restoration sites across your region. That may include wetlands, streambanks, prairies, or stormwater facilities. You’ll work alongside a skilled crew, contributing to projects that make a tangible impact. If you're ready to roll up your sleeves, work in a collaborative environment, and enjoy the satisfaction of seeing your work come to life, we want you on our team!

The ability to travel weekly Monday-Friday with overnight stay-- Per Diem and hotel stay provided-- Certain projects will require working weekends.

Why You’ll Love This Job

• You’ll work hands-on in nature, helping bring real landscapes back to life

• You’ll learn practical skills in planting, seeding, erosion control, and invasive species removal

• You’ll gain experience using tools and equipment in the field

• You’ll work on a tight-knit crew that values safety, teamwork, and hard work

• You’ll be part of a growing company with a mission to restore the Earth

A Day in the Life

No two days are exactly the same, but here's a glimpse into what your day-to-day might look like:

Morning Kickoff

• Start your day by reviewing detailed work specifications and plans for the day’s tasks.

• Conduct safety checks on all tools and equipment, ensuring proper functionality and readiness.

Tool Operation

• Operate a variety of tools, including power tools like drills and circular saws, as well as landscape equipment like chainsaws and weed eaters, to perform critical tasks on-site.

Hands-On Erosion Control

• Work hands-on to implement erosion and sediment control measures, following detailed specifications to ensure compliance with environmental regulations. Seeding, mulching and matting

• Assist in setting up and maintaining traffic control systems to ensure safety around the work area

• Set-Up and maintenance of bypass water pumping & work area dewatering

End-of-Day Wrap-Up

• Clean and store tools and equipment, ensuring everything is ready for the next day.

• Review completed tasks with your supervisor to confirm everything meets the required standards and specifications.

Every day brings new challenges, making it a rewarding position for someone who enjoys hands-on work and making a direct impact on the environment.

Physical Requirements

• Ability to lift up to 50 lbs regularly.

• Capable of walking over uneven surfaces, climbing on construction equipment, and navigating hills.

• Comfortable working outdoors and performing tasks at ground level.

We would like to talk to you if you have many of the following:

• Ability to operate and maintain various tools and equipment.

• Quick learner with the ability to take on new tasks effectively.

• Good communication skills and ability to work well within a team.

• Ability to interpret and follow detailed work specifications.

• Familiarity with basic hand tools or landscape equipment

• A valid driver’s license and reliable transportation to travel to job sites

What would make you stand out?

• High school diploma or GED.

• Prior experience in landscaping, construction, farming, or outdoor labor

• Understanding of erosion and sediment control guidelines

• Basic Knowledge of traffic control procedures

Please note that the “Day in the Life” section is not intended to be an exhaustive list of job duties, but rather a representative snapshot of typical responsibilities and work experiences at RES.

RES is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a VEVRAA Federal Contractor. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Administrative Assistant

jobs.description:

The position will handle a wide range of administrative and executive support-related tasks, including but not limited to calendar management, meeting preparation, travel arrangements and coordination, organizing and submitting expenses, and project management. The Administrative Assistant will operate with the utmost discretion while working with highly confidential information, ensuring impeccable attention to detail, organizational skills, and thoroughness. • Anticipate all needs of the executives by thinking and working proactively with a one-step-ahead mentality throughout the day in terms of meeting prep, arising issues and new developments.

• Serve as liaison between the SVPs and key stakeholders.

• Assist in regularly creating and editing memos and PowerPoint presentations to be presented by the executives.

• Coordinate travel arrangements; prepare detailed travel itineraries inclusive of flights, hotels, meeting agendas, etc.

• Screen phone calls and forward calls appropriately, communicating with external and internal partners in a professional manner.

• Oversee personal and departmental expenses. Prepare, reconcile and submit all necessary invoices and credit card expenses in Concur in a timely and accurate manner.

• Handle confidential information meticulously; escalate any required information with discretion.

• Operate with sound judgement and efficiency.

• Significant experience working in Microsoft Outlook, Excel, Word and PowerPoint required.

• Strong technology skills including ability to work within PC and Mac programs, iPad, iPhone, and Google products. The ability to type fast and efficiently is a plus.

• Expert level written and verbal communication skills.

• Experience managing highly sensitive information with discretion and professionalism.

• Strong ability to work well under pressure in a fast-paced environment with a positive attitude.

• Highly organized; a strategic planner who is able to create, implement and improve organizational systems, both digital and physical files.

• Able to work independently and with little supervision.

• Demonstrated project management skills.

• Demonstrated comfort interacting with high level executives and high-profile individuals.

• Ability to work proactively with a solution-oriented mindset and a can-do attitude; always thinking one-step-ahead, while staying calm and confident.

• Impeccable attention to detail and solutions oriented.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and project/program management skills.

• Exercise a high degree of professionalism and diplomacy in interactions with all levels of the organization.

• Excellent follow through skills and the ability to anticipate and address business needs proactively.

• Exemplary time management skills.

• Highly adaptable to a fluid, ever-changing work environment.

• Demonstrate curiosity, resourcefulness, resilience and a commitment to process improvement.

Physical Demands

• Occasional light lifting and standing

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

• NFL employees are required to work 40 hours per week in office.

Salary / Pay Range

The NFL expects to hire for this position near the middle of the range. Handshake was founded on a simple belief that everyone deserves a path to a great career, regardless of where they went to school or who they know. Today, we power 25 million job seekers, 1 million+ employers, and 1,600 educational institutions.

Human data is the core infrastructure to AI advancement. Frontier AI labs currently improve model capabilities with various data-intensive post-training techniques.  - Design and adapt staffing models, incentives, and workflows to improve throughput, margins, and delivery reliability under changing requirements

 - Partner directly with frontier AI labs and senior stakeholders to shape scope, resolve issues, and expand programs through execution




YOU HAVE

 - High ownership mindset with pride in end-to-end accountability

jobs.title: Application Security Engineer
jobs.description:
How You’ll Make An Impact

At Strive Health, patients come first. We’re on a mission to transform chronic conditions by identifying risk earlier, coordinating thoughtful care, and supporting people through every stage of their health journey.

Our work reduces emergency visits, improves outcomes, and helps patients live fuller lives. You’ll work alongside passionate Strivers who care deeply about making an impact, show up for one another as One Team, and find ways to elevate the everyday.

If you’re looking for meaningful work where your contributions truly matter, you’ll feel right at home at Strive!

Benefits & Perks

• Hybrid-Remote Flexibility – Work from home while fulfilling in-person needs at the office, clinic, or patient home visits.

• Comprehensive Benefits – Medical, dental, and vision insurance, employee assistance programs, employer-paid and voluntary life and disability insurance, plus health and flexible spending accounts.

• Financial & Retirement Support – Competitive compensation with a performance-based bonus program, 401k with employer match, and financial wellness resources.

• Time Off & Leave – Paid holidays, vacation time, sick time, and paid birthgiving, bonding, sabbatical, and living donor leaves.

• Wellness & Growth – Family forming services through Maven Maternity at no cost and physical wellness perks, mental health support, and an annual professional development stipend.

To learn more about our offerings, click here.

What You’ll Do

The Application Security Engineer is responsible for embedding application security directly into Strive’s product development lifecycle, specifically supporting the deployment of Canvas Medical, patient-facing experiences, and future mobile applications. You will serve as the primary security partner for Product and Engineering, ensuring that applications are built securely from the design phase through to production. Rather than treating security as a late-stage penetration test, you will establish the requirements, review gates, testing frameworks, and remediation operating rhythms necessary to support a secure and compliant development pipeline.

The Day to Day

Security Discovery and Threat Modeling:

• Perform threat modeling and establish a security baseline for internal environments, patient portals, mobile applications, and integration services.

• Maintain data-flow and trust-boundary diagrams, assessing identity, operational, and PHI data classifications.

Architecture & Secure Product Development:

• Collaborate with engineering teams to embed security acceptance criteria into PRDs, technical plans, and Jira stories.

• Conduct architecture reviews focusing on tenant boundaries, server-side authorization, prevention of IDOR (insecure direct object references), and lateral movement guardrails.

• Develop and enforce merge request (MR) checklists covering authentication, input validation, secrets management, and cryptography.

Application Security Testing Framework:

• Design, deploy, and operate application security testing tools including SAST, DAST, Software Composition Analysis (SCA), and container/IaC scanning.

• Perform authenticated testing of browser workflows and APIs (e.g., using Burp Suite Enterprise).

• Conduct manual testing for complex vulnerabilities such as privilege escalation, SSRF, and business-logic abuse.

Vulnerability Management & Remediation:

• Manage the vulnerability intake pipeline, assign severities, and track remediation aligned with internal SLAs.

• Lead recurring vulnerability review sessions with Security, Product, and Engineering stakeholders.

• Coordinate external penetration tests, including scoping, vendor selection, and tracking of remediation/retesting.

Compliance & Audit Readiness:

• Ensure all security requirements, threat models, testing evidence, and remediation documentation align with internal compliance needs (e.g., HITRUST, SOC 2).

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field.

• 3+ years (Engineer) to 5+ years (Senior) of experience in information security, with a strong focus on Application Security, DevSecOps, or software engineering.

• Demonstrable experience integrating security tools into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., SAST, DAST, SCA).

• Experience leading or performing application threat modeling, architecture reviews, and manual security testing.

• Familiarity with securing cloud environments (SaaS, IaaS, PaaS) and understanding of cloud architecture.

• Internet Connectivity - Min Speeds: 3.8Mbps/3.0Mbps (up/down): Latency <60 ms.

• Ability to travel and be onsite to meet business needs.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience within the healthcare sector, securing environments that manage PHI and complying with frameworks like HITRUST.

• Deep expertise in identifying and exploiting vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, IDOR, SSRF, authentication bypass).

• Experience with testing and securing complex API integrations, mobile application releases, and web-based portals.

• Familiarity with enterprise dynamic testing tools (e.g., Burp Suite Enterprise) and automating security testing against deployed applications.

• Advanced certifications in application security or information security (e.g., CSSLP, GWAPT, CISSP, CEH).

About You

• Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, able to assess complex application security issues and provide practical, developer-friendly solutions.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills; capable of articulating technical risk to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Proactive and adaptable, comfortable embedding directly with engineering pods to shift security “left”.

Annual Salary Range: $108,500 - $136,000. This position is also eligible for a target annual bonus of 10%

Final compensation will be determined based on location, experience, and qualifications.

Please apply even if you feel you do not meet all qualifications. If you require reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to talentacquisition@strivehealth.com.

We do not accept unsolicited resumes from outside recruiters/placement agencies. Strive Health will not pay fees associated with resumes presented through unsolicited means.

Qualifications

• Sharp product instincts: asks the right questions, gets to root causes, lays out trade-offs clearly, and pushes back when needed

• Excellent communication skills

• Sound judgment around responsible AI use, confidentiality and operational risk; comfortable working with security and compliance partners

• Thrives with high autonomy in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment; comfortable owning outcomes and making or coordinating difficult trade-offs

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience building AI fluency or enablement programs for technical teams

• Experience shipping tools or products for technical audiences, internal or external

• Admin or power-user experience with one or more enterprise AI platforms

• Familiarity with usage-based and token-based pricing models

Benefits

Tower’s headquarters are in the historic Equitable Building, right in the heart of NYC’s Financial District and our impact is global, with over a dozen offices around the world.

At Tower, we believe work should be both challenging and enjoyable. That is why we foster a culture where smart, driven people thrive – without the egos. jobs.title: Robotics Research Intern, Manipulation
jobs.description:
At Toyota Research Institute (TRI), we’re on a mission to improve the quality of human life. We’re developing new tools and capabilities to amplify the human experience. To lead this transformative shift in mobility, we’ve built a world-class team advancing the state of the art in AI, robotics, driving, and material sciences.
This is a paid 12-week internship opportunity and is a hybrid, in-office role.
Here’s a glimpse into the Internship experience from some of our TRI interns!


The Team/Project
TRI's Robotics Division develops technologies that enable robots to operate effectively in complex, real-world environments. The project explores how foundation-model agents can understand manipulation tasks, reason about physical environments, and orchestrate reusable robotic capabilities to accomplish diverse objectives. Our research combines vision-language models, robotic perception, motion planning, manipulation, and robot learning. We investigate these questions through hands-on experimentation on physical robotic platforms.
The Challenge
Recent advances in foundation models have significantly improved AI systems' ability to understand visual scenes, reason about tasks, and plan sequences of actions. However, translating these capabilities into reliable physical robot behavior remains challenging. Robots must reason about three-dimensional geometry, physical constraints, contact interactions, and failures during execution.
An important research question is how far foundation-model agents can go by leveraging existing robotic capabilities, and when specialized learned policies become necessary.
The Opportunity
We are seeking a Robotics Research Intern to investigate agentic approaches to robotic manipulation. You will work closely with researchers and engineers to develop systems that connect foundation-model reasoning with physical robot capabilities.
Depending on your background and research interests, your project may focus on spatial reasoning, robotic skill orchestration, execution monitoring, failure recovery, or systematic evaluation of agentic manipulation systems.
This internship offers an opportunity to tackle open research questions while gaining practical experience with cutting-edge AI models and real robotic systems. Your work will contribute to understanding how foundation-model agents can enable more generalizable and reliable robot autonomy.

*** COMING SUMMER 2027***

ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

THE JOB

As an Emergency Credentialed Veterinary Technician, you’re part of a team that thrives on the front lines of emergency veterinary care where every second counts. You’ll handle a wide range of cases, from minor to complex emergencies, collaborating with our doctors and team in delivering gold standard, emotionally intelligent care. You’ll jump into triage, treatments, diagnostics, anesthesia, monitoring, and critical care nursing, all while being a steady, compassionate presence for pet parents in their most stressful moments. This role is for someone who wants to do the work they were trained to do (and more), continue growing their skills, and help people and their pets when they need it most.

WHAT YOU’LL DO
